text: Sang Agusto, matandaan nga nagpalupad ang China sang missiles sa kadagatan nga sakop pa sang economic zone sang Japan bilang kabahin sang major military exercises sang Beijing sa palibot sang Taiwan, ang self-governing democracy nga ginakabig sang China nga kabahin sang ila nga teritoryo.
english: In August, China fired missiles into the waters of Japan's economic zone as part of Beijing's major military exercises around Taiwan, the self-governing democracy that China considers part of its territory.

text: Aktibo man ang nuclear kag missile activities ni North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.
english: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un's nuclear and missile activities are also active.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, matandaan nga halos kada bulan ang pagpatigayon sang Pyongyang sang sanctions-busting weapons tests lakip na ang pagpalupad sang ila most advanced intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM).
english: Last year, Pyongyang conducted sanctions-busting weapons tests almost every month, including the launch of its most advanced intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM).

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Japan nga doblehon sini ang budget para sa defense sa masunod nga lima ka tuig.
english: Japan has previously said it will double its defense budget over the next five years.

text: Ginakabig ini nga isa ka daku nga pagbag-o sa Japan bangud halin sang nalutos sa World War II, ginakilala nga pacifist ang amo nga pungsod ukon nagapamatok sa giyera, militarism, kag violence.
english: This is considered a major change in Japan because since its defeat in World War II, the country has been known to be pacifist or opposed to war, militarism, and violence.

text: Maga-develop man ang Japan sang “counterstrike” capacity agud nga mabatuan ang pagpamahog sang launch sites kag magabakal man ini sang ginatos nga Tomahawk cruise missiles nga yara lamang subong makit-an sa arsenals sang Estados Unidos kag Britanya.
english: Japan will also develop a counterstrike capability to counter the threat of launch sites and will also purchase hundreds of Tomahawk cruise missiles that are currently only found in the arsenals of the United States and Britain.

text: Nag-istorya naman si Kishida sa prime ministers sang United Kingdom kag Italya agud mas mapalapit sa three-way development sang next-generation fighter-jet nga magagamit sang artificial intelligence.
english: Kishida also held talks with the prime ministers of the United Kingdom and Italy to move closer to the three-way development of a next-generation fighter-jet that will use artificial intelligence.

text: Aga pa nga nagboto si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: Early in the morning, President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. voted.

text: sa Mariano Marcos Memorial Elementary School sa Batac, Ilocos Norte.
english: at Mariano Marcos Memorial Elementary School in Batac, Ilocos Norte.

text: Kaupod sang punong ehekutibo ang iya iloy nga si former First Lady Imelda Marcos, utod nga si Irene Marcos, kag anak nga si Ilocos Norte Rep.
english: The chief executive was accompanied by his mother, former First Lady Imelda Marcos, sister Irene Marcos, and son Ilocos Norte Rep.

text: Sandro Marcos.
english: Sandro Marcos.

text: 95-anyos na ang former first lady kag nakasakay ini sa iya wheelchair sang nag-abot sa eskwelahan.
english: The 95-year-old former first lady arrived at the school in her wheelchair.

text: Antes ang adlaw sang eleksyon, nagpangabay si President Marcos sa mga pumuluyo nga gamiton gid ang ila kinamatarong sa pagboto kag magpili sang mga kandidato nga makaserbe gid sa pungsod.
english: Ahead of election day, President Marcos urged the people to exercise their right to vote and choose candidates who can serve the country.

text: “Ngayong halalan, gamitin natin ang ating karapatan at gampanan ang ating pananagutan bilang mamamayang Pilipino.
english: “This election, let us exercise our rights and fulfill our responsibilities as Filipino citizens.

text: Isang pagkakataon ito para marinig ang boses ng bawat isa at maipahayag ang mga pangarap na mahalaga sa inyo at sa bayan,” kabahin sang pahanumdom sini sa video message.
english: This is an opportunity for everyone's voice to be heard and to express the dreams that are important to you and the country,” he reminded in a video message.

text: “Kaya bumoto po tayo.
english: “So let’s vote.

text: Piliin ang tapat, may malasakit, at may kakayahang magsilbi,” dugang sini.#
english: Choose the one who is honest, caring, and capable of serving,” it added.#

text: ILOILO – All set na ang mga candidates sang Mr. and Ms. Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Region 6.
english: ILOILO CITY – The candidates for Mr. and Ms. Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Region 6.

text: Sa Iloilo, ang mga tiglawas amo sanday Fire Officer 1 Joezal Balico sang Office of the Provicial Fire Marshall kag Fire Officer 1 Mariel Jinon sang Leganes Fire Station.
english: In Iloilo, the representatives are Fire Officer 1 Joezal Balico of the Office of the Provicial Fire Marshall and Fire Officer 1 Mariel Jinon of the Leganes Fire Station.

text: Ang nasambit nga pageant ang kabahin sang selebrasyon sang Fire Prevention Month subong nga Marso.
english: The pageant is part of the celebration of Fire Prevention Month this March.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Balico nga tumandok sang Barotac Viejo, iya ginpahayag nga tuig 2021 sang nagsulod siya sa BFP.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Balico, a native of Barotac Viejo, said he joined the BFP in 2021.

text: Apang antes nagsulod sa BFP, anom ini ka tuig nga nagtrabaho bilang seafarer sa diin nagtapos ini sang kurso nga BS Marine Engineering sa John B.Lacson Foundation Maritime University.
english: However, before joining the BFP, he worked as a seafarer for six years where he completed a BS Marine Engineering course at the John B. Lacson Foundation Maritime University.

text: Sa subong, apat ka tuig na serbisyo si Balico.
english: Balico has now been in service for four years.

text: Samtang nagtapos naman si Jinon sa kurso nga Bachelor of Science in Criminology sa PHINMA University of Iloilo.
english: Meanwhile, Jinon graduated with a Bachelor of Science in Criminology from PHINMA University of Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jinon, sang Leganes Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga ang nagtulod sa iya nga magsulod sa BFP amo ang nakita sini nga pagserbisyo sang mga bombero sa ila komunidad sa tion nga may sunog.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jinon, of Leganes, Iloilo, said he was inspired to join the BFP because he saw the service of firefighters in their community during fires.

text: Sa subong, lima ka tuig na ini sa serbisyo.
english: So far, it has been in service for five years.

text: Suno kay Jinon, kaangay ni Balico, first time nila nga magpasakop sa pageant kag positibo nga makuha ang titulo.
english: According to Jinon, like Balico, it was their first time to participate in the pageant and positively won the title.

text: Patigayunon ang pageant sa Abril 2 sa Robinson’s Pavia.
english: The pageant will be held on April 2 at Robinson’s Pavia.

text: Patay ang 11 ka mga tawo matapos ang shooting incident nga natabo sa Bondi Beach, Australia sa ginpatigayon nga Hanukkah event, kahapon nga adlaw sang Domingo, Disyembre 14.
english: Eleven people were killed after a shooting incident that occurred in Bondi Beach, Australia during the Hanukkah event, yesterday, Sunday, December 14.

text: Suno sa mga una nga report, ginapatihan nga target sang amo nga shooting incident ang Jewish community, madamo man nga mga sibilyan ang nasamaran, lakip na ang pila ka kabataan, nga ginbulong sa nagkalain-lain nga ospital sa lugar.
english: According to initial reports, the Jewish community was believed to be the target of the shooting incident, many civilians were also injured, including several children, who were treated at various hospitals in the area.

text: Subong yara na sa idalom sang kustodiya sang mga kapulisan ang mga suspek, kag ang isa sa ila yara sa kritikal nga kahimtangan matapos maigo sang bala sa engkwentro sang kapulisan kag sang mga ini.
english: The suspects are now under police custody, and one of them is in critical condition after being hit by a bullet in the encounter between the police and them.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang otoridad agud matumod ang motibo sang krimen kag kun may iban pa nga persona sa insidente.
english: Authorities are still investigating the motive of the crime and whether there were other persons involved in the incident.

text: Suno sa mga awtoridad ang nagluntad nga shooting incident amo ang pinakaulihi nga mass shooting nga narecord sa Australia sa sulod sang 29 ka tuig.
english: Authorities said the shooting incident was the latest mass shooting recorded in Australia in 29 years.

text: Ginakondena naman sang gobyerno sang Australia ang nasambit nga insidente kag gin-athag nga pabaskugon pa gid ang mga security measures.
english: The Australian government condemned the incident and made it clear that security measures will be strengthened.

text: Isa ka maayo nga paagi sa pag-develop sa aton ihibalo amo ang pagbasa adlaw-adlaw.
english: A good way to develop our knowledge is to read daily.

text: Ikaw, pila ka oras ang imo ginapain para nga makabukad ikaw sang libro ukon makapangita sang maayo nga content nga imo mabasa online?
english: How much time do you set aside to open a book or find good content to read online?

text: Sa Nigeria, isa ka lalaki ang ginakilala subong nga amo ang naga-uyat sang pinakamalawig nga marathon sa bug-os nga kalibutan kun pagbasa sang matunog ang pagahambalan.
english: In Nigeria, a man is now recognized as holding the world’s longest marathon when it comes to reading aloud.

text: Ini amo si Samson Ajao, 27, residente sang Osogbo sa amo nga pungsod sa Africa nga nakabasa sa sulod sang 215 oras ukon isa ka oras na lang antes eksakto magtupa sa siyam ka adlaw!
english: This is Samson Ajao, 27, a resident of Osogbo in that African country who read for 215 hours or just one hour before exactly nine days!

text: Naguba sini ang anay record nga 124 ka oras nga gin-set sang 2022 ni Rysbai Isakov sang Kyrgyzstan.
english: This broke the previous record of 124 hours set in 2022 by Rysbai Isakov of Kyrgyzstan.

text: Sa sini nga challenge, dapat nga sige-sige ang pagbasa sa libro kag wala dapat sang masobra sa 30 segundos nga pag-untat sa kada item nga ginabasa.
english: In this challenge, the book should be read continuously and there should be no more than 30 seconds of pause between each item read.

text: Kabug-usan nga 100 ka libro ang gingamit ni Samson lakip na ang subjects sa finance, sales, management, leadership, politics, health kag mental wellness.
english: Samson used a total of 100 books including subjects in finance, sales, management, leadership, politics, health and mental wellness.

text: Suno sa iya, ginhimo niya ini agud nga ma-promote ang literacy development kag ma-inspire ang reading culture sa Nigeria.
english: He said he did this to promote literacy development and inspire reading culture in Nigeria.

text: Bilang pagsulundan sa pinakamalawig nga marathon records, ginhatagan man si Samson sang tag-lima ka minutos nga pahuway sa kada matapos ang isa ka oras nga pagbasa — ukon buot silingon, duha ka oras lamang nga pahuway sa isa ka adlaw.
english: As a rule with the longest marathon records, Samson was also given a five-minute break each time an hour of reading was completed — or that is, only two hours of rest a day.

text: Sa sini nga breaktime lamang mahimo makatulog, makakadto sa bathroom, ukon makailis ang tawo nga naga-readathon.
english: Only during this breaktime can the person conducting the readathon sleep, go to the bathroom, or change.

text: Suno kay Samson, wala gid siya nagtulog-tulog sa iya break.
english: According to Samson, he never took a nap during his break.

text: “Even when it’s tough, you have to get going to meet your target,” pahayag sini sa interview sa NTA News base sa report sang Guinness World record.
english: “Even when it’s tough, you have to get going to meet your target,” he said in an interview with NTA News based on the Guinness World record report.

text: Antes ang record attempt, may abiso pa nga nakuha ang natungdan sa medical professionals kun ano nga pagkaon kag ilimnon ang iya dal-on kag paano halungan ang iya tingog amo man ang pag-minimize sang toilet break.
english: Before the record attempt, he received a warning from medical professionals on what food and drinks to bring and how to protect his voice as well as minimize toilet breaks.

text: Pagkatapos nga nagmadinalag-on sa iya attempt sa Guinness, nagparada pa si Samson kag ang iya supporters lakip ang iya ginikanan bilang selebrasyon sa iya pinasahi nga nahimo.
english: After succeeding in his Guinness attempt, Samson and his supporters including his parents paraded in celebration of his special achievement.

text: Ini nga record ang may yara sang manggaranon nga maragtas.
english: This record has a rich history.

text: Sang 1987, ang Englishman nga si Adrian Hilton ang ginkilala man bangud sa pag-recite sini sa complete works ni Shakespeare sa “bard-a-thon” nga naglawig sang 110 hours kag 46 minutes.##
english: In 1987, Englishman Adrian Hilton was also recognized for his recitation of the complete works of Shakespeare in a “bard-a-thon” that lasted 110 hours and 46 minutes.##

text: Bangud sa nagahilapit na nga Paskwa sa pungsod, indi na naman mapunggan ang pagtukar sang mga masadya nga ambahanon ukon Christmas songs.
english: Due to the approaching Christmas in the country, it is impossible to stop playing Christmas songs.

text: Suno kay clinical psychologist Scott Bea, practitioner sang cognitive-behavioral psychotherapy sa Estados Unidos, magluwas nga nagapa-improve sang mood sang isa ka tawo ang pagpamati sang Holiday music, natukiban nga dako man ini nga bentaha para sa masangkad nga memorya, nagapalikaw sa stress kag makabulong sa chronic pain.
english: According to clinical psychologist Scott Bea, a practitioner of cognitive-behavioral psychotherapy in the United States, besides improving a person's mood, listening to holiday music has also been found to have great advantages for memory, stress relief and chronic pain.

text: Pahayag sang doktor, makabulig man pasangkad sang cognitive abilities sang mga pasyente nga may dimentia kag Alzheimer’s disease ang pagpaidalom sa holiday music therapy.
english: The doctor said holiday music therapy can also help improve the cognitive abilities of patients with dementia and Alzheimer's disease.

text: Bangud man sa simple nga pagpamati sa Christmas music, natukiban sa isa ka pagtuon nga nagnubo ang pagkinahanglan sang mga pasyente nga bag-o lang napaidalom sa operasyon sang bulong nga morphine nga nagabulig manage sang ila nga chronic pain.
english: Because of the simple listening to Christmas music, a study found that patients who had just undergone surgery decreased their need for morphine to help manage their chronic pain.

text: Gindala sa ikaduha nga adlaw sang confirmation hearing sa International Criminal Court (ICC) ang kaso sang 17-anyos nga solterito nga si Kian Delos Santos nga ginpatay sa kasagsagan sang Duterte drug war.
english: The case of 17-year-old Kian Delos Santos, who was killed in the midst of Duterte's drug war, was brought to the second day of the confirmation hearing at the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Ginpatay si Kian sang Agusto 16, 2017 sa Caloocan City.
english: Kian was killed on August 16, 2017 in Caloocan City.

text: Ang amo nga insidente nagresulta sa lapnagon nga pagpakamalaot sa administrasyon rason nga temporaryo pa nga ginpauntat ang mga pulis sa drug operations.
english: The incident resulted in widespread condemnation of the administration, which led to the temporary suspension of police drug operations.

text: Ginhalimbawa sang prosekusyon ang kaso ni Kian para sa third count sang kaso ni Duterte nga crimes against humanity.
english: The prosecution cited Kian's case as an example for the third count of Duterte's crimes against humanity case.

text: Nakatutok ini sa kontrobersyal nga “Project Tokhang”.
english: It focuses on the controversial “Project Tokhang”.

text: Kaangay sa iban nga modus operandi nga ginagamit sa iban nga biktima sang barangay clearance operations, gin-identify sila paagi sa “listahan” kag ginpatay sa police operations.
english: Like other modus operandi used against other victims of barangay clearance operations, they were identified through a “list” and killed in police operations.

text: Sa amo nga scheme, ginatanuman ang crime scene sang mga ebidensya kaangay sang armas, droga, ukon kwarta, kag ginapeke ang police reports agud mahambal nga lehitimo ang operasyon kag nagdepensa lamang ang mga pulis.
english: In this scheme, the crime scene is planted with evidence such as weapons, drugs, or money, and police reports are falsified to say that the operation is legitimate and the police were only defending themselves.

text: “In this context, as witnesses explained, the police often used the term ‘nanlaban’ which translates to fighting back to describe incidents in which they supposedly shot a victim in self-defense,” suno sa prosekusyon.
english: “In this context, as witnesses explained, the police often used the term ‘nanlaban’ which translates to fighting back to describe incidents in which they supposedly shot a victim in self-defense,” according to the prosecution.

text: “These reports were often almost identical, in essence, copy-paste reports in which victims were frequently blamed for their own death, and finally, unofficial rewards were paid,” dugang niya.
english: “These reports were often almost identical, in essence, copy-paste reports in which victims were frequently blamed for their own death, and finally, unofficial rewards were paid,” he added.

text: Ini nga padya nagadiretso sa mga pulis nga amo ang nagpatay sa target.
english: This reward goes straight to the police officers who killed the target.

text: Three counts sang crimes against humanity ang ginapangatubang ni Duterte sa ICC kun sa diin may ginplastar nga 76 ka mga kaso sang pagpatay halin sang 2013-2018.
english: Duterte is facing three counts of crimes against humanity at the ICC where 76 cases of murder were filed from 2013-2018.

text: Ini nga record suno sa prosekusyon ang porsyon pa gid lamang ukon “mere fraction” sang linibo nga nagkalamatay sa “war on drugs” campaign sang mayor pa si Duterte tubtub nga na-eleher na bilang presidente.#
english: This record, according to the prosecution, is only a portion or “mere fraction” of the thousands who died in the “war on drugs” campaign from Duterte's mayoralty until he was elected president.

text: Patigayunon karon sa hapon sa sa probinsya sang Antique ang opening ceremony sang Western Visayas Regional Athletic Association (WVRAA) Meet 2025.
english: The opening ceremony of the Western Visayas Regional Athletic Association (WVRAA) Meet 2025 will be held this afternoon in Antique province.

text: Opisyal nga magabukas ang regional sports meet paagi sa parada.
english: The regional sports meet will officially open with a parade.

text: Ginalauman man nga masobra sa 5,300 ka delegasyon halin sa Aklan, Antique, Capiz, Guimaras, Iloilo, kag Negros Occidental ang magatipon para sa daku nga programa.
english: More than 5,300 delegations from Aklan, Antique, Capiz, Guimaras, Iloilo, and Negros Occidental are also expected to gather for the big program.

text: Antes ini nga programa, ginpatigayon man ang solidarity meeting sa Binirayan Gymnasium, San Jose, Antique nga gintambungan sang coaches kag technical officials agud nga mapahibalo ang final instructions sa pagsugod sang event.
english: Before this program, a solidarity meeting was also held at Binirayan Gymnasium, San Jose, Antique attended by coaches and technical officials to announce the final instructions for the start of the event.

text: Suno kay Dr. Nicasio Frio, Schools Division Superintendent sa Antique, nakapatigayon na sila sang serye sang coordination meeting sa mga tiglawas sang Philippine National Police, Philippine Army, Bureau of Fire Protection, Department of Public Works and Highways, Water Works kag Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council agud masiguro nga safe kag matalunsay ang kahiwatan.
english: According to Dr. Nicasio Frio, Schools Division Superintendent in Antique, said they have already held a series of coordination meetings with representatives of the Philippine National Police, Philippine Army, Bureau of Fire Protection, Department of Public Works and Highways, Water Works and Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council to ensure safety and security.

text: Ang tanan nga 18 ka mga banwa sa Antique ang gin-tap sang Provincial Government sa diin tanan nga district supervisors ang ginbutang sa 7 ka mga billeting schools nga tiniran sang mga delegates halin sa nagkalain-lain nga probinsya.
english: All 18 towns in Antique were tapped by the Provincial Government where all district supervisors were placed in 7 billeting schools to accommodate delegates from different provinces.

text: Nagapatigayon man ang monitoring kag inspection ang Provincial kag Municipal Health Office sa billeting areas.
english: The Provincial and Municipal Health Offices are also conducting monitoring and inspection in the billeting areas.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang nagligad nga tuig, ginpatigayon ang regional sports meet sa Bacolod City kag Negros Occidental kun sa diin nakuha sang Iloilo ang kampyonato.
english: Last year, the regional sports meet was held in Bacolod City and Negros Occidental where Iloilo won the championship.

text: Sang amo nga tion, gintiglawas sang masobra 800 delegates ang Iloilo kag nakuha ang championship titles sa tanan nga lebel nga ginalakipan sang Elementary, Secondary, Paragames, kag Demo Sports categories.
english: At that time, more than 800 delegates represented Iloilo and won championship titles at all levels including Elementary, Secondary, Paragames, and Demo Sports categories.

text: Ginpatuman sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) ang campaign silence period umpisa Domingo, Mayo 11, bilang preparasyon sa eleksyon sa Lunes, Mayo 12.
english: The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) has implemented a campaign silence period starting Sunday, May 11, in preparation for the Monday, May 12 elections.

text: Ginapahanumdom sang COMELEC ang tanan nga kandidato kag mga supporters nga untaton ang ano man nga porma sang kampanya lakip na ang mga materyales pareho sang tarpaulin kag posts sa social media.
english: The COMELEC reminds all candidates and supporters to stop any form of campaigning including materials such as tarpaulins and posts on social media.

text: Gin-athag man niya nga ang campaign ban indi lang para sa physical nga aktibidad sang kampanya kundi pati man sa digital platforms.
english: He also clarified that the campaign ban is not only for the physical activity of the campaign but also on digital platforms.

text: Ginmanduan man sang COMELEC ang pagbaklas sang tanan nga campaign materials bangud ini subong kabahin na sang paglapas sa election rules.
english: The COMELEC also ordered the destruction of all campaign materials as it is now part of the violation of election rules.

text: Umpisa man Mayo 11, ginpatuman ang nationwide liquor ban agud malikawan ang mga insidente nga may kaangtanan sa ilimnon sa tion sang eleksyon.
english: Also starting May 11, a nationwide liquor ban was implemented to prevent alcohol-related incidents during the election.

text: Sa adlaw sang eleksyon mismo, ginpahanumdom man sang Comelec nga indi angay maglibot-libot ang mga kandidato matapos sila makaboto agud indi ini matawag nga last-minute campaigning.
english: On election day itself, the Comelec also reminded candidates not to go around after they vote so that it will not be called last-minute campaigning.

text: Nagpabutyag man sang kabalaka ang ahensya sa posibilidad sang vote-buying sa mga katapusan nga adlaw antes ang botohan.
english: The agency also expressed concern over the possibility of vote-buying in the final days before the vote.

text: Ginpahanumdom ni Garcia nga may penalidad para sa mga magahimo sang vote-buying/buyer man ukon seller.
english: Garcia reminded that there are penalties for those who engage in vote-buying/buyer or seller.

text: Magabukas ang mga presinto sang pagboto sa alas 5:00 sang aga para hatagan priority ang mga senior citizen, mga PWDs, kag mga nagabusong nga botante, tubtob alas 7:00 sang aga.
english: Polling stations will open at 5:00 am to give priority to senior citizens, PWDs, and pregnant voters, until 7:00 am.

text: Ginpuhag sang 7.6-magnitude nga linog ang mga residente sa Indonesia.
english: A 7.6-magnitude earthquake rocked residents in Indonesia.

text: Suno sa US Geological Survey, yara ang epicenter sang linog sa 427 kilometers (265 miles) south sang Indonesian island nga Ambon kag may kadalumon nga 95 kilometers.
english: According to the US Geological Survey, the epicenter of the quake was 427 kilometers (265 miles) south of the Indonesian island of Ambon and had a depth of 95 kilometers.

text: Nag-report man ang Meteorology, Climatology and Geophysics Agency sang Indonesia sang aftershocks sa magnitude nga 5.5.
english: Indonesia's Meteorology, Climatology and Geophysics Agency also reported aftershocks measuring 5.5 on the Richter scale.

text: Nagpaandam man ang Indonesian geophysics agency sang potential tsunami, apang sang ulihi gin-lift naman ang warning.
english: The Indonesian geophysics agency also warned of a potential tsunami, but the warning was later lifted.

text: Wala pa sang reported nga nagkalahalitan sa amo nga linog.
english: No casualties were reported in the quake.

text: Kaangay sa Pilipinas, masami nga naga-eksperyensya ang Indonesia sang sini nga seismic activity bangud sa posisyon sini sa Pacific “Ring of Fire” kun sa diin nagabungguanay ang tectonic plates.
english: Like the Philippines, Indonesia often experiences this seismic activity due to its position in the Pacific “Ring of Fire” where tectonic plates collide.

text: Sang nagligad lang nga Nobyembre, may 5.6-magnitude quake man sa West Java province kun sa diin patay ang 602 ka tawo.
english: Last November, a 5.6-magnitude quake also struck West Java province, killing 602 people.

text: Nagahulat na lang ang Iloilo City Government sang sabat sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) natuhoy sa request sang syudad nga exemption sa spending ban para sa 2025 elections.
english: The Iloilo City Government is awaiting the response of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) regarding the city's request for exemption from the spending ban for the 2025 elections.

text: Ini agud nga mapaiway sa ban ang social welfare programs kag infrastructure projects sang Iloilo City.
english: This is to avoid the ban on social welfare programs and infrastructure projects of Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ms. Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Mayor Jery Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga nagalaum ang syudad nga maaprubahan ang ila request.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ms. Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Mayor Jery Treñas, said the city hopes their request will be approved.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, tinutuyo lamang sang tikang nga tayuyon ang paghatag sang serbisyo sa mga Ilonggo.
english: According to Fantilaga, the move only aims to provide continuous services to Ilonggos.

text: Sa bahin naman sang infrastructure, gintu-ad sini nga nag-request na ang COMELEC sang dugang nga requirements kon sa diin, ginatinghuwaan naman nga ma-comply.
english: In terms of infrastructure, he admitted that the COMELEC has already requested additional requirements which, it is trying to comply with.

text: Ginhatagan man sini sang punto nga luyag sang city government nga mapadayon ang ‘on-going’ infrastructure project sang syudad.
english: He also pointed out that the city government wants to continue the city's on-going infrastructure project.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang request nagasakop sang 16 ka social welfare program kag 190 ka mga proyekto sa imprastraktura agud masiguro nga indi sila maapektuhan sang spending restrictions sugod Marso 28 tubtob Mayo 11, 2025.
english: The request covers 16 social welfare programs and 190 infrastructure projects to ensure that they are not affected by spending restrictions from March 28 to May 11, 2025.

text: Nagsabat si Defense Secretary Gilberto “Gibo” Teodoro Jr.
english: Defense Secretary Gilberto “Gibo” Teodoro Jr. responded.

text: sa pagpamalabag sang China sa pagpadala sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika sang ila nga military assets diri sa Pilipinas.
english: China's objection to the United States sending its military assets to the Philippines.

text: “Wala silang pakialam ‘dun, bakit sila nagde-deploy din sa ibang mga lugar.
english: “They don't care about that, why are they deploying to other places.

text: Eh ano sa akin kung magalit sila?” kabahin sang sabat sang tiglikom sa ambush interview sa Camp Aguinaldo.
english: What if they get angry with me?” part of the secretary's response to the ambush interview at Camp Aguinaldo.

text:
Dugang sini: “Ang importante huwag magalit ang taumbayan ng Pilipinas sa atin.”

Matandaan nga ang ginapamatukan sang China amo ang US deployment sang Typhon weapon systems kag high-precision anti-ship Navy-Marine Expeditionary Ship Interdiction System (NMESIS) launchers sa pungsod bangud suno sa ila, ginaguba sini ang kalinong sa rehiyon.
english:
He added: “The important thing is that the people of the Philippines do not get angry with us.”

China opposes the US deployment of Typhon weapon systems and high-precision anti-ship Navy-Marine Expeditionary Ship Interdiction System (NMESIS) launchers in the country because it says it undermines peace in the region.

text: Abril sang ginkumpirma sang 3rd Marine Littoral Regiment sang US Marine Corps ang labing-una nga deployment sang NMESIS sa Pilipinas.
english: In April, the 3rd Marine Littoral Regiment of the US Marine Corps confirmed the first deployment of NMESIS in the Philippines.

text: Ini nga system ang ginposisyon anay sa Northern Luzon kag sa Batanes Islands bilang kabahin sang 40th iteration sang tuigan nga Balikatan (Shoulder-to-Shoulder) military exercises sang Pilipinas kag US.
english: This system was originally positioned in Northern Luzon and the Batanes Islands as part of the 40th iteration of the annual Balikatan (Shoulder-to-Shoulder) military exercises between the Philippines and the US.

text: Makasarang ang NMESIS system sa pag-igo sa targets nga masobra 185 kilometros ang kalayuon paagi sa sea-skimming precision kag radar-evading stealth.
english: The NMESIS system is capable of hitting targets more than 185 kilometers away with sea-skimming precision and radar-evading stealth.

text: Gindesinyo ini para sa coastal defense kag sea denial operations.#
english: It is designed for coastal defense and sea denial operations.#

text: Liwat nga ginpatuman sang Iloilo City General Services Office (GSO) ang massive cleanup drive sa mga kabarangayan agud maprotektahan ang residente sa makamamatay nga dengue virus.
english: The Iloilo City General Services Office (GSO) has once again implemented a massive cleanup drive in the barangays to protect residents from the deadly dengue virus.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Niel Ravena, head sang General Services Office, iya ginpahayag nga nagsugod ang pagpanglimpyo sang nagligad nga semana kon sa diin, ginapapasa sila sang report sang Department of Health (DOH).
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Niel Ravena, head of the General Services Office, said the clean-up began last week where they are being submitted a report by the Department of Health (DOH).

text: Suno kay Ravena, ginapabalik sang talatapan ang ila nga street sweepers agud mabuligan ang barangay nga nagapatuman sang cleanup drive.
english: According to Ravena, the office is sending back its street sweepers to assist the barangay in implementing the cleanup drive.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nagkooperar man ang mga residente sa tikang kasunod sang pagpaguwa man sang order sang city government.
english: He said the residents also cooperated in the move following the issuance of the city government's order.

text: Nagpanugyan man ini sa publiko nga himuon ang 5S kontra Dengue – Search and Destroy breeding sites, self-protective measures, seek early consultation, support fogging, kag sustain hydration.
english: He also advised the public to practice 5S against Dengue – Search and Destroy breeding sites, self-protective measures, seek early consultation, support fogging, and sustain hydration.

text: Apisar nga ginsiling ni Pope Francis nga daw kaangay nga may Lolo ang isa ka puluy-an sang pareho sila nga nagtinir ni Pope Emeritus Benedict XVI sa Vatican, ginbuyagyag sang libro sang personal secretary sang former pope ang tensyon nga nabatyagan sa gamay nga city-state bangud sa duha ka santo papa.
english: Although Pope Francis said that a home was like having a grandfather when he and Pope Emeritus Benedict XVI both stayed at the Vatican, a book by the former pope's personal secretary revealed the tension felt in the small city-state over the two popes.

text: Huwebes sang ginlubong si Benedict kag si Pope Francis man ang nagpanguna sa misa sa St.
english: Benedict was buried on Thursday and Pope Francis also led the mass at St.

text: Peter’s Square.
english: Peter’s Square.

text: Pagkatapos sini, may yara sang Italian publishing house nga naghatag sang advance copies sang 330-ka pahina sang libro nga “Nothing But The Truth – My Life Beside Benedict XVI” nga ginsulat ni Archbishop Georg Ganswein.
english: Subsequently, there was an Italian publishing house that provided advance copies of the 330-page book “Nothing But The Truth – My Life Beside Benedict XVI” written by Archbishop Georg Ganswein.

text: Si Ganswein, 66, amo ang personal secretary ni Benedict halin sang 2003 tubtub nga napatay ini.
english: Ganswein, 66, was Benedict's personal secretary from 2003 until his death.

text: Nangin gatekeeper man ni Pope Francis si Ganswein apang gin-islan siya sang 2020.
english: Ganswein also served as Pope Francis’ gatekeeper but was replaced in 2020.

text: Sa amo nga libro, ginpatpat ni Ganswein ang mga hitabo sa pag-elect kay Benedict bilang santo papa sang 2005, pag-resign sang 2013, ang iya kabuhi bilang pope emeritus, tubtub sa iya pagbalatian kag kamatayon.
english: In the book, Ganswein explains the events of Benedict's election as pope in 2005, his resignation in 2013, his life as pope emeritus, until his illness and death.

text: Apisar nga wala na halos sang public appearances si Benedict sang nanaog ini sa posisyon, nagpabilin siya nga standard-bearer para sa Catholic conservatives nga ginpahayag daw nagbatyag nga lain sila bangud sa mga pagbag-o nga gin-umpisahan ni Pope Francis lakip na ang crack down sang old Latin Mass.
english: Although Benedict made almost no public appearances when he stepped down, he remained a standard-bearer for Catholic conservatives who reportedly felt alienated by the changes initiated by Pope Francis, including the crack down of the old Latin Mass.

text: Suno kay Ganswein, nakibot man si Benedict nga wala nagsabat si Pope Francis sa public letter sang apat ka conservative cardinals sang 2016 lakip na ang halin kay American Cardinal Raymond Leo Burke nga nag-akusar kay Francis sang pagtanum sang confusion sa moral issues.
english: Ganswein said Benedict was also surprised that Pope Francis did not respond to a public letter from four conservative cardinals in 2016 including one from American Cardinal Raymond Leo Burke that accused Francis of sowing confusion on moral issues.

text: Sa amo nga libro ginpahayag man nga wala nag-ugyon si Benedict sa pila ka panindugan ni Francis.
english: The book also states that Benedict disagreed with some of Francis' positions.

text: Pagkatapos sang long interview ni Francis sa isa ka Jesuit journal anum ka bulan ang nakaligad matapos ang iya nga election, ginpahayag nga nagpadala si Francis sang journal kay Benedict para sa iya nga mga komento.
english: After Francis' long interview with a Jesuit journal six months after his election, Francis reportedly sent a journal to Benedict for his comments.

text: Ginpahayag ni Ganswein nga gin-critique ni Benedict ang paagi sang pagsabat ni Francis sa questions kaangay sa abortion kag homosexuality.
english: Ganswein said Benedict criticized the way Francis answered questions such as abortion and homosexuality.

text: Suno pa sa libro ni Ganswein,”sala” ang pagkabig sang pope emeritus sa desisyon ni Pope Francis nga i-restrict ang paggamit sang traditionalist Latin Mass.
english: According to Ganswein's book, the pope emeritus considered Pope Francis' decision to restrict the use of the traditionalist Latin Mass "wrong."

text: Wala naman sang komento si Vatican spokesman Matteo Bruni sa amo nga libro nga ginsulat kaupod kay Italian journalist Saverio Gaeta.
english: Vatican spokesman Matteo Bruni had no comment on the book, which was written with Italian journalist Saverio Gaeta.

text:
‘SERVING TWO MASTERS’

Sa una nga pito ka tuig matapos na-elect bilang santo papa si Pope Francis, duha ang trabaho ni Ganswein – Prefect of the Pontifical Household kag private secretary sa ex-pope.
english:
‘SERVING TWO MASTERS’

In the first seven years after Pope Francis was elected pope, Ganswein had two jobs – Prefect of the Pontifical Household and private secretary to the ex-pope.

text: Suno kay Ganswein, wala siya nakakuha sang “climate of trust” sa bag-o nga santo papa, kag ginpahayag man sini nga posible nga gintugtan lang siya ni Pope Francis nga tungdan sa gihapon ang trabaho bilang prefect bilang respeto na lang kay Benedict.
english: According to Ganswein, he did not get a “climate of trust” from the new pope, and he also said that it is possible that Pope Francis only allowed him to continue to hold the job as prefect out of respect for Benedict.

text: Enero 2020 sang nangin sentro man sang kontrobersyal nga episode si Ganswein bangud sa libro kaangot sa priestly celibacy nga ginsulat sang conservative nga si Cardinal Robert Sarah.
english: In January 2020, Ganswein also became the center of a controversial episode over a book on priestly celibacy written by conservative Cardinal Robert Sarah.

text: Suno kay Sarah, si Benedict ang co-author — butang nga ginpanginwala ni Benedict kag nagpahayag pa sang amo nga tion nga kakason ang iya pangalan sa cover.
english: According to Sarah, Benedict was the co-author — something Benedict denied and even said at the time that his name would be removed from the cover.

text: Nabutang sa tunga-tunga si Ganswein kag gilayon siya nga ginkakas ni Pope Francis bilang prefect.
english: Ganswein was caught in the middle and Pope Francis immediately removed him as prefect.

text: Suno pa sa archbishop, ginmanduan siya ni Pope Francis nga indi na magbalik sa iya nga trabaho kag magtutok na lang sa pagbantay sa pope emeritus.
english: The archbishop said Pope Francis ordered him not to return to his job and to focus on guarding the pope emeritus.

text: Nagsulat si Benedict kay Francis kag nag-apelar nga maghimo man sang tikang agud nga ma-athag ang sitwasyon bangud ginpahayag nga nagsuprer si Ganswein kag “under attack from all sides”.
english: Benedict wrote to Francis and appealed for him to take steps to clarify the situation as Ganswein was said to have suffered and was “under attack from all sides”.

text: Wala naman ginbalik ni Francis si Ganswein sa iya daan nga posisyon.
english: Francis did not reinstate Ganswein to his old position.

text: ## — via Reuters
english: ## — via Reuters

text: Gin-aktohan na sang Office of the Ombudsman ang request for assistance ni Former Our Lady of Lourdes, Jaro Barangay Captain Amado Hollero.
english: The Office of the Ombudsman has already acted on the request for assistance of Former Our Lady of Lourdes, Jaro Barangay Captain Amado Hollero.

text: Ini kaangot sa P39.7 million nga disallowed transaction sang Iloilo City Government sa idalom sang pagpamuno ni former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog.
english: This is in connection with the P39.7 million disallowed transaction of the Iloilo City Government under the leadership of former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Hollero, iya ginpahayag nga Pebrero 5, 2025 sang nagsulat siya sang letter kag gilayon man nga nag-response ang Office of the Ombudsman.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Hollero said he wrote the letter on February 5, 2025 and the Office of the Ombudsman immediately responded.

text: Suno kay Hollero, nagsulat man ang Ombudsman sa Office of City Accountant nahanungod sa amo nga concern kon sa diin, nagpahayag ang opisina nga mangayo anay sang 10 ka adlaw agud nga makasabat.
english: Hollero said the Ombudsman also wrote to the Office of City Accountant regarding the concern where the office said it would ask for 10 days to respond.

text: Gintuad man sini nga luyag lamang niya nga mahibaluan ang natabo sa disallowed transaction kag hatagan igtalupangod sang Ombudsman ang amo nga concern.
english: He also admitted that he just wanted to know what happened to the disallowed transaction and have the Ombudsman pay attention to the concern.

text: Luyag man sang natungdan nga masabat ni Mabilog ang amo nga transakyon agud maklaro ini sa publiko.
english: He also wants Mabilog to answer the transaction so that it will be clear to the public.

text: Nagapati man ini nga ang Ombudsman ang may ikasarang agud nga ma-address ang issue kag malab-ot ang anay alkalde.
english: He also believes that the Ombudsman has the capacity to address the issue and reach out to the former mayor.

text: Gin-athag man ni Jollero nga wala sang lamod pulitika ang iya tinutuyo kag bisan sin-o ang may kinamatarong agud magpamangkot natuhoy sa amo nga transaksyon.
english: Jollero also clarified that his intention is not political and anyone has the right to ask questions about the transaction.

text: Kumbinsido si Department of National Defense (DND) Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr.
english: Department of National Defense (DND) Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. is convinced.

text: nga may interes gid ang China sa pagpanghilabot sa eleksyon sa Pilipinas.
english: that China has a real interest in interfering in the Philippine elections.

text: Suno kay Teodoro, maathag katama nga may tuyo ang China kag sa pagkamatuod suno sa tiglikom, yara na sa ila DNA nga manghilabot sa amo sini nga bagay.
english: According to Teodoro, it is very clear that China has an intention and in fact, according to the secretary, it is in their DNA to interfere in such a matter.

text: “‘Yang China talagang may interest na pakialaman ang eleksyon dito dahil obvious na obvious ‘yan at nakikialam naman talaga yang mga yan kasi nasa DNA nila yan,” pahayag sang defense official.
english: "China really has an interest in interfering in the election here because it's obvious that it's obvious and they're really interfering because it's in their DNA," the defense official said.

text:
Apang gindugang man sini nga indi lang Beijing ang may amo sini nga interes kundi ang “non-state rogue actors.”

“‘Yan ay laging present hindi lamang sa china kung hindi non-state rogue actors,” dugang sini.
english:
But he also added that it is not only Beijing that has such an interest but “non-state rogue actors.”

“‘That is always present not only in China but also non-state rogue actors,” he added.

text: Matandaan nga sa Senate hearing sang Abril 24, ginpahayag ni National Security Council spokesperson Assistant Director General Jonathan Malaya nga may mga indikasyon nga nagahilabot ang mga Chinese sa midterm elections sang Pilipinas nga matabo na sa Mayo 12.
english: It can be recalled that in a Senate hearing on April 24, National Security Council spokesperson Assistant Director General Jonathan Malaya said there are indications that the Chinese are interfering in the Philippine midterm elections that will be held on May 12.

text: Madasig nga ginbali sang China ang akusasyon kun sa diin gin-athag ni Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun nga may ginasunod sila nga prinsipyo sang non-interference sa domestic affairs sang iban nga mga nasyon.
english: China quickly refuted the accusation where Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun explained that they follow the principle of non-interference in the domestic affairs of other countries.

text: Apang suno naman kay Teodoro, nagahimo ang China sang “united front works” kag nagtukod pa gani sang government department para sa sini nga mga operasyon.
english: However, Teodoro said China is doing “united front works” and has even established a government department for these operations.

text: Gindugang sini nga ginahimo ini sang China paagi sa illegal, coercive, aggressive and deceptive actions.
english: He added that China is doing this through illegal, coercive, aggressive and deceptive actions.

text: Ginpresentar sa International Criminal Court (ICC) ang “PRRD List” ukon ang listahan sang mga high-value targets ni former President Rodrigo Duterte sa kasagsagan sang iya implementasyon sang drug war.
english: The International Criminal Court (ICC) has presented the “PRRD List” or the list of high-value targets of former President Rodrigo Duterte in the midst of his implementation of the drug war.

text: Ginpakita ini sang trial lawyer sang prosekusyon nga si Edward Jeremy sa ikaduha nga adlaw sang confirmation of charges hearing sa ICC Pre-Trial Chamber I, Pebrero 24.
english: This was indicated by the prosecution’s trial lawyer Edward Jeremy on the second day of the confirmation of charges hearing at the ICC Pre-Trial Chamber I, February 24.

text:
Suno kay Jeremy, ini nga listahan ang mahimo kabigon nga “death list.”

Gingamit sang prosecution nga listahan agud i-establisar nga responsable si Duterte sa kaso nga pagpamatay kag tuyo nga pagpamatay sa 59 ka mga indibidwal.
english:
According to Jeremy, this list can be considered a “death list.”

The prosecution used the list to establish that Duterte was responsible for the murder and attempted murder of 59 individuals.

text: Sa sini nga numero, 14 ang “high-value targets” nga ginpatay sang 2016 kag 2017.
english: Of this number, 14 were “high-value targets” killed in 2016 and 2017.

text: Ginpatay man ang 43 ka iban pa kag gintuyo patyon ang duha ka mga indibidwal sa barangay-level operations sang pulis sang 2016 tubtub 2018.
english: Forty-three others were also killed and two individuals were attempted to be killed in barangay-level police operations from 2016 to 2018.

text: “It’s worth pausing here and taking a step back… this is the President of the Philippines, commander in chief, the most powerful man in the Philippines, pointing directly at the crowd and telling them to kill someone’s child….
english: “It’s worth pausing here and taking a step back… this is the President of the Philippines, commander in chief, the most powerful man in the Philippines, pointing directly at the crowd and telling them to kill someone’s child….

text: simply because they may have an addiction to drugs,” suno pa sa trial lawyer samtang padayon ang iya presentasyon.
english: simply because they have an addiction to drugs,” the trial lawyer said while continuing his presentation.

text: Ginsugid man sang prosecution sa judges nga pila ka beses nga ginpadayaw pa ni Duterte ang iya drug matrix.
english: The prosecution also told the judges that Duterte praised his drug matrix several times.

text: Wala man ginpalampuwas sang prosecution ang lahog ni former President Rodrigo Duterte nga mangin maayo nga negosyo ang punerarya kadungan sang iya nga pagpatuman sang drug war.
english: The prosecution also did not ignore former President Rodrigo Duterte's claim that the funeral home would be a good business while implementing the drug war.

text: Sa amo nga statement, nagpahayag si Duterte nga kun maghina na ang negosyo sa punerarya, hambalon lang sini ang mga pulis nga dasig-dasigon ang pagpamatay.
english: In the statement, Duterte said that if the business at the funeral home slows down, he will tell the police to speed up the killing.

text: Three counts of crimes against humanity ang ginapangatubang ni Duterte sa ICC kun sa diin may ginplastar nga 76 ka mga kaso sang pagpatay halin sang 2013-2018.
english: Duterte is facing three counts of crimes against humanity at the ICC where 76 cases of murder were filed from 2013-2018.

text: Ini nga record suno sa prosekusyon ang porsyon pa gid lamang ukon “mere fraction” sang linibo nga nagkalamatay sa “war on drugs” campaign sang mayor pa si Duterte tubtub nga na-eleher na bilang presidente.#
english: This record, according to the prosecution, is only a portion or “mere fraction” of the thousands who died in the “war on drugs” campaign from Duterte's mayoralty until he was elected president.

text: ILOILO CITY –Isa ka rehiyon na gid lang sa bilog nga Pilipinas ang wala sang may narecord nga COVID-19 delta variant.
english: ILOILO CITY – Only one region in the Philippines has no recorded COVID-19 delta variant.

text: Suno kay Dr. Alethea De Guzman, director sang Epidemiology Bureau sang Department of Health (DOH), ang Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) na lang ang nagaisahanon nga rehiyon nga wala pa sang may nadetect nga mas makalalaton nga variant sang COVID-19.
english: According to Dr. Alethea De Guzman, director of the Epidemiology Bureau of the Department of Health (DOH), said the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) is the only region that has not yet detected a more contagious variant of COVID-19.

text: Apang gin-athag niya nga wala ini nagakahulugan nga wala sang presensya sang amo nga COVID-19 strain sa Bangsamoro.
english: However, he clarified that this does not mean that there is no presence of the COVID-19 strain in the Bangsamoro.

text: Pahayag niya, ini bangod nga diutay pa lang ang samples nga ila nakuha halin sa rehiyon.
english: He said this is because they have only received few samples from the region.

text: Ang Delta variant nga kilala nga mas makalalaton kumparar sa original COVID-19 strain ang nagabug-os sang 11 percent sang tanan nga sequenced samples sa Pilipinas.
english: The Delta variant, which is known to be more contagious than the original COVID-19 strain, accounts for 11 percent of all sequenced samples in the Philippines.

text: Una na nga ginkumpirmar sang DOH nga may yara sang community transmission sang Delta variant sa National Capital Region kag Calabarzon, apang mabudlay nga ideklarar ang community transmission sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: Earlier, the DOH confirmed that there is community transmission of the Delta variant in the National Capital Region and Calabarzon, but it is difficult to declare community transmission nationwide.

text: Naluwas ang isa ka una ginpahayag “injured” nga bald eagle gikan sa isa ka national park sa Missouri, United States of America.
english: A previously declared “injured” bald eagle was rescued from a national park in Missouri, United States of America.

text: Apang, ginkakibot lamang sang mga eksperto sang nasapwan nga ang bald eagle ang indi injured bangud tuman lang ini katambok pagkatapos nga makakaon ini sang tuman kadamo nga raccoon rason nga indi ini makasarang maglupad.
english: However, experts were surprised to find that the bald eagle was not injured because it was just too fat after eating so many raccoons that it could not fly.

text: Santo sa Facebook page sang Wilson’s Creek National Battlefield, ang mga opisyales sang Missouri Department of Conservation ginpatawag sa park agud dakpon ang isa ka bald nga agila nga orihinal nga ginreport nga injured.
english: According to the Wilson’s Creek National Battlefield Facebook page, Missouri Department of Conservation officials were called to the park to capture a bald eagle that was originally reported injured.

text: Ginpahayag man nga ang agila nakita nga mapagros apang puno sang raccoon — sa iban nga mga pulong, tuman ini katambok para sa paglupad.
english: It was also reported that the eagle was found healthy but full of raccoon — in other words, it was too fat for flight.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma man sang Dickerson Park Zoo matapos nagkuha sang X-ray sang agila, nga nagapakita sang isa ka bag-o nga pagkaon sang isa ka daku nga roadkill raccoon.
english: This was also confirmed by the Dickerson Park Zoo after taking an X-ray of the eagle, which revealed a recent meal of a large roadkill raccoon.

text: Sa ulihi nga bahin, ang agila gin-rehabilitate kag liwat nga ginbuy-an pabalik sa parke.
english: At a later stage, the eagle was rehabilitated and again released back into the park.

text:
Wala ginlimitahan sang isa ka jeepney driver halin sa Tubungan, Iloilo ang iya kaugalingon sa pag-diskubre sang iya mga ikasarang

Paagi sa  nagkalain-lain nga trabaho, iya gingamit ang iya mga abilidad agud mapalapad pa ang iya ihibalo sa mga nagkalain-lain nga obra.
english:
A jeepney driver from Tubungan, Iloilo did not limit himself to discovering his abilities

Through various jobs, he used his skills to expand his knowledge of various works.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Chris Salinas Plotena, isa ka driver, registered criminologist, civil service eligible, certified safety officer kun kaisa konduktor, dispatcher, kag sa masunod nga bulan matapos na sa iya public administration, iya ginpahayag nga madamo sang mga tawo ang nag-motivate sa iya agud nga mag-pursue sang nagkalain-lain nga bagay nga masarangan sini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Chris Salinas Plotena, a driver, registered criminologist, civil service eligible, certified safety officer sometimes conductor, dispatcher, and next month will finish his public administration, he said that many people motivated him to pursue various things that he can do.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga ginapangitaan gid sini sang paagi nga mapasulod ang iya ginpangtun-an sa iya mga hilig agud magamit man sini sa pagpangita sang obra.
english: He said he is always looking for ways to incorporate what he learned into his hobbies so that he can use it to find a job.

text: Ginpahayag pa sini nga wala nagapabaya ang Ginoo bangud ginaubayan gid sini ang mga tawo sa pagtuman sang ila nga mga handom sang amat-amat lang.
english: He added that the Lord does not neglect because he helps people to fulfill their dreams gradually.

text: Nagbilin man ini sang pahanumdom sa kaangay man sini nga driver nga kun may ara sang opportunidad indi dapat magkahadlok nga mag-try agud makabulig man sa ini sa ila kaugalingon nga magsangkad.
english: He also left a reminder to fellow drivers that if there is an opportunity they should not be afraid to try so that it can help themselves to expand.

text: WELCOME sa pagbalik mo, former Mayor Jed Mabilog!
english: WELCOME to your return, former Mayor Jed Mabilog!

text: Indi ka lang ugaling anay magbalik sa Filipinas, sunu sa mga nagakabalaka gid sa imo nga mga sumulunod mo.
english: But don't go back to the Philippines, according to your worried followers.

text: Indi ka gid kuno magpauli pa tungod nagabaga pa ang balatyagon ni President Duterte batok sa imo.
english: Don't go home because President Duterte's feelings against you are still burning.

text: Basi kuno masid-ingan ka pa sang riding-in-tandem, tapos ka gid!
english: They say you might be caught by a riding-in-tandem, you're done!

text: Indi man guro, a. Basi makasandad lang kag mahulog sa manhole nga ginapabay-an nga bukas sang DPWH, lahog gani sang isa.
english: I guess not, a. They might stumble and fall into the manhole left open by the DPWH, one of them said.

text: Matuod man, dira ka lang anay kon diin ka man subong, meyor, para segurado.
english: It's true, stay where you are now, mayor, to be safe.

text: Labi na gid karon sa sining paggwa na sang desisyon sang Court of Appeals nga naga-dismiss sang “ill-gotten” case nga gin-file sa imo sadtong  2014.
english: Especially now that the Court of Appeals has issued a decision dismissing the “ill-gotten” case filed against you in 2014.

text: Basi bala indi ini mabaton sang iban dira kag mag-amok.
english: Maybe some people there won't accept it and will riot.

text:
***

Kinawatan mo kuno ang ginpatindug mo nga “mansion” dira sa Tap-ok, Molo.
english:
***

You stole the mansion you built here in Tap-ok, Molo.

text: Kinawatan nga “mansion”?
english: Stolen “mansion”?

text: Daw indi man.
english: Apparently not.

text: Daw daku-daku lang diutay ina sa ginapatukod sang ordinaryo nga empleyado nga nakapangutang sa Pag-ibig.
english: That seems a little too big for what the ordinary employee who borrowed from Pag-ibig is building.

text: Kabahin kuno ini sang imo “unexplained wealth” tungod sa daku nga pagtaas sang imo networth sing mga P8 ka milyon sa sulod lang sang isa ka tuig sa gindeklarar mo nga Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Networth (SALN) sadtong 2013.
english: This is supposedly part of your “unexplained wealth” because of the huge increase in your networth by about P8 million in just one year in your declared Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Networth (SALN) in 2013.

text: Dapat pa tani dayawon si Mayor Mabilog, siling sang isa ka supporter, kay nangin “honest” siya sa pagdeklarar sining iya SALN.
english: Mayor Mabilog should be praised, said one supporter, because he was “honest” in declaring his SALN.

text: Subong ina ka daku kuno ang networth ni meyor tungod sa pagtaas man nga kinitaan sang ila negosyo ni Mrs. Mabilog kag sang kinitaan ni Mrs. bilang corporate accountant sa Canada.
english: The mayor's networth is said to be so large because of the increased income of Mrs. Mabilog and the income of Mrs. as a corporate accountant in Canada.

text: Ang problema sadto kay indi magpati ang iban nga subong gid kadaku ang pagtaas sang gindeklarar nga SALN ni meyor, nga ginmalisyahan na sang iban tubtub naglab-ut ini sa akusasyon nga kuno tungod ini sa “ill-gotten wealth” nga naangkon niya.
english: The problem was that some people did not believe that the increase in the mayor's declared SALN was so large, which was misunderstood by others until it reached the accusation that it was because of the “ill-gotten wealth” he acquired.

text: Kon “ill-gotten wealth” yadto, tani ginsekreto lang ato ni meyor kag wala gin-include sa iya SALN, indi bala?
english: If it was “ill-gotten wealth”, the mayor would have kept it secret and not included it in his SALN, right?

text: Amo man gani ang pagpati sang Court of Appeals sa pag-dismiss sining kaso kontra kay meyor.
english: The Court of Appeals also believes in dismissing this case against the mayor.

text:
***

Balik kita sa kaakig ni Presidente Duterte batok kay anay Mayor Jed, nga indi gihapon seguro malipatan ni Presidente.
english:
***

Let's go back to President Duterte's anger against former Mayor Jed, which the President will probably never forget.

text: Natabo yadto sadtong ila kampanya sang Mayo 2016 nga eleksyon.
english: That happened during their May 2016 election campaign.

text: Gin-sabotahe kuno ni Mayor Jed ang ila rally sadtong pagkampanya nila sa siyudad sang IIoilo.
english: Mayor Jed allegedly sabotaged their rally during their campaign in Ioilo City.

text: Ginpapatyan kuno sila ni meyor sing suga sa plaza, nga gin-deny ni meyor.
english: The mayor allegedly turned off the lights in the plaza, which the mayor denied.

text: Kag tungod man seguro sa sining kaakig ni Presidente Duterte sa natabo nga ato, nalakip na si meyor sa listahan sang presidente sa kuno mga “protector” sang illegal drug activities diri sa siyudad.
english: And probably because of President Duterte's anger at what happened, the mayor has been included in the president's list of alleged “protectors” of illegal drug activities here in the city.

text: Tubtub subong, ugaling, mga lima na ka tuig nga nagligad, wala pa sing formal nga akusasyon ang na-file batok sa kay meyor angot diri.
english: To date, however, some five years later, no formal charges have been filed against the mayor in this regard.

text: Ngaa ayhan?
english: Why maybe?

text: Ina tungod seguro kay indi man ebidensya nga nakapa-picture ka lang sa isa ka druglord kag tungod sa pagduging sang illegal activities diri sa siyudad sa panahon ni meyor.
english: That's probably because it's not evidence that you just took a picture with a druglord and because of the increase in illegal activities here in the city during the mayor's time.

text: Kon may suspetso man, suspetso lang kay indi ini mapag-on nga mga ebidensya agud mapasakaan sing kaso nga “protector” si meyor sang illegal drug activities diri sa siyudad.
english: If there is any suspicion, it is only suspicion because it is not strong evidence to charge the mayor with being a “protector” of illegal drug activities here in the city.

text: Ining akusasyon nga “protector” sang illegal activities dala ini seguro sa salabton ni meyor sa idalom sang “principle of command responsibility”, sa diin may salabton siya sa pagpabaya ukon pagsugo gid gani sa iya mga tinawo nga pabay-an lang ining illegal drug activities.
english: This accusation of being a “protector” of illegal drug activities is probably due to the mayor's responsibility under the principle of command responsibility, where he is responsible for neglecting or even ordering his men to leave these illegal drug activities alone.

text: Daw amo-amo man ini nga akusasyon ang gina-pensar nga ipasaka sang International Court batok kay Presidente Duterte sa pagkamatay sang madamo – sobra 10,000 – nga mga suspetsado sa ilegal nga droga.
english: It seems that the International Court of Justice is considering filing similar charges against President Duterte for the deaths of many – more than 10,000 – illegal drug suspects.

text: Matuod, masiling naton nga wala ini nga problema nahatagan sing lubos nga pagtamod ni meyor, pero indi masiling nga gin-tolerar ini ni Mayor Jed.
english: True, we can say that this problem was not given full attention by the mayor, but it cannot be said that Mayor Jed tolerated it.

text: In fact, wala man si meyor nagpabaya sa paghatag ang bulig sa kapulisan katulad sang mga patrol cars, dugang nga mga armas, galastuhon sa gasolina, dugang nga intelligence fund, kag iban pa.
english: In fact, the mayor did not neglect to provide assistance to the police such as patrol cars, additional weapons, gasoline expenses, additional intelligence fund, and others.

text: Kon may problema dira, ina tungod lawlaw gid man ang mga pulis kag ang PDEA, ukon ang mga pulis mismo ang mga “protector”.
english: If there is a problem, it is because the police and the PDEA are really stupid, or the police themselves are the “protectors”.

text: Wala man gani sang bisan isa lang ka pulis ang nakasumbong nga ginsugo ni meyor sila agud pabay-an lang ining mga drug personalities.
english: Not a single police officer has complained that the mayor ordered them to leave these drug personalities alone.

text: Ti, paano mo abe basulon si meyor?/PN
english: Well, how can you blame the mayor?/PN

text: Nagapanginit ka man bala kun kadugay na sa imo pagpangita sang tawo nga para sa imo, pero daw indi mo gid makita kag feeling mo kulang sila sa kalibutan?
english: Do you get angry when you've been looking for the right person for a long time, but you can't find them and you feel like they're missing in the world?

text: May mga tawo gid nga nainit bangud 8 billion na ang populasyon sa kalibutan suno sa United Nations pero single sila gihapon.
english: There are people who are angry because the world population is 8 billion according to the United Nations but they are still single.

text: Sa India, masobra 50 ka mga kalalakihan ang nagprotesta sa ila nga lokal nga gobyerno bangud ginapahayag nga kulang ang mga single nga mga kababaihan sa ila nga lugar.
english: In India, more than 50 men protested to their local government over an alleged lack of single women in their area.

text:
Sa kagustuhan nga makapangita na sang pangasaw-on, naghimo sang committee ang 50 single nga mga lalaki kag gintawag ini nga ‘Bridegroom Morcha.’

May gin-organisar nga rally ang 50 ka mga soltero sa atubang sang ila nga local government.
english:
With the desire to find a bride, 50 single men formed a committee and called it the 'Bridegroom Morcha.'

The 50 young men organized a rally in front of their local government.

text: Agud masapakan ang ila nga kawsa, nagsuksok pa sila sang magarbo nga traditional wedding attire kag nagsakay sa puti nga mga kabayo.
english: To promote their cause, they even wore fancy traditional wedding attire and rode white horses.

text: May dala man sila nga mga musikero para may magpatokar sang traditional wedding music.
english: They also brought musicians to play traditional wedding music.

text: Dala sang mga nagprotesta ang petisyon nga pangitaan sila sang gobyerno sang ila mapangasawa.
english: The protesters carried a petition demanding that the government find them a wife.

text: Ini bangud sa data sang National Family Health Survey, ang Maharashtra sa amo nga pungsod ang may yara lamang sang 920 ka mga babayi sa kada 1,000 ka lalaki.
english: This is because according to the National Family Health Survey data, Maharashtra in that country has only 920 women for every 1,000 men.

text: Sa subong, ginahulat pa sang grupo nga Bridegroom Morcha ang sabat sang Maharastra local government sa ila nga petisyon.##
english: The Bridegroom Morcha is still waiting for the Maharastra local government's response to its petition.

text: ILOILO CITY- Apat ka tawo ang patay sa pagbungguanay sang duha ka helicopters malapit sa Sea World sa Gold Coast sang Australia.
english: ILOILO CITY – Four people were killed when two helicopters collided near Sea World on Australia's Gold Coast.

text: Suno sa Queensland Police, ang crash natabo sang isa ka aircraft ang naga-take off kag nagahugpa naman ang isa.
english: According to Queensland Police, the crash occurred when one aircraft was taking off and the other was landing.

text: Tatlo naman ang yara sa kritikal nga kondisyon.
english: Three others are in critical condition.

text: Duha ka UK citizens ang patay sa pag-crash.
english: Two UK citizens were killed in the crash.

text: Padayon pa ang pagtul-id sang otoridad sa amo nga aksidente.
english: Authorities are still investigating the accident.

text: Duha gid lamang ka official state delegations — halin sa Italy kag Germany — ang magatambong sa funeral ni Pope Emeritus Benedict XVI.
english: Only two official state delegations — from Italy and Germany — will attend the funeral of Pope Emeritus Benedict XVI.

text: Sa Germany ginbun-ag si Benedict (formerly Cardinal Joseph Ratzinger), kag nagpuyo siya sa Italya sa masobra 40 ka tuig.
english: Benedict (formerly Cardinal Joseph Ratzinger) was born in Germany, and he lived in Italy for more than 40 years.

text: Suno sa Holy See Press Office, magapadala ang duha ka pungsod sang official representatives sa lubong sang anay Santo Papa sa Huwebes.
english: According to the Holy See Press Office, the two countries will send official representatives to the funeral of the former Pope on Thursday.

text: Antes sini, lunsay na nagkadto sanday Italian President Sergio Mattarella kag Italian Prime Minister Geogia Meloni sa haya sang pope emeritus sa St.
english: Earlier, Italian President Sergio Mattarella and Italian Prime Minister Geogia Meloni both attended the funeral of the pope emeritus at St.

text: Peter’s Basilica kun sa diin magapabilin ang bangkay tubtub sa Enero 4.
english: Peter’s Basilica where the body will remain until January 4.

text: Samtang yara didto, nagpabutyag sang simpatiya si Meloni sa longtime personal secretary ni Benedict nga si Archbishop Georg Gänswein.
english: While there, Meloni expressed sympathy to Benedict's longtime personal secretary, Archbishop Georg Gänswein.

text:
Suno naman sa news magazine nga Der Spiegel, lauman nga magatambong si German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier sa funeral sa Huwebes “in an official capacity.”

Antes sini nga kumpirmasyon nagikan sa Vatican, madamo sang mga kwestyon kun ano ang matabo kun mapatay ang pope emeritus.
english:
According to the news magazine Der Spiegel, German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier is expected to attend the funeral on Thursday “in an official capacity.”

Before this confirmation from the Vatican, there were many questions about what would happen if the pope emeritus died.

text: Ini bangud plastado ang rituals pananglitan mapatay ang reigning pope, apang lain naman ang sitwasyon kun isa ka former pope ang mapatay.
english: This is because the rituals are in place if the reigning pope dies, but the situation is different if a former pope dies.

text: Lakip sa mga ginkwesyon amo ang suksukon ni Benedict (kun papal dress ukon ang iya sang cardinal) kag amo man ang mga tawo nga magasunod sa funeral bangud indi naman si Benedict XVI ang head of state.
english: Among the questions raised were what Benedict would wear (whether papal dress or cardinal's) and also the people who would follow the funeral because Benedict XVI is not the head of state.

text: Lakip naman sa inisyal nga mga sabat amo nga ilubong ang pope emeritus nga may features nga reserved para sa pope apang indi tanan.
english: Among the initial responses was to bury the pope emeritus with features reserved for the pope but not all.

text: Halimbawa, ang red shoes nga ginsuksok ni Benedict bilang santo papa ang gin-islan sang itom.
english: For example, the red shoes that Benedict wore as pope were replaced with black ones.

text: Sa official delegations, duha lamang ang imbitado; apang mahimo makatambong ang sin-o man nga public figure apang sa personal capacity lamang.
english: Of the official delegations, only two were invited; but any public figure may attend but only in a personal capacity.

text: Sang 2005, 159 ka delegations ang nagtambong sa lubong ni Pope John Paul II, 157 cardinals, 700 archbishops, kag masobra 6,000 ka journalists, photographers, kag iban pa nga media personnel.
english: In 2005, 159 delegations attended the funeral of Pope John Paul II, 157 cardinals, 700 archbishops, and more than 6,000 journalists, photographers, and other media personnel.

text: Ang funeral sang reigning pope ang ginatambungan sang madamo nga cardinals nga nagakadto sa Roma agud mag-attend sa conclave ukon ang eleksyon sang bag-o nga santo papa.
english: The funeral of the reigning pope is attended by many cardinals who travel to Rome to attend the conclave or the election of a new pope.

text: Sa subong, indi kumpirmado kun pila ka mga cardinal ang magatambong sa lubong ni Benedict bangud wala man sang conclave nga matabo.
english: At present, it is not confirmed how many cardinals will attend Benedict's funeral because there will be no conclave.

text: Napasa na sang prosecutor sa International Criminal Court (ICC) ang second batch sang mga ebidensya sa kaso batok kay former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The prosecutor has submitted to the International Criminal Court (ICC) the second batch of evidence in the case against former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Nagaunod ini sang 139 items nga ginalantaw nga magapapag-on sa kaso nga crimes against humanity.
english: It contains 139 items that are expected to strengthen the case of crimes against humanity.

text: Ginpasa ini ni ICC Prosecutor Karim Khan sa ICC Pre-Trial Chamber 1 kag napadala naman sa defense team ni Duterte sang Abril 30, 2025.
english: ICC Prosecutor Karim Khan forwarded it to ICC Pre-Trial Chamber 1 and sent it to Duterte's defense team on April 30, 2025.

text: Matandaan nga Marso sang ginpasa naman ang una nga batch sang mga ebidensya.
english: The first batch of evidence was submitted in March.

text: Suno kay Khan, ang 139 ka mga items ang gin-organisar sa idalom sang apat ka disclosure packages kaangay sang contextual elements, modes of liability, murder sa termino ni Duterte bilang Davao City mayor, kag murder sa idalom sang clearance operations sa iya termino bilang presidente sang Pilipinas.
english: According to Khan, the 139 items are organized under four disclosure packages such as contextual elements, modes of liability, murder during Duterte's term as Davao City mayor, and murder under clearance operations during his term as president of the Philippines.

text: Nahibaluan nga natalana sa Septyembre 23 ang confirmation of charges sa ICC batok sa anay punong ehekutibo.
english: The confirmation of charges against the former chief executive is scheduled for September 23 in the ICC.

text: Ginpaguwa ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas ang mga litrato ni Public Information and Community Affairs Office Chief Nereo Lujan nga ginaalegar nagagamit sang van sang Iloilo Provincial Government nga indi sakop sang iya trabaho.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas released photos of Public Information and Community Affairs Office Chief Nereo Lujan allegedly using a van of the Iloilo Provincial Government that is not part of his job.

text: Nakit-an si Lujan nga nanaog sa van sang Iloilo Provincial Government kag ginpalapitan kag namangkot sa Anti-Squatting and Illegal Structures Unit (ASIS-U) kun ngaa ginbaklas ang campaign poster nga nakapaskil sa isa ka private building sa Diversion Road, Mandurriao.
english: Lujan was seen getting out of the Iloilo Provincial Government van and approached and asked the Anti-Squatting and Illegal Structures Unit (ASIS-U) why the campaign poster posted on a private building in Diversion Road, Mandurriao was removed.

text: Depensa naman ni Lujan, wala ini nagagamit sang salakyan sang gobyerno para sa iya public interest bangud ang litrato nga nakuha sang alkalde amo ang adlaw nga nagbaton ini sang award nga Best Performing Information Office (Provincial Category) sa Western Visayas Information Officers Regional Summit.
english: Lujan defended that he did not use a government vehicle for his public interest because the photo taken by the mayor was the day he received the award of Best Performing Information Office (Provincial Category) at the Western Visayas Information Officers Regional Summit.

text: Suno sa iya, padulong siya sa venue sang awarding sang iya nalabayan ang ASIS-U kag namangkot sang ila ginahimo bangud nga yara man sa private building ang campaign poster.
english: He said he was on his way to the venue of the awarding when he passed ASIS-U and asked what they were doing because the campaign poster was also in a private building.

text: Sa facebook post naman ni Lujan, iya ginpahayag nga ang paggamit sang government resources para sa personal use ang makabig nga grave concern.
english: In a Facebook post, Lujan said the use of government resources for personal use is a serious concern.

text:
Yari ang post ni Lujan:

”Mayor Jerry Treñas has accused me of misusing government resources, specifically alleging that I have used my office’s service vehicle for personal errands.
english:
Here’s Lujan’s post:

”Mayor Jerry Treñas has accused me of misusing government resources, specifically alleging that I have used my office’s service vehicle for personal errands.

text: Yet, if we are to scrutinize the use of public resources, should we not also examine how his daughter, Raisa Treñas, is benefiting from government programs and activities?”
english: Yet, if we are to scrutinize the use of public resources, should we not also examine how his daughter, Raisa Treñas, is benefiting from government programs and activities?”

text: DINGLE, ILOILO – Nagpatigayon sang pagsinapol ang Archdiocese of Jaro kag Local Government Unit sang Dingle, Iloilo may kaangtanan sa ginaduso nga road widening sa diin ginaalegar madalasa ang semicircular nga hagdan sang historic nga St.
english: DINGLE, ILOILO – The Archdiocese of Jaro and the Local Government Unit of Dingle, Iloilo held a meeting regarding the proposed road widening where the semicircular stairs of the historic St.

text: John the Baptist Church.
english: John the Baptist Church.

text: Ang ginapahayag plano nga pag-demolish sang hagdan sang simbahan ang nagresulta sang pagkabalaka sang pila ka mga heritage advocates bangud may yara sang historical kag cultural significance ang simbahan.
english: The alleged planned demolition of the church steps has resulted in concern among some heritage advocates as the church has historical and cultural significance.

text: Ang St.
english: The St.

text: John the Baptist Church sa Dingle ang gintukod sang Spanish colonia era pa sa diin human sa granite stone ang nasambit nga simbahan nga gin-quarry malapit sa kabukiran sang Bulabog Putian.
english: John the Baptist Church in Dingle was built during the Spanish colony era and is made of granite stone that was quarried near the mountains of Bulabog Putian.

text: Ginpakig-angotan sang Bombo Radyo si Father Angelo Colada, ang director sang Social Communications Office sang Archdiocese of Jaro, kag iya ginkumpirma nga nakapakig-angot na ang simbahan sa local government unit sang Dingle natuhoy sa plano.
english: Bombo Radyo contacted Father Angelo Colada, the director of the Social Communications Office of the Archdiocese of Jaro, and he confirmed that the church has already contacted the local government unit of Dingle regarding the plan.

text: Pahayag niya, sa subong, ginhatagan na sang Roman Catholic Archbishop of Jaro kag Archdiocesan Property Administration Office ang local government unit sang Dingle sang records sa duta nga subject sa ginaduso nga road widening.
english: He said the Roman Catholic Archbishop of Jaro and the Archdiocesan Property Administration Office have already provided the local government unit of Dingle with records on the land subject to the proposed road widening.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, padayon nga nagapakig-angot ang simbahan kag ang legal team sini sa local government unit sang Dingle agud makahimo sang “mutually acceptable solution” sa amo nga concern.
english: He added that the church and its legal team are in constant contact with the local government unit of Dingle to come up with a “mutually acceptable solution” to the concern.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang St.
english: It is known that St.

text: John the Baptist Church ang yara sa idalom sang hurisdiksyon sang Archdiocese of Jaro.
english: John the Baptist Church is under the jurisdiction of the Archdiocese of Jaro.

text: Bukas naman ang Bombo Radyo sa paathag sang Local Government Unit sang Dingle.
english: Bombo Radyo is open to the explanation of the Local Government Unit of Dingle.

text: Naglapaw na sa 400 ka reports ang nabaton sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) Committee on Kontra Bigay (CKB) kaangot sa baligyaanay kag baklanay sang boto amo man sa abuse of state resources (ASR).
english: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) Committee on Kontra Bigay (CKB) has received more than 400 reports regarding vote buying and selling as well as abuse of state resources (ASR).

text: Suno sa committee chairperson nga si Commissioner Ernesto Maceda Jr., sa 439 reports nga ila nabaton, 268 ang kaso sang vote-buying kag vote-selling, 130 naman ang nag-abuso sang resources sang gobyerno, kag 41 ang kumbinasyon gid sang duha ka mga kaso.
