english: According to committee chairperson Commissioner Ernesto Maceda Jr., of the 439 reports they received, 268 were cases of vote-buying and vote-selling, 130 were cases of abuse of government resources, and 41 were a combination of the two cases.

text: Ang kadam-an nga kaso sang vote-buying kag vote-selling ang naangot sa cash distribution, financial assistance, kag paghatag sang mga bagay-bagay sa mga tawo.
english: The majority of vote-buying and vote-selling cases are linked to cash distribution, financial assistance, and giving things to people.

text: Ang mga rehiyon nga may pinakamataas nga record sang reklamo amo ang Calabarzon, Cagayan Valley, Metro Manila, Bicol Region, Mimaropa, kag Ilocos Region.
english: The regions with the highest complaint records are Calabarzon, Cagayan Valley, Metro Manila, Bicol Region, Mimaropa, and Ilocos Region.

text: Matandaan nga sang Pebrero sang ginlunsar liwat sang Comelec ang Kontra-Bigay committee agud nga matapna ini nga mga kaso samtang nagahilapit ang eleksyon.
english: It can be recalled that in February, the Comelec relaunched the Kontra-Bigay committee to prevent these cases as the election approaches.

text: Nag-partner man ini sa e-wallet applications kaangay sang GCash kag Paymaya agud nga ma-address ang vote-buying nga ginahimo naman paagi sa digital transactions.
english: It also partnered with e-wallet applications such as GCash and Paymaya to address vote-buying which is done through digital transactions.

text: Bilang selebrasyon sang pagpungko ni Cardinal Robert Francis Prevost bilang bag-o nga Santo Papa, nag-post ang Augustinian community sa Cebu sang mga laragway sang nagkadto ini anay sa amo nga probinsya sang 2004.
english: In celebration of the inauguration of Cardinal Robert Francis Prevost as the new Pope, the Augustinian community in Cebu posted pictures of his visit to the province in 2004.

text: Sang amo nga tion, siya ang Prior General of the Augustinians.
english: At the time, he was Prior General of the Augustinians.

text: Lakip sa iya nga ginkadtuan amo ang Santo Nino de Cebu Parish sa Barangay Mohon, Talisay City sa ika-19 nga anibersaryo sang ila nga Canonical Foundation bilang Domus Formata.
english: Among those he visited was Santo Nino de Cebu Parish in Barangay Mohon, Talisay City on the 19th anniversary of their Canonical Foundation as Domus Formata.

text: “With great joy, the Augustinian Province of Santo Niño de Cebu–Philippines joins the Catholic Church in praying for Robert Cardinal Prevost, OSA—now Pope Leo XIV—as he begins his ministry as the 267th Supreme Pontiff,” post sang Order of Saint Augustine – Province of Santo Niño de Cebu.
english: “With great joy, the Augustinian Province of Santo Niño de Cebu–Philippines joins the Catholic Church in praying for Robert Cardinal Prevost, OSA—now Pope Leo XIV—as he begins his ministry as the 267th Supreme Pontiff,” posted the Order of Saint Augustine – Province of Santo Niño de Cebu.

text: Nagbisita man ini sa Intramuros sang 2010 kun sa diin nagselebrar ini sang Mass sa San Agustín Church kadungan sang Order of Saint Augustine’s Intermediate General Chapter.
english: He also visited Intramuros in 2010 where he celebrated Mass at San Agustín Church in conjunction with the Order of Saint Augustine's Intermediate General Chapter.

text: Si Cardinal Prevost ang 267th head sang Roman Catholic Church kag una nga Santo Papa halin sa Order of Saint Augustine ukon Augustinians.
english: Cardinal Prevost is the 267th head of the Roman Catholic Church and the first Pope from the Order of Saint Augustine or Augustinians.

text: Naeleher siya sang 133 ka cardinal electors pasado alas dose kaina sang kaagahon oras sa Pilipinas.
english: He was elected by 133 cardinal electors around 12:00 am Philippine time yesterday.

text: Gin-reject sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) ang pangabay sang mga election observers gikan sa European Union (EU) nga makasulod sa mga polling places sa Mayo 12, 2025 midterm elections.
english: The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) has rejected a request by election observers from the European Union (EU) to access polling places in the May 12, 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa isa ka news forum sa Manila, ginpahayag ni COMELEC chairman George Garcia nga ginhambalan sang EU observers ang poll body nga ang pagdumili sa ila sa sulod sang polling precincts mahimo nga maglapas sa international standards.
english: At a news forum in Manila, COMELEC chairman George Garcia said EU observers told the poll body that banning them inside polling precincts could violate international standards.

text: Apang suno kay Garcia, indi mahimo nga pahanugutan sang Comelec nga maglagaw sila sa sulod sang mga polling precincts sa adlaw sang eleksyon.
english: However, Garcia said the Comelec cannot allow them to walk inside the polling precincts on election day.

text: Suno kay Garcia, welcome sila mag-observe kag may freedom of movement po sila sa interes sang transparency, kon sa diin, ginakabug-usan sila sang halos 300 ka myembro.
english: Garcia said they are welcome to observe and have freedom of movement in the interest of transparency, where they have nearly 300 members.

text: Sa idalum sang Omnibus Election Code, ginpahayag ni Garcia nga limitado lang ang mga accredited nga tawo ang ginapahanugutan sa sulod sang mga polling places sa tion sang pagpatigayon sang eleksyon.
english: Under the Omnibus Election Code, Garcia said only limited accredited persons are allowed inside polling places during the conduct of elections.

text: Pahayag ni Garcia, handa ang commission en banc nga atubangon ang posible nga konsekwensya kasunod sang paandam sang mga EU observers.
english: Garcia said the commission en banc is ready to face the possible consequences following the warnings of EU observers.

text: Masobra 20 ka tawo ang napatay sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika kag linibo man ang nawad-an sang suplay sang kuryente sa mismo adlaw sang Paskuwa bangud sang natabo nga major winter storm.
english: More than 20 people were killed in the United States of America and thousands were left without power on Easter Sunday due to a major winter storm.

text: Sa latest report, nagsaka na sa 24 ang death toll bangud sa bangud sa brutal nga bomb cyclone nga nag-dala sang snow, mabaskog nga hangin, kag freezing temperatures.
english: According to the latest report, the death toll has risen to 24 due to the brutal bomb cyclone that brought snow, strong winds, and freezing temperatures.

text: Ang western US state sang Montana amo ang worst-hit sang pinakamalamig nga tyempo kun sa diin nagnubo sa -50F (-45C) ang temperatura.

text: Wala na ginasapubliko sang China ang adlaw-adlaw nga numero sang Covid-19 cases sa pungsod.
english: China no longer publishes the daily number of Covid-19 cases in the country.

text: Wala man ginpaathag sang National Health Commission (NHC) kun ngaa islan ang ila policy sa pagbalhag sang figures apisar nga amo na ini ang nakaandan halin sang 2020.
english: The National Health Commission (NHC) also did not explain why it changed its policy of publishing figures despite the fact that it has been the norm since 2020.

text: Suno sa komisyon, iga-publish lamang sang Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention ang kinahanglanon nga Covid-19 information para sa reference kag research, apang wala man gin-detalye kun ano ka-regular ipaguwa ang data.
english: According to the commission, the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention will only publish the necessary Covid-19 information for reference and research, but did not detail how regularly the data will be released.

text: Matandaan nga sang pag-umpisa sang Disyembre, ginhalugan sang China ang ila nga istrikto nga zero-Covid policy kasunod sang pag-protesta sang mga tawo sa dalanon.
english: In early December, China relaxed its strict zero-Covid policy following street protests.

text: Halin sang gin-lift na ang mga restrictions, anum pa gid lamang ka Covid-19 deaths ang na-report sa amo nga pungsod.
english: Since the restrictions were lifted, only six more Covid-19 deaths have been reported in the country.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, may yara sang health data firm sa Britanya nga nagsaad nga may ginabanta masobra isa ka milyon nga kaso sang Covid-19 kag masobra 5,000 ka patay sa China kada adlaw.
english: Last week, there was a health data firm in Britain promising that there are estimates of more than a million cases of Covid-19 and more than 5,000 deaths in China every day.

text: Lain ini ipaanggid sa report sang National Health Commission nga zero COVID-19 deaths sa China sa nagligad nga apat ka adlaw.
english: This is different from the National Health Commission's report of zero COVID-19 deaths in China in the past four days.

text: Ginapatihan sang mga eksperto nga kabahin ini sang tikang sang pungsod agud nga mabuhinan ang numero sang nagaguwa nga patay nga naangot sa virus.
english: Experts believe this is part of the country's move to reduce the number of deaths linked to the virus.

text: Wala man sang nabaton nga data ang World Health Organization halin sa China may kaangtanan sa bag-o nga COVID hospitalisations halin sang ginpahalugan ang ila nga mga restrictions.
english: The World Health Organization has also not received any data from China regarding new COVID hospitalizations since its restrictions were eased.

text: Nagsabat si former Kabataan Partylist Rep.
english: Former Kabataan Partylist Rep.

text: Raoul Manuel matapos ginlakip sang nagapakilala ex-marines ang iya pangalan sa ginaalegar nga nakabaton sang kickback.
english: Raoul Manuel after the ex-marines included his name in the alleged receipt of kickback.

text:
Gintawag ini ni Manuel nga “mga asal marites” kag mga “traydor sa bayan” nga indi gani makapangapin sa teritoryo sang pungsod, apang nagahimo pa sang mga istorya nga nagadalahig sang “mga anti-Duterte nga indi man kurakot.”

“Sinama ng 16 ex-Marines (plus one ex-army personnel and one army reservist) ang pangalan ko sa mga kongresista na tumanggap daw o nakinabang sa kikbak.
english:
Manuel called them “asalmaris” and “traitors to the people” who cannot even defend the country's territory, but still make up stories involving “anti-Dutertes who are not corrupt.”

“Sixteen ex-Marines (plus one ex-army personnel and one army reservist) included my name among congressmen who allegedly accepted or benefited from the kikbak.

text: Nakakahiya itong former Marines at Army!
english: This former Marines and Army is a shame!

text: Mga asal marites!
english: Behavior sweaters!

text: Di na nga nila naipagtanggol ang mga dagat natin mula sa panghihimasok ng mga banyaga, tapos gumawa pa sila ng mga kwento para idamay ang mga anti-Duterte na hindi kurakot,” suno sa former lawmaker.
english: They can no longer protect our seas from foreign interference, and they make up stories to hurt the anti-Duterte who are not corrupt,” the former lawmaker said.

text: Ginkwestyon man sini kun ngaa lunsay mga naga-kontra sa Duterte ang ginlista sang “ex-marines” sa affidavit.
english: He also questioned why the ex-marines listed all those who are against Duterte in the affidavit.

text: “Gets na namin na si Marcos Jr ang hari ng kurapsyon sa bansa ngayon.
english: “We get that Marcos Jr. is the king of corruption in the country now.

text: Si Sara Duterte naman ang reyna.
english: Sara Duterte is the queen.

text: Pero bakit puro kalaban ng mga Duterte ang target ng affidavit nitong ex-Marines?
english: But why is the target of the affidavit of this ex-Marine all against the Dutertes?

text: Mga traydor sa bayan!,” dugang niya.
english: Traitors to the people!,” he added.

text:
Yari ang dugang pa nga kaundan sang post ni Manuel:

“Dati pa pinapakalat ng Duterte camp sa social media ang imbentong kwento na tumanggap ako ng kikbak, habang sila itong nagtatago ng bank records.
english:
Here is more of the content of Manuel’s post:

“The Duterte camp used to spread the fabricated story on social media that I received a kikbak, while they were hiding bank records.

text: Kung tumanggap nga ako ng kikbak, saan ko ginamit?
english: If I accept a kikbak, where did I use it?

text: Alam ng mga taong nakakakilala sa akin na hindi ako nabubuhay nang marangya.
english: People who know me know that I don't live a lavish lifestyle.

text: Sasabihin ba nila na binigay ko ang mga kikbak sa NPA, na sinasabi rin nilang paubos na?
english: Will they say that I gave the kikbak to the NPA, which they also say is running out?

text: The thinking is not giving!
english: The thinking is not giving!

text: Hindi umuubra ang redtagging, mga paratang at diskriminasyon sa akin.
english: Redtagging, accusations and discrimination will not work for me.

text: Alam nila na malinis ang konsyensya ko at hindi ako kurakot bilang dating kongresista.
english: They know that I have a clean conscience and I am not corrupt as a former congressman.

text: Alam nila na tumitindig ako sa tama at di ako tumitigil kahit ni-re-redtag at inaatake.
english: They know that I will stand up for what is right and I will not stop even if I am re-redtaged and attacked.

text: Kaya natatakot sila sa mga kabataan gaya ko!
english: So they're afraid of kids like me!

text: Ngayon, aktibo ako sa kampanya kontra kurapsyon.
english: Today, I am active in the anti-corruption campaign.

text: Kaya pilit nila akong binabahiran ng mga alegasyon ng kurapsyon.
english: So they keep filling me with allegations of corruption.

text: Pero hindi sila magwawagi!
english: But they won't win!

text: Hindi namin titigilan ang impeachment ni Inday Lustay!
english: We will not stop the impeachment of Inday Lustay!

text: Titiyakin naming mabubulok si Digong sa Netherlands!
english: We'll make sure Digong rots in the Netherlands!

text:
Isasabuhay namin ang diwa ng EDSA!”

Nahibaluan nga sa affidavit sang ex-marines, ila ginpahayag nga ginsugo sila nga mag-escort kag mag-deliver sang lain-lain nga kadakuon sang mga maleta sa mga kongresista.
english:
We will live the spirit of EDSA!”

In the affidavit of the ex-marines, they said they were ordered to escort and deliver different sizes of suitcases to the congressmen.

text: “Nautusan din kami na mag-escort at mag-deliver ng iba’t-ibang laki ng maleta sa mga congressmen/women na naaalala namin sa ngayon dahil sila ang napapanood namin minsan sa telebisyon o palagi namin silang nakikita pag nakakausap sila ni Zaldy Co,” suno pa sa affidavit.
english: “We were also ordered to escort and deliver different sizes of suitcases to the congressmen/women that we remember now because they are the ones we watch sometimes on television or we always see them when they talk to Zaldy Co,” according to the affidavit.

text:
Dugang nila: “Nagdeliver kami mismo sa bahay ng ilan, sa House of Representatives, at yong iba ay kinuha nila sa Unit 8 o Unit 9 ng Polo Club Townhouse, Forbes Park.”

Subong nga adlaw sang nagguwa ang alegasyon sang mga nagpakilala nga anay mga miyembro sang Philippine Marines nga naga-claim man nga nag-deliver sila sang ₱805 billion nga cash nga nakabutang sa maleta kanday President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english:
They added: “We delivered to the house of some, to the House of Representatives, and the others were picked up at Unit 8 or Unit 9 of the Polo Club Townhouse, Forbes Park.”

Today, when the allegation of former members of the Philippine Marines came out that they also claimed that they delivered ₱805 billion cash in a suitcase to President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: kag former House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: and former House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Base sa ila nga statements, ginbyahe ang kuwarta paagi sa van kag may yara man nga naggamit pa sila sang aircraft agud madul-ong ini sa designated locations.
english: Based on their statements, the money was transported by van and some even used an aircraft to deliver it to the designated locations.

text: Sa press conference kaina sa Club Filipino, gin-claim sang abogado nga si Levi Baligod nga ini nga ex-marines ang kaupdanan anay ni Master Sgt.
english: In a press conference yesterday at Club Filipino, lawyer Levi Baligod claimed that these ex-marines were former companions of Master Sgt.

text: Orly Guteza.
english: Orly Teasing.

text: Si Guteza amo ang kontrobersyal nga Senate whistleblower nga naga-claim nga nagserbe anay bilang security personnel ni anay Ako Bicol Rep.
english: Guteza is the controversial Senate whistleblower who claims to have served as a security personnel of former Ako Bicol Rep.

text: Zaldy Co.
english: Zaldy Co.

text: Gindumog sang masobra 2 million ka mga tawo ang libre nga concert sang kilala nga pop star nga si Lady Gaga sa baybayon sang Copacabana sa Brazil.
english: More than 2 million people attended the free concert of pop star Lady Gaga on the beach of Copacabana in Brazil.

text: Amo ini ang pinakamadamo nga audience sa bug-os nga karera ni Lady Gaga, kag ginpunduhan sang syudad bilang kabahin sang inisyatibo nga pagpasanyog liwat sang ekonomiya sang Brazil.
english: It was the largest audience of Lady Gaga’s entire career, and was funded by the city as part of an initiative to revitalize Brazil’s economy.

text: Ginalauman sang mga otoridad nga ang aktibidad makahatag sang ginabulubanta nga $100 million (₱5.7 billion) nga benepisyo sa lokal nga ekonomiya.
english: Authorities expect the activity to generate an estimated $100 million (₱5.7 billion) in benefits to the local economy.

text:
Ang nasambit nga performance ang kabahin sang promotional tour ni Lady Gaga para sa iya ikawalo nga album nga ginatawag “Mayhem,” nga nagalakip sang mga kanta nga “Abracadabra” kag “Die With a Smile.”

Madumduman nga ang ulihi niya nga pagperform sa Brazil sang tuig 2012.
english:
The performance was part of Lady Gaga's promotional tour for her eighth album called “Mayhem,” which includes the songs “Abracadabra” and “Die With a Smile.”

His last performance in Brazil was in 2012.

text: Ginpahamtang ang hugot nga seguridad sa lugar, upod ang 5,000 ka mga kapulisan nga nagbantay.
english: Tight security was deployed in the area, with 5,000 police officers on standby.

text: Si Lady Gaga indi lang ang una nga artista nga nagtanyag sang libre nga concert sa Brazil.
english: Lady Gaga isn’t the only artist to offer a free concert in Brazil.

text: Sang Mayo 2024, si Madonna man nagpatigayon sang libre nga concert sa amo man nga baybayon.
english: In May 2024, Madonna also held a free concert on the same beach.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagbiyahe pa ang mga fans halin sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang pungsod agud lang masaksihan ang performance sang isa ka kilala nga pop superstar.
english: It is known that fans even traveled from different parts of the country just to witness the performance of a well-known pop superstar.

text: INDI naton ma-intiendihan kon ngaa ginpataas sang Malacañang ang quarantine level sang siyudad kag sang probinsya sang Iloilo halin sa MECQ pa-ECQ tubtub Hulyo 31.
english: We do not understand why Malacañang raised the quarantine level of the city and the province of Iloilo from MECQ to ECQ until July 31.

text: Ang ECQ, ukon Enhanced Community Quarantine,  amo ang pinakamataas nga level sang CQ.
english: ECQ, or Enhanced Community Quarantine, is the highest level of CQ.

text: Sunod dira ang Modified ECQ.
english: Next is the Modified ECQ.

text: Ginadumilian sa ECQ ang mga pumuluyo sa paggwa sa ila mga puluy-an, luas sa pagpatigayon sang mga essential nga kinahanglanon kag isa lang sa pamilya ang matugutan.
english: The ECQ prohibits residents from leaving their homes, except to meet essential needs and only one person per family is allowed.

text: Limitado man ini sa may edad 18-65 anyos lang.
english: It is also limited to those aged 18-65 years old.

text: Skeletal lang man ang mga empleyado.
english: The employees are skeletal.

text: Dapat mag-face mask, mag-social distancing, kag hygienic practice ang pagginawi sa puluy-an kag sa publiko.
english: Wear face masks, social distancing, and hygienic practices at home and in public.

text: Ngaa bala amo gid ina ang classification naton?
english: Why is that our classification?

text: Panghingabot, ukon pang-“bully”,  na ina ya!
english: Harassment, or bullying, that's it!

text: Amo-amo man gihapon ang lakat sang panglaton sang COVID-19 kag gataas gani ang recovery sang mga pasyente.
english: The spread of COVID-19 is still going on and the recovery of patients is increasing.

text: Manubo man kaayo ang kaso nga “severe”, wala pa sa 3%, kag galab-ut ang “mild” nga kaso sa indi magnubo sa 90%.
english: Severe cases are also very low, less than 3%, and mild cases reach at least 90%.

text: Manubo man kaayo ang death rate nga pwede ikibit abaga kag risguhan sang maisug nga mga Ilonggo nga nakig-away sa mga sumalakop bisan binangon lang ang ginauyatan.
english: The death rate is also very low which can be shrugged off and risked by the brave Ilonggos who fought against the invaders even with binangon in their hands.

text: Sa siyudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo wala man gapalya ang quality healthcare program diri.
english: In the city and province of Iloilo, the quality healthcare program is not failing here.

text: Bastante ang kadamuon sang mga hospital beds kag wala man ginakulang ang mga doktor kag mga nars nga handa sa ano man nga matabo.
english: There are enough hospital beds and there is no shortage of doctors and nurses who are ready for anything that happens.

text: Gani, dapat tani amo man gihapon ang quarantine level nila sa MECQ lang, agud ligwa gawa gihapon ang panghulag sang tawo kag pagpangita nila sing kabuhian.
english: Therefore, the quarantine level should remain the same in MECQ, so that people can move around and earn a living.

text: Kon sa akon lang, pwede na gani seguro ang Iloilo sa GCQ nga less strict sangsa MECQ, tutal sige man ang pangbakuna sang mga pumuluyo nga galab-ut na sobra 100,000 sang populasyon sang siyudad nga mga 500,000.
english: In my opinion, Iloilo can probably be in a GCQ that is less strict than the MECQ, since more than 100,000 of the city's population of 500,000 are still being vaccinated.

text: Madasig man nga nagaalabot ang mga bakuna.
english: Vaccines are also coming fast.

text: Mas less strict naman ang Modified GCQ (MGCQ) sangsa GCQ kon diin na-assign ang Aklan, Capiz, Negros Occidental kag Guimaras.
english: The Modified GCQ (MGCQ) is less strict than the GCQ where Aklan, Capiz, Negros Occidental and Guimaras are assigned.

text:
***

Nakasiling gani si Antique Governor Rhodora Cadiao nga daw gina-“bully” ang siyudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo sang Malacañang.
english:
***

Antique Governor Rhodora Cadiao even said that the city and province of Iloilo are being bullied by Malacañang.

text: Labi na gid kay ang gin-assign lang sa Antique amo ang GCQ samtang diri sa Antique gani na-detect ang mapintas nga Delta variant.
english: Especially since the only one assigned to Antique is GCQ while here in Antique the vicious Delta variant was detected.

text: Tungod bala kay reklamador si Mayor Treñas sa iya pagkabalaka sa iya mga pumuluyo?
english: Is it because Mayor Treñas is a complainer in his concern for his people?

text: Normal sa Demokrasya ang magreklamo kon may ireklamo ka kay ang mga pumuluyo ang matuod-tuod nga gobyerno kag indi kon sin-o ang naga-mayor-mayor dira nga opisyales.
english: It is normal in a democracy to complain when you have something to complain about because the people are the real government and not who the officials are.

text: Sa diktadurya lang nga pangginahom nagakatabo nga kipot baba ang mga pumuluyo tungod sa kahadlok.
english: Only in dictatorships do people keep their mouths shut because of fear.

text: Indi bala Senyor Roque?
english: Not Mr. Roque?

text: Kag indi ka malipat nga daw may gana ka man magdalagan sa pagka-senador.
english: And don't forget that you seem to have a desire to run for senator.

text:
***

Sa ECQ total lockdown na ina ya, nga halos indi tanan makahulag kag makapangabuhi!
english:
***

In ECQ total lockdown, that almost everyone can not move and live!

text: Aba, magutman ina kami diri sa siyudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo!
english: Alas, we are hungry here in the city and province of Iloilo!

text: Daw indi man bala makasarang na ang gobyerno sa pagpakaon sa mga tawo?
english: Doesn't the government seem to be able to feed the people?

text: Ti, ngaa indi pagtugtan ang sige pagpangabuhi sang tawo sa idalom sang MECQ?
english: Well, why not allow people to continue living under MECQ?

text: Tutal, sa luyag naton ukon indi, unay sa lawas ang risgo.
english: After all, whether we like it or not, the risk is always in the body.

text: Ang importante mapakaon naton ang aton pamilya samtang naga-amlig man kita.
english: The important thing is that we can feed our families while protecting ourselves.

text: Ti, mapakaon mo kami nga mga Ilonggo sa sining ginpahayag mo nga ECQ namon nga classification?
english: Well, can you feed us Ilonggos with this ECQ classification you announced?

text: Mga 150,000 ka food packs kag cash assistance ang kinahanglan namon diri sa kada semana.
english: We need about 150,000 food packs and cash assistance here every week.

text: Kaya nyo?
english: Can you do it?

text: Andam ka lang nga nagapilit gid ipatulon sa amon ang ECQ kon magutman kami nga mga Ilonggo tungod sining waslik poder ninyo nga pang-“bully” sa amon.
english: You are ready to force us to swallow the ECQ when we Ilonggos are hungry because of this waslik power of yours to “bully” us.

text: Malapit na baya ang eleksyon.
english: The election is near.

text: Wae ina ya sang mga manggaranon kay gasulobra pa ang ila sinuptan ukon “savings”.
english: The rich don't have that because they still have too much savings.

text: Pero indi man naton ina sila mabasol tungod ginpangabudlayan man nila ina.
english: But we can't blame them because they worked hard for it.

text: Indi bala high school klasmit Gop Lokomal?
english: Isn't Gop Lokomal a high school classmate?

text: Balo na karon si Gop kag nakapangasawa liwat sang kapareho nga Hindu nga nagapahayon-hayon na lang sa ila “savings” sa sining panahon sang COVID-19 sa isa ka subdivision sa Makati.
english: Gop is now a widow and remarried to a fellow Hindu who is enjoying their savings during this time of COVID-19 in a subdivision in Makati.

text:
***

Kon ang ginapaligban sang gobyerno nasyonal amo ang Delta variant, nga madasig kuno manglaton, gakadlaw lang gani ang mga taga-radyo sini.
english:
***

If the national government is concerned about the Delta variant, which is said to spread quickly, its radio broadcasters just laugh.

text: Matuod may kaso sang Delta variant sa West Visayas.
english: It is true that there are cases of the Delta variant in West Visayas.

text: Ang duha sini ugaling na-detect lang sa Pandan, Antique.
english: Two of them, however, were detected only in Pandan, Antique.

text: Mga 250 ka kilometro ini sa Iloilo kag mas malapit pa sa Aklan, siling gani nila.
english: It is about 250 kilometers from Iloilo and closer to Aklan, they said.

text: Pero GCQ ang Aklan kag ang Antique!
english: But Aklan and Antique are under GCQ!

text: Bato lang Mayor Treñas kag Gov.
english: Mayor Treñas and Gov.

text: Defensor para sa mga pumuluyo, a!/PN
english: Defensor for the people, a!/PN

text: Naapektuhan gid sang “tagkiliwi” ang automotive industry sa Pilipinas sang Agusto.
english: The automotive industry in the Philippines was severely affected by the “tagkiliwi” in August.

text: Sandig sa joint report sang Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines, Inc.
english: According to the joint report of the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines, Inc.

text: (CAMPI) kag Truck Manufacturers Association (TMA), nag-us-os sang 7.6% ang sales sa mga passenger cars kag commercial vehicles sang amo nga bulan.
english: (CAMPI) and Truck Manufacturers Association (TMA), sales of passenger cars and commercial vehicles fell 7.6% that month.

text: Nagnubo ini sa 36,174 sang nagligad nga bulan nga mas manubo sa 39,155 units sa amo man nga period sang 2024.
english: It fell to 36,174 last month which is lower than the 39,155 units in the same period in 2024.

text: Kun bulanan naman ang basehan, 5.5% ang gin-nubo sang vehicle sales halin sa 38,295 units nga nagabaligya sang Hulyo.
english: On a monthly basis, vehicle sales decreased by 5.5% from 38,295 units sold in July.

text: Kun pahat-pahaton, may decrease nga 3.5% ang sales sang commercial vehicles halin sa 29,626 units sang August 2024 pakadto sa 28,583 sa August 2025.
english: Broken down, there will be a decrease of 3.5% in sales of commercial vehicles from 29,626 units in August 2024 to 28,583 in August 2025.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ang sales sa passenger cars nag-us-os man sang 20.3% sa 7,591 units sini nga tuig halin sa 9,529 units sang August 2024.
english: On the other hand, sales in passenger cars also fell by 20.3% to 7,591 units this year from 9,529 units in August 2024.

text: Apisar sini nga numero, nagapabilin nga positibo ang CAMPI nga makabawi kag magsaka ang car sales sa nabilin nga apat ka bulan subong nga tuig.
english: Despite this figure, CAMPI remains positive that car sales will recover and rise in the remaining four months of this year.

text: Ginasaligan sang industry group ang “evolving consumer preferences” kag ang pagsaylo sa “sustainable mobility”.
english: The industry group relies on “evolving consumer preferences” and a shift to “sustainable mobility”.

text:
“CAMPI and TMA reaffirm their commitment to supporting innovation and advancing the automotive sector’s contribution to national development,” kabahin sang joint report.#

(Photo: Boy Santos)
english:
“CAMPI and TMA reaffirm their commitment to supporting innovation and advancing the automotive sector’s contribution to national development,” part of the joint report.#

(Photo: Boy Santos)

text: Naghisugtanay na ang Thailand kag Cambodia nga untaton ang ginamo, epektibo kahapon, suno kay United States President Donald Trump.
english: Thailand and Cambodia have agreed to end the violence, effective yesterday, according to United States President Donald Trump.

text: Ini matapos nga naistorya ni Trump ang mga lider sang duha ka pungsod agud masalbar ang ceasefire nga iya ginpatigayon sang nagligad, kasunod sang lima ka adlaw nga tensyon sa border sang Thailand kag Cambodia.
english: This comes after Trump held talks with the leaders of the two countries to save the ceasefire he brokered earlier, following five days of tension on the border between Thailand and Cambodia.

text: Suno kay Trump, nakaistorya niya sanday Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul kag Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet may kaangtanan sa pagpauntat liwat sang nagluntad nga tensyon.
english: Trump said he had spoken with Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet in relation to re-easing the escalating tensions.

text: Matandaan nga ang duha ka pungsod ang nagpalupad sang rockets kag artillery sa nanari-sari nga bahin sang ila gina-awayan nga border.
english: It can be recalled that the two countries have fired rockets and artillery in various parts of their disputed border.

text: Bangud sa amo nga tensyon, gin-report nga 20 ka tawo ang napatay samtang 260 ang pilason.
english: Due to the tension, 20 people were reportedly killed while 260 were injured.

text: Inihahanda na ang isang world-class pole vault tournament na gaganapin sa Ayala Triangle Gardens, Makati City sa darating na Setyembre 20 hanggang 21, 2025, tampok ang pambato ng Pilipinas na si Ernest John “EJ” Obiena at ilan sa mga pinakamahusay na pole vaulters mula sa iba’t ibang panig ng mundo.
english: A world-class pole vault tournament is being prepared to be held at Ayala Triangle Gardens, Makati City from September 20 to 21, 2025, featuring Philippine champion Ernest John “EJ” Obiena and some of the best pole vaulters from around the world.

text: Emosyonal na ibinahagi ni Obiena ang katuparan ng isa sa kaniyang matagal nang pangarap ang dalhin ang isang prestihiyosong paligsahan ng pole vault sa gitna ng lungsod ng Makati.
english: Obiena emotionally shared the fulfillment of one of his long-standing dreams of bringing a prestigious pole vault competition to the heart of Makati City.

text: Una nang inakala ng marami na ang countdown na lumabas sa social media accounts ni Obiena ay para sa kaniyang pagreretiro, ngunit nilinaw niyang ito ay para sa isang malaking kumpetisyon na matagal na niyang pinaghandaan.
english: Initially, many thought that the countdown that appeared on Obiena's social media accounts was for his retirement, but he clarified that it was for a big competition that he had been preparing for a long time.

text: Ang torneo ay opisyal na kinikilala ng World Athletics, Asian Athletics, at ng PATAFA (Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association), at inaasahang magpapakita ng world-class performances mula sa mga pinakamagagaling sa larangan ng pole vault.
english: The tournament is officially recognized by World Athletics, Asian Athletics, and PATAFA (Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association), and is expected to showcase world-class performances from the best in the field of pole vault.

text: Bagama’t hindi pa inilalabas ang kompletong listahan ng mga kalahok, tiniyak ni Obiena na inaanyayahan nila ang mga top-ranked international athletes, kasunod ng World Championships.
english: Although the complete list of events has not yet been released, Obiena assured that they are inviting top-ranked international athletes, following the World Championships.

text: Inaasahan ding maaaring masungkit ang bagong national o kahit world record sa nasabing paligsahan.
english: The winners are expected to set a new national or even world record in the said competition.

text: Si Obiena mismo ang sasabak para sa Pilipinas, at umaasa siyang ang event na ito ay magsisilbing inspirasyon sa mga kabataang Pilipino upang mas lumawak pa ang interes sa pole vault at athletics sa bansa.
english: Obiena himself will compete for the Philippines, and he hopes that this event will serve as an inspiration to Filipino youth to expand their interest in pole vault and athletics in the country.

text: “Isa po ito sa mga pangarap kong natupad ang maibalik ang world-class athletics sa harap ng mga Pilipino,” ani Obiena.
english: “It's one of my dreams to bring world-class athletics back to the Filipinos,” Obiena said.

text:
Ginsumite na sang prosekusyon sa International Criminal Court (ICC) ang 139 nga mga ebidensya batok kay anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte tuhoy sa kaso nga crimes against humanity kasunod sang kontrobersyal nga ‘war on drugs’

Suno sa dokumento, ginsumite ni ICC Prosecutor Karim Khan ang ebidensya sang Abril 30 sa ICC Pre-Trial Chamber 1 kun sa diin natunga ini sa apat ka kategorya.
english:
The prosecution has submitted to the International Criminal Court (ICC) 139 pieces of evidence against former President Rodrigo Duterte in connection with the case of crimes against humanity following the controversial 'war on drugs'

According to the document, ICC Prosecutor Karim Khan submitted the evidence on April 30 to the ICC Pre-Trial Chamber 1 where it was divided into four categories.

text: Una na nga gin pahayag sang datos sang gobyerno, nga yara sa 6,200 ang napatay sa anti-drug operations sa Duterte administration.
english: Earlier, government data showed that 6,200 people were killed in anti-drug operations under the Duterte administration.

text: Apang suno sa mga human rights group, possible nga magalab-ot pa ini sa 30,000 ang numero bangud sa mga indi pa naplastar nga kaso.
english: However, according to human rights groups, it is possible that the number will reach 30,000 due to pending cases.

text: “Maayo man madayon, maayo man kon indi.” Ini ang nangin sentyemento sang pila ka mga vendors sa Iloilo Terminal Market sa posibilidad nga makasaylo sila kasunod sang padayon nga konstruksyon sang pasilidad.
english: “It's good to go, it's good not to.” This is the sentiment of some vendors in the Iloilo Terminal Market on the possibility that they will be able to move following the ongoing construction of the facility.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Oque Gascon, Presidente sang Terminal Market Vendors Association, iya ginpahayag nga excited ang pila ka mga vendors sa pagpasalig sang city government nga sila ang makasaylo sa bulan sang Mayo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Oque Gascon, President of the Terminal Market Vendors Association, said some vendors are excited about the city government's assurance that they will be able to move in May.

text: Suno kay Gascon, pila sa mga vendors ang nagapanghakroy sa ila nga sitwasyon subong, ilabi na kon mag-inulan-ulan.
english: According to Gascon, some of the vendors are complaining about their current situation, especially when it rains.

text: Gipahayag man sini nga lakip sa mga problema nga ginapalab-ot sa ila amo ang indi maagwantahan nga pagkinawatay sa merkado.
english: He also said that among the problems brought to them is the unbearable theft in the market.

text: Una nga nagpasalig presidente sang Iloilo Terminal Market nga ang Market Police ang nagalibot sa merkado agud nga mapabilin nga hilway ini sa kawatan.
english: Earlier, the president of the Iloilo Terminal Market assured that the Market Police are patrolling the market to keep it free from thieves.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang damlag lang man, gin-isdog ang pila ka fish vendors sa amo nga merkado kasunod sang himuon nga sewerage treatment plan.
english: It was learned that recently, some fish vendors in the market were arrested following the sewerage treatment plan.

text: Madumduman nga una nagpahayag ang Chief sang Local Economic Enterprise Office nga si Maricel Mabaquiao nga medyo na-delay ang paghuman sa merkado bangud sa pagkuha sang mga materyales apang posible nga sa bulan sang Mayo mabuksan kag magamit.
english: It can be recalled that the Chief of the Local Economic Enterprise Office, Maricel Mabaquiao, earlier said that the completion of the market was slightly delayed due to the acquisition of materials but it is possible that it will be opened and used in May.

text: “My power’s really low, so this may be the last image I can send.
english: “My power’s really low, so this may be the last image I can send.

text:
Don’t worry about me though: my time here has been both productive and serene.”

Ini na ang posible katapusan nga mensahe nga napadala sang InSight lander sang National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) halin sa Mars.
english:
Don’t worry about me though: my time here has been both productive and serene.”

This is likely the last message sent by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) InSight lander from Mars.

text: “If I can keep talking to my mission team, I will – but I’ll be signing off here soon.
english: “If I can keep talking to my mission team, I will – but I’ll be signing off here soon.

text: Thanks for staying with me,” pahayag pa sang InSight, ukon Interior Exploration Using Seismic Investigations, Geodesy and Heat Transport sa kumpleto nga pangalan.
english: Thanks for staying with me,” said InSight, or Interior Exploration Using Seismic Investigations, Geodesy and Heat Transport in its full name.

text: 2018 sang gin-launch ang InSight para sa isa ka history-making mission sa “inner space” sang Red Planet — buot silingon, tun-an sini ang rust, mantle, kag core sang Mars.
english: 2018 when InSight was launched for a history-making mission to the Red Planet’s “inner space” — that is, it will study the rust, mantle, and core of Mars.

text: Ini nga craft ang nagalaba sang halos 20 ka tapak, kag nagabug-at sang halos 800 pounds.
english: This craft is nearly 20 feet long, and weighs nearly 800 pounds.

text: Sa una sini nga Mars year nga katumbas sang halos duha ka ka tuig sa Earth, nalab-ot sini ang madamo nga target sang iya nga mission rason nga gin-extend pa gid ini tubtub sa 2022.
english: In its first Mars year, which is equivalent to nearly two years on Earth, it has achieved many of the targets of its mission, which is why it has been extended until 2022.

text: Ang nagapanguna nga mission sini amo ang paggamit sang instrumento nga ginatawag nga seismometer agud nga ma-track ang Marsquakes.
english: Its main mission is to use an instrument called a seismometer in order to track Marsquakes.

text: Ginapahayag nga antes pa man ang Insight mission, wala pa sang ideya ang scientists nga may yara sang nagakatabo nga Marsquakes.
english: Allegedly, even before the Insight mission, scientists had no idea that Marsquakes were occurring.

text: Sa amo nga rason, ang InSight ang ginakabig una nga naka-detect sang quakes sa lain nga planeta.
english: For that reason, InSight is considered the first to detect quakes on a different planet.

text: Dugang pa diri, naka-measure ini sang masobra 1,300 ka seismic events.
english: In addition, it has measured more than 1,300 seismic events.

text: Suno sa NASA, ini nga findings ang naghatag sa scientists sang bag-o nga ideya sa composition kag structure sang layers sa Mars kag amo ang nagpadalom pa sang ila nga paghangop sa geologic history sang surface sang Mars kag sa abilidad sini nga maka-support sa kabuhi.
english: According to NASA, these findings have given scientists new ideas about the composition and structure of the layers on Mars and have deepened their understanding of the geologic history of the Martian surface and its ability to support life.

text: Ang iban pa nga ginadumdum nga kontribusyon sang InSight amo ang pagkarga sang first-ever magnetometer instrument sa surface sang Mars (agud nga maka-detect sang magnetic signals) kag ang pagkolekta sang pinaka-komprehensibo nga weather data out sang tanan nga mission nga ginpadala didto.
english: Other remembered contributions of InSight include loading the first-ever magnetometer instrument on the surface of Mars (in order to detect magnetic signals) and collecting the most comprehensive weather data out of all the missions sent there.

text: Naka-detect man ini sang magnitude 4 quake sang May 2022 nga suno sa scientists, gintuga sang isa ka meteoroid strike.
english: It also detected a magnitude 4 quake in May 2022 that scientists say was caused by a meteoroid strike.

text: Bangud sini, nadiskubre sang Mars orbiter ang layer sang water ice nga nalubong underground.
english: As a result, the Mars orbiter discovered a layer of water ice buried underground.

text:
Gintawag sang NASA ang serye sini nga events bilang “icy bonanza.”

‘MY POWER IS REALLY LOW’

Mayo pa lang subong nga tuig, nagpaandam na ang project officials nga posible indi na maka-operate ang lander sa katapusan sang 2022 bangud sang nagtipon nga yab-ok sa iya nga solar panels rason nga nagakadula na ang power source.
english:
NASA called this series of events an “icy bonanza.”

‘MY POWER IS REALLY LOW’

Earlier this year, project officials warned that the lander may not be able to operate by the end of 2022 due to the accumulation of dust on its solar panels causing the loss of power source.

text: Sang November, nagpahayag ang NASA nga nagahilapit na ang katapusan kag gin-amat amat na tapos ang mission.
english: In November, NASA announced that the end was near and the mission was phased out.

text: Sa Twitter, regular man ini nga naga-update sa 800,000 sini ka followers.
english: On Twitter, he also regularly updates his 800,000 followers.

text: Lakip sa mga update sini ang new discoveries, promisa nga magapadayon sa pag-operate kun masarangan pa sini, pagpahayag nga nagahilapit na ang iya nga retirement, kag tributes sa “friends” nga iya natipon sa mission.
english: His updates include new discoveries, a promise to continue operating if he can, an announcement that his retirement is approaching, and tributes to the “friends” he made during the mission.

text: Ang katapusan sini nga update amo ang picture sang rocky surface kag horizon line sa Mars.
english: The last of this update is a picture of the rocky surface and horizon line on Mars.

text: Naggamit ang mga pulis sa Italya sang specially adapted Lamborghini supercar agud madul-ong ang duha ka kidneys sa mga nagakinahanglan nga pasyente sa duha ka separado nga ospital.
english: Police in Italy used a specially adapted Lamborghini supercar to deliver the two kidneys to needy patients in two separate hospitals.

text: Ginsapubliko sang otoridad ang picture sang medical cool box sa purpose-built compartment sa atubang sang Lamborghini Huracán.
english: Authorities released a picture of the medical cool box in the purpose-built compartment in front of the Lamborghini Huracán.

text:
Pahayag sang Italian Police: “Travelling on the motorway to deliver the most beautiful Christmas present: life!”

Dugang pa sini, “Thanks to the State Police’s special Father Christmas, two people have received the gift of a kidney.”

Gin-deliver ang organs halin sa Padua sa norteast sang Italy padulong sa ospital sa Modena kag sa Rome.
english:
Italian Police statement: “Travelling on the motorway to deliver the most beautiful Christmas present: life!”

It added, “Thanks to the State Police’s special Father Christmas, two people have received the gift of a kidney.”

The organs were delivered from Padua in northeastern Italy to hospitals in Modena and Rome.

text: Ang gingamit nga Lamborghini Huracan ang gin-regalo lang sang luxury carmaker sa pulis sang 2017.
english: The used Lamborghini Huracan was only gifted to the police in 2017 by the luxury carmaker.

text: May top speed ini nga 300kmh (190mph).
english: It has a top speed of 300kmh (190mph).

text: Assigned ini sa Bologna, northern Italy, para sa normal police operations kag sa urgent nga transport sang dugo kag organs.
english: It is assigned to Bologna, northern Italy, for normal police operations and the urgent transport of blood and organs.

text: May yara man sang isa pa ka Huracan nga gina-operate sang highway patrol sa Rome, samtang ang 2009 Lamborghini Gallardo naman nga gingamit man anay sang pulis ang yara na subong sa isa ka museum.
english: There is also another Huracan operated by the highway patrol in Rome, while the 2009 Lamborghini Gallardo that was also used by the police is now in a museum.

text: Ginpangkakas ang pila ka senior citizens sa Brgy.
english: Some senior citizens in Brgy.

text: Rizal Pala-Pala Uno, Iloilo City Proper bilang benepisyaryo sang cash for senior citizens bangud sa ginapahayag sa ila pagsuporta sa ‘political rivals’.
english: Rizal Pala-Pala Uno, Iloilo City Proper as beneficiaries of cash for senior citizens due to their alleged support for political rivals.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Perlita Detablan, Senior Citizen President sang nasambit nga barangay, iya ginpahayag nga sa ila bahin, wala pa sang may nakala-ot nga reklamo nahanungod sa pagpangkakas sang ila katapo bangud sa ginapahayag pagpakita sang suporta sa team USWAG ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Perlita Detablan, Senior Citizen President of the said barangay, said that on their part, no complaints have been received regarding the dismissal of their members for allegedly showing support to team USWAG by Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas.

text: Suno kay Detablan, gilayon man nga ginapahibalo sa iya kon may mga senior citizens nga ginapangkakas ukon ginadugang sa amo nga cash for senior citizens.
english: According to Detablan, he is also immediately informed if there are senior citizens who are removed or added to the cash for senior citizens.

text: Gintumod man sini nga santo sa iya nabatian nga mga reports, kalabanan sa reklamo amo ang ginapahayag nagapadulong sa ila punong barangay nga magpalista, apang kon indi kaalyado sang punong barangay, wala sini ginadala bilang benipesyaryo.
english: He also pointed out that based on the reports he heard, most of the complaints are allegedly going to their barangay captain to register, but if not an ally of the barangay captain, he does not bring as a beneficiary.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga wala sang pagpanagtaganay sang cash assistance subong nga adlaw, baliskad man sa nagalapta nga impormasyon sa ila mga katapo.
english: He also clarified that there was no distribution of cash assistance today, contrary to the information spreading among their members.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang cash assistance ang kabahin sang Expanded Centenarians Act of 2024 kun sa diin ang octogenarians ukon 80 tubtob 85-anyos kag nonagenarians ukon 90 tubtob 95-anyos ang nagabaton sang P10,000, samtang ang mga centenarians ukon 100-anyos ang nagabaton sang P100,000.
english: The cash assistance is part of the Expanded Centenarians Act of 2024 where octogenarians or 80 to 85-year-olds and nonagenarians or 90 to 95-year-olds receive P10,000, while centenarians or 100-year-olds receive P100,000.

text: Una na nga nagpabutyag sang pagkabalaka ang Iloilo City government sa isa ka palaabuton nga cash payout event sa Pebrero 28, nga ginreport nga gin-organisar ni Iloilo City lone District Rep.
english: Earlier, the Iloilo City government expressed concern over an upcoming cash payout event on February 28, reportedly organized by Iloilo City lone District Rep.

text: Julienne “Jam-Jam” Baronda nga wala sang nagakaigo nga koordinasyon sa opisina ni Mayor Treñas.
english: Julienne “Jam-Jam” Baronda that there is no proper coordination with Mayor Treñas' office.

text: Nabaton na man sang National Commission of Senior Citizens ang sulat nga ginpadala sang Iloilo City government sa amo nga talatapan naangot sa ginaalegar pagpangkakas sang mga senior citizen bilang benepisyaryo.
english: The National Commission of Senior Citizens has also received the letter sent by the Iloilo City government to the office regarding the alleged removal of senior citizens as beneficiaries.

text: Suno kay Ms. Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginapahayag nga indi ini ang una nga kahigayunan nga natabo bangud makapila na man ka beses nga nabatian sang talatapan ang amo nga reklamo.
english: According to Ms. Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, said this is not the first time that this has happened because the office has heard the same complaint several times.

text: Dugang ni Fantilaga, ang Brgy.
english: Fantilaga added that Brgy.

text: Rizal Pala-Pala Uno lang gid ang nangisog nga magpalab-ot sang ila concern sa city government.
english: Only Rizal Pala-Pala Uno dared to convey their concern to the city government.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga indi luyag sang alkalde nga magamit sa pamulitika ang cash gift sang senior citizens.
english: He also explained that the mayor does not want the cash gift of senior citizens to be used for politics.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sang natungdan nga ang grant sa cash for senior citizens ang naghalin sa pagpanguna ni Iloilo City lone District Rep.
english: He also revealed that the cash grant for senior citizens came from the leadership of Iloilo City lone District Rep.

text: Julienne “Jam-Jam” Baronda.
english: Julienne “Clock-Clock” Baronda.

text: Gintumod man ni Fantilaga nga santo sa guidelines, dapat nagakoordinar kontani sila sa Local Government Unit ukon LGU apang ang nagakatabo, nagaderetso sila sa mga kabarangayan.
english: Fantilaga also pointed out that according to the guidelines, they should be coordinating with the Local Government Unit or LGU but what is happening is that they are going straight to the barangays.

text: Nag-deploy na ang militar sang Thailand sang warships kag helicopters agud pangitaon ang 33 ka mga marino nga na-missing matapos naglugdang ang warship nga may sakay nga masobra 100 ka mga crew sa Gulf of Thailand.
english: The Thai military has deployed warships and helicopters to search for 33 sailors who went missing after a warship carrying more than 100 crew sank in the Gulf of Thailand.

text: Suno sa Thai Navy, matapos naglugdang ang His Thai Majesty’s Ship Sukhothai, 75 pa lang ka sailors ang natigayon nga na-rescue.
english: According to the Thai Navy, after His Thai Majesty's Ship Sukhothai sank, only 75 sailors were rescued.

text: Magluwas sa search operation,may ginpatigayon man nga imbestigasyon kun ano ang rason sang insidente.
english: Besides the search operation, an investigation was also conducted into the cause of the incident.

text: May video ang Navy kun sa diin makit-an ang crew members nga napangputos sa mga habol, ginabulong, samtang gin-airlift naman ang iban pakadto sa ospital.
english: The Navy has video showing crew members wrapped in blankets, being treated, while others were airlifted to hospital.

text: Santo sa inisyal nga impormasyon gikan sa Navy, una nga nasudlan sang tubig ang hull sang barko kag na-short-circuit ang power room.
english: According to initial information from the Navy, the hull of the ship was first flooded and the power room was short-circuited.

text: Bangud nadulaan na sang kuryente, nadulaan man ang crew sang kontrol sa barko tubtub nga dalayon nga naglugdang.
english: Because of the loss of power, the crew also lost control of the ship until it immediately sank.

text: Nahibaluan nga naga-patrol ang barko 32 kilometros east sang Bang Saphan sa Prachuap Khiri Khan province sang naalangan ini bangud sa bagyo.
english: The ship was patrolling 32 kilometers east of Bang Saphan in Prachuap Khiri Khan province when it was delayed by the typhoon.

text: Tatlo ka naval ships kag helicopters ang ginpadala agud nga maghatag assistance apang warship His Thai Majesty’s Ship Kraburi lamang ang nakalab-ot sa vessel antes ini dalayon nga naglugdang.
english: Three naval ships and helicopters were sent to provide assistance but only the warship His Thai Majesty's Ship Kraburi reached the vessel before it immediately sank.

text: Ini nga HTMS Sukhothai ang gintukod sa Estados Unidos para sa Thai Navy sang mid-1980s.
english: This HTMS Sukhothai was built in the United States for the Thai Navy in the mid-1980s.

text: ILOILO – Wala pa sa gihapon napasakaan ang kaso ang suspek nga nagluthang-patay sa manugbantay sang pantatan sa Sitio Bulod 2 Barangay Pulao, Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: ILOILO – The suspect who shot dead the guard of the pier in Sitio Bulod 2 Barangay Pulao, Dumangas, Iloilo has not yet been charged.

text: Ang biktima amo si Jomarie Torres, 32, residente sang Barangay Cabilauan, Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo.
english: The victim was identified as Jomarie Torres, 32, resident of Barangay Cabilauan, Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Kenn Albert Lepsia, hepe sang Dumangas Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga yara pa sa kasubo ang pamilya sang biktima rason nga wala pa ang mga ini nakapasaka sang kaso.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Kenn Albert Lepsia, chief of the Dumangas Municipal Police Station, said the victim's family is still in mourning and has not yet filed a case.

text: Suno kay Lepsia, isa pa lang ang ila witness sa kaso nga makabulig sa pagsolbar sa krimen.
english: Lepsia said they have only one witness in the case who can help solve the crime.

text: Matandaan nga gintuad sang mga residente sa lugar nga may nabatian sila nga lupok sang ‘las 11 sang gab-i sang Pebrero 9, apang hapon na sang Pebrero 10 nakit-an ang lawas sini sang nagbisita ang utod sang tag-iya sang pantatan.
english: It can be recalled that residents in the area confessed that they heard gunshots at 11 pm on February 9, but the body was found on the afternoon of February 10 when the brother of the owner of the pier visited.

text: Nahibaluan nga nag-inom-inom pa ang biktima sa balay sang tag-iya sang pantatan nga ginabulubanta 300 metros ang kalayuon sa payag inoras antes nagluntad ang insidente.
english: It was learned that the victim was drinking at the house of the owner of the pentatan, which is about 300 meters away from the hut, hours before the incident.

text: Walo ka gunshot wounds ang naagum sang biktima nga igo sang 12 gauge shot gun.
english: The victim sustained eight gunshot wounds from a 12 gauge shot gun.

text: -𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗣𝗵𝗮𝘂𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝗣𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗿𝗮
english: -Advanced 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗣𝗵𝗮𝘂𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝗣𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗿𝗮

text: Wala nakatambong sa ginpatawag nga imbestigasyon sang Land Transportation Office (LTO)ang vlogger nga si Yanna.
english: Vlogger Yanna did not attend the investigation convened by the Land Transportation Office (LTO).

text: Ginpatawag ang nasambit nga vlogger matapos ang pagka-involve niya sa road rage incident sa Zambales.
english: The vlogger was summoned after his involvement in a road rage incident in Zambales.

text: Sa baylo nga magtambong, ang abogado na lamang sini ang nag-atubang para sabton ang show cause order sang LTO.
english: Instead of attending, only his lawyer appeared to answer the show cause order of the LTO.

text: Ginpahayag ang iya nga legal counsel nga ginpakamaayo sang iya nga kliyente nga si Alyana Mari Aguinaldo nga indi magtambong bangud sa iya pagkabalaka para sa iya nga seguridad.
english: His legal counsel, Alyana Mari Aguinaldo, said he was blessed not to attend because of her concern for her security.

text: Gin-alegar nga nakabaton ini sang pamahog sa kabuhi humalin sang naglapta ang nasambit nga video.
english: She has allegedly received death threats since the video went viral.

text: Sa iya nga ginpadala nga sulat sa LTO, nagpangayo ini sang pasaylo sa driver sang pick-up kag mangin sa pamilya sini kag sa mga tawo nga naapektuhan sa iya nga batasan.
english: In a letter sent to the LTO, he apologized to the driver of the pick-up and also to his family and the people affected by his behavior.

text: Handa man ini nga batunon ang ano man nga silot nga idagdag batok sa iya sang LTO.
english: He is also ready to accept any punishment imposed against him by the LTO.

text: Ginpahayag ni LTO chief Atty. Vigor Mendoza, nga ginmanduan niya ang abogado ni Yanna nga isurrender ang driver’s license matapos nga inisyal na gindagdagan siya sang 90-day preventive suspension samtang padayon ang imbestigasyon.
english: LTO chief Atty. Vigor Mendoza, who ordered Yanna's lawyer to surrender her driver's license after she was initially given a 90-day preventive suspension while the investigation continues.

text: Sa masunod nga hearing sa Mayo 8 , indi lang ang lisensya sini ang ginapa-surrender kag mangin ang motorsiklo nga gin-gamit nga wala nakarehistro sa iya nga pangalan sang nagluntad ang insidente.
english: In the next hearing on May 8, not only his license will be surrendered but also the motorcycle used that was not registered in his name when the incident occurred.

text: Matandaan nga ginlutsan sang vlogger ang pick-up driver samtang yara sila sa lubak-lubak nga dalan sa Zambales kag matapos nga ginlutsan, ginhatagan pa niya sang ‘dirty finger’ ang driver bag-o ginkompronta.
english: It can be recalled that the vlogger assaulted the pick-up driver while they were on a bumpy road in Zambales and after assaulting him, he gave the driver a dirty finger before confronting him.

text: Mismo ang kaupdanan ni Yanna ang nangayo sang pasaylo sa driver sang amo nga tion samtang wala naman nag-sorry ang babaye nga vlogger.
english: Yanna's companion himself apologized to the driver at the time while the female vlogger did not apologize.

text: Nangin mas malala pa kag nangin mas matunog ang warning nga ginpaguwa sang Iran batok sa mga residente nga nagapasakop sa nationwide protests.
english: Iran's warning against residents participating in nationwide protests has become even worse and louder.

text: Sa atubang mismo sang publiko, ginpatay ang isa ka 23-anyos nga lalaki nga si Majidreza Rahnavard nga ginapahayag nagbuno sa duha ka myembro sang paramilitary force bangud sa iya kaakig sa security forces nga nagapangpatay sa protesters.
english: In front of the public, a 23-year-old man named Majidreza Rahnavard was killed for allegedly stabbing two members of the paramilitary force because of his anger at the security forces killing protesters.

text: Ginsapubliko man ang mga laragway sang public execution kun sa diin nakit-an ang isa lalaki nga nakahigot ang kamot kag ginbitay sa construction crane.
english: Photos of the public execution were also made public where a man was seen with his hands tied and hung from a construction crane.

text: Nakamaskara ang security forces nga nag-kordon sa lugar kun sa diin ginpatigayon ang public execution samtang may mga tawo man nga nagalantaw apang may yara sang mga barikada.
english: Masked security forces cordoned off the area where the public execution was held while there were people watching but there were barricades.

text: Ikaduha na si Rahnavard sa mga preso nga ginpatay bangud sa kahilabtanan sa protesta.
english: Rahnavard is the second prisoner to be executed in connection with the protest.

text: Ang una amo ang 23-anyos man nga si Mohsen Shekari nga ginpatay sang nagligad nga Huwebes bangud sa pag-atake sini kag pagpilas sa isa ka miyembro sang Basij paramilitary force sa central Tehran.
english: The first was 23-year-old Mohsen Shekari who was killed last Thursday for allegedly attacking and wounding a member of the Basij paramilitary force in central Tehran.

text: Tuyo sang public execution nga ipakita sa publiko kun ano kadasig ang ginahimo sang Iranian judiciary sa mga kaso nga naangot sa protesta.
english: The public execution aims to show the public how quickly the Iranian judiciary is handling cases related to the protests.

text: Nagpaandam man ang iban nga mga aktibista nga dinosena na sa ila ang nasentensyaha sang kamatayon sa closed-door hearings.
english: Other activists also warned that dozens of them have already been sentenced to death in closed-door hearings.

text: Ginapahayag 488 na ka tawo ang ginpangpatay halin sang ginpatigayon ang demonstrations sa tunga-tunga sang bulan sang September suno sa Human Rights Activists sa Iran.
english: Human rights activists in Iran have reportedly killed 488 people since the demonstrations began in mid-September.

text: Present ang tanan nga elemento sang cyber libel nga ginpasaka ni Buenavista, Guimaras Vice Mayor Cyril Beltran batok kay Sangguniang Bayan Member Vincent Pascal De Asis.
english: All elements of the cyber libel filed by Buenavista, Guimaras Vice Mayor Cyril Beltran against Sangguniang Bayan Member Vincent Pascal De Asis are present.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Jose Recsan Tormon, Abogado ni Vice Mayor Beltran, iya ginpahayag nga nag-ugat ang indi pag-intindihanay sang duha sa nangin komento ni De Asis post ni Beltran sang 2022.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Jose Recsan Tormon, Vice Mayor Beltran's lawyer, said the misunderstanding between the two stemmed from De Asis's comments on Beltran's post in 2022.

text: Suno kay Tormon, ang post ang nagaunod sang picture nga nagabayaw sa kamot ni Guimaras Vice Governor John Edward Gando.
english: According to Tormon, the post contained a picture of Guimaras Vice Governor John Edward Gando raising his hand.

text: Sa amo nga tion board member pa lang si Beltran.
english: Beltran was still a board member at the time.

text: Gintuad man sini nga nakasaad sa komento ni De Asis nga ginatawag sini nga kawatan si Beltran bangud sa alegasyon sa isa ka purenarya.
english: He also admitted that De Asis's comment stated that he called Beltran a thief because of the allegation of a purenarya.

text: Nagsabat naman ang bise-alkalde nga kon mapamatud-an sini ang iya alegasyon, gilayo siya nga maga-resign sa pwesto.
english: The vice-mayor replied that if he proves his allegation, he will resign immediately.

text: Gintunghuwaan man ni Atty. Tormon nga maistorya ang duha ka apang wala gid nahitsu ang indi pag-intindihanay.
english: He was also visited by Atty. Tormon said the two could talk but the misunderstanding was never resolved.

text: Nahibaluan nga Disyembre 2022 sang nagpasaka sang kaso si Beltran batok kay De Asis.
english: Beltran filed a case against De Asis in December 2022.

text: Sang damlag lang, ginpamatbatan sang Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 65 nga guilty sa kaso nga nga online libel si De Asis.
english: Recently, the Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 65 found De Asis guilty of online libel.

text: ILOILO CITY – Unanimously approved sang Indonesian lawmakers ang bag-o nga criminal code nga naga-criminalize sang pre-marital sex.
english: ILOILO CITY – Indonesian lawmakers unanimously approved a new criminal code that criminalizes pre-marital sex.

text: Ini ang lubos nga ginpamalabagan sang mga kritiko bangud nga nagalapas ini sang kinamatarong kag kahilwayan sa nasambit nga Southeast Asian country.
english: This was strongly opposed by critics because it violates rights and freedoms in the Southeast Asian country.

text: Sa amo nga layi nga naga-apply man sa mga foreign residents kag sa mga turista, ginadumilian man ang cohabitation ukon ang pag-updanay antes ang kasal, ang indi pagsunod sa religious ukon political belief ukon ang ginatawag nga apostasy.
english: The law, which also applies to foreign residents and tourists, also prohibits cohabitation or living together before marriage, non-compliance with religious or political beliefs or so-called apostasy.

text: Ini ang nagapina man sa mga maga-insulto sa presidente ukon sa mga magapabutyag sang opinyon batuk sa national ideology.
english: It also penalizes those who insult the president or those who express opinions against the national ideology.

text: Sang nagligad nga mga tinuig, nakita ang pagsaka sang religious conservatism sa pungsod nga ginakabig nga world’s largest Muslim-majority nation.
english: Recent years have seen a rise in religious conservatism in the country considered the world’s largest Muslim-majority nation.

text: Ang mga Islamic laws ang istrikto nga ginapatuman sa pila ka bahin sang pungsod lakip na sa semi-autonomous Aceh province kun sa diin, ang pag-inom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon kag ang pagsugal ang ginadumili-an.
english: Islamic laws are strictly enforced in some parts of the country including the semi-autonomous Aceh province where, drinking alcoholic beverages and gambling are prohibited.

text: Sa pila naman ka rehiyon sang pungsod, ginapangbakol sang stick ang mga nagakomiter sang homosexuality kag adultery.
english: In some regions of the country, those who commit homosexuality and adultery are beaten with sticks.

text: Ang ini nga mga pagbag-o ang ginalantaw sang travel industry representatives nga maga-apekto sa turismo sang pungsod.
english: These changes are expected by travel industry representatives to affect the country's tourism.

text: Gin-imbestigaran sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) ang tatlo ka mga nadakpan sa Sta.
english: The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) is investigating the three arrested in Sta.

text: Cruz, Laguna nga nagapakuno-kuno nga trabahador sang poll body.
english: Cruz, Laguna who pretended to be a poll body worker.

text: Ang mga nadakpan ang naggamit sang peke nga mga dokumento kag bisan ang ila nga mga salakyan ang may logo sang COMELEC.
english: The arrested used fake documents and even their vehicles had the COMELEC logo.

text: Kaangot diri, ang tatlo ang natukiban nga magpamilya.
english: Kaangot diri, ang tatlo ang natukiban nga magpamilya.

text: Suno kay Commission on Elections (COMELEC) Chairman George Erwin Garcia, gina-ako sang mga suspek nga empleyado sila sang task force Kontra-Bigay kag naga-inspeksyon sang isa ka eskwelahan sa Laguna kun sa diin may mga Automated Counting Machines (ACMs).
english: According to Commission on Elections (COMELEC) Chairman George Erwin Garcia, the suspects admitted that they were employees of the task force Kontra-Bigay and were inspecting a school in Laguna where there were Automated Counting Machines (ACMs).

text: Apang, ginklaro ni COMELEC Chairman Garcia, nga indi na task force ang Kontra-Bigay para sa palaabuton nga election, kundi isa na ka kumite, nga gilayun man ginkumpirmar nga indi empleyado sang COMELEC ang mga suspek.
english: However, COMELEC Chairman Garcia clarified that Kontra-Bigay is no longer a task force for the upcoming election, but a committee, which immediately confirmed that the suspects are not employees of the COMELEC.

text: Dugang pa ni COMELEC Chairman Garcia, nga isa ini ka dako nga problema nga posible magamit sa pagpanunto sang mga botante kag mga kandidato.
english: COMELEC Chairman Garcia added that this is a big problem that can be used to mislead voters and candidates.

text: Ginaklaro man ni Garcia sa publiko, nga kun magpadala man sang mga tinawo ang COMELEC Main Office, maga-coordinate anay ini sa local COMELEC.
english: Garcia also clarified to the public that if the COMELEC Main Office sends personnel, it will first coordinate with the local COMELEC.

text: Sa kaso sang tatlo ka suspetsado, wala sang ihibalo ang ila Lokal nga opisyales.
english: In the case of the three suspects, their local officials were unaware.

text: Ginpasalig man ni Garcia nga magapangatubang sang kaso nga ‘usurpation of authority kag falsification of public documents’ ang tatlo ka suspek.
english: Garcia also assured that the three suspects will face charges of usurpation of authority and falsification of public documents.

text: Ano ang imo ma-bida-bida nga adventure sa imo edad subong?
english: What adventure would you star in at your age now?

text: Basi pirdehon kag sang isa ka 102-anyos nga Lola nga “extra na extra” gid ang ginhimo kadungan sang iya kaadlawan sang nagligad gid lamang nga Agusto 25!
english: Maybe a 102-year-old grandmother who did “extra na extra” on her birthday last August 25 will lose!

text: Ini nga centenarian amo si Manette Baillie, kasado sa isa ka paratrooper, kag naka-serbe anay sa Women’s Royal Navy Service sang World War II.
english: This centenarian was Manette Baillie, married to a paratrooper, and having served in the Women’s Royal Navy Service during World War II.

text: Wala sang kahadlok si Lola nga nag-skydive sa Suffolk, England kag matapos nakumpleto ang 7,000 ka tapak ukon 2133-meter jump, siya na ang ginakilala nga oldest skydiver sang Britanya!
english: Lola fearlessly skydived in Suffolk, England and after completing a 7,000-foot or 2133-meter jump, she is now recognized as Britain's oldest skydiver!

text: Apang wala niya ini ginhimo para lamang sa titulo.
english: But he didn't do it just for the title.

text: Kadungan sang amo nga challenge, ang iya natipon nga pondo nga $13,000 ang magakadto sa iya paborito nga mga charity sa nagkalain-lain nga United Kingdom.
english: In parallel with that challenge, her raised funds of $13,000 will go to her favorite charities in various United Kingdom.

text: Lakip sa iya ginpili nga charities amo ang East Anglian Air Ambulance nga amo anay ang nagluwas sa kabuhi sang iya anak nga lalaki sang naaksidente ini sa salakyan sang 1969.
english: Among her chosen charities is the East Anglian Air Ambulance which previously saved her son’s life when he was involved in a car accident in 1969.

text: Indi lamang pamilya kag mga abyan ang nagbantay kag nagpalakpak sa nahimo sang Lola bangud mangin ang mga miyembro sang Royal Family ang nakakilala sa iya kag bilib gid sa iya abilidad.
english: Not only family and friends watched and applauded the grandmother's achievement because even members of the Royal Family knew her and admired her ability.

text: Lakip sa nagtamyaw sa iya amo si Prince William (nga amo ang masunod nga hari sang Britanya) nga nagpadala sang iya mensahe kaupod sa iya asawa nga si Princess Catherine ukon si Kate Middleton.
english: Among those who greeted him was Prince William (who was the next king of Britain) who sent his message along with his wife Princess Catherine or Kate Middleton.

text: Indi man ini ang una nga tion nga may thrill kag challenge nga ginsudlan ang Lola sa iya kaadlawan bangud sang nagselebrar siya sang iya 100th birthday, nagmaneno ini sang race car sa official track sang British Grand Prix kun sa diin nakalab-ot ini sa 130 miles per hour.
english: This is not the first time that Lola has been thrilled and challenged on her birthday because when she celebrated her 100th birthday, she drove a race car on the official track of the British Grand Prix where it reached 130 miles per hour.

text: Sang ginpamangkot sa iya panugyan sa mga bataon pa, ginsiling sang Lola nga dapat mangin busy gid pirme, mangin interesado sa madamo nga bagay, magpabilin nga mabuot sa mga tawo sa palibot, kag labaw sa tanan, indi gid magkalipat nga mag-“party” para maglawig ang kabuhi.#
english: When asked about her advice to the younger generation, Lola said to always be busy, be interested in many things, stay kind to the people around you, and above all, never forget to “party” to prolong life.#

text: Tatlo ka incumbent lawmakers kag isa ka former representative halin sa Iloilo ang ginlakip sa alegasyon sang ex-Marines nga ila gindul-ungan sang mga maleta nga may unod sang kuwarta.
english: Three incumbent lawmakers and a former representative from Iloilo were included in the allegation by the ex-Marines that they delivered suitcases containing money.

text: Sa affidavit sang ex-marines, ila ginpahayag nga ginsugo sila nga mag-escort kag mag-deliver sang lain-lain nga kadakuon sang mga maleta sa mga kongresista.
english: In the affidavit of the ex-marines, they said they were ordered to escort and deliver different sizes of suitcases to the congressmen.

text:
Lakip sa ila nga ginhingadlan amo sanday:

* Iloilo City Lone District Rep.
english:
Among those named were:

* Iloilo City Lone District Rep.

text: Julienne ‘Jamjam’ Baronda* Uswag Ilonggo Rep.
english: Julienne ‘Jamjam’ Baronda* Uswag Ilonggo Rep.

text: Jojo Ang* Iloilo 1st District Rep.
english: Jojo Ang* Iloilo 1st District Rep.

text: Janette Garin* Former Kabataan Partylist Rep.
english: Janette Garin* Former Kabataan Partylist Rep.

text:
Raoul Manuel

“Nautusan din kami na mag-escort at mag-deliver ng iba’t-ibang laki ng maleta sa mga congressmen/women na naaalala namin sa ngayon dahil sila ang napapanood namin minsan sa telebisyon o palagi namin silang nakikita pag nakakausap sila ni Zaldy Co,” suno pa sa affidavit.
english:
Raoul Manuel

“We were also ordered to escort and deliver different sizes of suitcases to the congressmen/women that we remember now because they are the ones we watch sometimes on television or we always see them when they talk to Zaldy Co,” according to the affidavit.

text:
Dugang nila: “Nagdeliver kami mismo sa bahay ng ilan, sa House of Representatives, at yong iba ay kinuha nila sa Unit 8 o Unit 9 ng Polo Club Townhouse, Forbes Park.”

Subong nga adlaw sang nagguwa ang alegasyon sang mga nagpakilala nga anay mga miyembro sang Philippine Marines nga naga-claim man nga nag-deliver sila sang ₱805 billion nga cash nga nakabutang sa maleta kanday President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english:
They added: “We delivered to the house of some, to the House of Representatives, and the others were picked up at Unit 8 or Unit 9 of the Polo Club Townhouse, Forbes Park.”

Today, when the allegation of former members of the Philippine Marines came out that they also claimed that they delivered ₱805 billion cash in a suitcase to President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: kag former House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: and former House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Base sa ila nga statements, ginbyahe ang kuwarta paagi sa van kag may yara man nga naggamit pa sila sang aircraft agud madul-ong ini sa designated locations.
english: Based on their statements, the money was transported by van and some even used an aircraft to deliver it to the designated locations.

text: Sa press conference kaina sa Club Filipino, gin-claim sang abogado nga si Levi Baligod nga ini nga ex-marines ang kaupdanan anay ni Master Sgt.
english: In a press conference yesterday at Club Filipino, lawyer Levi Baligod claimed that these ex-marines were former companions of Master Sgt.

text: Orly Guteza.
english: Orly Teasing.

text: Si Guteza amo ang kontrobersyal nga Senate whistleblower nga naga-claim nga nagserbe anay bilang security personnel ni anay Ako Bicol Rep.
english: Guteza is the controversial Senate whistleblower who claims to have served as a security personnel of former Ako Bicol Rep.

text: Zaldy Co.
english: Zaldy Co.

text:
‘ASAL MARITES, MGA TRAYDOR SA BAYAN’

Nagsabat naman si former Representative Manuel matapos nga gindalahig ang iya pangalan.
english:
‘ASAL MARITES, TRAITORS TO THE COUNTRY’

Former Representative Manuel responded after his name was involved.

text:
Gintawag sini ang former marines nga mga “asal marites.”

“Sinama ng 16 ex-Marines (plus one ex-army personnel and one army reservist) ang pangalan ko sa mga kongresista na tumanggap daw o nakinabang sa kikbak.
english:
It called the former marines “asalmaris.”

“Sixteen ex-Marines (plus one ex-army personnel and one army reservist) included my name among congressmen who allegedly accepted or benefited from the kikbak.

text: Nakakahiya itong former Marines at Army!
english: This former Marines and Army is a shame!

text: Mga asal marites!
english: Behavior sweaters!

text: Di na nga nila naipagtanggol ang mga dagat natin mula sa panghihimasok ng mga banyaga, tapos gumawa pa sila ng mga kwento para idamay ang mga anti-Duterte na hindi kurakot,” suno sa anay kongresista.
english: They can no longer protect our seas from foreign interference, and they make up stories to hurt the anti-Duterte who are not corrupt,” said the former congressman.

text: Ginpamangkot sini ang mga naglakip sa iya pangalan kun ngaa lunsay mga nagakontra sa mga Duterte ang ginapuntariya sa affidavit.
english: He asked those who included his name why all those who oppose the Dutertes are targeted in the affidavit.

text: “Gets na namin na si Marcos Jr ang hari ng kurapsyon sa bansa ngayon.
english: “We get that Marcos Jr. is the king of corruption in the country now.

text: Si Sara Duterte naman ang reyna.
english: Sara Duterte is the queen.

text: Pero bakit puro kalaban ng mga Duterte ang target ng affidavit nitong ex-Marines?
english: But why is the target of the affidavit of this ex-Marine all against the Dutertes?

text: Mga traydor sa bayan,” kabahin pa sang iya Facebook post.
english: Traitors to the people,” he wrote in his Facebook post.

text: Ginahulat naman ang mangin sabat sang tatlo ka kongresista kasunod sang sini nga alegasyon, kag iga-publish gilayon kun mangin available na.
english: The three congressmen's response to the allegation is awaited, and will be published as soon as it becomes available.

text:
DAPAT I-EVALUATE PAAGI SA LEGAL KAG INVESTIGATIVE PROCESS

Nagpagwa naman sang statement ang Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) kaangot sa kontrobersyal nga isyu nga naga-involve sang mga indibidwal nga nagalaragway sang ila kaugalingon bilang anay Philippine Marine Corps members.
english:
SHOULD BE EVALUATED THROUGH LEGAL AND INVESTIGATIVE PROCESS

The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) issued a statement regarding the controversial issue involving individuals who describe themselves as former Philippine Marine Corps members.

text: Suno sa AFP, ini nga alegasyon ang dapat nga i-evaluate paagi sa legal and investigative processes sa atubang sang competent authorities.
english: According to the AFP, this allegation should be evaluated through legal and investigative processes before the competent authorities.
