text: “The Filipino people deserve facts, and we urge all parties to allow lawful processes to take their course,” kabahin sang statement sang AFP.
english: “The Filipino people deserve facts, and we urge all parties to allow lawful processes to take their course,” the AFP said in a statement.

text: SA SUBONG mabudlay pa sa mga pumuluyo ang maghimo sang desisyon sa mga ginatugpo sa ila nga mga potensyal nga mga kandidato sa Mayo 2022 nga eleksyon, labi gid ang para sa pwesto sang Presidente kag Bise Presidente.
english: IT IS still difficult for the people to make a decision on their potential candidates in the May 2022 elections, especially for the posts of President and Vice President.

text: Luas sa pwesto sang Presidente kag Bise Presidente, halos pila pa lang gani ka bilog ang nagapabatyag sang ila huyog paagi sa mga interbyu kag pahayag sa tri-media samtang sa Oktubre 1-8, 2021 na ang pag-file sang kandidatura sa nasyonal kag lokal nga eleksyon.
english: Apart from the posts of President and Vice President, almost a few are still expressing their inclination through interviews and statements in tri-media while on October 1-8, 2021, the filing of candidacies for the national and local elections.

text: Pila sini sa ila mga bag-o nga nawong nga daw gintulod lang sa public scene sang ila mga supporter nga kinahanglan pa sing lubos nga makilala sang publiko.
english: Some of these are new faces who seem to have been pushed into the public scene by their supporters who still need to be fully recognized by the public.

text: Sa ila, kinahanglan pa sang mga botante mahibal-an kon ano bala ang nahimo kag mahimo nila para sa kaayuhan sang mga pumuluyo, kon ano ang ila pamatasan nga luyag nila, kag kon ano ang ila tindug sa mga isyu nga may kahilabtanan sa kaayuhan sang pungsod kag sang mga pumuluyo.
english: Among them, voters still need to know what has been done and can be done for the benefit of the people, what behavior they want, and what their position is on issues related to the welfare of the country and the people.

text: Indi ta man dale-dale mahusgaran ang mga nakilala na naton tungod may karibal na sila nga mga kandidato halin sa iban nga grupo political sa kaisipan kag balatygon sang mga botante, nga kinahanglan mabinag-binag gid sang mga pumuluyo sing maayo bag-o desidiran botohon ukon indi.
english: We should not be quick to judge those we have already met because they already have rival candidates from other political groups in the minds and feelings of voters, which the people must consider carefully before deciding to vote or not.

text: Labi na gid kay may leksyon na kita sa mga “fake” nga mga “suluguon sang banwa” nga nagaliwat ang pamatasan kon yara na sa poder.
english: Especially since we have learned a lesson from the “fake” “servants of the people” who change their behavior when they are in power.

text: Mas maalam naman sa karon ang aton mga pumuluyo tungod madamo na ang may mas mataas nga tinun-an.
english: Our people are smarter now because many have higher education.

text: Indi mo na mabakal ang ila boto.
english: You can’t buy their vote anymore.

text: Laban-laban kuhaon lang nila ang kwarta sang kandidato  apang ang ila gid luyag ang ila botohon.
english: Most of the time they will just take the candidate's money but they will vote for the one they really want.

text: Labi na gid kay mabudlay na karon mahibaluan sang kandidato kon sin-o ang imo ginboto tungod sa mga moderno na nga mga pahito sa pagbotohay.
english: Especially since it is now difficult for a candidate to know who you voted for because of modern voting techniques.

text: May exit polls pa gani nga maka-kwestyon kon gindayaan ukon wala ang inisipay sang boto.
english: There are even exit polls that can question whether or not the vote count was rigged.

text: May NGO man ang nagabulig sa pagpahibalo sang matuod nga mga resulta halin sa mga presinto.
english: There are also NGOs that help announce the real results from the polling stations.

text: Madasig man ang pag-inisipay agud mapunggan ang hungod nga pag-delay sang inisipay kag pagkawat sang mga ballot box agud islan ang kaundan sini.
english: Counting was also done quickly to prevent deliberate delays in counting and theft of ballot boxes to change their contents.

text: Todo gwardyado man ang mga presinto kag ang paglikaw sini sa hilway nga mga lugar sa mga poblacion kag kasubong nga mga lugar.
english: Polling stations are also fully guarded and their avoidance of free areas in poblacion and similar areas.

text:
***

Tungod nagapabilin pa ang impluwensya ni Presidente Duterte  admitido bisan sang political opposition ang kabakud sang iya mga kandidato.
english:
***

Because President Duterte's influence remains, even the political opposition admitted the strength of his candidates.

text: Kag kon may pamangkot man nga dapat sabton amo lang kon sin-o gid nga mga kandidato sa pihak nga kudal ang pwede makigsumpong sing maayo kontra sa sining mga kandidato ni Duterte.
english: And if there is a question that needs to be answered, it is just which candidates on the other side of the fence can fight well against these Duterte candidates.

text: Si Senador Manny Pacquao, sang iya ka-tandem para Bise Presidente kag mga kaupdanan sini bala, kon madayon gid man ang pagpihak sang PDP-Laban nga partido?
english: Senator Manny Pacquao, his tandem for Vice President and his colleagues, if the split of the PDP-Laban party continues?

text: Ukon ang mga kandidato sang coalition nga ISAMBAYAN nga ginaupdan sang Liberal Party kag pila pa ka grupo?
english: Or the candidates of the ISAMBAYAN coalition accompanied by the Liberal Party and several other groups?

text: Personal ta lang nga pagpati, mabakod seguro ang tandem ni Manila Mayor Isko Moreno para Presidente kag si VP Leni Robredo gihapon para Bise Presidente.
english: Our personal belief is that the tandem of Manila Mayor Isko Moreno for President and VP Leni Robredo for Vice President is probably strong.

text: Indi man ini pagpakanubo sa kay VP Robredo.
english: This is not to belittle VP Robredo.

text: Pagkilala lang ini sa realidad nga mas may winning edge si Mayor Isko, sa aton pagpati, ikumparar kay VP Leni.
english: This is just a recognition of the reality that Mayor Isko has more of a winning edge, in our belief, compared to VP Leni.

text: Katulad lang ini sa padayon nga pagdalagan ni anay Vice President Fernando Lopez sa iya pwesto para maseguro ang pagdaug sang ila grupo, nga natabo naman.
english: This is similar to former Vice President Fernando Lopez's continued run for office to ensure the victory of his group, which happened.

text: Kinahanglan ni Mayor Isko ang popularidad ni VP Leni sa iya baluarte sa Bicol Region agud makakuha daku nga boto dira.
english: Mayor Isko needs VP Leni's popularity in his stronghold in the Bicol Region to get big votes there.

text: Daku man nga bulig sa iya nga maka-tandem si VP Leni tungod sa phenomenal nga pagdaug sini sadto bilang asawa lang sang nagtaliwan nga DILG Secretary Jess Robredo.
english: It is also a big help to him that VP Leni can tandem because of her phenomenal victory as the wife of the late DILG Secretary Jess Robredo.

text: Matahum man ang pag-alagad niya bilang Bise Presidente bisan pa ginadid-an ini siya sang maayo nga obligasyon ni Presidente Duterte.
english: He also served well as Vice President despite being denied good obligations by President Duterte.

text: On the other hand, kinahanglan man ni VP Leni ang popularidad ni Mayor Isko sa iya baluarte sa Manila kag sa mga kabataan agud magdaug liwat upod sa ila grupo sa oposisyon.
english: On the other hand, VP Leni also needs Mayor Isko's popularity in his stronghold in Manila and among the children to win again with their opposition group.

text: Kag ano ayhan ang isa nila ka tagline sa sining kampanyahanay?
english: And what would be one of their taglines for this campaign?

text: Pwede seguro ang “Strong Rule of Law vs Strong Leader” sa away sang oposisyon sa strongman rule ni Presidente Duterte kag sang iya grupo sa PDP-Laban.
english: “Strong Rule of Law vs Strong Leader” is probably possible in the opposition's fight over the strongman rule of President Duterte and his group in the PDP-Laban.

text: Ano abe sa inyo?/PN
english: What do you think?/PN

text: Natapos na sang United Nations ang imbestigasyon angot sa mga alegasyon sang sekswal nga pang-abuso batok kay Karim Khan, ang prosecutor sang International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: The United Nations has concluded an investigation into allegations of sexual abuse against Karim Khan, the prosecutor of the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Ini ang ginpahayag sang presidency sang governing body sang korte.
english: This was announced by the presidency of the governing body of the court.

text: Suno sa nasambit nga opisina, magapadayon nga confidential ang resulta sang imbestigasyon samtang ini ang gina-review sang external panel of judicial experts.
english: According to the office, the results of the investigation will remain confidential while they are reviewed by an external panel of judicial experts.

text: Ginalauman nga magalab-ot sa tubtob 30 ka adlaw ang proseso sang pag-review sang panel antes pagadesisyonan ang masunod nga tikang.
english: The panel’s review process is expected to take up to 30 days before the next step is decided.

text: Matandaan nga nagpanaug anay sa iya pwesto si Khan samtang nagapadayon ang imbestigasyon.
english: It can be recalled that Khan had previously stepped down from his post while the investigation was ongoing.

text: Hugot man nga ginpanginwala sang ICC prosecutor ang tanan nga alegasyon batok sa iya.
english: The ICC prosecutor also strongly denied all allegations against him.

text: Ginmanduan na sang Office of the Ombudsman ang pila ka mataas nga opisyal sang gobyerno nga magsumiter sang ila counter-affidavit kasunod sang reklamo nga ginpasaka ni Senator Imee Marcos nga may kaangtanan sa pagdakop sang anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The Office of the Ombudsman has ordered several senior government officials to submit their counter-affidavits following a complaint filed by Senator Imee Marcos in connection with the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Ang mando sang Ombudsman ang naghalin sa hingyo ni Marcos nga imbestigaran ang papel sang mga opisyal sa pag-aresto kay Duterte sang International Police.
english: The Ombudsman's order stemmed from Marcos' request to investigate the role of officials in Duterte's arrest by the International Police.

text: Lakip sa mga ginmaduan sang counter-affidavit amo sanday Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla, CIDG Chief Maj.
english: Among those who were served with counter-affidavits were Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla, CIDG Chief Maj.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Nicolas Torre III, Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla, PNP Chief Gen.
english: Nicolas Torre III, Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla, PNP Chief Gen.

text: Rommel Marbil, kag Special Envoy for Transnational Crime Markus Lacanilao.
english: Rommel Marbil, and Special Envoy for Transnational Crime Markus Lacanilao.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ang Ombudsman nga ang kapaslawan sa pagsumiter sang counter-affidavit sa sulod sang napulo (10) ka adlaw halin sa pagbaton sang mando ang mangin basehan nga ginpabay-an sang mga nasambit nga opisyal ang ila katungdanan sa pagsabat kag ang preliminary investigation magapadayon bisan wala sila sang pahayag.
english: The Ombudsman also reminded that failure to submit a counter-affidavit within ten (10) days of receipt of the order will be grounds that the said officials neglected their duty to respond and the preliminary investigation will continue even if they do not have a statement.

text: Gin-athag man sang Ombudsman nga kinahanglan ilakip sang mga opisyal ang affidavit sang ila mga testigo kag iban pa nga mga dokumento nga magasuporta sang ila depensa.
english: The Ombudsman also clarified that officers need to include the affidavits of their witnesses and other documents that will support their defence.

text: Madumduman nga nagapanindugan ang mga nasambit nga mga opisyal nga wala sang sala ang gobyerno sa natabo nga pag-aresto kay Duterte kag ginpanginwala ang mga alegasyon sang “kidnapping” .
english: The officials insisted that the government was not guilty of Duterte's arrest and denied the allegations of kidnapping.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, si Duterte ang naga-edad na sang 80 anyos kag magapangatubang sang kaso nga crimes against humanity nga may kaangtanan sa iya “war on drugs” nga nagtuga sang kamatayon sang linibo ka mga indibidwal.
english: On the other hand, Duterte is now 80 years old and will face charges of crimes against humanity in connection with his “war on drugs” that has caused the deaths of thousands of individuals.

text: Gindagdagdan sang memorandum sang Iloilo City Schools Division agud indi anay makatudlo ang manunudlo nga ginpa-Bombo bangud wala naghatag sang exam sa iya mga estudyante sa Fort San Pedro National High School.
english: The memorandum of the Iloilo City Schools Division added that the teacher who was sent to Bombo for not giving an exam to his students at Fort San Pedro National High School will not be able to teach.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Ma.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Ma.

text: Luz Delos Reyes, Iloilo City Schools Division Superintendent, iya ginpahayag nga lain na lang anay nga manunudlo ang maga-handle sang iya subject nga ginatudlo-an samtang padayon ang imbestigasyon.
english: Luz Delos Reyes, Iloilo City Schools Division Superintendent, said another teacher will handle her subject while the investigation continues.

text: Suno kay Reyes, indi lang anay pagpa-atubang ang manunudlo sa mga estudyante agud indi ma-trauma ang mga kabataan.
english: According to Reyes, the teacher should not be allowed to face the students so that the children will not be traumatized.

text: Nagpabilin naman nga wala sang ‘formal administrative complaint’ nga ginpasaka sa ila sang nagpa-Bombo.
english: There was no formal administrative complaint filed against them by the Bombo.

text: Una na nga ginbuyagyag sang natungdan nga may report ang mga estudyante nga ginahambalan sila sang indi manami nga tinaga kag ginapahog sang manunudlo.
english: Earlier, he revealed that there were reports from students that they were being used bad words and threatened by the teacher.

text: Nahibaluan nga gintuad sang ginikanan nga nagpa-Bombo nga magluwas sa iya anak, may 9 ka iban pa nga mga estudyante nga wala man ginpakuha sang exam.
english: It was learned that the parent who went to Bombo confessed that besides his son, there were 9 other students who were not allowed to take the exam.

text: Ginatudlo sang Department of Health (DOH) Region 6 nga ang pag-ulan-ulan ang rason sang pagduging sang kaso sang dengue sa Western Visayas.
english: The Department of Health (DOH) Region 6 points to heavy rains as the reason for the increase in dengue cases in Western Visayas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Bea Camille Natalaray, Spokesperson sang Department of Health Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga kinahanglan nga sundon sang publiko ang 4S strategy nga amo ang Search and Destroy, Self-Protect, Seek Consultation kag Support Fogging agud malikawan ang balatian nga Dengue.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Bea Camille Natalaray, Spokesperson of the Department of Health Region 6, said the public needs to follow the 4S strategy of Search and Destroy, Self-Protect, Seek Consultation and Support Fogging to prevent Dengue.

text: Suno kay Natalaray, mas mataas sang 72 porsyento subong nga tuig 2025 sa period halin Enero tubtob Pebrero ang kaso sang dengue kon ikumpara sang nagligad nga tuig sa kapareho nga period.
english: According to Natalaray, the number of dengue cases in 2025 in the period from January to February will be 72 percent higher compared to last year in the same period.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ugalion ang pagpang-limpyo kag pag-ula sang naga-pondo nga tubig sa diin masami ang gina-istaran kag gina-pangitlogan kag mangin breeding areas sang lamok.
english: He also said that it is a practice to clean and drain stagnant water where mosquitoes often live and lay their eggs and become breeding areas.

text: Nagpasalig man ang talatapan nga preparado ang tagsa ka rural health unit kon sa diin, gina-monitor ang mga kaso kag may inventory sa stock sang logistics para sa amo nga balatian.
english: The office also assured that each rural health unit is prepared to monitor cases and have an inventory in stock of logistics for the disease.

text: Dugang pa, nagpanugyan man ini nga dapat magpatigayon kag suportahan ang Fogging Activities sa diin mas epektibo ini kon ipatigayon sa alas-6 tubtob las-8 sang aga ukon las-4 tubtob las-6 sa hapon.
english: In addition, he also suggested that Fogging Activities should be conducted and supported where they are more effective if conducted from 6 to 8 am or 4 to 6 pm.

text: Samtang, kon makabatyag sang sintomas “Seek Consultation” ukon magpa-konsulta ilabi na kon hinali lang nga maghilanat kag maglawig sang duha ka adlaw pasaka.
english: Meanwhile, if you experience symptoms, “Seek Consultation” or consult especially if you suddenly have a fever that lasts for two days or more.

text: Ginahingyo ni Senate Deputy Minority Leader Risa Hontiveros sa Senado nga imbestigahan ang mga water concessionaires sa ila ginaalegar unprofitable joint venture agreements sa mga water districts.
english: Senate Deputy Minority Leader Risa Hontiveros urged the Senate to investigate water concessionaires for their alleged unprofitable joint venture agreements with water districts.

text: Sa Senate resolution 1352 nga gin-file ni Hontiveros, nagpanawagan ang senador sa Senate Committee on Public Services nga magpatigayon sang imbestigasyon sa joint venture agreements sa tunga sang mga water districts kag mga pribado nga kumpaniya—nga nagaresulta sa indi nagakaigo ukon kulang nga supply sang tubig.
english: In Senate resolution 1352 filed by Hontiveros, the senator called on the Senate Committee on Public Services to conduct an investigation into joint venture agreements between water districts and private companies—resulting in inadequate or insufficient water supplies.

text: Ginhatagan punto ni Hontiveros nga ang iban sini nga mga kasugtanan ang nakit-an sang Commission on Audit (COA) nga “disbentaha” ukon indi benepisyo sa mga konsumidor.
english: Hontiveros pointed out that some of these agreements were found by the Commission on Audit (COA) to be “disadvantageous” or not beneficial to consumers.

text: Kinahanglan suno sa iya nga tan-awon ang mga water concessionaires bangud madamo nga mga Pinoy ang ginauhaw sa maayo nga serbisyo, ilabi na subong nga tig-ilinit.
english: He said water concessionaires need to be looked at because many Filipinos are thirsty for good service, especially this summer.

text: Apisar nga gin-anunsyo sang Malacañang nga maga-file ini sang imbestigasyon sa gina-alegar kakulangan sang PrimeWater, ginpanindugan ni Hontiveros nga bastante na ang findings gikan sa mga audits agud mabasehan sang aksyon.
english: Although Malacañang announced that it will file an investigation into the alleged shortcomings of PrimeWater, Hontiveros insisted that the findings from the audits are sufficient to base action on.

text: Ginhatagan man pagtamod sang senador nga bangud sa kakulang sang transparency kag maathag nga mga mekanismo sang accountability sa mga kasugtanan, nangin mabudlay para sa publiko nga huptan ang mga pribado nga concessionaires, water district boards, local water utilities administrations, ang National Water Resources Board, ang Commission on Audit, kag ang Public-Private Partnership Center nga may salabton.
english: The senator also noted that due to the lack of transparency and clear accountability mechanisms in the agreements, it has been difficult for the public to hold private concessionaires, water district boards, local water utilities administrations, the National Water Resources Board, the Commission on Audit, and the Public-Private Partnership Center accountable.

text: Sang Abril 30, ginmando man ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: On April 30, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. also ordered

text: ang imbestigasyon sa PrimeWater kasunod sang madamo nga reklamo gikan sa mga konsumidor nahanungod sa ginaalegar indi maayo nga serbisyo sini.
english: investigation into PrimeWater follows numerous complaints from consumers about its allegedly poor service.

text: Naglunsar man sang imbestigasyon ang Local Water Utilities Administration (LWUA) sa ginaalegar indi maayo nga serbisyo sang PrimeWater nga ginapanag-iyahan sang pamilya Villar.
english: The Local Water Utilities Administration (LWUA) also launched an investigation into the alleged poor service of PrimeWater owned by the Villar family.

text: Kalabanan sa operasyon sang PrimeWater yara sa Batangas, Cavite, Bulacan, Pampanga, Pangasinan, Cabanatuan, Tarlac, Camarines Norte, Subic, kag iban pa.
english: Most of PrimeWater's operations are in Batangas, Cavite, Bulacan, Pampanga, Pangasinan, Cabanatuan, Tarlac, Camarines Norte, Subic, and others.

text: Apang, ang PrimeWater nagsiling nga bukas sila sa isa ka makahulugan nga paghambalanay upod sa Local Water Utilities Administration.
english: However, PrimeWater said they are open to a meaningful dialogue with the Local Water Utilities Administration.

text: Sa statement nga ginpagwa sang kompaniya, ginpahayag sini nga nagapakig-angot na sila sa Local Water Utilities Administration agud masolusyunan ang mga isyu.
english: In a statement released by the company, it said it is already working with the Local Water Utilities Administration to resolve the issues.

text: Nagtimbuok pa ang turismo sa Big Island ukon opisyal nga ginakilala nga Hawaii kasunod sang paglupok sang Mauna Loa, ang ginakabig nga largest active volcano sa kalibutan.
english: Tourism on the Big Island or officially known as Hawaii has boomed following the eruption of Mauna Loa, considered the largest active volcano in the world.

text: Ginapahayag linibo ka mga tawo ang nagbisita sa syudad sang Hilo agud nga makit-an lamang ang bulkan nga naglupok sang Domingo sa labing-una nga tion sa sulod sang 38 ka tuig.
english: Thousands of people reportedly visited the city of Hilo just to see the volcano that erupted on Sunday for the first time in 38 years.

text: Fully-booked ang hotels sa Hilo apisar pa nga sa normal nga tinion, pigado kuntani ini nga period para sa travel industry sa Hawaii, ang period nga nabutang sa tunga-tunga sang Thanksgiving kag Christmas holidays.
english: Hotels in Hilo are fully booked despite the fact that in normal times, it would have been a poor period for the travel industry in Hawaii, the period between the Thanksgiving and Christmas holidays.

text: Mataas man ang demand sa helicopter tours sa Mauna Loa bangud sang mga turista kag journalists.
english: Helicopter tours of Mauna Loa are also in high demand due to tourists and journalists.

text: Lakip sa ginatumod rason sang pagdugok sang mga turista amo ang bright orange molten rock gush halin sa Mauna Loa, ang shield volcano nga nagakahulugan “Long Mountain” sa Hawaiian.
english: Among the cited reasons for the influx of tourists is the bright orange molten rock gush from Mauna Loa, the shield volcano that means “Long Mountain” in Hawaiian.

text: Tuman ka tahom ang glow sang eruption kag amo sini ang ginatudlo ginalagas sang mga turista bangud sarang ini makit-an bisan sa mga malayo nga hotels.
english: The glow of the eruption is so beautiful that tourists are said to be chasing it because it can be seen even in remote hotels.

text: Nahibaluan nga may threat man ang volcanic flows sa main artery apang kinilometros pa ang kalayuon sa subong kag indi pa makabig nga delikado sa mga komunidad malapit sa bulkan.
english: It is known that there is also a threat of volcanic flows in the main artery but it is still kilometers away and not yet considered dangerous to the communities near the volcano.

text: Kun balikan ang maragtas, 33 ka beses na nga nakalupok ang Mauna Loa halin sang 1843.
english: Historically, Mauna Loa has erupted 33 times since 1843.

text: Ang katapusan sini nga eruption ang natabo sang 1984.
english: Its last eruption occurred in 1984.

text: Naglawig ang eruption sa sulod sang 22 ka adlaw kag nag-ilig ang lava nga nakalab-ot sa pito ka kilometros nga sakop sang syudad sang Hilo kun sa diin may ginabanta 44,000 ka mga tawo nga nagatinir.
english: The eruption lasted for 22 days and flowed lava that reached seven kilometers within the city of Hilo where an estimated 44,000 people live.

text: Gintudlo sang Philippine Navy ang mabaskog nga hampak sang balod nga amo ang rason kun ngaa nagkapan ang decommissioned World War II corvette BRP Miguel Malvar (PS-19).
english: The Philippine Navy blamed the strong waves for the capsizing of the decommissioned World War II corvette BRP Miguel Malvar (PS-19).

text: Ini nga barko amo kuntani ang gamiton nga target vessel nga palugdangon para sa Balikatan exercises sang Pilipinas kag Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: This ship was supposed to be used as the target vessel to be launched for the Balikatan exercises between the Philippines and the United States of America.

text: Apang antes pa man ang aktibidad, nauna na ini nga naglugdang sa dagat nga sakop sang San Antonio, Zambales.
english: But before the activity, it had already sunk in the sea of ​​San Antonio, Zambales.

text: “The Balikatan 25 maritime strike target vessel sank off the west coast of the Philippines prior to the event commencing today,” suno kay Philippine Navy spokesman John Percie Alcos.
english: “The Balikatan 25 maritime strike target vessel sank off the west coast of the Philippines prior to the event commencing today,” according to Philippine Navy spokesman John Percie Alcos.

text: “Due to rough sea conditions … and with its long service life… she took on a significant amount of water and eventually sank,” dugang sini.
english: “Due to rough sea conditions … and with its long service life… she took on a significant amount of water and eventually sank,” it added.

text: Suno sa Navy, naglugdang ang daan nga warship apat ka nautical miles halin sa kun diin kuntani ini naka-posisyon para sa Balikatan.
english: According to the Navy, the old warship sank four nautical miles from where it was supposed to be positioned for Balikatan.

text: Wala man sang mga personnel nga nasamaran bangud sa insidente.
english: No personnel were injured in the incident.

text: Antes man ang pagguyod sang barko sa operational area, napaidalom man ini sa environmental cleaning kag preparation para sa MARSTRIKE.
english: Before the ship was towed to the operational area, it also underwent environmental cleaning and preparation for MARSTRIKE.

text: Una na nga ginpaathag nga ginpili ang BRP Miguel Malvar nga mangin target ship sa aktibidad sang US kag Pilipinas bangud lapaw na ini service life kag indi na nagakadapat para sa normal maritime operations.
english: Earlier, it was explained that the BRP Miguel Malvar was chosen to be the target ship in the activity of the US and the Philippines because it has exceeded its service life and is no longer suitable for normal maritime operations.

text: Antes ini naglugdang, naka-serbisyo ini sang 81 ka tuig matapos ginlunsar kag ginkomisyon sang 1944.
english: Before it sank, it served 81 years after being launched and commissioned in 1944.

text: Sa pihak sang natabo, ginsiling sang Navy nga magapabilin ang MARSTRIKE nga parte sang Balikatan 25 Command Post Exercises kun sa diin iga-rehearse sang Armed Forces of the Philippines kag US joint task forces ang virtual and constructive fire missions.
english: Despite the incident, the Navy said MARSTRIKE will remain part of the Balikatan 25 Command Post Exercises where the Armed Forces of the Philippines and US joint task forces will rehearse virtual and constructive fire missions.

text: “The training will integrate ground, maritime, and air-based sensors in a combined joint fire network as the Philippines and US joint task forces exercise command-and-control while exercising combined warfighting capabilities,” suno sa Navy official.#
english: “The training will integrate ground, maritime, and air-based sensors in a combined joint fire network as the Philippines and US joint task forces exercise command-and-control while exercising combined warfighting capabilities,” the Navy official said.#

text: Kasuhan sang Philippine National Police (PNP) ang isa ka vlogger nga nagpalapta sang fake news nga magapatigayon sang raid ang mga pulis sa balay ni former president Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) will charge a vlogger who spread fake news that police will conduct a raid on the house of former president Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Suno kay PNP chief Gen.
english: According to PNP chief Gen.

text: Romel Marbil, nakilala na nila kun sin-o ini nga vlogger nga ginaalegar naka-base sa Davao City.
english: Romel Marbil, they have identified this vlogger who is allegedly based in Davao City.

text: Ginpa-freeze man ang ebidensya kag nagpamalibad anay ang pulisya nga isapubliko ang pangalan.
english: The evidence was also frozen and police previously refused to release the name.

text: “We already identified this vlogger who is spreading fake news, we have already asked to freeze the evidence.
english: “We have already identified this vlogger who is spreading fake news, we have already asked to freeze the evidence.

text: I don’t want to name the person but we’ll be filing a case,” suno kay Marbil.
english: I don’t want to name the person but we’ll be filing a case,” according to Marbil.

text: Matandaan nga bangud sa impormasyon nga ginpalapta nga may raid, nagtinipon man ang mga supporters sang mga Duterte sa atubang sang iya balay, kag ang iban naman ang nag-check pa sang puluy-an sang iban nga katapo sang Duterte family.
english: It can be recalled that due to information spread that there was a raid, Duterte supporters also gathered in front of his house, and others even checked the homes of other members of the Duterte family.

text: Una naman nga gin-athag sang Davao Region Police Office nga wala sang scheduled operation ang anuman nga law enforcement unit sa balay sang anay punong ehekutibo.
english: Earlier, the Davao Region Police Office clarified that there is no scheduled operation by any law enforcement unit at the former chief executive's house.

text: Sa bahin sang PNP, matandaan nga naglunsar na ini sang gyera batok sa fake news sang nagtukod ini sang Joint Anti-Fake News Action Committee (JAFNAC) sang Mayo 2.
english: On the part of the PNP, it can be recalled that it launched the war against fake news when it established the Joint Anti-Fake News Action Committee (JAFNAC) on May 2.

text: “We want to stop those who are spreading fake news.
english: “We want to stop those who are spreading fake news.

text: This is a war we must fight and win not with weapons but with vigilance, individual responsibility and collective will because in defending truth, we defend what is right.
english: This is a war we must fight and win not with weapons but with vigilance, individual responsibility and collective will because in defending truth, we defend what is right.

text: In protecting truth, we protect our people,” dugang sang PNP chief.
english: In protecting truth, we protect our people,” the PNP chief added.

text: Gin-anunsyo ni North Korean leader Kim Jong Un nga ang tuyo sang iya pungsod amo nga makaangkon kag makatukod sang pinaka-gamhanan nga nuclear force sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has announced that his country's goal is to acquire and build the most powerful nuclear force in the world.

text: Kadungan ini sang iya pag-inspect sa Hwasong-17, ang largest intercontinental ballistic missile sang North Korea.
english: This coincided with his inspection of the Hwasong-17, North Korea's largest intercontinental ballistic missile.

text: Nagpasalig man si Kim nga batuan ukon punggan ang amo man nga nuclear threats halin sa Estados Unidos.
english: Kim also pledged to counter or deter similar nuclear threats from the United States.

text: Para sa presidente,ang Hwasong-17 amo ang “world’s strongest strategic weapon”.
english: For the president, the Hwasong-17 is the “world’s strongest strategic weapon”.

text: Ini ang ginapahayag makalab-ot sa mainland sang Estados Unidos.
english: It is said to reach the mainland of the United States.

text: Ang paglunsar sini nga missile ang nangin rason kun ngaa nanawagan ang Estados Unidos sa United Nations Security Council nga magpaguwa sang presidential statement agud himuon nga accountable ang North Korea bangud sa ila nga missile tests apisar nga gin-ban na ini sang Security Council resolutions.
english: The launch of the missile prompted the United States to call on the United Nations Security Council to issue a presidential statement to hold North Korea accountable for its missile tests despite the ban by Security Council resolutions.

text: Kaupod man ni Kim Jong Un ang iya 10 ka tuig nga anak nga babayi sang gin-review sini ang officers.
english: Kim Jong Un was also accompanied by his 10-year-old daughter when he reviewed the officers.

text: Ginapanan-aw nga ang iya nga pagpakita sa Hwasong-17 test amo ang posible signal nga ipasa ang leadership sang totalitarian state sa fourth generation sang mga Kim.
english: His appearance in the Hwasong-17 test is expected to be a possible signal to pass the leadership of the totalitarian state to the fourth generation of Kims.

text: Nag-file si former Iloilo City Councilor Plaridel Nava sa Korte Suprema sang petition for certiorari nga nagahangkat sa ginhatag ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Former Iloilo City Councilor Plaridel Nava filed a petition for certiorari in the Supreme Court challenging President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: nga executive clemency kay former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog.
english: executive clemency to former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog.

text: Sa petition ni Nava, ginplastar sini nga indi mahimo i-subject sa executive clemency ang administrative dismissal nga gin-issue sang Office of the Ombudsman base sa una nga ruling sang Korte Suprema.
english: In Nava's petition, he argued that the administrative dismissal issued by the Office of the Ombudsman cannot be subjected to executive clemency based on the previous ruling of the Supreme Court.

text: Ang executive clemency nga ginhatag sang presidente ang angot sa dismissal order nga ginpapanaug sang Ombudsman batok kay Mabilog sa administrative case nga ginpasaka ni Mr. Manuel Mejorada sang tuig 2017 kaangut sa Statement of Assets,Liabilities and Net Worth ukon SALN ni Mabilog.
english: The executive clemency granted by the president is in connection with the dismissal order issued by the Ombudsman against Mabilog in the administrative case filed by Mr. Manuel Mejorada in 2017 regarding Mabilog's Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth or SALN.

text: Ginsiling ni Nava nga nagapangatubang sa gihapon ang anay alkalde sang kaso- kriminal sa Sandiganbayan gani ineligible ini nga mahatagan sang executive clemency ni Marcos.
english: Nava said the former mayor is still facing criminal charges in the Sandiganbayan and is therefore ineligible for Marcos' executive clemency.

text: Sa amo nga petition, ginahingyo ni Nava sa Supreme Court nga ideklarar nga null and void ang executive clemency bangud nagasupak ini sa kun ano ang ginamando sa 1987 Constitution.
english: In the petition, Nava is asking the Supreme Court to declare the executive clemency null and void because it violates the provisions of the 1987 Constitution.

text: Luyag man ni Nava nga ideklarar ang respondent nga si Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin nga nagkumiter sang grave abuse of discretion sa paghatag sang clemency kay Mabilog.
english: Nava also wants to declare respondent Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin committed grave abuse of discretion in granting clemency to Mabilog.

text: Matandaan nga ginpirmahan ni Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin ang executive clemency sang Enero15,2025.
english: Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin signed the executive clemency on January 15, 2025.

text: Wala na nakabalik padulong sa Europa ang Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) nga amay sang lima ka tuig nga bata nga napatay sa aksidente sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) Terminal 1 sang Mayo 4.
english: The Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) father of a five-year-old child who died in an accident at Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) Terminal 1 on May 4 has not returned to Europe.

text: Nahibaluan nga gindul-ong lang sang bata nga babaye ang iya nga amay sang gin-arado sang SUV sa departure area.
english: It was learned that the girl was just taking her father when the SUV plowed into the departure area.

text: Kaupod sa nabungguan ang iloy kag lola sang bata.
english: The child's mother and grandmother were among the victims.

text: Samtang, nagpasalig naman ang Department of Migrant Worker (DMW) nga handa sila nga makig-angot sa employer sang amay sang biktima bangud sa kapaslawan nga magbalik sa trabaho.
english: Meanwhile, the Department of Migrant Worker (DMW) assured that they are ready to contact the employer of the victim's father due to his failure to return to work.

text: Nadala na pauli ang bangkay sang bata samtang ginpaidalom naman sa operasyon ang iya iloy kag ang lola sang napatay.
english: The child's body was taken home while his mother and grandmother of the deceased underwent surgery.

text: Iga-require sang Department of Transportation ang tanan nga drivers sang public utility vehicles nga magpaidalom sa drug testing sa kada 90 ka adlaw.
english: The Department of Transportation will require all drivers of public utility vehicles to undergo drug testing every 90 days.

text: Manduan man ang tanan nga bus lines nga magbuhin sang driving hours sa apat lang ka oras kag un maglapaw sa apat ka oras ang trip sang bus, may yara dapat sang reliever nga upod agud magbulos kag makapahuway ang driver.
english: All bus lines are also ordered to reduce driving hours to four hours and if the bus trip exceeds four hours, there must be a reliever to take over and rest the driver.

text: Ini nga mga tikang sang ahensya ang kasunod man sang pila ka mga trahedya sa dalanon sang damlag lang.
english: These moves by the agency also come in the wake of several recent road tragedies.

text: ILOILO – Naga-umpisa na ang mga banwa sa Iloilo sa paghimo sang mga eco-friendly bags, wallets, pouches, kag cellphone cases gamit ang mga ginpangbaklas nga election campaign materials.
english: ILOILO – The towns in Iloilo are starting to make eco-friendly bags, wallets, pouches, and cellphone cases using discarded election campaign materials.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mitzi Peñaflorida, Senior Environmental Management Specialist, iya ginpahayag nga ang nasambit nga inisyatibo ang kabahin sang “Limpyo Eleksyon.”

Suno kay Peñaflorida, katuyuan sang nasambit nga inisyatibo amo nga matudluan ang publiko nga sa pag-upcycle sang mga waste materials kag ma-phase out ang mga single-use plastics sa merkado.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mitzi Peñaflorida, Senior Environmental Management Specialist, said the initiative is part of the “Clean Election.”

According to Peñaflorida, the purpose of the initiative is to educate the public to upcycle waste materials and phase out single-use plastics in the market.

text: Santo sa Executive Order No.
english: According to Executive Order No.

text: 265, gina-engganyo ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr., ang mga kandidato political parties, party-list organizations, kag iban pa nga grupo nga nagapasakop sa kampanya nga i-dispose sang insakto ang mga campaign materials.
english: 265, Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr. urged candidates political parties, party-list organizations, and other groups participating in the campaign to properly dispose of campaign materials.

text: Matandaan nga sang 2022 elections, nakatipon ang Provincial Government Environment and Natural Resources Office (PGENRO) sang 14,886.075 kilograms ukon 14.8 ka tonelada sang nabasura nga election campaign materials sa 42 ka mga banwa kag sa Passi City.
english: It can be recalled that during the 2022 elections, the Provincial Government Environment and Natural Resources Office (PGENRO) collected 14,886.075 kilograms or 14.8 tons of waste election campaign materials in 42 towns and Passi City.

text: Sa nasambit nga mga campaign materials, 7,180.5 kilograms sang tarpaulins ang mahimo i-upcycle.
english: Of these campaign materials, 7,180.5 kilograms of tarpaulins can be upcycled.

text: -𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗟𝘆𝗻𝗱-𝗖 𝗝𝗼𝘆 𝗕𝗮𝗱𝗲
english: -Sugar 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗟𝗼𝗻𝗻𝗵 𝗝𝗼𝘆 𝗕𝗮𝗱𝗲

text: 𝗪𝗔𝗟𝗘𝗦— Masami naton nga ginasiling nga kon kita ang late amo ang “It’s better to be late, than never nor absent”.
english: 𝗪𝗔𝗟𝗘𝗦— We often say that if we are late is “It’s better to be late, than never nor absent”.

text: Apang, sa isa ka tumalagsahon nga tinion, matapos ang isa ka siglo… late apang nag-abot gidman ang isa ka sulat.
english: However, in a strange moment, after a century... late but finally a letter arrived.

text: Ang isa ka postcard nag-abot sa iya gintuyo nga destinasyon sa Wales 121 ka tuig pagkatapos sang petsa sa iya postmark.
english: One postcard arrived at its intended destination in Wales 121 years after the date on its postmark.

text: Suno sa Swansea Building Society, ang postcard nag-abot sa ila Cradock Street, Swansea, nga address upod ang nabilin nga sulat.
english: According to the Swansea Building Society, the postcard arrived at their Cradock Street, Swansea, address with the rest of the letter.

text: Ang postcard gin-address kay Lydia Davis, nga ang mga empleyado nagteorya nga mahimo nagapuyo sa address sadto sang isa ini ka balay sa baylo nga isa ka bangko.
english: The postcard was addressed to Lydia Davis, who employees theorized may have lived at the address back when it was a house rather than a bank.

text: Ginpahayag ni Henry Darby, official marketing and communication sang bangko nga ang address husto, 11 (kag 12) pa sila sa Cradock Street, apang 121 ka tuig na ang ulihi sangsa ginapaabot nga ginakabig niya makahaladlok.
english: Henry Darby, official marketing and communication of the bank stated that the address was correct, they were still 11 (and 12) on Cradock Street, but 121 years later than expected which he considered appalling.

text:
Ang selyo mismo amo si King Edward, bangud siya ang Hari halin sang 1901 tubtob 1910, kag mahibaluan mo gilayon gikan sa sinulatan kag sa paagi sang paghambal sini, nga ‘Dearest, I could not’, it was very much of the time.”

Si Darby nagsiling nga ang kalabanan sang postcard indi na mabasa karon, apang ang postmark may petsa nga Agosto 3, 1903.
english:
The stamp itself is King Edward, because he was King from 1901 to 1910, and you can tell immediately from the writing and the way it was said, that ‘Dearest, I could not’, it was very much of the time.”

Darby said much of the postcard is now illegible, but the postmark is dated Aug. 3, 1903.

text: Ang isa ka tigpamaba sang Royal Mail nagsiling nga ang istorya sa likod sang ulihi nga pag-abot sang postcard indi maathag.
english: A Royal Mail spokeswoman said the story behind the postcard’s late arrival was unclear.

text: Suno sa iya, mahimo nga ini nga postcard ginbalik sa amon sistema sa baylo nga madula sa koreo sa sulod sang kapin sa isa ka siglo.
english: He said this postcard could have been returned to our system instead of being lost in the mail for over a century.

text: Ginsaysay man sini nga kon ang isa ka butang ang yara sa isa sistema, obligado sila nga idul-ong ini sa husto nga address apisar nga makaligad pa ang pila ka dekada.
english: He also explained that if an item is in a system, they are obliged to deliver it to the correct address even if it is decades later.

text: MAY nangutana sa aton kon ngaa wala na gid kita nakasulat pa parti sa mga interesante nga mga bagay angot sa aton rehiyon, ang Western Visayas.
english: SOMEONE asked us why we have never written about interesting things about our region, Western Visayas.

text: Sorry, medyo naagaw lang seguro ang aton atensyon sing lubos sang madamo nga mga problema sang siyudad, sang rehiyon, sang pungsod, kag kon diin pa sa kalibutan labi na gid ang angot sa Covid-19 pandemic.
english: Sorry, we must have been completely distracted by the many problems of the city, the region, the country, and elsewhere in the world especially related to the Covid-19 pandemic.

text: Salamat sa pagpadumdum sa aton, kag ginakalipay ta gid nga may isulat naman kita parti sa rehiyon diri sa aton kolum.
english: Thank you for reminding us, and we are very happy to have something to write about the region here in our column.

text: Sa gihapon kuha naton ini sa “Interesting Facts About West Visayas” sa Book 14: “Origin of Names of Places” ni Atty. Rex S. Salvilla (+).
english: Still, let's take it from “Interesting Facts About West Visayas” in Book 14: “Origin of Names of Places” by Atty. Rex S. Salvilla (+).

text: Kabahin na ining mga libro sa reference books nga na-authorize gamiton sa public kag private schools sang Department of Education, Region 6 sa iya Regional Memorandum No.
english: These books are part of the reference books authorized for use in public and private schools by the Department of Education, Region 6 in its Regional Memorandum No.

text: 60 dated May 25, 1993.
english: 60 dated May 25, 1993.

text: Napulo’g isa (11) sining mga libro, nga may kopya pa si Atty. Salvilla sa iya puluy-an sa Molo, ang ginhatag niya libre sa aton sadtong pagkit-anay namon mga lima (5) na ka tuig nga nagligad.
english: Eleven (11) of these books, with a copy of Atty. Salvilla at his home in Molo, what he gave us free of charge when we met about five (5) years ago.

text: Buhi pa sadto si Attorney (Bless your soul, my good friend!).
english: Attorney was still alive (Bless your soul, my good friend!).

text: Gintagaan niya kita sini nga daku gid ang pagpasalamat naton sa iya sa sining “interesting facts” parti sa Western Visayas, kon diin siya kag ako natawo kag nagapuyo.
english: He gave us this and we are very grateful to him for these “interesting facts” about Western Visayas, where he and I were born and live.

text: By the way, ang West Visayas nagasakop sang mga probinsya sang Iloilo, Capiz, Aklan, Antique, Guimaras kag Negros Occidental.
english: By the way, West Visayas includes the provinces of Iloilo, Capiz, Aklan, Antique, Guimaras and Negros Occidental.

text: Sa matuod, madamo diri ang wala gid kita sing hinalung-ong halin sadto pa bisan sa sugid-sugid lang, nga ang madamo sa aton kasubong man nga wala pa makahibalo.
english: In fact, there are many things that we have never known since then, even in rumors, that many of us are just as ignorant of.

text: Sa kabug-usan, galakip ini sang mga ngalan sang mga lugar sa WV halin sa laton-laton nga sugilanon nga nagasaysay sang ginsuguran (legend); kag mga ngalan sang mga lugar nga kuha sa pagkilala sang mga sapat, tanom kag kakahuyan, mga tinuga sa kadagatan, importante nga mga tawo, hitabo kag iban pa.
english: In total, it includes place names in WV from legend; and names of places taken to identify animals, plants and trees, sea creatures, important people, events and so on.

text: Tungod sang limite sang kalabaon nga tugot lang sa aton kolum, pila lang ang madala naton diri, kag ang pagdugang sini now and then na lang sa aton masunod nga mga artikulo.
english: Due to the length limit allowed for our column, we can only bring a few here, and adding them will be done now and then in our next articles.

text:
***

Ngalan sang mga banwa halin sa mga tanom

Bago City – halin sa tanom, ukon kahoy, nga Bago-Bago nga madamo sa ini nga lugar.
english:
***

Names of towns from plants

Bago City – from the plant, or tree, that is Bago-Bago that is abundant in this area.

text: Banate, Iloilo – halin sa isa ka tanom (shrub) nga Bulubanate nga madamo sa amo nga lugar.
english: Banate, Iloilo – from a shrub called Bulubanate that is abundant in the area.

text: Miagao, Iloilo – halin sa Miagos nga isa ka herbal plant.
english: Miagao, Iloilo – from Miagos which is an herbal plant.

text: Pandan, Antique – halin sa tanom (shrub) nga Pandan nga madamo sa amo nga lugar.
english: Pandan, Antique – from the Pandan shrub that is abundant in the area.

text: Pulupandan, Negros Occidental – halin sa pulo kon diin madamo ang Pangdan.
english: Pulupandan, Negros Occidental – halin sa pulo kon diin madamo ang Pangdan.

text:
Ngalan sang lugar halin sa ‘tubers’

Pan-ay, Capiz – Ang orihinal nga ngalan sini amo ang Bamban, nga isa ka “tuber”.
english:
Place name from ‘tubers’

Pan-ay, Capiz – Its original name is Bamban, which is a “tuber”.

text: (Ang “tuber” isa ka tanom nga nagapatubo sang bunga halin sa gamut sini sa duta kasubong sang kamote, nga mananam kan-on kon luto.) Sang mag-abot ang mga Katsila sa ini nga lugar, kon diin madamo nga pagkaon ang ila nakita, nakapahayag sing matonog (exclaim) ining mga Katsila sing “Pan hay” (There’s bread!) kag amo na ang pagtawag nila sini sugod sadto.
english: (A tuber is a plant that grows fruit from its roots in the ground like a sweet potato, which is delicious to eat when cooked.) When the Spaniards arrived in this area, where they found a lot of food, they exclaimed “Pan hay” (There’s bread!) and that’s what they called it.

text: Badiangan, Iloilo – halin sa Badiang, nga isa man ka “tuber”.
english: Badiangan, Iloilo – from Badiang, which is also a “tuber”.

text: Dingle, Iloilo – isa ka klase sang lunang (clay) nga kon tawgon Dingle nga madamo sa amo nga lugar.
english: Dingle, Iloilo – a type of clay called Dingle that is abundant in the area.

text: Una ini nga ginkilala sa ngalan nga Ba-ong halin sa ba-ong, isa man ka “tuber”.
english: It was first known as Ba-ong from ba-ong, also a “tuber”.

text: May yara man ugaling nga nagasiling nga ginhingadlan ini sing Ba-ong tungod ang daan sini nga naluntaran isa ka lupyak (depressed) nga lugar nga ginalibutan sang mga bukid-bukid (hill) nga kon tan-awon daw isa ka ba-ong (big frying pan).
english: However, there are those who say that it was named Ba-ong because its old location was a depressed area surrounded by hills that looked like a big frying pan.

text:
Ngalan halin sa ‘springs and rivers’

Maasin, Iloilo – kuha sa Pait Spring sa Barangay Tamban (karon Barangay Magsaysay).
english:
Name from ‘springs and rivers’

Maasin, Iloilo – taken at Pait Spring in Barangay Tamban (now Barangay Magsaysay).

text: Ang tubig halin diri mapait (salty).
english: The water from here is bitter (salty).

text: Ining tuburan ginhimo na sang barangay nga isa ka “shrine”.
english: This spring has been turned into a shrine by the barangay.

text: Dumalag, Capiz – Ang Dalag nagatumod sa duag (color) nga “yellow”.
english: Dumalag, Capiz – Yellow refers to the color “yellow”.

text: Ginsiling nga kuha ang ngalan sini sa mga nagakahulog nga dalag nga mga dahon sang dalagku nga mga kahoy nga nagatabon (blanket) sang Agbalagon Creek sadto.
english: It is said to take its name from the falling yellow leaves of the large trees that used to cover (blanket) the Agbalagon Creek.

text: Madalag, Aklan – halin sa “brown” nga kolor sang malunangon (muddy) nga tubig sang suba.
english: Madalag, Aklan – from the “brown” color of the muddy river water.

text: Malinao, Aklan – halin sa masinaw (clear) nga tubig sang suba.
english: Malinao, Aklan – from the clear water of the river.

text: Ilog, Neg.
english: River, Neg.

text: Occ.
english: Occ.

text: – halin sa ilog (flow) sang suba./PN
english: – from the flow of the river./PN

text: Gin-akusahan sang 18 ka mga anay katapo sang Philippine Marines nagbaton sang minilyon nga suhol ang mga imbestigador sang ICC halin kanday anay Senador Antonio Trillanes kag anay Rep.
english: Eighteen former members of the Philippine Marines have accused ICC investigators of accepting millions in bribes from former Senator Antonio Trillanes and former Rep.

text: Zaldy Co.
english: Zaldy Co.

text: Sa isa ka event sa Club Filipino, ginpakigbahin ni Atty. Levi Baligod ang affidavit sang mga suldado nga nagasiling nga sila mismo ang nagdul-ong sang kwarta kay Trillanes agud gastuhan ang imbestigasyon sang ICC batok kay anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: At an event at Club Filipino, Atty. Levi Baligod rejected the affidavit of the soldiers who said they themselves delivered the money to Trillanes to finance the ICC's investigation against former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Suno sa mga suldado, bilang mga executive assistants ni Co, ginmanduan sila nga magbaylo sang duha ka maleta nga nagaunod sang tag-P56 milyon.
english: According to the soldiers, as Co's executive assistants, they were ordered to exchange two suitcases containing P56 million each.

text: Gindugang pa nila nga sang nag-abot ang mga ICC investigators sang Disyembre 2023, si Trillanes ang suno sa ila amo ang nagbayad sang tanan nga hotel accommodation, pagkaon, salakyan, kag iba pa nga gasto.
english: They further added that when ICC investigators arrived in December 2023, Trillanes allegedly paid for all hotel accommodation, meals, vehicles, and other expenses.

text: Nagpamalibad si Baligod nga ihatag ang kopya sang affidavit.
english: Baligod refused to provide a copy of the affidavit.

text: Apang magagwa ini pagkatapos nga mapasaka ang reklamo sa Office of the Ombudsman.
english: But it will come out after the complaint is filed with the Office of the Ombudsman.

text: Nagpirma si Shai Gilgeous-Alexander kag ang Oklahoma City Thunder sa isa ka kasugtanan kun sa diin nakasaad ang 4-year extension sang basketball superstar.
english: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Oklahoma City Thunder signed an agreement that included a 4-year extension for the basketball superstar.

text: Ang balor nagalab-ot sa $285 milyon nga amo ang pinakamahal nga kontrata sa kasaysayan sang NBA base sa kada tuig nga sweldo.
english: The value amounts to $285 million which is the most expensive contract in NBA history based on annual salary.

text: Bangud sini, siya na subong ang may pinakamataas nga single-season average salary sa NBA history.
english: As a result, he now has the highest single-season average salary in NBA history.

text: Gikan si Gilgeous-Alexander sa isa ka maragtason nga season sa liga kun sa diin siya ang ikaapat nga NBA player sa history nga nadeklarar nga MVP, Finals MVP, scoring title, kag nakadaug sang championship sa isa lang ka season.
english: Gilgeous-Alexander is coming off a historic season in the league where he became the fourth NBA player in history to be named MVP, Finals MVP, scoring title, and win a championship in a single season.

text: Nauna na nga nakaobra sini sanday Kareem Abdul-Jabbar (isa ka bes), Michael Jordan (apat ka beses), kag Shaquille O’Neal.
english: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar (once), Michael Jordan (four times), and Shaquille O’Neal have done it before.

text: Mangin kwalipikado na ang mga trabahador sa transport sector nga makabakal sang bugas sa presyo nga P20 kada kilo.
english: Workers in the transport sector will be eligible to buy rice at P20 per kilo.

text: Suno sa Department of Agriculture, ini magasugod sa Martes nga adlaw, Setyembre 16.
english: According to the Department of Agriculture, it will start on Tuesday, September 16.

text: Ginpahayag sang DA nga may 57,000 ka public transport workers ang ginapaabot nga makabenepisyo sa nasambit nga programa sa inisyal nga pagpapatuman sini.
english: The DA said 57,000 public transport workers are expected to benefit from the program in its initial implementation.

text: Kalakip sa mga kwalipikado amo ang mga bus, jeepney, kag tricycle drivers, pati na ang mga transport operators.
english: Among those eligible are bus, jeepney, and tricycle drivers, as well as transport operators.

text: Sa idalom sang programa, ang mga kwalipikado nga drivers kag operators ginatugutan nga makabakal sang tubtob 10 ka kilo sang bugas kada bulan sa naka-subsidiya nga presyo nga P20/kilo.
english: Under the program, qualified drivers and operators are allowed to purchase up to 10 kilos of rice per month at a subsidized price of P20/kilo.

text: Ang ini nga tikang kabahin sang kampanya sang gobyerno nga maghatag sang mas abot-kaya nga presyo sang pagkaon sa mga sektor nga apektado sang padayon nga pagtaas sang presyo sang mga balaklon.
english: The move is part of the government’s campaign to provide more affordable food prices to sectors affected by the continuous rise in commodity prices.

text: Ginpaidalom sa 90 ka adlaw nga suspension sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) ang lisensya sang driver matapos ang makasulubo nga aksidente sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA).
english: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has placed a driver's license under 90-day suspension after a tragic accident at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA).

text: Ang nasambit nga Insidente ang nagresulta sa kamatayon sang duha ka indibidwal kun sa diin ginalakipan sang isa ka 28-anyos nga lalaki kag isa ka 5-anyos nga bata, kag duha naman ka mga tawo ang nasamaran kag gindala sa ospital.
english: The incident resulted in the death of two individuals, including a 28-year-old man and a 5-year-old child, and two others were injured and taken to hospital.

text: Suno sa Anti-Drunk and Drugged Driving Act of 2013, ang mga driver nga involved sa mga aksidente ang nagakinahanglan magpa-chemical test, lakip na ang drug screening test kag kun kinahanglan, drug confirmatory test agud masiguro nga wala sila sang alcohol ukon ilegal nga droga sa ila sistema.
english: According to the Anti-Drunk and Drugged Driving Act of 2013, drivers involved in accidents are required to undergo a chemical test, including a drug screening test and if necessary, a drug confirmatory test to ensure that they do not have alcohol or illegal drugs in their system.

text: Ginpasiguro ni Assistant Secretary Vigor Mendoza II nga nag-issue na sila sang show-cause order batok sa rehistrado nga driver.
english: Assistant Secretary Vigor Mendoza II assured that they have already issued a show-cause order against the registered driver.

text: Dugang pa niya, ginahingyo man ang driver nga i-surrender ang iya lisensya sa pinakamadali nga panahon.
english: He added that the driver is also urged to surrender his license as soon as possible.

text: Base sa report sang mga otoridad, gintu-ad sang driver nga ginpaandar niya ang iya salakyan matapos nga nagpanaog ang pasahero sang gulpyada nga may naglabay nga salakyan sa atubang niya rason nga nagtuga ini sang aksidente.
english: According to the report of the authorities, the driver confessed that he started his vehicle after the passenger got out when suddenly a vehicle passed in front of him causing the accident.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginsiling ni Department of Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon nga wala sang intensyon ang driver nga maaksidente, kun sa diin nagdul-ong lang kuntani ini sang pasahero sa Airport.
english: Meanwhile, Department of Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon said the driver had no intention of causing an accident, where he was just taking the passenger to the airport.

text:
Pahayag pa ni Dizon, nagapadayon pa sila sa pagtan-aw sang iban nga Angulo sang CCTV footage, kag magapadayon man ang drug testing sa nasambit nga driver

Suno sa New NAIA Infrastructure Corp.
english:
Dizon said they are still looking at other angles of the CCTV footage, and drug testing will also continue on the driver.

According to New NAIA Infrastructure Corp.

text: (NNIC), nagapadayon ang ila imbestigasyon kaupod ang Philippine National Police (PNP) kag Manila International Airport Authority (MIAA) Security.
english: (NNIC), they are continuing their investigation with the Philippine National Police (PNP) and Manila International Airport Authority (MIAA) Security.

text: Sa subong, ang operasyon sa Departure Area nagbalik na sa normal, kag ang mga nasamaran gintagaan sang bulig medical.
english: In the meantime, operations in the Departure Area have returned to normal, and the injured have been provided with medical assistance.

text: May yara na ang Venezuela sang mangin pinakauna sini nga santo matapos nga gin-canonize ni Pope Francis ang isa ka physician nga napatay masobra 100 ka tuig na ang nagligad.
english: Venezuela has its first saint after Pope Francis canonized a physician who died more than 100 years ago.

text: Ini amo si Jose Gregorio Hernandez nga nabun-ag sang 1864, nagtuon sa Paris, Berlin, Madrid kag New York, kag napatay sa Caracas sang 1919 matapos mabungguan sang salakyan.
english: This was Jose Gregorio Hernandez who was born in 1864, studied in Paris, Berlin, Madrid and New York, and died in Caracas in 1919 after being hit by a car.

text: Siya ang ginadayaw bangud sa iya selfless service sang tion nga may yara sang pandemya.
english: He was praised for his selfless service during the pandemic.

text: Una siya nga gin-beatify sang 2021 sa tunga sang nagatimbuok nga kaso sang coronavirus sa Venezuela, isa ka siglo matapos siya ang ginkilala bilang “doctor of the poor” nga nagatatap sa mga pasyente sang tion sang isa ka major global pandemic, ang Spanish flu.
english: He was first beatified in 2021 amid surging coronavirus cases in Venezuela, a century after he was recognized as the “doctor of the poor” caring for patients during a major global pandemic, the Spanish flu.

text: Ang iya beatification ang nangin posible matapos nga ang isa ka milagro nga naangot sa iya ang ginkilala sang simbahan.
english: His beatification was made possible after a miracle linked to him was recognized by the church.

text: Ini amo ang pag-ayo sang 10 ka tuig nga bata nga babaye nga naigo sang bala sa ulo sang 2017.
english: It was the recovery of a 10-year-old girl who was shot in the head in 2017.

text: Ginsiling sang mga doktor nga imposible nga maulian ang bata apang nangamuyo ang iya iloy kay Hernandez kag nag-ayo ini.
english: Doctors said it was impossible for the child to recover but his mother prayed to Hernandez and he recovered.

text: Gin-aprubahan ni Francis ang canonization ni Hernandez kag iban pa nga bag-o nga saint gikan sa iya hospital bed sa Rome, kun sa diin siya ang ginabulong bangud sa double pneumonia.
english: Francis approved the canonization of Hernandez and other new saints from his hospital bed in Rome, where he is being treated for double pneumonia.

text: Kasunod sang approval sang santo papa, ang canonization masami nga gina- formalize sa isa ka special mass bilang pagkilala sa bag-o nga santo.
english: Following papal approval, canonization is usually formalized at a special mass in recognition of the new saint.

text: Naghiwat sang candle lighting ang St.
english: St.

text: Clements Church kadungan sa pagkomemorar sang ika-39 nga anibersaryo sang EDSA People Power Revolution.
english: Clements Church in conjunction with the commemoration of the 39th anniversary of the EDSA People Power Revolution.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Father Frank Tobin, redemptorist priest sang St.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Father Frank Tobin, redemptorist priest of St.

text: Clements Church, iya ginpahayag nga ginakalipay nila ang nangin madinalag-on nga response sang kadam-an sa panawagan sang padumdom sa makasaysayan nga hitabo sa pungsod.
english: Clements Church, he said they are pleased with the successful response of the public to the call for remembrance of the historic event in the country.

text: Suno kay Tobin, kinahanglan nga dumdomon ang sakripisyo sang mga Filipino nga nagtanyag sang ila kabuhi agud maangkon ang demokrasya.
english: According to Tobin, it is necessary to remember the sacrifices of Filipinos who offered their lives to achieve democracy.

text: Para sa iya, kon indi makomemorar ang kahiwatan, daw kaangay nga gintalikdan ang mga leksyon nga natun-an sa 1986 EDSA People Power.
english: For him, not commemorating the event would be like abandoning the lessons learned in the 1986 EDSA People Power.

text: Nagalaum man ini nga wala sang makalipat nga maghatag sang kadungganan sa mga baganihan nga nagsakrapisyo sang ila kabuhi.
english: He also hoped that no one would forget to pay tribute to the heroes who sacrificed their lives.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes ginpatigayon ang candle lighting sa amo nga simbahan, ginatos ka mga bumulutho, rehilyoso kag progresibo nga grupo, ang nagmartsa gikan sa West Visayas State University padulong sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol agud ikomemorar ang EDSA People Power Revolution.
english: Before the candle lighting at the church, hundreds of youths, religious and progressive groups, marched from West Visayas State University to the Iloilo Provincial Capitol to commemorate the EDSA People Power Revolution.

text: Nagpalabtik si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas kay Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam-jam” Baronda nga indi inutangan ang mga eskwelahan nga ginpatindog sang syudad.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas assured Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam-jam” Baronda that the schools built by the city are not in debt.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ang tanan nga gintukod nga eskwelahan, ang pondo ang naghalin sa special education fund kag wala naghalin sa national government.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Treñas said that all the schools built, the funds came from the special education fund and did not come from the national government.

text: Suno kay Treñas, ang P2 billion nga budget sa mga eskwelahan ang wala sang bahid sang utang.
english: According to Treñas, the P2 billion budget for schools is not debt-free.

text: Ginpunto man sini ang legislative building nga nagabalor sang P250 million ang naghalin sa pondo sang Iloilo City government kag indi inutangan.
english: He also pointed out that the legislative building worth P250 million came from the funds of the Iloilo City government and was not borrowed.

text: Ginplastar man sang natungdan nga ang sitwasyon sa merkado sa syudad ang yara sa income generating process naghalin ang gingamit nga pondo.
english: He also pointed out that the situation in the market in the city is in the income generating process where the funds used came from.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga nagaganar lamang sang budget agud mapondohan ang mga merkado rason nga may utang ang syudad.
english: He also explained that the budget is only used to fund the markets, which is why the city is in debt.

text: Gin-reschedule sang Duterte Campaign Team Western Visayas ang ila pagahiwaton kontani nga campaign rally sang Team Duterte kag Partido Demokratiko Pilipino Lakas ng Bayan (PDP Laban) sa La Paz Freedom Park in La Paz, Iloilo sa Marso 1, 2025.
english: The Duterte Campaign Team Western Visayas has rescheduled the campaign rally of Team Duterte and Partido Demokratiko Pilipino Lakas ng Bayan (PDP Laban) at La Paz Freedom Park in La Paz, Iloilo to March 1, 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Hansel Didulo, spokesperson sang campaign team sang Duterte, iya ginpahayag nga nakatalana na kuntani nga magpatuman sang traffic scheme ang Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU) apang, gin-isol ang petsa sang amo nga kahiwatan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Hansel Didulo, spokesperson of Duterte's campaign team, said the Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU) was scheduled to implement the traffic scheme but the date of the event was postponed.

text: Suno kay Didulo, nakakuha na sila sang permit para sa caravan kag rally kon sa diin, nahatag na man sa ila sang Pebrero 24, 2025.
english: Didulo said they have already obtained permits for the caravan and rally which will be issued to them on February 24, 2025.

text: Apang, gin-anunsyo sang national nga bahin sang Duterte Campaign Team nga i-reschedule ang petsa sa bulan sang Abril.
english: However, the national part of the Duterte Campaign Team announced that the date will be rescheduled to April.

text: Gin-ako man sini nga wala siya nakahibalo sang rason sang rescheduling apang ginpasigurado sini nga madayon na sa Abril.
english: He also admitted that he does not know the reason for the rescheduling but assured that it will continue in April.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Iloilo City lang gid ang syudad nga tuyo padulongan ni Former President Rodrigo Duterte sa Western Visayas kadungan man sa paghiwat sang rally sa pila ka lugar sa rehiyon.
english: Iloilo City is the only city that Former President Rodrigo Duterte intends to visit in Western Visayas while holding rallies in several parts of the region.

text: ILOILO CITY- Bukas sa gihapon ang mga Filipino Americans nga supporters sang Republican Party sa Estados Unidos sa sin-o man nga mangin standard bearer sang partido para sa 2024 presidential elections.
english: ILOILO CITY- Filipino Americans who are supporters of the Republican Party in the United States are still open to anyone who will be the party's standard bearer for the 2024 presidential elections.

text: Suno kay Bombo Raul Sabido, Bombo Correspondent sa Estados Unidos kag chairman sang Conservative Republican Filipino American sa Nevada, sa subong wala pa sila makahibalo kun sin-o ang ila iduso nga mangin presidentiable.
english: According to Bombo Raul Sabido, Bombo Correspondent in the United States and chairman of the Conservative Republican Filipino American in Nevada, they do not know who they will propose to be president.

text: Ini bangud suno sa iya, si former US President Donald Trump pa lang ang nagpahayag sang intensyon nga magpadalagan liwat sa pagka-presidente.
english: This is because, he said, only former US President Donald Trump has expressed his intention to run for president again.

text: Matandaan nga kahapon sang gin-anunsyo ni Trump ang iya presidential bid para sa 2024 nga eleksyon.
english: Trump announced his presidential bid for the 2024 election yesterday.

text: Para kay Sabido, ang temprano nga pag-anunsyo ni Trump sang iya pagkandidato ang mangin bentaha agud mas makatipon ini sang pondo gikan sa iya mga supporters agud magamit niya sa primary election sa Republican party.
english: For Sabido, Trump's early announcement of his candidacy will be an advantage so that he can better raise funds from his supporters to use in the primary election in the Republican party.

text: Ginplastar naman ni Sabido nga isa ka pagpanghangkat nga atubangon sang anay presidente amo ang matunog subong nga pangalan ni Florida governor Ron DeSantis nga posible magpierde kay Trump sa primary election.
english: Sabido said one of the challenges the former president will face is the now loud name of Florida governor Ron DeSantis who is likely to defeat Trump in the primary election.

text: Suno pa kay Sabido apisar bentaha ni Trump amo ang iya mapag-on nga army of supporters apang base sa pinakaulihi nga polls, nagapanguna nga choice si DeSantis sa Republican primary voters sa diin 34% ang nakuha ni DeSantis kag 26% lamang ang nakuha ni Trump.
english: Sabido said that although Trump's advantage is his strong army of supporters, based on the latest polls, DeSantis is the leading choice among Republican primary voters with DeSantis getting 34% and Trump getting only 26%.

text: Wala ginkalipay ni Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David ang AI-generated nga laragway nga ginpakigbahin ni US President Donald Trump, kun sa diin makita nga nakasuksok ini sang bayo nga kapareho sang Santo Papa.
english: Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David is not happy with the AI-generated picture shared by US President Donald Trump, where he is seen wearing clothes similar to the Pope.

text: Suno kay Cardinal David, nainsulto gid siya sa gin-ubra ni Trump, kun sa diin nga isa man ini sa nagtambong sa lubong ni Pope Francis sa Vatican sang April 26, 2025.
english: Cardinal David said he was insulted by Trump's actions, as he was one of those who attended Pope Francis' funeral at the Vatican on April 26, 2025.

text:
Gin-athag man niya nga ini nga bagay ang wala ginahimo nga kaladlawan ilabi na nga may yara ini sang dako nga kahulugan sa pagtu-o.

Madumduman nga gin-appoint si David bilang cardinal ni Pope Francis sang nagligad nga tuig, kag isa siya sa maboto sa bag-o nga santo papa sa palaabuton nga conclave sa Sistine Chapel.
english:
He also explained that this matter is not made fun of especially since it has a great significance in the faith.

David was appointed a cardinal by Pope Francis last year, and he is one of those who will vote for the new pope at the upcoming conclave in the Sistine Chapel.

text: 50 ka tuig makaligad ang katapusan nga Apollo moon mission, nagpalupad ang National Aeronautics and Space Administration ukon NASA sang megarocket kag space capsule sa panibag-o nga mission nga nagatuyo nga mapa-balik ang mga astronauts sa bulan.
english: 50 years after the last Apollo moon mission, the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) launched a megarocket and space capsule on a new mission aimed at returning astronauts to the moon.

text:
Wala sang crew sa test flight nga gintawag nga Artemis I.

Ginpangalanan ini nga mission nga Artemis kasunod sa goddess sa Greek mythology nga amo ang twin sister ni Apollo.
english:
There was no crew on the test flight dubbed Artemis I.

This mission was named Artemis after the goddess in Greek mythology who was the twin sister of Apollo.

text: Gintawag sang American space agency ang rocket nga “most powerful rocket in the world”.
english: The American space agency called the rocket the “most powerful rocket in the world”.

text: Sa ibabaw sanfg rocket amo ang Orion capsule nga amo ang ginalantaw nga magadala sang astronauts sa bulan.
english: Above the rocket is the Orion capsule which is expected to carry astronauts to the moon.

text: Kun balikan ang maragtas, katapusan nga nagpadala ang Amerika sang astronauts sa bulan sang Apollo era ukon sang 1969-1972.
english: Historically, America last sent astronauts to the moon during the Apollo era or in 1969-1972.

text: Subong nga 2022, ginalauman nga makatukod ini sang sustained presence sa bulan lakip na ang lunar space station agud makabulig sa pag-preparar para sa isa ka mission sa Mars.
english: As of 2022, it is expected to establish a sustained presence on the moon including a lunar space station to help prepare for a Mars mission.

text: Ini nga 26 ka adlaw nga flight sang Artemis 1 amo ang test flight sa Space Launch System rocket kag sa Orion capsule antes magpasakay sang mga tawo para sa mission.
english: This 26-day flight of Artemis 1 was the test flight on the Space Launch System rocket and the Orion capsule before getting people on board for the mission.

text: Dala sang spacecraft ang set sang mannequins nga may sensors agud nga matun-an ang mga kondisyon sa tion sang byahe kag agud nga ma-measure ang radiation levels sa kabug-usan nga mission.
english: The spacecraft will carry a set of mannequins equipped with sensors to study conditions during the flight and to measure radiation levels throughout the mission.

text: Ini nga Orion spacecraft ang magapadulong sa moon kag magapadayon sa pag-orbit sa sulod sang pila ka semana antes ini magbalik sa earth.
english: This Orion spacecraft will head to the moon and continue in orbit for several weeks before returning to earth.

text: Sa Disyembre 11, ginalauman nga magbalik ang capsule sa Pacific Ocean.
english: On December 11, the capsule is expected to return to the Pacific Ocean.

text: Ginpatigayon ini nga Artemis I mission matapos ang duha ka palpak nga attempts bangud sa technical reasons.
english: This Artemis I mission was conducted after two failed attempts due to technical reasons.

text: Gin-delay man anay ang pagpalupad sini bangud sa malain nga tyempo lakip na ang Hurricane Ian nga nag-igu sa Florida sang katapusan nga bahin sang Septyembre.
english: The launch was also delayed due to bad weather including Hurricane Ian that hit Florida in late September.

text: Kun magmadinalag-on ini nga test flights kag ang masunod pa nga flights, mahimo na makapadala ang Amerika sang mga tawo sa bulan sa 2025.
english: If these test flights and subsequent flights are successful, America could send people to the moon by 2025.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon halin sa NASA, kun magmadinalag-on ang Artemis 1, sundan ini sang Artemis II test flight nga tentatively scheduled sa 2024.
english: According to initial information from NASA, if Artemis 1 is successful, it will be followed by an Artemis II test flight tentatively scheduled for 2024.

text: I-lakip sa amo nga mission ang apat ka astronauts sa Orion spacecraft para sa ginakalangkagan nga expedition sa bulan.
english: The mission will include four astronauts in the Orion spacecraft for the long-awaited expedition to the moon.

text: Pagkatapos sini suno sa NASA, ilakip naman sa Artemis III flight ang una nga babayi kag first person of color nga amo ang makaabot sa bulan.
english: After that, NASA said, the Artemis III flight will include the first woman and first person of color to reach the moon.

text: Paano ma-resolba kun halimbawa nag-tie ang duha ka kandidato sa eleksyon?
english: How can it be resolved if two candidates are tied in an election?

text: Sa Rogers City sa Michigan sa Estados Unidos, wala na sang madamo nga gamo ang duha ka babayi nga pareho nga nakakuha sang 616 nga boto sang nagpadalagan bilang councilor.
english: In Rogers City in Michigan in the United States, there is not much trouble between two women who both received 616 votes when running for councillor.

text: Gindesisyunan nga magabot sila sang papel nga ginbutang sa bowl.
english: It was decided that they would pull out a piece of paper that was placed in the bowl.

text:
Naswertehan nga nagabot ni Timeen Adair ang papel nga may sulat nga “elected.”

Nakabutang naman ang “not elected” sa papel nga nagabot sang iya kasumpong nga si Brittany VanderWall.
english:
Luckily, Timeen Adair received a piece of paper with the words “elected.”

His opponent, Brittany VanderWall, said “not elected” on the paper.

text: No hard feelings… nagkup-anay ang duha matapos ang draw.
english: No hard feelings… the two hugged each other after the draw.

text: Antes pa man naggabot ang papel, nagpahayag na si VanderWall nga bisan sin-o man sa ila ang maswertehan, daog sa gihapon ang ila syudad kag pareho man nga satisfied sa ila nga duha bangud pareho ang numero sang boto nga ila nakuha.
english: Before the paper was torn, VanderWall said that no matter who was lucky, their city would still win and he was equally satisfied with both of them because they got the same number of votes.

text: Ginpanginbulahan sini si Adair kag nagpahayag nga makit-anay lang ugaling sila sa masunod nga eleksyon.
english: He congratulated Adair and said they would see each other in the next election.

text: Ginpasaka na sa full alert ang status sang Philippine National Police (PNP) epektibo subong nga adlaw, Mayo 3, bilang preparasyon sa May 12, 2025 midterm elections.
english: The status of the Philippine National Police (PNP) has been raised to full alert effective today, May 3, in preparation for the May 12, 2025 midterm elections.

text: Suno kay PNP Chief Gen.
english: According to PNP Chief Gen.
