text: Rommel Marbil, 100% na ang pwersa sang ila hanay sa pagbulig para sa piniliay para masiguro nga mangin malinong ini.
english: Rommel Marbil, 100% of the strength of their ranks to help for the election to ensure that it will be peaceful.

text: Sa record sang ahensya, nagsaka na sa 35 ang numero sang validated election-related incidents (ERIs) kun sa diin nagapanguna ang Cordillera Administrative Region (CAR) nga may 11, Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao nga may walo kag Calabarzon nga may lima.
english: According to the agency's records, the number of validated election-related incidents (ERIs) has risen to 35, led by the Cordillera Administrative Region (CAR) with 11, the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao with eight and Calabarzon with five.

text: May yara man sang tatlo ka insidente sa Zamboanga Peninsula, tag-duha sa Western Visayas kag Davao Region, samtang may tag-isa naman sa Ilocos Region, Central Luzon, Eastern Visayas, kag Soccsksargen.
english: There were also three incidents in the Zamboanga Peninsula, two each in Western Visayas and Davao Region, while there was one each in Ilocos Region, Central Luzon, Eastern Visayas, and Soccsksargen.

text: Nauna na nga ginpahayag ni PNP Director for Police Community Relations Maj.
english: Earlier, PNP Director for Police Community Relations Maj.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Roderick Augustus Alba nga magapadala ang enforcement agency sang masobra 120,000 personnel agud mabantayan ang masobra sa 37,000 ka voting centers sa nagkalain-lain nga parte sang Pilipinas.
english: Roderick Augustus Alba said the enforcement agency will send more than 120,000 personnel to monitor more than 37,000 voting centers in various parts of the Philippines.

text:
Nagguwa sa isa ka pagtuon sang Philippine Institute for Development Studies nga mahinay sa gihapon ang mga negosyo sa Pilipinas sa pag-adoptar artificial intelligence ukon A.I.

Nakasaad sa report nga 14.9 percent lamang ang nagagamit sang AI bisan nga may yara man sang access sa internet.
english:
A study by the Philippine Institute for Development Studies found that Philippine businesses are still slow to adopt artificial intelligence or A.I.

The report states that only 14.9 percent use AI despite having access to the internet.

text: Base sa sini nga pagtuon nga may titulo “Readiness for AI Adoption of Philippine Business and Industry: The Government’s Role in Fostering Innovation- and AI-Driven Industrial Development,” naka-konsentrar lamang ang AI adoption sa dalagku nga mga kumpaniya sa urban centers.
english: Based on this study titled “Readiness for AI Adoption of Philippine Business and Industry: The Government’s Role in Fostering Innovation- and AI-Driven Industrial Development,” AI adoption was only concentrated in large companies in urban centers.

text: Ang mga sector nga may pinakamataas nga AI adoption amo ang information and communications technology nga may 7.19 percent kag business process outsourcing ukon BPO nga may 5.94 percent.
english: The sectors with the highest AI adoption are information and communications technology with 7.19 percent and business process outsourcing or BPO with 5.94 percent.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa data sang Philippine Statistics Authority, 90.8 percent sa mga establisyemento sa pungsod ang may yara sang computers kag 81 percent ang may internet access.
english: According to the Philippine Statistics Authority, 90.8 percent of establishments in the country have computers and 81 percent have internet access.

text: Base sa mga author sang pagtuon nga sanday PIDS senior research fellow Francis Mark Quimba, former supervising research specialist Neil Irwin Moreno kag former research analyst Alliah Mae Salazar, ang mayor nga mga balabag sa paggamit sang AI amo ang limitado nga digital infrastructure, manubo nga ihibalo kaangot sa Al technologies, kakulang sa mga ikasangkol, kag indi bastante nga pondo.
english: According to study authors PIDS senior research fellow Francis Mark Quimba, former supervising research specialist Neil Irwin Moreno and former research analyst Alliah Mae Salazar, the main barriers to the use of AI are limited digital infrastructure, low knowledge related to Al technologies, lack of resources, and insufficient funding.

text: Lakip sa ginarekomendar sang pagtuon nga dapat magpokus gid ang gobyerno sa pagpa-uswag sang imprastruktura, ilabi na gid sa paghatag prioridad sa pagpasangad sang broadband connectivity, ilabi na sa mga lugar nga kulang sang serbisyo.
english: Among the study’s recommendations is that the government should focus more on improving infrastructure, especially prioritizing the expansion of broadband connectivity, especially in underserved areas.

text: Ginpahayag man sang pagtuon nga kinahanglan mag-invest sa mga data center kag cloud computing facilities agud masuportahan ang nagadamo nga kinahanglanon sa datos.
english: The study also revealed the need to invest in data centers and cloud computing facilities to support the growing demand for data.

text: Dugang pa, ginpunto sang pagtuon ang kinahanglanon nga magpokus sa pagpauswag sang human capital paagi sa pag-set sang clear metrics para sa pagtakos sa AI talent development outcomes.
english: Furthermore, the study pointed out the need to focus on human capital development by setting clear metrics for measuring AI talent development outcomes.

text: Ginarekomendar man sang pagtuon nga pagatukibon ang regulatory frameworks, pagpasanyog sang kooperasyon sa tunga sang gobyerno kag pribado nga sektor, kag paghimo sang mga giya para sa responsable nga paggamit sang sini nga teknolohiya.#
english: The study also recommends exploring regulatory frameworks, promoting cooperation between the government and the private sector, and developing guidelines for the responsible use of this technology.#

text: Nagapakadto na kita sa Paskwa sa diin amat-amat na nga naga-tuman ka lamig ang aton nga kaagahon kag panahon.
english: We are heading towards Christmas where our mornings and weather are slowly getting colder.

text: Ang iban natamaran na sa pag-ehersisyo ukon magpadayon sang ila walking routine bangud sa malamig nga dapya sang hangin.
english: Others are too lazy to exercise or continue their walking routine because of the cold wind.

text: Apang suno sa mga ekperto, wala sang nagakadapat kabalak-an bangud natukiban nga mas bentaha sa ikaayong-lawas ang pag-ehersisyo sa malamig nga temperatura.
english: But according to experts, there is nothing to worry about because it has been found that exercise in cold temperatures is more beneficial to health.

text: Suno kay Dr. Cedric Bryant, president kag chief science officer sang American Council, mas maka-burn sang calories ang lawas kun naga-ehersisyo ukon nagapabalhas sa tunga sang cold weather.
english: According to Dr. Cedric Bryant, president and chief science officer of the American Council, said the body burns more calories when exercising or sweating in the middle of cold weather.

text: Bentaha man ini sa mga indibidwal nga may problema sa pag-focus ukon indi maka-paminsar sang tadlong bangud sa tion nga exposed ang lawas sa malamig nga temperatura, nagasangkad man ang immune system.
english: It is also advantageous for individuals who have trouble focusing or cannot think straight because when the body is exposed to cold temperatures, the immune system also expands.

text: Nagapabuhin man sang stress ang pagginhawa sang oxygenated fresh air ukon malamig nga hangin sa diin samtang naga-burn sang calories ang lawas sa tunga sang kalamigon, naga-produce man ang utok sang serotonin kag endorphins nga nagahatag sang positibo nga panan-awan kag mood.
english: Breathing in oxygenated fresh air also reduces stress where while the body burns calories in the cold, the brain also produces serotonin and endorphins that give a positive outlook and mood.

text: Makabulig man ang pag-ehersisyo sa tunga sang malamig nga temperatura sa paglikaw sa stressful nga mga sitwasyon kag nanuhay-tuhay nga balatian kaangay sang heart disease, stroke, makabulig pabaskog sang mga tul-an kag nagapadugang sang muscle strength kag endurance.
english: Exercise in cold temperatures can also help avoid stressful situations and various diseases such as heart disease, stroke, help strengthen bones and increase muscle strength and endurance.

text: Ginkontra ni PCOL.
english: PCOL opposed.

text: Kim Legada ang nangin pahayag ni Department of Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla nga masobra 36 ka-oras antes pa nga magresponde ang kapulisan sa ginpahayag nga gun fire incident ni Dueñas Vice Mayor Lamasan nga gintunaan sang kamatayon sini.
english: Kim Legada said that more than 36 hours before the police responded to the alleged gun fire incident of Dueñas Vice Mayor Lamasan that caused his death.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCOL.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PCOL.

text: Legada, Police director sang Iloilo city Police Office, iya ginpahayag nga matapos nila nga nahibaluan ang natabo, nagsugod naman sila sa pag-imbestigar kun sa diin gintinguhaan man nila nga mag-istorya kay Vice Mayor Lamasan samtang yara ini sa ospital kag amo man sa pamilya sini.
english: Legada, Police director of the Iloilo City Police Office, said that after they learned of the incident, they began investigating where they also tried to talk to Vice Mayor Lamasan while he was in the hospital and also his family.

text: Ginklaro man niya nga wala mapatigayon sang Scene of the Crime Operatives (SOCO) ang ila nga imbestigasyon bangud nga ginsanitize na ang area kun sa diin ini natabo kag ginturn-over na lang sa imbestigador ang armas.
english: He also clarified that the Scene of the Crime Operatives (SOCO) could not conduct their investigation because the area where the incident occurred was sanitized and the weapon was turned over to the investigator.

text: Dugang pa niya nga ginapangunahan na sa subong sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) ang imbestigasyon kun sa diin nagapakig-angot man ang Iloilo City Police Office.
english: He added that the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) is now leading the investigation with the Iloilo City Police Office in cooperation.

text: Suno sa iya nga ila pa paga-imbestigaran ang nangin tikang sang mga personnel sang La Paz Police Station sa insidente.
english: He said they will investigate the actions of the personnel of the La Paz Police Station in the incident.

text: SA karon wala sing 100% safe, ukon 100% “effective” nga mahimo naton batok sa COVID-19, bisan pa gani sa paggamit sang Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) sang mga health workers.
english: Currently there is nothing 100% safe, or 100% “effective” that we can do against COVID-19, not even with the use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) by health workers.

text: In fact, may mga napatay man sa ila.
english: In fact, some of them were killed.

text: Ang makaseguro lang nga indi malatnan kag makalaton sing COVID-19 amo lang ang mga pumuluyo ukon grupo nga wala pa malab-ut sang pagpangalapkap sini halin sa kon diin nagsugod (sa Wuhan, China) kag kon diin nakasaylo na ini.
english: The only people who can be sure not to be infected and spread COVID-19 are the people or groups that have not yet been reached by its spread from where it started (in Wuhan, China) and where it has moved.

text: Sa karon gani, yari na kag nagapanghalit na sa aton pungsod ang iloy-iloy nga COVID-19 lakip na ang pila ka “variant” sini nga mas makahalangawa sa pagpanglaton, katulad sang variant sa United Kingdom, South Africa, Brazil, kag ang Delta Variant halin sa India nga ginabantayan gid naton nga indi makasulod diri.
english: Now, the mother-mother COVID-19 is here and is already ravaging our country including some of its “variants” that are more dangerous in infection, such as the variant in the United Kingdom, South Africa, Brazil, and the Delta Variant from India that we are watching out for.

text: Sa matuod man, indi pa gihapon hilway kita sa COVID-19 bisan nga nabakunahan na kita samtang indi pa lubos mapamatud-an ang epekto sini sang mga health experts.
english: In fact, we are still not free from COVID-19 even though we have been vaccinated while health experts have not yet fully proven its effects.

text: Ang mga health experts nagapanugyan pa gani nga sigehon anay ang naandan na nga pagpangamlig paagi sa minimum health protocols tubtub magsiling na sila nga may mapat-ud na nga panahon nga mahilway ang mga pumuluyo at least sa pila lang ka bulan ukon tinuig.
english: Health experts even recommend that the usual protection through minimum health protocols be maintained until they say that there is a definite time when the people will be free at least in a few months or years.

text: Ang ginapanugyan nila amo man gihapon ang minimum health protocols katulad sang paggamit sang face mask, handwashing upod ang habon, social distancing, kag paglikaw sa pagginutok (crowd) kag kulang sing ventilacion nga mga lugar.
english: They also recommend minimum health protocols such as wearing face masks, handwashing with soap, social distancing, and avoiding crowded and poorly ventilated areas.

text:
***

Tungod wala pa kita sing lubos nga sabat batok sa COVID-19, luas sa pagpabakuna kag padayon nga pagtuman sang health protocols, ano ayhan ang mahimo naton agud makapangamlig ang mga pumuluyo?
english:
***

Since we do not yet have a complete response against COVID-19, other than vaccination and continued compliance with health protocols, what can we do to protect the people?

text: Una na diri ang ihibalo naton halin sa health experts nga ang COVID-19 virus infection mahibal-an lang sa tatlo pa ka adlaw despues tubtub sa 14 ka adlaw.
english: First of all, we know from health experts that the COVID-19 virus infection can only be detected in three days after up to 14 days.

text: In other words, kon hilway kita sa mga sintoma sang COVID-19 pahibalo na ini sa aton nga wala kita sang COVID-19, discounting ang posibilidad nga basi dala mo ang virus tungod nga asymptomatic ka nga wala nagapakita sing sintoma.
english: In other words, if we are free of symptoms of COVID-19, it tells us that we do not have COVID-19, discounting the possibility that you may be carrying the virus because you are asymptomatic and do not show symptoms.

text: Sa nahibal-an sang mga health experts, labi na gid sa China, sa masami “mild” lang ang igu sini, nga pwede ma-ignore kay madula lang ini.
english: As far as health experts know, especially in China, it is usually mild, which can be ignored because it will disappear.

text: Tungod sini, bisan wala ta man gina-admitir, ginapasugtan ta man gani diri sa pungsod ang hilway nga paghulag ang bug-os nga panimalay nga wala nagagamit sing face mask kon sa sobra 14 ka adlaw nga wala man nagapakita sing sintoma.
english: Because of this, even if we do not admit, we even allow the free movement of the whole household without using a face mask if for more than 14 days without showing symptoms.

text: Ginatugot ta man ang hilway nga pag-angkasanay sang mag-asawa nga indi malapit sa iban.
english: We also allow freedom of movement for couples who are not close to others.

text: In fact, may mga barangay officials nga wala man naga-istrikto sa magkasilingan sa ila barangay sa ila paghinambaro basta wala lang nagapakita sang sintoma sa ila pag-inupod.
english: In fact, there are barangay officials who are not strict with their neighbors in their barangay in their conversation as long as they do not show symptoms in their association.

text: Ginapanugyan lang nila sa magkasilingan nga mag-amlig sa nagabisita ukon nagakadto sa ila lugar sa pag-deliver sang online order kag kon ano pa nga importante nga buluhaton sa ila lugar katulad sang pag-check sang mga “reading” sang mga metro sang tubig kag kuryente.
english: They only advise the neighbors to protect those who visit or come to their area to deliver online orders and other important activities in their area such as checking the readings of water and electricity meters.

text: Ining paghinambaro sang mga magkasilingan, lakip ang pagkit-anay sing masami sang mag-abyan nga nagasalig nga wala sila sing COVID-19, “social bubble” kon tawgon, nga ginakilala kag wala man gani gina-istriktuhan sang mga public officials sa United Kingdom, New Zealand kag Sweden, although wala ini gina-authorize sang mga health authorities.
english: This neighborly exchange, including the frequent meetings of friends who are confident that they do not have COVID-19, is a “social bubble” so to speak, which is recognized and not even strictly enforced by public officials in the United Kingdom, New Zealand and Sweden, although it is not authorized by health authorities.

text: Ngaa ayhan wala gid man ginapapunggan ining “social bubble” sang mga health authorities?
english: Why is it that the health authorities are not trying to stop this social bubble?

text: Tungod seguro luyag man nila, bilang mga scientist, tun-an kag hibaluon kon ano ini ka daku nga kabangdanan sang virus transmission nga indi sila mabasolan, tutal sa aton Demokrasya indi basta mapilit mo ang mga pumuluyo sa ila man luyag himuon nga madepensahan man nila sang ila kinaalam.
english: Because they probably want to, as scientists, study and know what is the biggest cause of virus transmission that they can not blame, since in our democracy you can not just force the people to do what they want to do that they can defend their knowledge.

text:
***

Paano ayhan naton matugutan ang “social bubble” sa gwa sang puluy-an kag sa sonado nga kasilingan, nga wala gid man naton gina-istriktuhan?
english:
***

How can we allow a social bubble outside the home and in the neighborhood, without being strict?

text: In fact, ginatugutan na naton ang mag-dine-in ang pamilya sa mga restawran kag maluag nga paglibut-libut sa mall samtang nagatuman sang health protocols.
english: In fact, we are already allowing families to dine-in at restaurants and walk around the mall while observing health protocols.

text: Ano ayhan kon tugtan ta man ang pagtililipon – sa conference man, party, plaza ukon sa beach upod ang kabataan – tubtub sa 50 ka tawo, katulad sa Sweden, basta diri sa aton may COVID-19 medical card ukon certification lang nga wala sila nakapakita sing sintoma sugod sadtong 14 ka adlaw antes?
english: What if we allow gatherings – whether at conferences, parties, plazas or on the beach with children – of up to 50 people, as in Sweden, as long as we have a COVID-19 medical card or certification that they have not shown symptoms since 14 days before?

text: Of course, kon itugot gid man sang aton health authorities!/PN
english: Of course, if our health authorities allow it!/PN

text: Sulod sa ikaduha nga round sang Wimbledon si Serbian tennis star Novak Djokovic.
english: Serbian tennis star Novak Djokovic is in the second round of Wimbledon.

text: Matapos ginlutos sini si Alexandre Muller sang France sa score nga 6-1 6-7(7) 6-2 6-2.
english: After defeating France's Alexandre Muller 6-1 6-7(7) 6-2 6-2.

text: Umpisa sang nagpasakop sa Wimbledon si Djokovic sang tuig 2005 wala pa ini nakaangkon sang kapyerdihan.
english: Since joining Wimbledon in 2005, Djokovic has not lost.

text: Target sang seven-time Wimbledon champion nga matupungan si Roger Federer sa All England Club.
english: The seven-time Wimbledon champion aims to match Roger Federer at the All England Club.

text: Ginsilinh man sini nga wala siya nagatahag sang kumpyansa sa iya kaugalingon bangud naga-umpisa pa lamang ini sa hampang kag madamo pa sang mga players nga iya makasambuwa.
english: He also said that he does not have confidence in himself because he is just starting the game and there are still many players he can meet.

text: Wala sang paghinulsol si former Philippine National Police Chief Gen.
english: Former Philippine National Police Chief Gen.

text: Nicolas Torre III nga nangin instrumento ini sa pag-aresto kay anay Presidente Rodrigo Roa Duterte.
english: Nicolas Torre III that he was instrumental in the arrest of former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte.

text: Suno kay Torre nga general manager subong sang Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA), gintungdan lang niya ang iya opisyal nga responsibilidad kag wala siya sang personal nga motibo.
english: Torre, who is now the general manager of the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA), said he was only carrying out his official responsibilities and had no personal motive.

text: Madumduman nga gin-aresto si Duterte sang Marso 2025 sa Manila sa idalom sang arrest warrant nga gin-isyu sang International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: Duterte was arrested in March 2025 in Manila under an arrest warrant issued by the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Ang amo nga pag-aresto ang nangin dalan kun ngaa napreso subong si Duterte sa The Hague.
english: The arrest led to Duterte's imprisonment in The Hague.

text: Subong nga adlaw natalana ang confirmation of charges hearing kay Duterte sa Pre-Trial Chamber sang tribunal.
english: Duterte's confirmation of charges hearing is scheduled for today in the Pre-Trial Chamber of the tribunal.

text: Iga-determinar sang tatlo ka babaye nga judges sang chamber kun may bastante nga ebidensya agud ma-establisar ang substantial grounds agud matum-ok si Duterte sa pagkumiter sang crimes against humanity.
english: The three female judges of the chamber will determine whether there is sufficient evidence to establish substantial grounds to charge Duterte with committing crimes against humanity.

text: Opisyal nga ginlunsyar ni US President Donald Trump ang “Trump Gold Card” visa program sang Disyembre 10, nga nagahatag sang oportunidad sa mga pumuluyo sang iban nga pungsod nga makabaton sang legal U.S. permanent residency pinaagi sa dako nga kontribusyon.
english: US President Donald Trump officially launched the “Trump Gold Card” visa program on December 10, which gives citizens of other countries the opportunity to obtain legal U.S. permanent residency through a large contribution.

text:
Ginpahayag sa White House nga ang programa nagapaumpisa sa bag-o nga website trumpcard.gov kun sa diin pwede maka-apply ang interesado kag nagapasalig sang “U.S. residency in record time.”

Ang Gold Card ginlaragway nga may kapareho nga pribilehiyo sa green card ukon permanent resident status, kag ang mga nakabaton sini pwede makatrabaho kag magpuyo permanente sa U.S.

May plano man nga maglunsyar sang mas mahal nga kategorya nga ginatawag “Trump Platinum Card” sa balor nga $5 million nga nagahatag sang dugang nga benepisyo sa mga foreign nationals, lakip na ang posibilidad nga makapuyo sa U.S. tubtub 270 ka adlaw nga wala sang pagabayran sang buwis sa non-U.S. income.
english:
The White House said the program is launching on a new website trumpcard.gov where interested parties can apply and guarantees “U.S. residency in record time.”

The Gold Card has been described as having similar privileges to a green card or permanent resident status, and its recipients can work and live permanently in the U.S.

There are also plans to launch a more expensive category called the “Trump Platinum Card” for $5 million that provides additional benefits to foreign nationals, including the possibility to stay in the U.S. for up to 270 days without paying taxes to non-U.S. income.

text: Nagpakigsapol ang pinuno sang Central Intelligence Agency sang Amerika sa iya nga Russian counterpart agud magpaandam sa mahimo kunsekwensya pananglitan maggamit si Russian President Vladimir Putin sang nuclear weapons sa Ukraine.
english: The head of the US Central Intelligence Agency met with his Russian counterpart to warn of the possible consequences if Russian President Vladimir Putin uses nuclear weapons in Ukraine.

text: Suno sa White House National Security Council, ginsapol ni Director William Burns si Sergei Naryshkin, head sang Foreign Intelligence Service sang Russia, may kaangtanan sa problema nga matuga sang tactical nuclear weapons kag sa risgo sini sa strategic stability.
english: According to the White House National Security Council, Director William Burns met with Sergei Naryshkin, head of Russia's Foreign Intelligence Service, regarding the problem that tactical nuclear weapons would create and the risk it poses to strategic stability.

text: Gin-athag sang Estados Unidos nga wala sila naga-negosyar ukon may ginahimo nga peace talks.
english: The United States has made it clear that it is not negotiating or having any peace talks.

text: Sa amo nga pagsinapol, ginmuno man sang Estados Unidos sa Russia ang isyu sang US citizens nga ginpreso sa Russia.
english: During the meeting, the United States also raised with Russia the issue of US citizens imprisoned in Russia.

text: Kun matandaan, ginpreso sa Russia ang US basketball star nga si Brittney Griner bangud sa drug charges amo man si Paul Whelan, isa ka auto supply company official nga nadakpan sang 2018 kag na-convict bangud sa pag-espiya.
english: US basketball star Brittney Griner was jailed in Russia on drug charges as was Paul Whelan, an auto supply company official who was arrested in 2018 and convicted of espionage.

text: May reports nga nagtanyag ang Washington sang prisoner swap.
english: There are reports that Washington has offered a prisoner swap.

text: Ginpahayag man nga handa ini nga ibaylo ang preso nga si Russian arms dealer Viktor Bout para mapapauli ang Americans.
english: He was also said to be ready to exchange the imprisoned Russian arms dealer Viktor Bout for the return of the Americans.

text: Sa Pennsylvania sa Estados Unidos, sa nagapadayon subong nga midterm elections, daog ang isa ka state lawmaker sa eleksyon apisar nga napatay na ini sang nagligad nga bulan bangud sa cancer.
english: In Pennsylvania in the United States, in the ongoing midterm elections, a state lawmaker won the election despite his death last month due to cancer.

text: Sa preliminary results, indi lang siya daog, kundi landslide nga sahi sang pagdaog.
english: In the preliminary results, he not only won, but a landslide kind of win.

text: Ang ginatumod nga politician amo si Tony DeLuca, isa ka Democrat nga state lawmaker sang Pittsburgh suburb sa House, nga napatay bangud sang lymphoma sang October 9 sa edad nga 85.
english: The politician in question was Tony DeLuca, a Democrat who was a state lawmaker of the Pittsburgh suburb in the House, who died of lymphoma on October 9 at age 85.

text: Sang amo nga tion, ulihi na agud nga makakas pa ang iya nga pangalan sa balota bangud nagahilapit na ang nationwide US legislative elections.
english: By then, it was too late to get his name off the ballot because the nationwide US legislative elections were approaching.

text: Napabilin ni Deluca ang iya nga pwesto bangud sa 86 percent sang votes nga nakuha out of 98 percent sang ballots nga naisip na.
english: Deluca retained his seat with 86 percent of the votes cast out of 98 percent of the ballots counted.

text: Bangud sini, kinahanglan ang espesyal nga eleksyon agud madesisyunan kun sin-o ang magapungko sa pwesto.
english: Because of this, a special election is needed to decide who will take office.

text: Nagpahayag man ang Pennsylvania Democratic Party nga bisan nasubuan ang partido nga wala na si Representative Tony DeLuca, proud man sila sa gihapon sa desisyon sang mga botante kag sa pagpili sa Democratic values paagi sa pag-eleher liwat kay De Luca sa pwesto.
english: The Pennsylvania Democratic Party also said that although the party is sad that Representative Tony DeLuca is gone, they are still proud of the decision of the voters and the choice of Democratic values ​​by re-electing De Luca to office.

text: Nangin emosyonal kag naghilibion si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas sang ginsaysay sini ang iya nangin eksperyensya bilang opisyal ilabi na ang pagpunto sini sang iya mga hinimuan sa syudad.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas became emotional and tearful when he told about his experience as an official especially when he pointed out his achievements in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Treñas, iya ginapahayag nga halin sadto kag antes pa man ang pandemya, ang iya ginaubra amo ang magpadulong sa iban nga lugar agud nga mag-obserba sang maayo nga practices kag ma-apply man sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Treñas said that since then and even before the pandemic, he has been going to other places to observe good practices and apply them to Iloilo City.

text: Suno kay Treñas, sa subong, naglain na gid ang sitwasyon bangud ang iban na nga syudad ang nagapadulong sa Iloilo City agud nga mag-obserba sang kauswagan.
english: According to Treñas, the situation has worsened because other cities are coming to Iloilo City to observe the development.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga indi sini mahimo ang tanan nga positibo nga tikang sa syudad kon wala ang sakripisyo sang mga empleyado sang Iloilo City Government.
english: He also said that he could not have done all the positive steps in the city without the sacrifice of the employees of the Iloilo City Government.

text: Nagapati man ini nga ang tagsa ka ubra nga ginahatag sini sa mga department heads, ang natungdan sang maayo rason nga naimplementar man sang matalunsay.
english: He also believes that each task that he gives to the department heads, the concerned well so it is also implemented smoothly.

text: Wala naman napunggan sang alkalde nga magtulo ang iya luha sa pagbalik-tanaw sini sa mga nangin serbisyo sini sa syudad.
english: The mayor could not help but shed tears as he looked back on his services to the city.

text: Ginapa-alerto sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) ang pito ka rehiyon sa Pilipinas bangud sa posible nga pagbaha subong nga adlaw, Mayo 2, base sa ginpagwa nga General Flood Advisory.
english: The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) is alerting seven regions in the Philippines for possible flooding today, May 2, based on the General Flood Advisory.

text:
Apektado sang nasambit nga advisory ang mga masunod nga rehiyon kag probinsya:

Region 4B (MIMAROPA) – PalawanRegion 8 (Eastern Visayas) – Northern Samar, Leyte, Eastern Samar, Samar, Biliran, Southern LeyteRegion 9 (Zamboanga Peninsula) – Zamboanga del Sur, Zamboanga Sibugay, Zamboanga del NorteRegion 10 (Northern Mindanao) – Misamis Oriental, Lanao del Norte, Misamis Occidental, Camiguin, BukidnonRegion 12 (SOCCSKSARGEN) – Sarangani, South Cotabato, Sultan Kudarat, North CotabatoRegion 13 (CARAGA) – Agusan del Norte, Surigao del Norte, Dinagat Islands, Surigao del Sur, Agusan del SurBangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) – Lanao del Sur, Maguindanao, Basilan

Suno sa PAGASA, ini nga mga lugar ang ginapaabot nga makaeksperyensya sang padayon nga pag-ulan dala sang low pressure area (LPA).
english:
The following regions and provinces are affected by the advisory:

Region 4B (MIMAROPA) – PalawanRegion 8 (Eastern Visayas) – Northern Samar, Leyte, Eastern Samar, Samar, Biliran, Southern LeyteRegion 9 (Zamboanga Peninsula) – Zamboanga del Sur, Zamboanga Sibugay, Zamboanga del NorteRegion 10 (Northern Mindanao, Mindanao Oriental) Lanao del Norte, Misamis Occidental, Camiguin, BukidnonRegion 12 (SOCCSKSARGEN) – Sarangani, South Cotabato, Sultan Kudarat, North CotabatoRegion 13 (CARAGA) – Agusan del Norte, Surigao del Norte, Dinagat Islands, Surigao del Sur, Agurus del Surigao in Mindago Muslim Autonomous Region (BARMM) – Lanao del Sur, Maguindanao, Basilan

According to PAGASA, these areas are expected to experience continuous rains due to the low pressure area (LPA).

text: Ang masami nga pag-ulan ang posible magapadayon sa pila ka oras kag magresulta sa pagsaka sang tubig sa mga suba kag sapa.
english: Frequent rainfall is likely to continue for several hours and result in rising water levels in rivers and streams.

text: Ginapanugyanan sang mga otoridad ang mga pumuluyo sa mga apektado nga lugar nga maghanda kag mag-monitor sang panahon para malikawan ang peligro.
english: Authorities are advising residents in the affected areas to be prepared and monitor the weather to avoid danger.

text: Nabutang sa alang-alang ang “kingmaker status” ni former United States President Donald Trump matapos napaslawan ang Republicans nga ma-dominar ang House kag ang Senate sa midterm elections.
english: Former United States President Donald Trump's “kingmaker status” was threatened after Republicans failed to dominate the House and Senate in the midterm elections.

text: Wala natuman ang “red wave” prediction matapos nagguwa ang resulta sang eleksyon sa Nevada kun sa diin daog ang incumbent nga Democrat candidate batok sa isa ka Republican challenger.
english: The “red wave” prediction did not come true after the results of the election in Nevada came out where the incumbent Democrat candidate won against a Republican challenger.

text: Bangud sini, nabatak sa 50 ang Senate seats nga ginauyatan sang Democrats, abanse sa 49 nga gina-uyatan sang Republicans.
english: This brings the Senate seats held by Democrats to 50, ahead of 49 held by Republicans.

text: May yara pa sang himuon nga runoff election sa Georgia sa Disyembre 6, apang pananglitan Republican candidate ang magadaog, diri naman kag magasulod si Vice President Kamala Harris nga mahimo maka-cast sang boto agud ma-break ang tie sa 100-member chamber sa Senado.
english: There will still be a runoff election in Georgia on Dec. 6, but if a Republican candidate wins, that's where Vice President Kamala Harris will come in who could cast a vote to break a tie in the 100-member chamber in the Senate.

text: Kun yara na sa 51-49 ang boto pabor sa Democrats, ginalantaw nga dugang ini nga pabor para sa partido ni US President Joe Biden sa pagpasar sang mga hagna.
english: With the vote in favor of the Democrats at 51-49, it is expected to be an additional favor for US President Joe Biden's party to pass the bills.

text: Suno kay Bombo Rex Viejon, international correspondent sa Washington D.C., isa man ini subong ka reality check sa Estados Unidos partikular na sa Republican Party kun sa si Trump pa bala ang nagakaigu nga kandidato agud manguna sa presidential ticket sa 2024.
english: According to Bombo Rex Viejon, international correspondent in Washington D.C., this is also a reality check in the United States particularly in the Republican Party whether Trump is the right candidate to lead the presidential ticket in 2024.

text: Bisan sa House, tuman man ka nipis ang abanse sang Republicans sa Democrats.
english: Even in the House, Republicans have a very slim lead over Democrats.

text: Ini apisar una na nga ginpahayag nga may “red wave” nga matabo bangud sa mga nagakontra sa Biden administration kag sa mataas nga inflation rate sa Estados Unidos.
english: This is despite earlier predictions of a “red wave” due to opponents of the Biden administration and the high inflation rate in the United States.

text: Ginpang-vandalize ang duha sa anom ka mga portalets sa Iloilo Sunset Boulevard.
english: Two of the six portalets on Iloilo Sunset Boulevard were vandalized.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Niel Ravena, head sang General Services Office, iya ginpahayag nga spray sang pinta ang ginbutang sa duha ka portalets.
english: Niel Ravena, head of the General Services Office, said spray paint was applied to the two portalets.

text: Suno kay Ravena, posible nga mga myembro sang gangs ang may kahimuan sini.
english: According to Ravena, it is possible that gang members were involved.

text: Ginpahayag sang natungdan nga bangud sa insidente, magapa-install ang syudad sang closed circuit television sa lugar kay maga-assign sang personnel ang Public Order and Safety Management Office.
english: He said that due to the incident, the city will install a closed circuit television in the area because the Public Order and Safety Management Office will assign personnel.

text: Una na nga nagtanyag si Mayor Jerry Treñas sang ₱15,000 nga reward sa sin-o man nga makadakop sa akto sa mga indibidwal nga nagahimo ang bandalismo sa mga propedad sang syudad.
english: Earlier, Mayor Jerry Treñas offered a ₱15,000 reward to anyone who can catch individuals committing vandalism on city properties.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – Saulugon sa bulan sang Marso ang Fire Prevention Month sa bilog nga Pilipinas.
english: Fire Prevention Month will be celebrated in March throughout the Philippines.

text:
Tema subong nga tuig amo ang, “Sa Pamayanang Nagdadamayan, Sunog ay Maiiwasan.”

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fire Senior Superintendent Melanie Habawel, Fire Marshall sa Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga katuyuan sini nga pabaskugon ang ihibalo sang publiko sa importansya sang paglikaw kag awareness sa sunog.
english:
This year's theme is, “In a Community Together, Fire Can Be Avoided.”

In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Fire Senior Superintendent Melanie Habawel, Fire Marshall in Iloilo City, said the aim is to strengthen public awareness on the importance of fire prevention and awareness.

text: Suno kay Biliran, ginpili ang Marso bilang Fire Prevention Month bangud mataas sang numero sang mga insidente sang sunog sa amo nga bulan.
english: According to Biliran, March was chosen as Fire Prevention Month because of the high number of fire incidents in that month.

text: Pinaagi sa nagkalain-lain nga kampanya kag programa, gina-engganyo ang publiko nga mangin mas handa agud malikawan ang sunog kag mga aksidente.
english: Through various campaigns and programs, the public is encouraged to be more prepared to prevent fires and accidents.

text: Samtang suno naman kay Fire Senior Superintendent Bartolome Biliran, Fire Marshall sa Iloilo Province, patigayunon ang Fire Prevention Month 2025 sa Sabado, Marso 1, 2025 tubtob sa Marso 31, 2025.
english: Meanwhile, Fire Senior Superintendent Bartolome Biliran, Fire Marshall in Iloilo Province, said the Fire Prevention Month 2025 will be held from Saturday, March 1, 2025 to March 31, 2025.

text: Sa sini nga tion, may nagkalain-lain nga mga aktibidad nga pangunahan sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) agud madugangan ang ihibalo sang publiko kaangot sa importansya sang fire safety kag malikawan ang mga insidente sang sunog.
english: During this time, there are various activities led by the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) to increase public awareness on the importance of fire safety and prevent fire incidents.

text: Tun-an sang gobyerno, partikular ang regional tripartite wages and productivity board ang hingyo para sa mas mataas nga sweldo para sa mga mamumugon.
english: The government, particularly the regional tripartite wages and productivity board, will study the request for higher wages for workers.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginpasalig ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr., nga wala ginabalewala sang gobyerno ang hingyo nga mas mataas ang sweldo.
english: Meanwhile, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. assured that the government is not ignoring the demand for higher wages.

text: Ginpasalig ni Marcos sa mga mamumugon nga ginapamatian sang gobyerno ang ila mga pangabay kag siguraduhon nga matuman ini.
english: Marcos assured the workers that the government is listening to their demands and will ensure that they are met.

text: Apang, ginpahayag sang Presidente nga may mga butang nga dapat lantawon kon ano ang mangin epekto sang wage increase.
english: However, the President said there are things to look at as to the impact of the wage increase.

text: Suno sa Presidente, dapat ikonsiderar ang epekto sini sa pag-uswag sang negosyo, trabaho, kag sa ekonomiya sang pungsod.
english: According to the President, the impact of this on business development, employment, and the country's economy should be considered.

text: Dugang ni Marcos nga manami pamatian ang mga matam-is nga promisa angut sa pagtaas sang sweldo, apang kinahanglan nga balansehon.
english: Marcos added that sweet promises regarding salary increases are good to hear, but they need to be balanced.

text: Ginpabugal sang Presidente nga 16 na ka mga rehiyon ang nagpatuman sang salary increase humalin sang Hunyo sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The President boasted that 16 regions have already implemented salary increases since June last year.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginpaambit sang Presidente ang nagkalain-lain nga mga programa sang gobyerno sa pagbulig sa mga Pilipino nga mapahagan-hagan ang ila pag-antos, ilabi na sa bahin sang pang-gastos.
english: On the other hand, the President shared the various government programs to help Filipinos alleviate their suffering, especially in terms of expenditure.

text: Gin-deploy ang 29 ka mga police personnel sang Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 sa Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) para sa Mayo 12, 2025 national and local elections.
english: Twenty-nine police personnel of the Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 have been deployed in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) for the May 12, 2025 national and local elections.

text: Sa sini nga numero, apat ang naghalin sa Aklan Police Provincial Office (PPO), anum sa Capiz PPO; duha sa Guimaras PPO ;11 sa Iloilo PPO; duha sa lloilo City Police Office kag apat naman ang naghalin sa Antique PPO.
english: Of these, four are from the Aklan Police Provincial Office (PPO), six from the Capiz PPO; two in Guimaras PPO; 11 in Iloilo PPO; two from the lloilo City Police Office and four from the Antique PPO.

text: Ini nga mga personnel ang magaserbe nga Special Electoral Board members.
english: These personnel will serve as Special Electoral Board members.

text: Suno kay PRO 6 Director Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky, ini ang pinakauna nga tion sa kasaysayan sang eleksyon nga ang Western Visayas regional office nagpadala sang augmentation sa iban nga rehiyon.
english: According to PRO 6 Director Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky, this is the first time in the history of elections that the Western Visayas regional office sent augmentation to other regions.

text: Dugang sini, ini ang kinahanglanon man para sa serbisyo sa amo nga lugar.
english: In addition, it is also necessary for the service in the area.

text: Nagpahanumdom man si Wanky sa mga pulis nga sa ila pag-augment sa Mindanao, ginadala nila ang pangalan sang PRO 6 gani ipakita nila ang tampad kag sinsero nga pagserbisyo.
english: Wanky also reminded the policemen that in their augmentation in Mindanao, they carry the name of PRO 6 so they will show honest and sincere service.

text: (Article: Bombo Hanna Andasa)
english: (Article: Bombo Hanna Andasa)

text: ILOILO CITY – All eyes sa subong sa estado sang Nevada ang bilog nga pungsod sang Estados Unidos bangud tuman ka lapit ang race sa tunga nanday incumbent Democratic Sen.
english: ILOILO CITY – The entire United States is now all eyes on the state of Nevada because the race between incumbent Democratic Sen.

text: Catherine Cortez Masto kag Republican challenger Adam Laxalt.
english: Catherine Cortez Masto and Republican challenger Adam Laxalt.

text: Sa subong, balanse na ang control sa Senado.
english: For now, control of the Senate is balanced.

text: Sa na-count na nga 95% sang balota, nagapanguna si Laxalt sa margin nga 0.1%.
english: With 95% of the ballots already counted, Laxalt leads by a margin of 0.1%.

text: Sa nabilin nga uncounted ballots, ang kampo ni Cortez Masto ang nagalaum sa gihapon nga madaog ang race.
english: With the remaining uncounted ballots, Cortez Masto's camp is still hoping to win the race.

text: Ang Senate race sa Silver State ang maka-decide sa kun ano nga partido ang maga-kontrol sang upper chamber sang Kongreso.
english: The Senate race in the Silver State will decide which party will control the upper chamber of Congress.

text: Sa tion nga magdaog si Cortez Masto, ang Democrats ang makakuha sang majority sang Senate bangud sang mangin tie-breaking vote ni Vice President Kamala Harris.
english: Should Cortez Masto win, Democrats will take the Senate majority thanks to what will be a tie-breaking vote by Vice President Kamala Harris.

text: Sa tion naman nga magdaog si Laxalt, ang kapalaran sang Democrats ang magadepende sa Georgia kun sa diin, sanday Democratic incumbent Sen.
english: If Laxalt wins, the fate of the Democrats will depend on Georgia where Democratic incumbent Sen.

text: Raphael Warnock kag Republican Herschel Walker ang maga-face off sa December run-off election.
english: Raphael Warnock and Republican Herschel Walker will face off in the December run-off election.

text: Lima ka mga grupo ang magapaindis-indis sa Sinamba sa Regatta 2025 nga isa sa highlights sang Iloilo Paraw Regatta Festival 2025.
english: Five teams will compete in Sinamba at Regatta 2025 which is one of the highlights of the Iloilo Paraw Regatta Festival 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. John Lex Bayombong, Chairperson sang Iloilo Paraw Regatta Festival, iya ginpahayag nga magapasundayag ang Grupo Bailarines del Manduryaw, Grupo Del Oeste, Grupo Ilonggo de Saltatores, Grupo Danza Forteza, kag Grupo Baile de los Obreros sa kompetisyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. John Lex Bayombong, Chairperson of the Iloilo Paraw Regatta Festival, said that Grupo Bailarines del Manduryaw, Grupo Del Oeste, Grupo Ilonggo de Saltatores, Grupo Danza Forteza, and Grupo Baile de los Obreros will perform in the competition.

text: Suno kay Bayombong, 90-porsyento na nga handa ang mangin venue sang kahiwatan.
english: According to Bayombong, the venue of the event is 90-percent ready.

text: Magasugod naman ang sailing event sang Paraw Regatta sa Marso 1, 2025.
english: The sailing event of the Paraw Regatta will begin on March 1, 2025.

text: Samtang, magapasakop man ang anom ka mga participants sa Paraw lechon contest kon sa diin, mahimo man matilawan ang unlimited lechon baboy.
english: Meanwhile, six participants will also participate in the Paraw lechon contest where they can also taste unlimited lechon baboy.

text: Iparada man ang lechon nga maluto kon sa diin, may mga dalan sa syudad nga mahimo ipasirado.
english: Also park the lechon that will be cooked where, there are roads in the city that may be closed.

text: Nagahilibion nga nag-sorry ang isa ka content creator matapos ini ginpasakaan sang reklamo sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) bangud sa ginapalapta sini nga fake news sa iya vlog.
english: A content creator has apologized after he was charged by the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) for spreading fake news in his vlog.

text: Nangin content ni alias Jenny amo ang ginaalegar pag-agaway sang NBI kag Philippine National Police sang P10-million nga reward money kasunod sang pagdakop kay Pastor Apollo Quiboloy nga may kaso nga sexual abuse.
english: The content of alias Jenny was the alleged fight between the NBI and the Philippine National Police for the P10-million reward money following the arrest of Pastor Apollo Quiboloy with a sexual abuse case.

text: Suno kay NBI Director Jaime Santiago, gin-claim sang vlogger nga ginpapundo sang PNP ang salakyan sang NBI.
english: According to NBI Director Jaime Santiago, the vlogger claimed that the PNP stopped the NBI vehicle.

text: Naghimo ini sang istorya sa amo nga anggulo, apang ang video sini nga ginpakita ang natabo kadungan sang lehitimo ukon ordinary lamang nga checkpoint sa Davao City.
english: It made a story on that angle, but the video of it shown happened at the same time as a legitimate or ordinary checkpoint in Davao City.

text: Ginklaro ni Santiago nga wala sang away ang NBI kag ang PNP —baliskad sa ginapalapta sang vlogger— kag ginpalakat man gilayon ang salakyan sang bureau sang nakaagi sa checkpoint.
english: Santiago clarified that there was no fight between the NBI and the PNP —contrary to what the vlogger was spreading—and the bureau's vehicle was immediately driven away when it passed the checkpoint.

text: Nagpaguwa na sang public apology ang vlogger, kag nag-ako nga luyag lang sini makaangkon sang likes kag followers rason nga na-post niya ang amo nga ‘fake news’.
english: The vlogger has issued a public apology, and admitted that he just wanted to get likes and followers that's why he posted the fake news.

text: Apisar sini, ginatun-an pa gihapon sang NBI ang kaso dala ang paandam sa iban nga himuon ini nga leksyon nga maghalong gid sa pagpalapta sang mga impormasyon ilabi na ang nagatuyo nga maghalit sa anuman nga ahensya sang gobyerno.
english: However, the NBI is still studying the case with a warning to others to take this as a lesson to be very careful in spreading information especially those that intend to harm any government agency.

text: Daku gid nga problema kun maayo gid kuntani ang imo modo kag kadamo sang imo plano para subong nga adlaw, apang gulpi lang nagsakit ang imo ngipon.
english: It's a big problem when you're in a good mood and have a lot of plans for today, but you suddenly have a toothache.

text: Halos bilog nga lawas mo ang apektado kag nagakadulaan na ikaw sang gana, indi bala?
english: Almost your whole body is affected and you are losing your appetite, right?

text: Didto sa isa ka lugar sa Nepal, indi clinic ang dalaganan sang mga tawo sa mga tion nga nagabatyag sila sang sakit sa ngipon kundi isa ka utod nga kahoy.
english: In one area of ​​Nepal, people run not to a clinic when they have a toothache but to a tree.

text: Kilala ini nga “Toothache Tree” ukon ang Vaisha Dev Shrine nga nahimo na nga tourist attraction kag nahamtang sa makitid nga kalye sa Kathmandu nga amo ang kapital sang Nepal.
english: It is known as “Toothache Tree” or the Vaisha Dev Shrine which has become a tourist attraction and is located in a narrow street in Kathmandu which is the capital of Nepal.

text: Ginapatihan nga ilistaran ini ni Vaisha Dev nga amo ang Newar goddess of toothache.
english: It is believed to be the abode of Vaisha Dev who is the Newar goddess of toothache.

text: Indi na maathag kun ano katigulang ang kahoy apang may nagasiling nga yara na ini sang tion sang Lichchhavi Kingdom nga nag-exist sa Kathmandu Valley halin pa sang 400 to 750 CE (Common Era)—ukon ang 1st millennium, ang 50th year sang 8th century, kag 1st year sang 750s decade.
english: The age of the tree is unclear but some say it dates back to the time of the Lichchhavi Kingdom that existed in the Kathmandu Valley from 400 to 750 CE (Common Era)—or the 1st millennium, the 50th year of the 8th century, and the 1st year of the 750s.

text: Apisar moderno naman ang teknolohiya sa dentistry sa Kathmandu, ginapili gihapon sang kadam-an nga magkadto sa amo nga “Toothache Tree” para magbutang sang mga sensilyo bangud nagapati sila nga kuhaon sang diyosa ang ila dental problems.
english: Despite the modern technology in dentistry in Kathmandu, many people still choose to go to the “Toothache Tree” to put coins because they believe that the goddess will take away their dental problems.

text: Nagapati sila nga may imahe ang goddess sa sulod sang kahoy, apang tubtub subong, indi mapat-od kun yara pa ang imahe bangud buta na sang mga sensilyo ang kahoy kag wala gid sang nagakuti sini bangud sa ila pagrespeto sa kahoy.
english: They believe that there is an image of the goddess inside the tree, but until now, it is not sure if the image is still there because the tree is full of coins and no one picks it up because of their respect for the tree.

text: Bangud kaladtuan ini sang mga tawo nga masakit ang ngipon, na-engganyo naman ang mga dentista nga magtukod sang clinic malapit sa lugar kag sa pagkamatuod amo ini ang dental district sang Kathmandu.
english: Because it is a popular destination for people with toothache, dentists were encouraged to set up a clinic nearby and in fact it is the dental district of Kathmandu.

text:
Tuman ka sikat ang lugar nga ini nga mangin ang mga turista halin sa amo nga pungsod ang nagatilaw man sa pagpangamuyo kun nabatian nila nga may goddess of toothache nga naga-istar didto.##

(Photo: Wanderlust Travel Magazine)
english:
This place is so famous that even tourists from that country try to pray when they hear that there is a goddess of toothache who lives there.##

(Photo: Wanderlust Travel Magazine)

text: GOOD kay namwersa kag nangakig na si Mayor Jerry Treñas agud dugangan ang alokasyon naton nga bakuna.
english: GOOD because Mayor Jerry Treñas is forced and angry to increase our vaccine allocation.

text: Kon wala, tani sige gihapon ang pagpabungol-bungol sang gobyerno nasyonal bisan nagasaka na ang kaso sang COVID-19 kag wala na kita pondo nga bakuna sa siyudad.
english: If not, the national government would continue to turn a blind eye even though the number of COVID-19 cases is increasing and we do not have funds for vaccines in the city.

text: Tungod sini nagpasalig na si presidential spokesperson Harry Roque nga sa priority list na ang siyudad para sa dugang nga alokasyon sang bakuna.
english: Presidential spokesperson Harry Roque has assured that the city is on the priority list for additional vaccine allocation.

text: Nakapangako man gani si vaccine czar Carlito Galvez Jr.
english: Vaccine czar Carlito Galvez Jr. has even promised.

text: nga padalhan kita sang mga 20,000 ka bakuna.
english: to send us about 20,000 vaccines.

text: So far, sulosobra pa lang sa 40,000 ka pumuluyo sang siyudad ang nabakunahan sugod sadtong Marso 5, 2021 tubtub Hunyo 21 nga report.
english: So far, just over 40,000 residents of the city have been vaccinated from the March 5, 2021 to June 21 report.

text: Mga 10 ka porsyento lang ini sang aton populasyon nga 478,000.
english: This is only about 10 percent of our population of 478,000.

text:
***

Sining ulihi lang, ginproponer ni Presidente Duterte nga tukuron kag armasan ang mga “civilian volunteers” agud kuno makabulig sa “pagpatuman sang ila (PNP) obligasyon kag, labaw sa tanan, agud mapabalik kag mapabakod ang pagsalig sang mga pumuluyo sa police force”.
english:
***

Recently, President Duterte proposed to establish and arm civilian volunteers to allegedly help “implement their (PNP) obligations and, above all, to restore and strengthen the people's confidence in the police force”.

text: Daku nga sayop ini nga armasan ang mga “civilian volunteers” agud buligan ang PNP sa ila trabaho.
english: It is a big mistake to arm civilian volunteers to help the PNP in their work.

text: Una nga rason amo nga labag sa kasuguan ining pagtukod sang armado nga “civilian volunteers”.
english: The first reason is that the establishment of armed civilian volunteers is illegal.

text: Gintudlo ni CHR spokesperson Jackqueline Ann de Guia ang provision sang 1987 Constitution sa Article XVI, Sec.
english: CHR spokesperson Jackqueline Ann de Guia pointed to the provision of the 1987 Constitution in Article XVI, Sec.

text:
6, nga nagasiling “The government shall maintain one police force, which is national in scope and civilian in character.”

In other words, wala sa lugar ang pagpa-armas sa mga “civilian volunteers” agud magbulig patuman sang trabaho sang kapulisan sa pag-amlig sang kalinong kag sang kahilwayan sang mga pumuluyo  batok sa mga kriminal kag malain nga mga hitabo  (lawlessness) sa komunidad.
english:
6, which states “The government shall maintain one police force, which is national in scope and civilian in character.”

In other words, it is not appropriate to arm civilian volunteers to help carry out the work of the police in protecting the peace and freedom of the people against criminals and lawlessness in the community.

text: Ikaduha, delikado inang basta mo lang pa-armasan ang mga sibilyan.
english: Second, it's dangerous to just arm civilians.

text: Sunu gani kay CHR spokesperson Guia, indi kita makasalig nga mapatuman nila sing husto ang trabaho sang mga kapulisan.
english: According to CHR spokesperson Guia, we cannot trust them to carry out the work of the police properly.

text: Sa matuod, indi dale-dale gid man mag-training sa ila sa husto nga pagpatuman sang trabaho sang kapulisan.
english: In fact, it is not necessary to train them in the proper implementation of the work of the police.

text: Amo gani nga nagtukod gid kita sang PNP Academy para nga makapa-graduate sang matarong nga pulis sa sulod sang apat gid ka tuig.
english: That's why we established the PNP Academy to graduate good police officers within four years.

text: Kon gaproblema gani kita sa kapalpakan sang pila ka kapulisan nga nakaagi training sing husto, ano pa gid ayhan kon pasugtan ining “civilian volunteers” sa pagdala sang papel sang kapulisan samtang kulang sa training.
english: If we are having problems with the failure of some police officers who have undergone proper training, what if these “civilian volunteers” are allowed to carry out the role of the police while lacking training.

text: Wala sing duha-duha nga makapadugang pa ini sang aton problema sa human rights violation sa pungsod!
english: No doubt this will only add to our problem of human rights violations in the country!

text: Ikatatlo, indi dapat mangin problema ang kadamuon sang aton kapulisan.
english: Third, the number of our police should not be a problem.

text: Sunu mismo sa PNP, may yara kita sing mga 220,000 nga kapulisan sa pungsod nga santu sa ideal ratio (1:500) nga isa ka pulis kada 500 ka pumuluyo para sa aton mga 110 ka milyon nga populasyon.
english: According to the PNP itself, we have about 220,000 policemen in the country based on the ideal ratio (1:500) of one policeman per 500 people for our 110 million population.

text: In other words, kon may problema kita sa kapulisan, indi tungod sa ila kadamuon kundi sa iban nga rason.
english: In other words, if we have a problem with the police, it is not because of their numbers but for other reasons.

text: Ina nga mga rason, sunu mismo sa mga pumuluyo, nagalakip sang problema nga ginahimo mismo sang pila ka kapulisan.
english: Those reasons, according to the residents themselves, include the problem that some police officers themselves are doing.

text: Katulad abe sang pagka-involved sa droga kag suspetso nga katapo sila sang death squad nga indi madakop-dakop.
english: Such as being involved in drugs and suspected of being members of a death squad that cannot be caught.

text: Involved man ang iban sa kidnap-for-ransom kag gun running.
english: Others are also involved in kidnap-for-ransom and gun running.

text: Naga- minaoy pa gani ang iban kag naga-pamintas sa mga sibilyan.
english: Some even become hostile and torture civilians.

text: Diri nga mga problema sa scalawag nga mga pulis kita seguro UNA NGA MAGTUTOK upod sa pagpanglagas sa loose firearms kag sang negosyo sa droga nga nagahimo kriminal sang mga adik.
english: Here problems with scalawag police we probably FIRST FOCUS with the pursuit of loose firearms and the drug trade that makes addicts criminals.

text: Ikaapat nga rason amo ang problema sang pagpa-armas mismo sining mga “civilian volunteers”.
english: The fourth reason is the problem of arming these civilian volunteers themselves.

text: Basi gwa ta katulad sa nagakatabo sa Estados Unidos, kon diin ang armas nga yara sa mga sibilyan tupong na sa ila populasyon nga mga 300 ka milyon.
english: Maybe we'll end up like what's happening in the United States, where civilians have as many weapons as their population of about 300 million.

text: Sining ulihi lang, nabantugan gani ini tungod sa madamo nga pinatyanay paagi sa luthang, nga pila sini naga-involve pa sang pagpamatay sang madamo nga tawo, ukon “mass killing”.
english: More recently, it has even become famous for its many shootings, some of which involve mass killings.

text: Well, basi ma-tolerate ina ya sang Estados Unidos kay sige gihapon ang pagpanag-iya sang armas sang mga sibilyan.
english: Well, maybe the United States will tolerate that because civilians still own weapons.

text: Pero indi naton ini ma-tolerate diri sa Filipinas tungod mas pikon kita kag gina-involve ang pamilya sa aton away.
english: But we can't tolerate this here in the Philippines because we are more picky and involve the family in our fight.

text: Maimon man kita, gani wala sing lugar diri ang diborsyo.
english: We are also jealous, so divorce has no place here.

text: Basi maluthangan patay pa gani ang asawa kon madakpan nga nagahana pa lang sa pag-pakigrelasyon sa iban.
english: The wife might even be shot dead if she was caught preparing to have sex with someone else.

text: Ang ikaapat nga rason may labot sa palaabuton nga eleksyon sa Mayo 2022.
english: The fourth reason has to do with the upcoming May 2022 elections.

text: Suspetso sang iban, nga yara sa oposisyon, nga gamiton ining mga “civilian volunteers” sang administrasyon sa pagpadaug sang iya mga kandidato.
english: Some, in opposition, suspect that the administration will use these “civilian volunteers” to defeat its candidates.

text: Pwede ini, indi bala?/PN
english: It can, right?/PN

text: Napirmahan na sa Iloilo City Police Station 2 ang mga dokumento agud nga matigayon na nga mapasakaan sang kaso nga adultery ang asawa sang Civil Engineer kag other man sini nga nagsulod sa isa ka lodging house sa La Paz, Iloilo City kahapon nga adlaw, Pebrero 27.
english: The documents have been signed at the Iloilo City Police Station 2 so that the wife of the Civil Engineer and his other man who entered a lodging house in La Paz, Iloilo City yesterday, February 27, will be charged with adultery.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCapt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PCapt.

text: Gimel Acuesta, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station 2, iya ginpahayag nga nagbinutig pa ang seaman nga single ini apisar nga kasado man ini sang 12 na ka tuig sa iya asawa kag ginapahayag nga may anak naman ini.
english: Gimel Acuesta, chief of Iloilo City Police Station 2, said the seaman lied that he was single despite being married to his wife for 12 years and allegedly having a child.

text: Nahibaluan nga una na nga nagpahayag ang seaman nga ginhinago sa pangalan nga ”alyas Jun” nga wala siya makahibalo nga kasado si alyas Lin.
english: It was learned that the seaman, who was hidden under the name of “alias Jun”, earlier said that he did not know that alias Lin was married.

text: Kaina lamang sang aga, may nagpakilala sa Iloilo City Police Station 2 bilang asawa ni alyas Jun.
english: This morning, someone introduced herself to the Iloilo City Police Station 2 as the wife of alias Jun.

text: Sa karon, nagaproseso naman ang seaman nga mapyansa ini sa kaso nga ginpasaka batok sa iya.
english: The seaman is currently in the process of being released on bail in the case filed against him.

text: Nahibaluan nga pursigido gid ang Civil Engineer nga bana sang online teacher nga magpasaka sang kaso.
english: The Civil Engineer, the husband of the online teacher, is determined to file a case.

text: Ginpabugal ni US President Trump nga ila nakumpiskar ang tanker malapit sa Venezuela.
english: US President Trump boasted that they seized the tanker near Venezuela.

text: Ginsiling sini nga ginpangunahan sang US Coast Guard ang pagkumpiskar nga nasambit nga oil tanker ang Venezuela.
english: He said the US Coast Guard led the seizure of the Venezuelan oil tanker.

text: Dugang pa ni Trump nga isa sa mha pinakadako nga oil tanker nga halin sa Venezuela ang ila nakumpiskar.
english: Trump added that one of the largest oil tankers from Venezuela was confiscated.

text: Matandaan nga makapila ka beses nga nagpatigayon sang airstrike ang US sa mga bangka sang Venezuela nga nagadala sang iligal nga droga.
english: The US has repeatedly conducted airstrikes on Venezuelan boats carrying illegal drugs.

text: Nagahilapit na ang pag-umpisa sang BER-months sa diin maga-umpisa naman ang paskwa sa pungsod.
english: The BER-months are approaching and Christmas will begin in the country.

text: Pat-od nga indi na naman madula sa mga lamesa ang paborito nga ice cream, cake, tinapay kag iban pa nga handa.
english: Surely the favorite ice cream, cake, bread and other ready-made items will not disappear from the tables.

text: Apang isa ka man bala sa mga indibidwal nga tuman ka paborito ang ube sa diin ang halos tanan nga ginahanda nga pagkaon ang may flavor nga ube?
english: But are you also one of those individuals who is so fond of ube that almost every prepared food is flavored with ube?

text: Ang ube ukon ‘purple yams’ ang kilala bilang tuberous root vegetable nga naghalin sa Southeast Asia kag ginakabig nga indigenous staple food sang Pilipinas.
english: Ube or 'purple yams' is known as a tuberous root vegetable that originated in Southeast Asia and is considered an indigenous staple food of the Philippines.

text: Apang ang ube indi lang basta-basta matam-is nga flavor nga ginagamit sa nanuhay-tuhay nga dishes ukon linuto, bangud manggaranon ini sa vitamins, minerals kag antioxidants nga tuman ka bentaha sa ikaayong lawas.
english: But grapefruit is not just a sweet flavor used in various dishes or cooking, because it is rich in vitamins, minerals and antioxidants that are very beneficial to health.

text: Suno kay Dr. Susan McCabe, Mental Health dietitian sa London, England, puno ang ube sang antioxidants, vitamin C kag anthocyanins nga nagabulig panubo sang blood pressure kag inflammation, kag nagabulig protiher sa lawas batok sa cancer kag type 2 diabetes.
english: According to Dr. Susan McCabe, Mental Health dietitian in London, England, ube is full of antioxidants, vitamin C and anthocyanins that help lower blood pressure and inflammation, and help protect the body against cancer and type 2 diabetes.

text: Ang vitamin C nga yara sa purple yams ukon ube ang nagabulig sa cells sang lawas nga mangin healthy, nagapa-boost sang iron absorption, kag nagapalikaw sa pagkaguba sang DNA.
english: The vitamin C present in purple yams or ube helps the body’s cells stay healthy, boosts iron absorption, and prevents DNA damage.

text: Pahayag sang doktor, santo sa ginpatigayon nga test-tube study, natukiban man nga ang cyanidin kag peonidin nga sakop sang anthocyanins nga yara sa ube, ang nagapa-reduce sang growth sang nanuhay-tuhay nga sahi sang cancer kaangay sang: Colon cancer, Lung cancer kag Prostate cancer.
english: The doctor said that based on the test-tube study, it was also found that cyanidin and peonidin, which are members of the anthocyanins in grapes, reduce the growth of various types of cancer such as: Colon cancer, Lung cancer and Prostate cancer.

text: Ginpamatian sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang hingyo sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) nga patapuson anay ang eleksyon antes ang full implementation sang P20-per-kilo rice program.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) has listened to the request of the Commission on Elections (Comelec) to postpone the elections before the full implementation of the P20-per-kilo rice program.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel, sa Mayo 13 maga-umpisa ang local government units sa pagbaligya sang amo sini kabarato nga bugas.
english: According to Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel, on May 13, local government units will start selling such cheap rice.

text: Kahapon sang ginlunsar sang ahensya ang programa sa Cebu sa pagpanguna ni Laurel nga kadungan sang komemorasyon sang Labor Day.
english: The agency launched the program in Cebu yesterday under the leadership of Laurel in conjunction with the commemoration of Labor Day.

text: Nagpasalig man ang tiglikom nga bisan maatrasar ang full implementation sang pagbaligya sang bugas sa Visayas, indi man maapektuhan ang kalidad sang produkto.
english: The secretary also assured that even if the full implementation of rice sales in the Visayas is delayed, the quality of the product will not be affected.

text: Una na nga ginpaathag sang Comelec nga ipaiway anay ang implementasyon sang programa samtang wala pa nakalampas ang May 12 national and local elections agud nga malikawan ang akusasyon nga ginagamit ang programa para sa pulitika.
english: Earlier, the Comelec explained that the implementation of the program will be postponed until the May 12 national and local elections to avoid accusations that the program is being used for political purposes.

text: Ini nga pilot test sang programa ang magalawig tubtub sa Disyembre 2025.
english: This pilot test of the program will run until December 2025.

text: Sakop sini pati ang iban nga mga rehiyon sa Visayas kag ginalantaw nga maka-benepisyo sa 800,000 tubtub sa apat ka milyon nga mga Pilipino.
english: It also covers other regions in the Visayas and is expected to benefit 800,000 to four million Filipinos.

text: Nagapati si Vice President Sara Duterte nga may lamod-pamulitika ang mandu ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte believes that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s order is politically motivated.

text: nga imbestigaran ang PrimeWater Infrastructure Corp.
english: to investigate PrimeWater Infrastructure Corp.

text: nga ginapanag-iyahan sang mga Villar.
english: owned by the Villars.

text: Suno sa bise-presidente, posible nga amo man ini ang rason bangud base sa iya nakit-an, pulitika man ang tanan nga rason sang hulag sang administrasyon sa baylo nga para kuntani sa kalinong kag pag-umwad.
english: According to the vice-president, it is possible that this is the reason because based on his observations, all the reasons for the administration's actions are political instead of for peace and development.

text: “Malamang, dahil lahat naman ng galawan ngayon ng administrasyon ay dahil sa pulitika.
english: “Probably, because everything the administration is doing now is because of politics.

text: So wala na akong nakita na ginawa ng administrasyon na ito para sa kapayapaan at kaunlaran ng ating bayan,” pahayag sini.
english: So I have not seen anything done by this administration for the peace and development of our country,” he said.

text: Posible suno kay Sara nga kaangot ini sa iya pag-endorso kay Las Piñas Rep.
english: Sara said it is possible that this is related to her endorsement of Las Piñas Rep.

text: Camille Villar sa pagka-senador.
english: Camille Villar for senator.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Camille ang myembro man sang Alyansa senatorial slate nga gina-endorso man ni Marcos.
english: It is known that Camille is also a member of the Alyansa senatorial slate that is also endorsed by Marcos.

text:
Sa nauna nga pahayag sang Malacañang sang Abril 30 paagi kay Undersecretary Claire Castro, ginsiling nga wala sang ligwa sa Marcos administration ang mga kakulangan sa serbisyo: “Ang kakulangan sa serbisyo ay walang puwang sa administrasyon ni Pangulong Marcos Jr…mag-uutos po ang Pangulo na maimbestigahan po.”

Una naman nga nagpahayag si House Assistant Majority Leader Jay Khonghun nga maga-file siya sang resolution para magduso sang full-blown investigation sa lapses sang PrimeWater kun mag-resume na ang session sa Congress sa Hunyo.
english:
In an earlier statement by Malacañang on April 30 through Undersecretary Claire Castro, it was said that the Marcos administration has no solution to the shortcomings in service: “The shortage of services is not unique to the administration of President Marcos Jr...the President will order an investigation.”

Earlier, House Assistant Majority Leader Jay Khonghun said he would file a resolution to propose a full-blown investigation into PrimeWater's lapses when the Congressional session resumes in June.

text: Nangibabaw na naman ang talento kag maduagon nga imahinasyon sang Filipino designers amo man ang kultura sang Pilipinas sa ginpatigayon nga national costume showcase nga Miss Universe Philippines 2025.
english: The talent and imagination of Filipino designers as well as the culture of the Philippines prevailed again in the national costume showcase Miss Universe Philippines 2025.

text: Duha sa sini nga designers ang halin sa Iloilo samtang ang ila masterpieces naman ang ginsuksok man sang duha ka Ilongga nga sanday Karen Nicole Piccio kag Angeline Kailani.
english: Two of these designers are from Iloilo while their masterpieces were also worn by two Ilonggas, Karen Nicole Piccio and Angeline Kailani.

text:
Si Kailani nga tiglawas sang Iloilo Province ang nagsuksok sang creation ni Ruffy Itaas nga inspired sa folklore nga “Apoy ni Santelmo.”

On fire kaangay sang firebeast ang performance ni Angeline samtang ginalakat sini sa stage ang recycled water bottles nga naadornahan sang gemstones.
english:
Kailani, who represents Iloilo Province, wore a creation by Ruffy Itaas inspired by the folklore “Apoy ni Santelmo.”

Angeline's performance was on fire like a firebeast as she walked the stage with recycled water bottles decorated with gemstones.

text: “Santelmo is a mythical ball of fire of a lost soul died from a tragic death.
english: “Santelmo is a mythical ball of fire of a lost soul died from a tragic death.

text: Now, with Angeline Cordero Kailani – one woman rising, not from ash, but from burning purpose.
english: Now, with Angeline Cordero Kailani – one woman rising, not from ash, but from burning purpose.

text: This legendary Santelmo becomes more than a tale – it becomes a voice.
english: This legendary Santelmo becomes more than a tale – it becomes a voice.

text: This national costume burns not to consume, but to illuminate the passion and strength of a more empowered woman,” kabahin sang caption ni Itaas.
english: This national costume burns not to consume, but to illuminate the passion and strength of a more empowered woman,” part of Itaas’ caption.

text:
Si Tata Blas Pinuela naman ang designer sang costume ni Piccio sang Iloilo City nga inspired sa “Nuno sa Punso.”

Tribute man ini sa Ilonggo folktales, mga pagpati kag istorya.
english:
Tata Blas Pinuela is the designer of Piccio's costume inspired by “Nuno sa Punso.”

It is also a tribute to Ilonggo folktales, beliefs and stories.

text: Naggamit ini sang colored cloths bilang base sang bungsod, may wood beads, rhinestones kag crystal beads, nga gindugangan pa sang uhong, bato, kag wood stems.
english: She used colored cloths as the base of the hill, with wood beads, rhinestones and crystal beads, topped off with mushrooms, rocks, and wood stems.

text: “A nuno sa punso is a dwarf-like nature spirit in Philippine mythology especially to Iloilo Province.
english: “A nuno sa punso is a dwarf-like nature spirit in Philippine mythology especially to Iloilo Province.

text: It is believed to live in an anthill or termite mound, Bungsod or Punso.
english: It is believed to live in an anthill or termite mound, Bungsod or Punso.

text: The Nuno sa Punso is a neutral supernatural being.
english: The Nuno sa Punso is a neutral supernatural being.

text: Sometimes they help humans but in some few cases they curse them if their home is destroyed,” kabahin naman sang description ni Pinuela.
english: Sometimes they help humans but in some few cases they curse them if their home is destroyed,” Pinuela said.

text: Antes sa event, may yara sang charity gala kun sa diin lakip sa attendees amo sanday Miss Universe Victoria Kjaer Theilvig kag ang iya continental queens nga sanday Miss Universe Africa and Oceania Chidimma Adetshina, Miss Universe Americas Tatiana Calmell, Miss Universe Europe and Middle East Matilda Wirtavouri, kag Miss Universe Asia Chelsea Manalo.
english: Before the event, there was a charity gala where among the attendees were Miss Universe Victoria Kjaer Theilvig and her continental queens Miss Universe Africa and Oceania Chidimma Adetshina, Miss Universe Americas Tatiana Calmell, Miss Universe Europe and Middle East Matilda Wirtavouri, Miss Universe Asia Manalo and Chelsea.

text: Natapos naman sang nagligad nga gab-i ang preliminaries kun sa diin featured ang 66 delegates sa swimwear kag evening gown.
english: The preliminaries ended last night where 66 delegates were featured in swimwear and evening gown.

text: Buwas na ang finals night sa Mall of Asia Arena.
english: Tomorrow is the finals night at the Mall of Asia Arena.

text: (Photos: Tata Pinuela and Mark Caceres Studios via Ruffy Itaas/FB)
english: (Photos: Tata Pinuela and Mark Caceres Studios via Ruffy Itaas/FB)

text: Ginpahayag ni Pope Francis nga ginpamatud-an sang mga babayi nga iya nga gin-appoint sa Vatican nga mas mas maayo pa sila nga managers ipaanggid sa mga lalaki.
english: Pope Francis said the women he appointed to the Vatican have proven that they are better managers than men.

text: Gindugang pa sang Santo Papa nga may yara matuod sang male chauvinism ukon aggressive patriotism sa Roman Catholic Church kag sa bilog nga sosyudad.
english: The Pope added that there is indeed male chauvinism or aggressive patriotism in the Roman Catholic Church and in society as a whole.

text: Ginplastar sang Santo Papa ini nga mga komento sa isa ka airborne news conference sa eroplano nga pabalik na sa Roma matapos ang iya apat ka adlaw nga trip sa Bahrain.
english: The Pope made these comments during an airborne news conference on a plane returning to Rome after his four-day trip to Bahrain.

text: Sabat ini ni Francis sang ginpamangkot siya nahanungod sa mga babayi nga amo ang nagapanguna subong sa lapnagon nga protesta sa Iran.
english: Francis responded when asked about the women who are now leading the widespread protests in Iran.

text: Wala ginsabat ni Pope Francis ang pamangkot kag ginliso ang topiko sa papel sang mga babayi sa kabug-usan.
english: Pope Francis did not answer the question and turned the topic to the role of women in general.

text: Gin-apresyar ni Francis ang managerial roles sang mga babayi kag ginmensyonar sini si Sister Raffaella Petrini, ang deputy governor sang Vatican City, nga amo ang ginakilala nga most powerful woman sa Vatican kag gin-appoint sang nagligad nga tuig nga mangin in charge sa 2,000 ka mga empleyado.
english: Francis appreciated the managerial roles of women and mentioned Sister Raffaella Petrini, the deputy governor of Vatican City, who is recognized as the most powerful woman in the Vatican and was appointed last year to be in charge of 2,000 employees.

text: Gin-abi abi man sini ang impact sang lima ka mga babayi nga amo ang gin-appoint sa department nga naga-oversee sang finances sang Vatican.
english: He also welcomed the impact of the five women who were appointed to the department that oversees the Vatican's finances.

text: Suno pa sa Santo Papa, matawag na ini nga revolution bangud nakahibalo ang mga babayi kun paano mangita sang paagi nga mapauswag ang Vatican.
english: According to the Pope, this can be called a revolution because women know how to find ways to improve the Vatican.

text: Ginkondenar man sini ang agresibo nga patritiosmo sa sosyudad kag ginplastar nga tuman ini ka duna sa kalibutan mangin sa iya ginhalinan nga lugar sa Argentina.
english: He also condemned aggressive patriotism in society and argued that it is very present in the world even in his homeland of Argentina.

text: Sa katapusan sang iya mensahe, gintawag sang Santo Papa nga regalo ang mga babayi bangud babayi kag lalaki ang gintuga sang Ginuo — indi puppy dog nga hampangan lang sang mga lalaki.
english: At the end of his message, the Pope called women a gift because the Lord created women and men — not puppy dogs for men to play with.

text: Madamo sa gihapon sang nagabakal sang aloy sa Iloilo Central Market, ini apisar sa abiso nga likawan anay ang pagbakal sini bangud sa gina-alegar nga allergic reactions ukon pagpalangatol kun makakaon sang nasambit nga isda.
