english: Many people are still buying aloy in the Iloilo Central Market, despite the warning to avoid buying it because of alleged allergic reactions or itching when eating the said fish.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jocel De Los Reyes, isa sa mga nagabaligya sang aloy sa Iloilo Central Market, iya ginpahayag nga dako sa gihapon ang nabuhin sa banyera nga ginabaligya sini nga aloy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jocel De Los Reyes, one of the vendors of aloy in the Iloilo Central Market, said the price of aloy is still large.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga agud nga malikawan nga makatuga sang allergy ang aloy, importante nga butangan sang bastante nga ice ang isda agud mapabilin ang ka preska sini.
english: He said that in order to avoid causing allergies, it is important to put enough ice on the fish to maintain its freshness.

text: Dugang pa sini nga agud indi makatuga sang malain nga reaksyon ang isda kun kan-on kinahanglan man nga indi ini pagpadugayon kag hugasan gid sang maayo kun lutuon na.
english: He added that in order not to cause a bad reaction to the fish when eaten, it is also necessary not to prolong it and wash it thoroughly when cooked.

text: Para sa iban nga tawo, indi man big deal ang pagsakay sa eroplano magluwas lang abi kun first time mo ini.
english: For some people, flying isn't a big deal unless it's your first time.

text: Apang lain ang eksperyensya ilabi na kun ikaw ang ginabansagan pinakamataas nga babayi sa bilog nga kalibutan!
english: But the experience is different especially when you are called the tallest woman in the world!

text: Ang naga-uyat sini nga rekord amo ang 25-anyos nga Turkish woman nga si Rumeysa Gelgi nga nagataas sang 7 feet kag 0.7 inches.
english: The holder of this record is 25-year-old Turkish woman Rumeysa Gelgi who stands at 7 feet and 0.7 inches.

text: Ini ang una nga bes nga nakasakay si Ms. Gelgi sa eroplano.
english: This is the first time Ms. Gelgi on the plane.

text: 13 ka oras ini nga flight halin sa Istanbul, Turkey padulong sa San Francisco, United States.
english: It is a 13 hour flight from Istanbul, Turkey to San Francisco, United States.

text: Agud masiguro nga matawhay ang flight para kay Ms. Gelgi, temporaryo nga gin-kuha sang airline ang anum ka economy seats kag gin-convert sa isa ka special stretcher.
english: To ensure a smooth flight for Ms. Gelgi, the airline temporarily removed six economy seats and converted them into a special stretcher.

text: Suno kay Ms. Gelgi, nangin matawhay man ang iya nga flight kag ginpasalamatan sini ang crew sang eroplano.
english: According to Ms. Gelgi, his flight was also smooth and he thanked the crew of the plane.

text: “This was my first plane ride but it certainly won’t be my last,” pahayag ni Gelgi.
english: “This was my first plane ride but it certainly won’t be my last,” stated Gelgi.

text: Suno sa Guinnes World Record, si Miss Gelgi man ang nagauyat sang rekord nga may longest finger sa living person, longest hands, kag longest back.
english: According to the Guinness World Record, Miss Gelgi also holds the record for having the longest finger in a living person, longest hands, and longest back.

text: Ang daw indi mapatihan nga kataason ni Ms. Gelgi ang tuga sang kondisyon nga ginatawag nga Weaver syndrome.
english: The seemingly incredible height of Ms. Gelgi is caused by a condition called Weaver syndrome.

text: Ini nga rare genetic condition ang rason sang accelerated growth kag talalupangdon nga advanced bone age.
english: This rare genetic condition accounts for accelerated growth and noticeably advanced bone age.

text: Bangud sini ugaling, limitado man ang hulag sang joints kag mabudlay man ang paglakat kag mangin ang pagginhawa kag ang pagtulon.
english: Because of this, however, the movement of the joints is limited and it is difficult to walk and even to breathe and to swallow.

text: Bangud sa iya nga kondisyon, nagagamit si Ms. Gelgi sang wheelchair ukon walker agud nga makalibot-libot kag makabyahe.
english: Due to her condition, Ms. Get a wheelchair or walker so you can get around and travel.

text: Naga-trabaho si Ms. Gelgi sa technology sector kag magatinir ini sa US sa sulod sang anum ka bulan para makakita sang dugang nga opportunities sa iya nga karera.
english: Ms. works. Gelgi in the technology sector and will stay in the US for six months to find more opportunities in his career.

text: Daku nga dungog para sa Filipino-British singer songwriter nga si Beatrice Kristi Laus ukon mas kilala nga “beabadoobee” nga makaupod sa ginakalangkagan nga concert tour ni Taylor Swift!
english: It is a great honor for Filipino-British singer songwriter Beatrice Kristi Laus or better known as “beabadoobee” to join Taylor Swift’s highly anticipated concert tour!

text:
Ang 22-anyos nga Filipino pride ang nangin kilala bangud sa iya kanta nga “Coffee” nga nangin global hit matapos gin-reinterpret sang rapper nga si Powfu kag na-feature man ang iya tingog sa “Death Bed (Coffee For Your Head).”

Lakip man sa magaupod kay Taylor bilang special guests amo ang Paramore, Phoebe Bridgers, kag HAIM.
english:
The 22-year-old Filipino pride became known for her song “Coffee” which became a global hit after it was reinterpreted by rapper Powfu and her voice was also featured in “Death Bed (Coffee For Your Head).”

Also joining Taylor as special guests are Paramore, Phoebe Bridgers, and HAIM.

text: Excited ang Swifties bangud ini ang una nga tour ni Taylor matapos ang “Reputation” tour sang 2018.
english: Swifties are excited as this will be Taylor’s first tour after 2018’s “Reputation” tour.

text:
Suno pa sa Grammy-winning megastar, ang iya nga “Eras” tour amo ang iya makabig “a journey through all of her musical eras of her career.”

Ginpatigayon ang tour announcement duha ka semana matapos ang release sang iya 10th album nga “Midnights.”

Sini lang mga semana, naghimo sang maragtas si Taylor bilang una nga artist nga nakakuha sang 10 tanan ka spots sa Billboard hot songs chart.
english:
According to the Grammy-winning megastar, her “Eras” tour is what she considers “a journey through all of her musical eras of her career.”

The tour announcement came two weeks after the release of his 10th album “Midnights.”

In recent weeks, Taylor made history as the first artist to earn all 10 spots on the Billboard hot songs chart.

text: Nagpasakop liwat ang Russia sa agreement nga naga-garantiya sang hilway nga pagpalayag sang mga barko nga nagakarga sang grain exports halin sa Ukraine.
english: Russia has rejoined the agreement guaranteeing the free passage of ships carrying grain exports from Ukraine.

text: Ini nga lihok ang ginalantaw nagapahagan-hagan sang mga kahangaw sang food supply para sa bilog nga kalibutan nga nabuhi sang nag-atras ang Moscow sa pagpartisipar sa amo man nga agreement sang nagligad nga semana.
english: The move is seen as easing food supply concerns for the rest of the world that were raised when Moscow withdrew from participating in the same agreement last week.

text: Kun matandaan, gin-rason sang Russia ang drone attacks sa syudad sang Sevastopol sang Crimea nga amo ang ila rason sa pag-isol sa kasugtanan.
english: Russia cited drone attacks in the Crimean city of Sevastopol as its reason for withdrawing from the agreement.

text: Ukraine ang ginbasol sang Russia sa amo nga pagpang-atake; apang wala nag-ako ang Ukraine kag tubtub subong indi pa maathag kun daw ano kadaku nga halit ang natuga sa naval vessels sang Russia.
english: Ukraine was blamed by Russia for that attack; but Ukraine has not admitted it and it is still unclear how much damage was caused to Russian naval vessels.

text: Apang subong, mismo ang Russian Ministry of Defense ang nag-anunsyo nga ma-intra sila liwat sa agreement.
english: But now, the Russian Ministry of Defense itself has announced that they will rejoin the agreement.

text: Sa idalom sa amo nga agreement, ginapasalig sang Russia nga indi sini pag-atakehon ang mga barko nga nagalabay sa humanitarian corridor sa Black Sea nga nagakarga sang Ukrainian grain, abono, kag iban pa nga pagkaon.
english: Under that agreement, Russia assures that it will not attack ships passing through the humanitarian corridor in the Black Sea carrying Ukrainian grain, fertilizer, and other food.

text: Sa idalom pa sang amo nga kasugtanan, gina-inspect ang tanan nga vessels nga nagapakadto-pakari sa pantalan sang Ukraine.
english: Under the agreement, all vessels coming and going to Ukrainian ports are inspected.

text: Ang naga-monitor amo ang international teams nga ginabug-usan sang mga opisyal halin sa Russia, Ukraine, Turkey, kag United Nations.
english: Monitoring are international teams composed of officials from Russia, Ukraine, Turkey, and the United Nations.

text: Kritikal ang papel sang grain supply halin sa Ukraine.
english: The role of the grain supply from Ukraine is critical.

text: Suno sa United Nations, naga-suplay ang Ukraine sang 45 million ka tonelada sang trigo kada tuig.
english: According to the United Nations, Ukraine supplies 45 million tons of wheat annually.

text: Ikalima ini sa bug-os nga kalibutan pag-abot sa top global exporters sang barley, corn, and wheat.
english: It is the fifth largest global exporter of barley, corn, and wheat.

text: Ini man ang biggest exporter sang sunflower oil nga katumbas sang 46% sang exports sa kalibutan.
english: It is also the biggest exporter of sunflower oil accounting for 46% of world exports.

text: Ginkumpirma ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga nakabaton siya sang summon halin sa Office of the Prosecutor may kaangtanan sa complaint nga ginpasaka batok sa iya sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) bangud sa iya pahayag nga nag-hire siya sang tawo nga magapatay kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte confirmed that she received a summons from the Office of the Prosecutor in connection with the complaint filed against her by the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) for her statement that she hired a man to kill President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: kag iban pa kun siya ang patyon man.
english: and so on if he is killed too.

text: Suno kay VP Sara, nakabato siya sang summons sa Office of the Prosecutor sa gin-file sang NBI.
english: According to VP Sara, he received a summons from the Office of the Prosecutor on the NBI file.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma man ni Prosecutor General Richard Fadullon.
english: This was also confirmed by Prosecutor General Richard Fadullon.

text: Suno kay Fadullon, gintalana ang preliminary investigation sa complaint sa Mayo 9 kag Mayo 16.
english: Fadullon said the preliminary investigation into the complaint is scheduled for May 9 and May 16.

text: Sang Pebrero, ginrekomendar sang NBI ang pag-file sang inciting to sedition kag grave threat batok kay Duterte.
english: In February, the NBI recommended the filing of inciting to sedition and grave threat against Duterte.

text: Sang ulihi, ginsiling ni Duterte nga ang iya “assassination” statement ang indi pagpamahog.
english: Later, Duterte said his “assassination” statement was not a threat.

text: Dugang niya, nahatagan lamang sang kag malisyoso nga interpretasyon ang iya pahayag.
english: He added that his statement was only given a malicious interpretation.

text: Nakaagi ka man damgo nga nagdaog ka sa lotto?
english: Have you ever had a dream that you won the lottery?

text: Ukon basi may kilala nga nakadaog na sa lotto?
english: Or maybe know someone who has already won the lottery?

text: Sa China, lab-ot sa langit ang kalipay sang isa ka lalaki matapos nakadaog sang malapit sa 220 million yuan ukon P1.76 billion sa lottery.
english: In China, a man was overjoyed after winning nearly 220 million yuan or P1.76 billion in the lottery.

text: Ang lalaki amo si alias “Li” nga nagbakal sang 40 lottery tickets balor 80 yuan ukon P640 kada isa sa autonomous region of Guangxi Zhuang.
english: The man was identified as alias “Li” who bought 40 lottery tickets worth 80 yuan or P640 each in the autonomous region of Guangxi Zhuang.

text: Palareho lang ang pito ka numero sa kada ticket.
english: The seven numbers on each ticket are the same.

text: Suno sa report sang South China Morning Post, nag-hit ang tanan nga pito ka numero.
english: According to a South China Morning Post report, all seven numbers hit.

text: Ginpahayag nga tinuig na nga ginatayaan ni Li ini nga mga numero ukon ginatawag na ini nga iya “alaga”.
english: Li has reportedly been betting on these figures for years or calling them his “pet”.

text: Bangud sini, nagdangat sa 5.48 million yuan per ticket ang daog ni Li ukon 220 million yuan.
english: As a result, Li won 5.48 million yuan per ticket or 220 million yuan.

text: Sang na-hit na ang jackpot sang Oktubre 21, indi na makatulog si Li kag nagsakay ini sa tren padulong sa Nanning pagkaaga mismo.
english: When the jackpot was hit on October 21, Li couldn’t sleep and took a train to Nanning the very next morning.

text: Nagtinir siya sa hotel sang weekend bangud nahadlok siya nga madula ang iya nga tickets.
english: He stayed at the hotel over the weekend because he was afraid he would lose his tickets.

text: Sunod siya nga nagpadulong sa Guangxi Welfare Lottery Distribution Center sa amo nga syudad sang Oktubre 24 agud kuhaon ang iya nadag-an nga kuwarta.
english: He next went to the Guangxi Welfare Lottery Distribution Center in the same city on October 24 to collect his winnings.

text: Sang ginhatag na ang cheke, suksok sini ang isa ka cartoon costume nga amo ang popular nga paagi sa China agud nga ma-proteksyunan ang identity sang mga nagadaog sa lottery.
english: When the check was handed over, he was wearing a cartoon costume which is a popular way in China to protect the identity of lottery winners.

text: Apisar tuman ang excitement ni Li bangud sa iya nga swerte, nag-desisyon siya nga indi ini pag-isugid bisan kay sin-o. Wala niya gani ini ginsugid pati sa iya nga pamilya!
english: Although Li was very excited about his luck, he decided not to tell anyone. He didn't even tell his family!

text: Paathag sini, nagakabalaka siya nga basi kun isugid niya nga nakadaog siya sa lotto, magtinamad na ang iya asawa kag anak, ukon basi indi na magtuon sa eskwelahan.
english: He explained that he was worried that if he told them that he had won the lottery, his wife and children would become lazy, or that they might not study in school.

text: Apang sa pagsulundan, dapat nga mangin joint asset ni Li kag sang iya nga asawa ang amo nga kuwarta.
english: However, according to the rules, the money must be a joint asset of Li and his wife.

text: May abogado man nga nagpahayag nga posible malapas ni Li ang local marriage law kunlapason sini ang kinamatarong sang iya asawa nga makahibalo tuhoy sa amo nga impormasyon.
english: May abogado man nga nagpahayag nga posible malapas ni Li ang local marriage law kunlapason sini ang kinamatarong sang iya asawa nga makahibalo tuhoy sa amo nga impormasyon.

text: Isa lang ang sigurado subong: dal-on ni Li pauli ang 171 million yuan ukon P1.37 billion bangud ginbuhinan pa ini sang buwis kag nag-donate man siya sang 5 million yuan ukon P40 million sa charity.
english: One thing is certain now: Li will take home 171 million yuan or P1.37 billion because it is tax-deductible and he also donated 5 million yuan or P40 million to charity.

text: Sang ginpamangkot kun ano ang iya nga plano sa kuwarta, suno kay Li, planuhan pa niya ini sang maayo.
english: When asked what his plans are for the money, Li said he will plan it carefully.

text: ILOILO CITY-Ang mga kalo, magluwas nga fashionable, functional man ang mga ini ilabi na batok sa UV rays sang adlaw kon summer.
english: ILOILO CITY-Hats, besides being fashionable, are also functional especially against the UV rays of the sun in summer.

text: Apang may nagapamangkot man kon malain bala sa imo hair health ang pagsuksok sini?
english: But some also ask if wearing them is bad for your hair health?

text: Ang kalo may yara sang maayo nga dulot sa imo buhok.
english: The hat has a good gift to your hair.

text: Sa tion sang matugnaw nga panahon, ini ang naga- protect sang imo buhok kag scalp gikan sa mga elements.
english: During cold weather, it protects your hair and scalp from the elements.

text: Ini ang beneficial kon magagwa ikaw nga basa ang buhok nga mahimo maggabok kag mangin prone sa breakage kon magcontact sa tugnaw.
english: This is beneficial if you go out with wet hair that can become frizzy and prone to breakage when in contact with the cold.

text: Sa mainit naman nga panahon, importante nga protektahan ang buhok kag scalp gilan sa UV rays, bangud ginapamala sang adlaw ang buhok kag nagatuga sang paglasyaw sang duag sang buhok.
english: In hot weather, it is important to protect the hair and scalp from UV rays, as the sun dries the hair and causes hair color to fade.

text: Suno naman sa National Health Service, ang masami nga pagsuksok sang kalo kag malawig nga tion ang wala nagapadasig sanghair loss.
english: According to the National Health Service, frequent wearing of hats and prolonged periods of time does not accelerate hair loss.

text: Apang ang tuman ka hugot nga kalo ang mahimo mag-trap sang oil sang imo hair roots gani ini ang nagapamala sang punta sang buhok.
english: But too tight a hat can trap the oil of your hair roots so it dries out the ends of the hair.

text: Kon ang buhok mangin greasy, ang circulation sang oxygen sa imo follicles ang mahimo ma-obstruct sang higko kag mag- build up ang bacteria kag nagaresulta sa pagkataktak sang buhok.
english: When hair becomes greasy, the circulation of oxygen to your follicles can be obstructed by dirt and bacteria build up and result in hair loss.

text: Gani panugyan sang eksperto, magpili sang kalo nga sakto lang nga makaginhawa man ang imo buhok kag scalp.
english: So the expert advises, choose a hat that is just right for your hair and scalp to breathe.

text: Umpisahan na sang International Criminal Court subong nga adlaw, Pebrero 23, ang confirmation stage ukon ang confirmation of charges hearing sa kaso nga crimes against humanity batok kay former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The International Criminal Court will begin today, February 23, the confirmation stage or the confirmation of charges hearing in the case of crimes against humanity against former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Matabo ini sa 10:00 sa aga (The Hague local time) sa Pre-Trial Chamber I ukon alas singko sa hapon oras naman sa Pilipinas.
english: This will take place at 10:00 am (The Hague local time) in Pre-Trial Chamber I or 5 pm Philippine time.

text: Pangunahan ini nanday Presiding Judge Iulia Antoanella Motoc kag duha ka iban pa nga judges nga sanday Reine Adélaïde Sophie Alapini-Gansou kag María del Socorro Flores Liera.
english: It will be presided over by Presiding Judge Iulia Antoanella Motoc and two other judges Reine Adélaïde Sophie Alapini-Gansou and María del Socorro Flores Liera.

text: Ginklaro sang korte nga indi pa ini trial kundi pre-trial hearing pa lamang.
english: The court clarified that this is not a trial but a pre-trial hearing.

text: Ang tuyo sang confirmation of charges hearing amo ang pagtumod kun may yara bala sang bastante nga ebidensya agud maestablisar ang substantial grounds agud patihan nga si Duterte nakahimo gid man sang mga krimen nga amo ang nakabutang sa akusasyon.
english: The purpose of the confirmation of charges hearing is to determine whether there is sufficient evidence to establish substantial grounds to believe that Duterte indeed committed the crimes listed in the indictment.

text: Bisan nga nakapasa na ang prosecution sang lista sang mga ebidensya sang nag-apply sila sang warrant of arrest, diri pa lamang nga stage diskusyunan ang mga merito sang kaso.
english: Although the prosecution had already submitted the list of evidence when they applied for the warrant of arrest, it is only at this stage that the merits of the case will be discussed.

text: Apat ka adlaw ang hearings kag ginpahat-pahat sa tatlo ka sessions.
english: The hearings lasted four days and were divided into three sessions.

text: Pagkabukas sang confirmation hearings subong nga aga, may yara sang opening statement halin sa prosecution, kag pagasundan sang break.
english: After the opening of the confirmation hearings this morning, there will be an opening statement from the prosecution, followed by a break.

text: Ang second session (6:30 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. PST) amo naman ang opening statements halin sa common legal representatives sang victims kag ang opening statement sang defense.
english: The second session (6:30 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. PST) will be the opening statements from the common legal representatives of the victims and the opening statement of the defense.

text: Ang third and final session subong nga adlaw (9 p.m. to 10 p.m. PST) ang ginpain naman para sa submissions sang prosecution sa merito sang kaso.
english: The third and final session today (9 p.m. to 10 p.m. PST) is set aside for the prosecution's submissions on the merits of the case.

text: Antes sini nga hearing, natabo ang initial appearance ni Duterte sa chamber sang Marso 14, 2025.
english: Before this hearing, Duterte's initial appearance in the chamber took place on March 14, 2025.

text: Sang 8 Setyembre 2025, gin-postpone sang chamber ang confirmation hearing nga una nga ginplano nga magsugod sa Setyembre 23, 2025.
english: On 8 September 2025, the chamber postponed the confirmation hearing initially scheduled to begin on 23 September 2025.

text: Ini kasunod sang Adjournment Request sang Defense team bahin sa ikaayong-lawas ni Duterte.
english: This follows the Adjournment Request of the Defense team regarding Duterte's health.

text: Sang Enero 26, 2026, ginpahayag sang Pre-Trial Chamber I nga si Duterte dapat kag fit nga magpartisipar sa pre-trial proceedings.
english: On January 26, 2026, Pre-Trial Chamber I said Duterte should and is fit to participate in the pre-trial proceedings.

text: Didto kag gin-anunsyo ang pagsugod sang confirmation of charges hearing sa Pebrero 23.
english: It was there that the confirmation of charges hearing was announced to begin on February 23.

text: Apisar nagapanindugan ang Defense nga maluya kag malipaton ang 80-anyos nga former president, nagdesisyon ang Chamber nga dayunon ini bangud sa nakabutang sa report sang medical experts nga makahangop pa si Duterte pati sa mga kaso nga iya ginaatubang kag mga ebidensya nga kalakip sini.#
english: Despite the Defense's insistence that the 80-year-old former president is weak and forgetful, the Chamber decided to continue it because the report of medical experts states that Duterte can still understand the cases he is facing and the evidence attached to them.

text: Naigo gid sang bala ang kinatawo sang isa ka lalaki sa Batangas matapos aksidente niya nga napitik ang gatilyo sang iya pusil.
english: A man in Batangas was shot in the genitals after he accidentally pulled the trigger of his gun.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, yara sa ilimnan ang 54-anyos nga biktima kag may ginasukbit ini nga converted caliber .22 handgun sang hinali ini nga naglupok.
english: According to the investigation, the 54-year-old victim was in a bar and was carrying a converted caliber .22 handgun when it suddenly exploded.

text: Gilayon naman nga nadala sa ospital ang biktima.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital.

text: Ginpahayag nga matapos ang insidente, gilayon man nga ginhaboy sang suspek ang iya pusil sa suba.
english: After the incident, the suspect immediately threw his gun into the river.

text: Padayon man ang imbestigasyon sang otoridad.
english: Authorities are also conducting an investigation.

text: Na-eksperyensyahan sang isa ka babaye nga literal nga bayaan sang iya nobyo.
english: A woman experienced being literally abandoned by her boyfriend.

text: Natabo ini sa indi kinaandan nga insidente sa San Mateo, Rizal sang nag-transact ang magkahagugma agud makabakal sang brand-new nga motorsiklo.
english: This happened in an unusual incident in San Mateo, Rizal when the couple transacted to buy a brand-new motorcycle.

text: Suno kay Rizal Police Provincial Director Police Colonel Felope Maraggun, naghingyo ang suspek sa seller nga i-test drive sini ang motorsiklo apang ulihi na natalupangdan nga wala na ini nagbalik kag nagpalagyo na dala ang scooter nga nagabalor sang P215,000.
english: According to Rizal Police Provincial Director Police Colonel Felope Maraggun, the suspect asked the seller to test drive the motorcycle but later noticed that he did not return and fled with the scooter worth P215,000.

text: Ginbilin naman sini ang nobya nga sang amo nga tion, naga-istorya sa manugbaligya.
english: He left the girlfriend who was talking to the seller at the time.

text: Nagtinguha pa ang seller nga kontakon ang suspek apang indi na ini malab-ot rason nga nagpakig-angot ang biktima sa mga pulis sa San Mateo.
english: The seller tried to contact the suspect but could not reach him so the victim contacted the San Mateo police.

text: Wala naman nagpamalibad ang nobya sang gindala ini sang mga pulis sa presuhan.
english: The girlfriend did not refuse when the police took her to jail.

text: Panindugan sini, nakilala lamang niya ang lalaki sa online dating app kag wala siya sang hinalung-ong nga mahimo ini sang iya nobyo.
english: She said she only met the man on an online dating app and had no idea that her boyfriend could do this.

text: Magluwas nga ginkawat sini ang motor, dala pa gid sini ang iPhone sang babaye.
english: Besides stealing the motorcycle, he also took the woman's iPhone.

text: “Wala po talaga akong kaalam-alam na ganun po yung gagawin niya sa motor.
english: “I really had no idea that he would do that on a motorcycle.

text: Actually, daladala niya po yung iPhone ko po.
english: Actually, he's carrying my iPhone.

text: Natangay din po yun.
english: That's also true.

text: Biktima din po ako,” pahayag sang girlfriend.
english: I am also a victim,” the girlfriend said.

text: Padayon pa subong ang follow-up operations sang mga pulis agud maaresto ang suspek, samtang nagapabilin naman ang babaye sa kustodiya sang San Mateo Police Station.
english: Police are still conducting follow-up operations to arrest the suspect, while the woman remains in the custody of the San Mateo Police Station.

text: “Sana mahanap ka na kasi ako yung nagbabayad ng kasalanan na di ko naman ginawa.
english: “I hope you find me because I'm paying for a sin I didn't commit.

text: Dapat ikaw yung nandito eh.
english: You should be here.

text: Dapat ikaw yung nakakulong,” sukma sang babaye sa lalaki nga iya ginpatihan.
english: You should be the one in jail,” the woman scolded the man she believed.

text: Napun-an sang katahum ang entablado sang Miss Universe Philippines 2025 kadungan sang pagpaindis-indis sang 66 ka mga kandidata sa preliminaries sa Newport Performing Arts Theater sa Pasay City.
english: The stage of Miss Universe Philippines 2025 was filled with beauty as 66 candidates competed in the preliminaries at the Newport Performing Arts Theater in Pasay City.

text: Nagpili ang pageant fans kun sin-o ang ila paborito paagi sa performances sang aspiring queens nga nagalakip sang pamilyar nga mga pangalan kag itsura kaangay kanday Ahtisa Manalo, Winwyn Marquez, kag Katrina Llegado.
english: Pageant fans chose their favorites through the performances of aspiring queens that included familiar names and faces like Ahtisa Manalo, Winwyn Marquez, and Katrina Llegado.

text: Nag-host sa event sanday Miss Universe Philippines 2024 kag reigning Miss Universe Asia Chelsea Manalo kag ang TV personality nga si Erika Kristensen-Lee.
english: Hosting the event were Miss Universe Philippines 2024 and reigning Miss Universe Asia Chelsea Manalo and TV personality Erika Kristensen-Lee.

text:
Nag-umpisa ang preliminary competition began sang 10:45 pm — halos tatlo ka oras nga atrasado sa original sini nga schedule nga 8:00 sa gab-i.

Lakip sa natabo amo ang swimsuit round kun sa diin suksok sang candidates ang lavender swimsuits kag purple cover-ups.
english:
The preliminary competition began at 10:45 pm — nearly three hours behind its original schedule of 8:00 pm.

Among the events was the swimsuit round where the candidates wore lavender swimsuits and purple cover-ups.

text: Ginsundan ini sang pagpakitang-gilas sang contestants sa ila elegant walks sa evening gown category.
english: This was followed by the contestants showing off their elegant walks in the evening gown category.

text: Nangin selebrasyon man ini sang Filipino ingenuity kag craftsmanship bangud kada gown ang himo sang Filipino designers.
english: It was also a celebration of Filipino ingenuity and craftsmanship as each gown was made by Filipino designers.

text: Abril 30 ang national costume competition samtang sa Mayo 2, alas sais sa gab-i, ang koronasyon sa Mall of Asia Arena sa Pasay City.
english: The national costume competition will be held on April 30 while the coronation will be held on May 2, at 6 pm, at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City.

text: Ginakabig man nga isa sa mabug-at nga problema sang pila ka mga punong barangay sa syudad sang Iloilo ang huol nga dala sang mga nagalay-lay nga kuryente.
english: The fatigue caused by power outages is also considered one of the biggest problems of some barangay captains in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay John Garry Patnubay sang Barangay East Baluarte, Molo, Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga magluwas sa makitid nga mga dalan nga nagapabudlay sa pagsulod sang fire trucks kag iban pa nga emergency vehicles sa lugar nagatuga man sang peligro kag nagadisturbo nga linya sang kuryente sa lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Punong Barangay John Garry Patnubay of Barangay East Baluarte, Molo, Iloilo City, said that besides the narrow roads that make it difficult for fire trucks and other emergency vehicles to enter the area, it also creates danger and disturbs the power lines in the area.

text: Gindugang man niya ang problema sa wire sang telecommunication companies (telco), bangud may mga kable nga nagawayway kag nagalapta, nga mahimo mangin risgo indi lamang sa sunog kundi pati sa iban pa nga aksidente.
english: He also added the problem with the wires of telecommunication companies (telco), because there are cables that are loose and scattered, which can be a risk not only to fire but also to other accidents.

text: Bilang preparasyon sa sunog, naka-install na ang barangay sang dry stand pipe agud may madali nga makuhaan sang tubig kun may ara sang emerhensya kaangay sang sunog.
english: In preparation for the fire, the barangay has installed a dry stand pipe so that there is an easy source of water in case of emergency such as fire.

text: Ginapanawagan man ni Patnubay sa mga residente nga indi magpatigayon sang illegal nga koneksyon sa kuryente kag magbuligay sa pagmentinar sang maayo nga paggamit sini.
english: Patnubay also appealed to residents not to establish illegal electricity connections and to work together to maintain good use of them.

text: Dugang pa sini nga bisan pa indi Fire Prevention Month, ginahangkat sini ang tanan nga magpadayon sa paghalong kag magmabinantayon agud malikawan ang sunog kag iban pa nga disgrasya sa ila lugar.
english: He added that although it is not Fire Prevention Month, he challenges everyone to remain vigilant and vigilant to avoid fires and other accidents in their area.

text: SA KULTURA naton nga mga Filipino ang maghatag sing respeto sa nagtaliwan kag ang pagpangamuyo sa kaluwasan sang iya kalag.
english: IT IS in our Filipino culture to pay respect to the deceased and to pray for the salvation of his soul.

text: In fact, naandan na naton ang magsiling sing “Kaluy-an ka sang Ginoo!” nga patuhoy sa kaluwasan sang iya kalag.
english: In fact, we are used to saying “The Lord has mercy on you!” concerning the salvation of his soul.

text: Kag ina mapatuhoy man naton gani bisan pa sa ginakaugtan ukon kaaway!
english: And we can even apply that to someone we hate or an enemy!

text: Pero, ngaa ipangamuyo pa naton ang kaluwasan sang mga ginakaugtan kag kaaway naton?
english: But, why should we pray for the salvation of those we hate and enemies?

text: Bangod ina sa tudlo man sang aton Ginoo: “Judge and you will be judged!” kag “Forgive and you shall be forgiven”.
english: That is because of the finger of our Lord: “Judge and you will be judged!” and “Forgive and you shall be forgiven”.

text: Nagapati man kita, labi na gid ang mga catolico, nga ang pagpangamuyo sang kadam-an sa kaluwasan sang kalag sang nagtaliwan daku nga bulig ini agud mapahumok ang balatyagon sang Ginoo sa iya kasal-anan, nga sa lugar magtupa sa Impyerno basi sa Purgatoryo na lang.
english: We also believe, especially Catholics, that the prayer of the masses for the salvation of the soul of the deceased is a great help to soften the Lord's feelings for his sin, which instead falls into Hell based on Purgatory.

text: Kag kon nagtupa siya sa Pugatoryo, sa mas malip-ut na lang nga panahon bag-o siya makasaka sa Langit upod na ang Ginoo sa Iya wala tupong nga Himaya.
english: And if he fell into Purgatory, it would be in a shorter time before he would ascend to Heaven with the Lord in His incomparable Glory.

text: Of course, kinamatarong man sang isa tawo ang magdumdum kag magpahayag sang iya kaisipan sa nakasala nga namatay.
english: Of course, it is also the right of a person to remember and express his thoughts to the offender who died.

text: May tion dira, ugaling, sunu mismo sa Bibliya: “Ang tanan may bagay nga panahon”.
english: There is a time, however, as the Bible itself says: “For everything there is a season”.

text: May panahon sa paghatag sing respeto sa nagtaliwan kag sang iya mga himata kag mga abyan.
english: There is a time to pay respect to the deceased and his relatives and friends.

text: May panahon man sa dutan-on ta nga balatyagon agud mapautwas ang aton kalain sang buot sa madumduman nga nagliligad.
english: There is also a time in our earthly feelings to express our anger at the past.

text: Ugaling, sa bagay lang nga tion kag lugar.
english: However, only at the right time and place.

text: Indi kay samtang ginahayaan pa lang ang nagtaliwan dira mo pa idungan ang imo pagpakalain sa iya, labi na gid sa publiko, nga indi makahulat sa pagbatak sang lalaw (mourning).
english: Not because while you are mourning the deceased, you will continue to insult him, especially in public, who cannot wait for the mourning.

text: Katulad sang ginhimo sang isa ka abogado nga kapartido ni Presidente Dutarte sa pagpabando gid sa kahanginan nga napatay si PNoy sa HIV/AIDS, nga isa ka malala nga balatian nga pwede makuha sa bawal nga relasyon sa kapareho nga lalake nga luyag sini ipahangop.
english: Like what a lawyer who is a party of President Dutarte did in banning the air that PNoy died of HIV/AIDS, which is a serious disease that can be contracted from illicit relationships with the same man that he wants to imply.

text: Indi ini matuod!
english: This is not true!

text: Patu-pato kag panghalit lang ini.
english: It's just hypocrisy and harm.

text: Ang sertipiko sang kamatayon ni PNoy nagasiling nga napatay siya tungod sa “renal failure secondary to diabetes”.
english: PNoy's death certificate said he died of renal failure secondary to diabetes.

text: Indi naton mahangpan ang kaakig sining abogado sa kay PNoy samtang nagakasubo pa ang iya pamilya kag mga abyan.
english: We cannot understand the anger of this lawyer against PNoy while his family and friends are still grieving.

text: Si President Duterte, nga kontra gid sa pulitika ang mga Aquino, nagpaabot pa gani sing maayo nga pahayag parti sa pagtaliwan ni PNoy kag nag-anunsyar pa sang kasubo sang Palasyo.
english: President Duterte, who is strongly opposed to the Aquinos' politics, even expected a good statement about PNoy's death and announced the Palace's grief.

text: Bisan si Senadora Imee Marcos, nga ang amay ginpabangdan nga nagpapatay kay anay Senador Ninoy Aquino, nagdayaw pa gani kay PNoy, nga gintawag niya nga “mabuot”.
english: Even Senator Imee Marcos, whose father was accused of killing former Senator Ninoy Aquino, even praised PNoy, whom she called “kind”.

text: Kon indi buang ining abogado nga ini, basi si Taning ini nga nagapakuno-kuno lang kag, kon indi man, tinawo ini seguro ni Taning nga may espesyal nga misyon agud pakalainon ang Diyosnon nga Presidente.
english: If this lawyer is not crazy, maybe it is Taning who is just pretending and, if not, he is probably Taning's servant with a special mission to defame the Divine President.

text: Tani mapa-disbar ining abogado sa iya masakit nga kabutigan batok kay PNoy.
english: I hope this lawyer will be disbarred for his painful lies against PNoy.

text:
***

Wala sing perfecto nga tawo.
english:
***

No one is perfect.

text: Labi na gid kon nagauyat ka sang daku nga responsibilidad, katulad sang isa ka Presidente sang isa ka pigado nga pungsod, katulad sang Filipinas, nga wala-tuo ang problema.
english: Especially when you hold a big responsibility, like a President of a poor country, like the Philippines, that has no problem.

text: Kon sa bagay, natural man lang gani nga ma-isyuhan ka sang mga kontra sa pulitika, pero wala lang tani yadtong mga mapintas nga kabutigan kag pang-insulto sang mga trolls batok kay PNoy sa iya pagtaliwan.
english: In fact, it's natural to be issued by political opponents, but there wouldn't be those cruel lies and insults of the trolls against PNoy in his death.

text: Unfair ina ya kag indi bagay, labi na gid halin sa mga kuno Diyosnon man nga mga pangontra.
english: That's unfair and not appropriate, especially from the supposedly Godly opponents.

text: Indi man perfecto si PNoy, no doubt!
english: PNoy is not perfect, no doubt!

text: Nonetheless, may mga dalayawon man parti kay PNoy, katulad sang pagpanikasug niya nga matagaan sing legal nga tindug ang aton soberanya sa 200-mile nga Exclusive Economic Zone sa West Philippine Sea sa pagdaug sang aton kaso sa Hague Tribunal sadtong 2016; ang pagpasangkad sang 4Ps para sa labing kubos; ang pagpatambok sang ekonomiya nga ginapasalamatan gid sang mga negosyante; pagduso sang katumanan sang Bangsamoro sa Mindanao; kag ang padayon nga pagpabaskug sang Demokrasya diri sa pungsod sa iya panahon.
english: Nonetheless, there are also commendable things about PNoy, such as his efforts to give our sovereignty a legal status in the 200-mile Exclusive Economic Zone in the West Philippine Sea in winning our case in the Hague Tribunal in 2016; the expansion of 4Ps for the least; the fattening of the economy for which entrepreneurs are so grateful; promoting the implementation of the Bangsamoro in Mindanao; and the continued strengthening of Democracy in the country during his time.

text: Luyag ta man idugang diri ang aton panugdaon sa FB blog site sang isa ka abyan, nga nagatumod kay PNoy nga: “Son of a father who chose to die than abandon his people and of a mother who while bequeathed with enormous power chose to have less than it in recognition of the majesty of the people, as he himself inherited and lived true their immeasurable love for country and Democracy.
english: We would also like to add here our suggestion on the FB blog site of a friend, who refers to PNoy as: “Son of a father who chose to die than abandon his people and of a mother who while bequeathed with enormous power chose to have less than it in recognition of the majesty of the people, as he himself inherited and lived for their true love and democratic country.

text: Rest in peace, President Noy!”/PN
english: Rest in peace, President Noy!”/PN

text: Balik sa pwesto ang former president sang Brazil nga si Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva matapos ginlutos sa presidential election ang incumbent nga right wing populist nga si Jair Bolsonaro.
english: Brazil's former president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is back in office after defeating incumbent right wing populist Jair Bolsonaro in the presidential election.

text: Nadag-an ni Lula ang 50.9 percent sang boto sang mga residente nga bastante na agud mapyerde si Bolsonaro.
english: Lula won 50.9 percent of the vote, enough to defeat Bolsonaro.

text: Ginakabig ini nga stunning comeback bangud sang nagligad nga presidential election sang 2018, indi makapadalagan si Lula bangud napreso ini kag gindumilian nga mag-uyat sang opisina sang gobyerno.
english: This is considered a stunning comeback because in the last presidential election in 2018, Lula could not run because he was imprisoned and barred from holding government office.

text: Ginpamatbatan anay ini nga guilty sa pagbaton sang bribe halin sa Brazilian construction firm bilang bayad sa kontrata sa state oil company nga Petrobras.
english: He was previously found guilty of accepting a bribe from a Brazilian construction firm as payment for a contract with state oil company Petrobras.

text: Naglawig man sang 580 ka adlaw ang tinir ni Lula sa presuhan antes gin-annul ang iya nga conviction.
english: Lula also spent 580 days in jail before his conviction was annulled.

text: Wala pa sang official statement gikan kay Bolsonaro, apang ginbaha naman sang pagpanginbulahan si Lula lakip na ang greetings gikan kay US President Joe Biden, Russian President Vladimir Putin, Narendra Modi sang India, kag UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak.
english: There is no official statement from Bolsonaro, but Lula has been flooded with congratulations including greetings from US President Joe Biden, Russian President Vladimir Putin, Narendra Modi of India, and UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak.

text: Nasubuan apang ginlauman na ni anay presidential spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque ang pagpasaka sang Department of Justice sang qualified human trafficking charges batok sa iya.
english: Former presidential spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque the Department of Justice will file qualified human trafficking charges against him.

text: Gin-file sang Department of Justice (DOJ) ang non-bailable nga kaso sa Angeles City Regional Trial Court (RTC) sa Pampanga kasunod sang ginaalegar nga involvement ni Roque sa gin-raid nga Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO) hub sa Porac sa amo man nga probinsya.
english: The Department of Justice (DOJ) filed the non-bailable case with the Angeles City Regional Trial Court (RTC) in Pampanga following Roque's alleged involvement in the raided Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO) hub in Porac in the same province.

text: Sa video nga gin-release ni Roque, ginsiling niya kabahin ini sang pagpabudlay sang gobyerno sa mga kaalyado ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: In a video released by Roque, he said this is part of the government's efforts to make it difficult for former President Rodrigo Duterte's allies.

text: Suno kay Roque, nag-ugat ang pagpang-ipit sa iya bangud siya ang ginapasibangdan sang gobyerno nga responsable sa pagpagwa sang polvoron video kun sa diin makit-an ang isa ka lalaki nga pareho ang itsura kay Presidente Ferdinand Marcos nga sang ulihi, ginkumpirma sang Philippine National Police kag independent fact-checkers nga AI-generated ini kag gin-alter lamang.
english: According to Roque, the pressure on him stemmed from the government's accusation that he was responsible for the release of the polvoron video showing a man who looked like President Ferdinand Marcos which was later confirmed by the Philippine National Police and independent fact-checkers to be AI-generated and altered.

text: Pahayag sang anay spokesperson, sa pihak sang ginapang-ubra sang gobyerno sa iya, nalipay ini bangud nabuyagyag ang isa ka kamatuoran nga dapat sabton ni Marcos kun bangag gid man ini.
english: The former spokesperson said that despite what the government is doing to him, he is happy because a truth has been revealed that Marcos should answer if he is really a fool.

text: Matandaan nga sa qualified human trafficking charges nga ginpasaka sang DOJ,lakip man sa inkasuhan amo si Cassandra Ong kag 48 ka iban pa nga ginaalegar tag-iya, opisyal, kag nagapanguna nga mga empleyado sang Whirlwind mother company kag Lucky South 99 POGO (Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator).
english: It can be recalled that among the qualified human trafficking charges filed by the DOJ, Cassandra Ong and 48 other alleged owners, officers, and top employees of Whirlwind parent company and Lucky South 99 POGO (Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator) are also charged.

text: Gin-akusaran sila nga nagapadalagan sang scam farm nga nagapang-traffic sang mga trabahador.
english: They were accused of running a scam farm that trafficked workers.

text: Landslide victory ang Team ABANSE sa ginpatigayon nga eleksyon sang Integrated Bar of the Philippines (IBP) Iloilo Chapter sa Ramon Q. Avanceña Hall of Justice.
english: Team ABANSE scored a landslide victory in the election conducted by the Integrated Bar of the Philippines (IBP) Iloilo Chapter at the Ramon Q. Avanceña Hall of Justice.

text: Na-eleher bilang bag-o nga president sang IBP si Atty. Mehelinda Penetrante.
english: Atty. was elected as the new president of IBP. Mehelinda Penetrante.

text: Nangin madinalag-on man ang iya ka-tandem nga si Atty. Edgar Pestaño bilang bise presidente, samtang si Atty. Anfred Panes naman ang iya nangin secretary.
english: His tandem partner, Atty. Edgar Pestaño as vice president, while Atty. Anfred Panes became his secretary.

text: Nagdaog man si Atty. Esther Lee -Trimañez bilang treasurer, Atty. Jordana Mari Jaco bilang auditor, kag Atty. Ma.
english: Atty. also won. Esther Lee -Trimánez as treasurer, Atty. Jordana Mari Jaco as auditor, and Atty. Ma.

text: Theresa Malones Sanchez bilang public relations officer (PRO).
english: Theresa Malones Sanchez as public relations officer (PRO).

text: Magapungko man bilang board of directors sanday Atty. Doriedel Lozañes, Atty. Christian Arfel Cuadras, Atty. Alfred Clement Palmares, Atty. Ian Thomas Besana, kag Atty. Doni June Almio.
english: Also serving as the board of directors will be Atty. Doriedel Lausanes, Atty. Christian Arfel Cuadras, Atty. Alfred Clement Palmares, Atty. Ian Thomas Besana, and Atty. Doni June Almio.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Penetrante, iya ginpahayag nga gin-ekspektar sini nga magadaog sila.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Penetrante, he said he expected them to win.

text: Nangin mainit man ang eleksyon matapos nga nag-file sang petisyon para disqualification ang kontra Partido nga ginapangunahan ni Atty. Eduardo Reyes III.
english: The election also became heated after the opposing party led by Atty. Eduardo Reyes III.

text: Ini kasunod man sang natukiban nga nagatudlo si Penetrante sa West Visayas State University – College of Law.
english: This follows the discovery that Penetrante is teaching at West Visayas State University – College of Law.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga kontrakwal lang siya nga nagatrabaho sa nasambit nga buluthuan.
english: He also explained that he is only contractually employed at the said school.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa ka ground nga ginalantaw sa disqualification case kon nagatrabaho sa gobyerno ang nagapadalagan sa amo nga pwesto.
english: It is known that a ground is considered in the disqualification case if the government employee is running for the post.

text: Suno naman kay Pestaño, wala sila nag-expect nga may petisyon nga magapamatok sa ila, bangud sa sulod sang lima ka tuig, wala sang kontra sa kada eleksyon.
english: Pestaño said they did not expect a petition to oppose them, because for five years, there was no opponent in every election.

text: Personal nga nagkadto sa Hall of Justice si Mayor Jerry Treñas adungan sang eleksyon sang mga officers sang Integrated Bar of the Philippines-Iloilo Chapter.
english: Mayor Jerry Treñas personally went to the Hall of Justice during the election of officers of the Integrated Bar of the Philippines-Iloilo Chapter.

text: Para sa alkalde, indi mainit ang nangin eleksyon sang IBP.
english: For the mayor, the IBP election was not hot.

text: Ginpakigbahin ni Treñas nga ginboto niya sa online voting bilang President si Atty. Mehelinda Penetrante.
english: Treñas shared that he voted for Atty. Mehelinda Penetrante.

text: Pasado na sa New York state bar examination si Kei Komoru, ang bana sang former princess sang Japan nga si Mako.
english: Kei Komoru, the husband of Japan's former princess Mako, has passed the New York state bar examination.

text: Nakuha sang 31-anyos nga si Kei ang kadalag-an sa amo nga pasinawan matapos nga nag-retake sang Hulyo kasunod sang iya duha ka beses nga kapaslawan nga makapasar.
english: The 31-year-old Kei won the exam after retaking it in July following his two failures to pass.

text: Antes sini, nagatrabaho si Kei bilang isa ka law clerk sa isa ka legal firm sa New York matapos nag-graduate sa Fordham University’s law school nga may Juris Doctor degree sang May 2021.
english: Prior to that, Kei worked as a law clerk at a New York legal firm after graduating from Fordham University’s law school with a Juris Doctor degree in May 2021.

text: Halin sang katapusan sang 2021, magkaupod na sila ni Mako nga nagapuyo sa Estados Unidos.
english: Since the end of 2021, she and Mako have been living together in the United States.

text: Si Mako amo ang 30-anyos nga hinablos ni Emperor Naruhito sang Japan.
english: Mako is the 30-year-old nephew of Emperor Naruhito of Japan.

text: Nagpakasal sila sang Oktubre sang nagligad nga tuig apisar sang pagpakamalaot nga nabaton bangud prinsesa si Mako, apang commoner lamang si Kei nga may kontrobersyal pa nga problema sa kuwarta sang amo nga tion.
english: They married in October last year despite the curse received because Mako was a princess, but Kei was only a commoner who still had controversial money problems at the time.

text: Sang tion nga nagpakasal sila nga duha, gintalikdan ni Mako ang iya nga royal status sa Japan.
english: When the two got married, Mako gave up his royal status in Japan.

text: Ini bangud sandig sa 1947 Imperial Household Law, required ang female royals nga i-give up ang ila nga status kun magpamana sila sang commoners.
english: This is because according to the 1947 Imperial Household Law, female royals are required to give up their status if they marry commoners.

text: Matunog anay ang espekulasyon kun masarangan ni Kei nga saguron si Mako bangud gina-kwestyon man kun pila ayhan ang income sini bilang isa ka abogado.
english: There was speculation about whether Kei would be able to support Mako because it was also questioned how much he would earn as a lawyer.

text: Ginapaanggid man ang duha sa masterpiece ni William Shakespeare nga Romeo and Juliet bangud sa pinasahi nga love story.
english: The two are also compared to William Shakespeare's masterpiece Romeo and Juliet because of the unique love story.

text: Ginsuguran na sang Pilipinas kag Japan ang opisyal nga pag-istoryahanay para sa mas madalom nga kooperasyon sa patag sang depensa kag intelligence sharing.
english: The Philippines and Japan have started official talks for deeper cooperation in the fields of defense and intelligence sharing.

text: Katuyuan sini nga pabaskugon pa ang koneksyon sa tunga sang duha ka nasyon bangud sa tensyon sa kadagatan nga pilit nga ginaagkon sang China.
english: The aim is to strengthen the connection between the two countries over the maritime tensions that China is forcibly claiming.

text: Sa ginpatigayon nga meeting sa Malacañang kaupod kay Presidente Ferdinand Marcos, ginkumpirma ni Japanese Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba nga nakasugtan nila nga umpisahan ang negosasyon para sa ginatawag nga Acquisition and Cross Servicing Agreement ukon ACSA.
english: In a meeting held in Malacañang with President Ferdinand Marcos, Japanese Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba confirmed that they have agreed to start negotiations for the so-called Acquisition and Cross Servicing Agreement or ACSA.

text: Isa ini ka kasugtanan nga magatugot sa bayluhanay sang suplay kag serbisyo sa tunga sang Japan Self-Defense Forces kag Armed Forces of the Philippines.
english: This is an agreement that will allow for the exchange of supplies and services between the Japan Self-Defense Forces and the Armed Forces of the Philippines.

text: Magluwas diri, suguran man ang government-to-government talks para sa isa ka Security of Information Agreement, nga magahatag sang ligwa para sa mas hilway nga bayluhanay sang sensitibo nga impormasyon.
english: In addition, government-to-government talks will be initiated for a Security of Information Agreement, which will provide a platform for the free exchange of sensitive information.

text: Gindayaw naman ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. praised the

text: ang Japan bilang pinakauna nga pungsod nga naghatag sang Official Security Assistance ukon OSA sa Pilipinas — nga nakabulig sa modernisasyon sang mga ahensya nga responsable sa pungsodnon nga seguridad.
english: Japan as the first country to provide Official Security Assistance or OSA to the Philippines — helping modernize the agencies responsible for national security.

text: Kabahin ini sang mas ginpabakod nga strategic partnership sang Pilipinas kag Japan, nga tuyo nga pat-uron kag ipabilin ang kalinong kag katawhay sa Indo-Pacific region bangud man sa nagainit nga isyu sa West Philippine Sea.
english: This is part of the strengthened strategic partnership between the Philippines and Japan, which aims to ensure and maintain peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific region as well as the escalating issue in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Ginapatigayon subong nga adlaw ang eleksyon sang masunod nga opisyales sang Integrated Bar of the Philippines (IBP) Iloilo Chapter sa Ramon Q. Avanceña Hall of Justice.
english: The election of the next officers of the Integrated Bar of the Philippines (IBP) Iloilo Chapter is being held today at the Ramon Q. Avanceña Hall of Justice.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Eduardo Reyes III, iya ginpahayag nga lakip sa mga nagapapili amo ang grupo sang Team ABANSE nga ginapangunahan ni IBP Presidential Aspirant Atty. Mehelinda Penetrante.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Eduardo Reyes III, he said that among the candidates is the group of Team ABANSE led by IBP Presidential Aspirant Atty. Mehelinda Penetrante.

text:
Ang ABANSE ang nagakahulugan sang:

A – Advocacies for women, children, and indigent communities thru legalB – Bench and Bar CollaborationA – Accountability and TransparencyN- Nurturing Lawyers thru continuing educationS – Sports and WellnessE – Empowered and Inclusive Membership thru fellowship and activities

Samtang, sa piyak naman nga grupo ang ginapangunahan ni IBP Presidential Aspirant Atty. Eduardo Reyes III.
english:
ADVANCE stands for:

A – Advocacies for women, children, and indigent communities through legalB – Bench and Bar CollaborationA – Accountability and TransparencyN- Nurturing Lawyers through continuing educationS – Sports and WellnessE – Empowered and Inclusive Membership through fellowship and activities

Meanwhile, the other group is led by IBP Presidential Aspirant Atty. Eduardo Reyes III.

text: Suno kay Reyes, sa 2,000 ka mga myemro sang IBP Iloilo, ginabanta 1500 diri ang rehistrado agud nga makaboto.
english: According to Reyes, of the 2,000 members of IBP Iloilo, about 1,500 are registered to vote.

text: Lakip namansa kaupod ni Atty. Reyes, amo si Atty. Victor Decida nga magaserbebilang iya bise presidente.
english: Among those with Atty. Reyes, Atty. Victor Decida who will serve as its vice president.

text: Samtang, ginkuha man sini si Atty. Kchyrziahshayne Dinopol sa pagka-secretary iya ginkuha kag si Atty. Peter John Pacheco naman sa pagka-auditor.
english: Meanwhile, he also took Atty. Kchyrziahshayne Dinopol as secretary he took and Atty. Peter John Pacheco as auditor.

text: Napilian ang Filipino cardinal nga si Luis Antonio Tagle nga mangin isa sa tatlo ka assistants sang camerlengo ukon ang caretaker sang papal household samtang nagapreparar para sa Conclave sa masunod nga tatlo ka adlaw.
english: Filipino cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle has been chosen to be one of the three assistants of the camerlengo or the caretaker of the papal household as it prepares for the Conclave in the next three days.

text: Suno sa Vatican, ang duha ka iban pa amo sanday Cardinal Dominique Mamberti kag Cardinal Reinhard Marx nga parte sang commission bilang coordinator sang Council for the Economy.
english: According to the Vatican, the other two are Cardinal Dominique Mamberti and Cardinal Reinhard Marx who are part of the commission as coordinator of the Council for the Economy.

text: Sila nga tatlo ang magabulig kay Cardinal Kevin Farrell agud magpreparar para sa eleksyon sa bag-o nga Santo Papa nga maga-umpisa sa Mayo 7.
english: The three will help Cardinal Kevin Farrell prepare for the election of the new pope, which begins on May 7.

text: “The office of these cardinals, called assistants, ceases at the conclusion of the third full day, and their place is taken by others, also chosen by lot and having the same term of office, also after the election has begun,” base sa dokumento nga Universi Dominici Gregis.
english: “The office of these cardinals, called assistants, ceases at the conclusion of the third full day, and their place is taken by others, also chosen by lot and having the same term of office, also after the election has begun,” according to the document Universi Dominici Gregis.

text: Pahayag pa sini: “The particular congregations are to deal only with questions of lesser importance which arise on a daily basis or from time to time.
english: It further stated: “The particular congregations are to deal only with questions of lesser importance which arise on a daily basis or from time to time.

text:
But should there arise more serious questions deserving fuller examination, these must be submitted to the general congregation.”

Sa nagligad nga duha ka conclaves nga ginpatigayon agud ma-elect sanday Pope Benedict XVI kag Pope Francis sang 2005 kag 2013, duha ka adlaw ang ginlawig sang eleksyon, apang may impormasyon nga posible mas maglawig ini subong nga tuig bangud may mga cardinal nga gin-appoint si Pope Francis nga indi pa pamilyar sa isa kag isa.
english:
But should there arise more serious questions deserving fuller examination, these must be submitted to the general congregation.”

In the previous two conclaves held to elect Pope Benedict XVI and Pope Francis in 2005 and 2013, the election lasted two days, but there is information that it may take longer this year because some cardinals appointed by Pope Francis are not yet familiar with each other.

text: Sa Pilipinas, tatlo ka cardinals ang elegible sa pag-elect sa bag-o nga Pope.
english: In the Philippines, three cardinals are eligible to elect a new Pope.

text: Ini amo sanday Tagle nga Prefect of the Dicastery for Evangelization, Manila Archbishop Jose Cardinal Advincula kag Kalookan Bishop Pablo Virgilio Cardinal David.
english: They are Tagle, Prefect of the Dicastery for Evangelization, Manila Archbishop Jose Cardinal Advincula and Kalookan Bishop Pablo Virgilio Cardinal David.

text: Indi naman pwede nga maka-upod sa eleksyon sanday Manila Archbishop Emeritus Gaudencio Cardinal Rosales kag Cotabato Archbishop Emeritus Orlando Cardinal Quevedo bangud masobra na sa 80-anyos ang ila nga edad.
english: Manila Archbishop Emeritus Gaudencio Cardinal Rosales and Cotabato Archbishop Emeritus Orlando Cardinal Quevedo are not allowed to participate in the election because they are over 80 years old.

text: Mahimo lamang sila makaupod sa preparatory General Congregations sang College of Cardinals.
english: They may only join the preparatory General Congregations of the College of Cardinals.

text: Wala gintuman ni Russian President Vladimir Putin ang promisa sini sang nagligad nga adlaw nga indi na kinahanglan ang massive strikes sa Ukraine.
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin has not kept its promise the previous day that massive strikes in Ukraine would no longer be necessary.

text: Ginabanta walo ka tawo ang patay sa panibag-o ang pagpang-atake sang Russia sa mga syudad sa Ukraine sang Lunes sang aga gamit ang halos 30 ka kamikaze drones nga ginapatihan nga human sa Iran.
english: At least eight people were killed in renewed Russian attacks on Ukrainian cities on Monday morning with nearly 30 kamikaze drones believed to be made in Iran.

text: Sa walo nga reported nga napatay, apat ang nagikan sa capital nga Kyiv lakip na ang isa ka nagabusong nga babayi, samtang apat man ang patay sa Sumy region.
english: Of the eight reported dead, four were from the capital Kyiv, including a pregnant woman, while four were also killed in the Sumy region.

text: May videos man nga nagapakita sang Shahed-136 drones sang Iran nga gin-rebrand sang Russia bilang Geran-2 nga amo ang naglinupad sa Kriv, nagpasigabong, kag nagpwersa sa mga tawo nga magpalalagyo.
english: There are also videos showing Iranian Shahed-136 drones rebranded by Russia as Geran-2 that flew over Kriv, set it on fire, and forced people to flee.

text: Lima ka asud-asud nga pagsigabong ang natabo sa Kyiv nga naguba sa kritikal nga mga imprastraktura kag nag-utod sang suplay sang kuryente.
english: Five consecutive fires struck Kyiv damaging critical infrastructure and cutting off power supplies.

text: Ginapatihan nga ginagamit sang Russia ang Shahed-136 drones nga gina-suplay sang Iran.
english: Russia is believed to be using Shahed-136 drones supplied by Iran.

text: Ginhatagan ini sang kamikaze description bangud sarang ini nga maka-operate sa kalayuon nga 1,000 km (620 miles) kag indi kaangay sang iban nga drones nga nagabalik sa base kun ma-launch na sini ang missile, ang “kamikaze” ukon “suicide” drones ang nagakaguba man sa mismo pag-atake sini.
english: It was given the kamikaze description because it can operate at a distance of 1,000 km (620 miles) and unlike other drones that return to base after launching a missile, “kamikaze” or “suicide” drones are also destroyed in the attack itself.

text: Kaangay sa cruise missiles, maka-atake sini bisan kilometros pa ang kalayuon, apang mas barato ang “kamikaze” apang ginatawag man nga precise alternative.
english: Like cruise missiles, it can attack even kilometers away, but the “kamikaze” is cheaper but also called a precise alternative.

text: Ginapatihan sang Ukraine nga nakabaton ang Russia sang 2,400 drones halin sa Iran.
english: Ukraine believes Russia received 2,400 drones from Iran.

text: Wala sang kumpirmasyon nagikan sa Iran kun gina-suplayan matuod sini sang drones ang Russia.
english: There is no confirmation from Iran whether it is indeed supplying Russia with drones.

text: Una na nga nagpaandam ang Estados Unidos nga manabat kag silutan ang sin-o man nga tawo, pungsod, ukon organisasyon nga nagasuporta sa Russia sa pag-atake sini sa Ukraine.
english: The United States has previously warned that it will hold accountable and punish any person, country, or organization that supports Russia in its attack on Ukraine.

text: Kun matandaan, sang nagligad lang nga semana, aga man sang nagpalupad ang Russia sang missiles sa Ukraine kag nagpatay sang 19 ka mga tawo.
english: Last week, Russia launched missiles into Ukraine, killing 19 people.

text: Ginpili sang mga Cardinal ang Mayo 7 nga amo ang petsa sang pag-umpisa sang Conclave kun sa diin iga-eleher ang bag-o nga lider para sa 1.4-billion nga mga Katoliko sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: The cardinals chose May 7 as the start date of the Conclave where a new leader will be elected for the 1.4-billion Catholics around the world.

text: Suno sa Vatican, nakasugtan ang petsa sang Lunes kadungan sang una nga daily congregation sang mga cardinal kasunod sang lubong ni Pope Francis.
english: According to the Vatican, the date was agreed on Monday during the first daily congregation of cardinals following the funeral of Pope Francis.

text: Ang mga cardinal lamang nga wala pa naka-80 anyos ang sarang nga makaboto sa papal election.
english: Only cardinals under the age of 80 can vote in the papal election.

text: May 135 ka cardinals subong nga eligible nga magpasakop sa eleksyon, apang may isa nga nagpahayag nga indi ini makakadto sa Vatican bangud sa problema sa ikaayong lawas.
english: There are currently 135 cardinals eligible to participate in the election, but one said he could not go to the Vatican because of health problems.

text: Suno anay Vatican spokesman Matteo Bruni, napili man sang College of Cardinals sanday Cardinal Reinhard Marx, Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle kag Cardinal Dominique Mamberti nga buligan si Cardinal Kevin Farrell ukon ang“camerlengo” (or chamberlain).
english: According to former Vatican spokesman Matteo Bruni, the College of Cardinals also selected Cardinal Reinhard Marx, Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle and Cardinal Dominique Mamberti to assist Cardinal Kevin Farrell or the “camerlengo” (or chamberlain).

text: Si Farrell ang may katungdanan nga mag-oversee kag magpanguna sa temporal goods kag rights sa Apostolic See kasunod sang kamatayon sang 88-anyos nga Santo Papa.
english: Farrell was charged with overseeing and leading temporal goods and rights in the Apostolic See following the death of the 88-year-old Pope.

text: Sa nagligad nga duha ka conclaves nga ginpatigayon agud ma-elect sanday Pope Benedict XVI kag Pope Francis sang 2005 kag 2013, duha ka adlaw ang ginlawig sang eleksyon, apang may impormasyon nga posible mas maglawig ini subong nga tuig bangud may mga cardinal nga gin-appoint si Pope Francis nga indi pa pamilyar sa isa kag isa.
english: In the previous two conclaves held to elect Pope Benedict XVI and Pope Francis in 2005 and 2013, the election lasted two days, but there is information that it may take longer this year because some cardinals appointed by Pope Francis are not yet familiar with each other.

text: Sa Pilipinas, tatlo ka cardinals ang elegible sa pag-elect sa bag-o nga Pope.
english: In the Philippines, three cardinals are eligible to elect a new Pope.

text: Ini amo sanday Tagle nga Prefect of the Dicastery for Evangelization, Manila Archbishop Jose Cardinal Advincula kag Kalookan Bishop Pablo Virgilio Cardinal David.
english: They are Tagle, Prefect of the Dicastery for Evangelization, Manila Archbishop Jose Cardinal Advincula and Kalookan Bishop Pablo Virgilio Cardinal David.

text: Indi naman pwede nga maka-upod sa eleksyon sanday Manila Archbishop Emeritus Gaudencio Cardinal Rosales kag Cotabato Archbishop Emeritus Orlando Cardinal Quevedo bangud masobra na sa 80-anyos ang ila nga edad.
english: Manila Archbishop Emeritus Gaudencio Cardinal Rosales and Cotabato Archbishop Emeritus Orlando Cardinal Quevedo are not allowed to participate in the election because they are over 80 years old.

text: Mahimo lamang sila makaupod sa preparatory General Congregations sang College of Cardinals.
english: They may only join the preparatory General Congregations of the College of Cardinals.

text: (Photo: Mario Tomassetti/Vatican Media/Reuters)
english: (Photo: Mario Tomasetti/Vatican Media/Reuters)

text: Ginabati-bati nga malapit na lang nga ma-settle ang problema sa tunga nanday Princess of Wales nga si Kate Middleton kag sang Duchess of Sussex nga si Meghan Markle.
english: It is rumored that the problem between Princess of Wales Kate Middleton and Duchess of Sussex Meghan Markle is close to being settled.

text: Sa reports, ginapahayag nga makigkita si Kate kay Meghan sa ila pagbisita ni Prince William sa Estados Unidos sa Disyembre subong nga tuig.
english: According to reports, Kate will meet Meghan during Prince William's visit to the United States in December this year.

text: Sa amo nga bulan, magatambong si Kate kag William sa ikaduha nga annual Earth shot Prize awards ceremony sa Boston nga kadungan man sang byahe nanday Prince Harry kag Meghan para sa Ripple of Hope Award Gala sang Robert F. Kennedy Human Rights organization sa New York.
english: That month, Kate and William will attend the second annual Earth shot Prize awards ceremony in Boston which also coincides with Prince Harry and Meghan's trip for the Robert F. Kennedy Human Rights organization's Ripple of Hope Award Gala in New York.

text: Ginapahayag nga amo man ini ang mangin daku nga tikang antes mag-ayo liwat ang relasyon sa tunga sang mag-utod nga sanday Prince Harry kag Prince William.
english: It is reported that this will also be the big step before the relationship between the brothers Prince Harry and Prince William will mend again.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag nga may daku nga argumento sa tunga nanday Meghan kag Kate antes ang kasal nanday Harry kag Meghan sang 2018.
english: It was previously reported that there was a huge argument between Meghan and Kate ahead of Harry and Meghan’s 2018 wedding.

text: Nag-kumplikado pa ang ila relasyon kasunod sang desisyon nanday Harry kag Meghan nga magpalayo na sa British Royal Family sang 2020.
english: Their relationship became even more complicated following Harry and Meghan's decision to step away from the British Royal Family in 2020.

text: ILOILO – Plano ni Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar nga i-address ang issue sa serye sang holdup incidents sa lebel sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan.
english: ILOILO – Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar plans to address the issue of the series of holdup incidents at the Sangguniang Panlalawigan level.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Board Member Mondejar, Chairman sang Committee on Public Order and Security, iya ginpahayag nga kinahanglan may yara anay siya sang detailed study may kaangtanan sa mga insidente nga natabo antes makahimo sang epektibo nga estratehiya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Board Member Mondejar, Chairman of the Committee on Public Order and Security, said he needs to have a detailed study on the incidents that occurred before developing an effective strategy.

text: Santu sa data sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, sa sulod lang sang bulan sang Pebrero 2025, nakarekord na ini sang apat ka mga holdup incidents lakip na ang sa Pavia sang Pebrero 10 sa diin nakuha sang mga suspek ang P300,000 nga benta sang fuel tanker sang Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative.
english: According to the data of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, in the month of February 2025 alone, it has recorded four holdup incidents including the one in Pavia on February 10 where the suspects took the P300,000 sale of the fuel tanker of the Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative.

text: Pebrero 11, natabo naman ang ika-duha nga insidente sa Santa Barbara sa diin nabiktima ang isa ka manugbaligya sang herbal product kag nakuha sa iya ang ginabanta P20,000, bulong kag cellphone.
english: On February 11, the second incident occurred in Santa Barbara where a herbal product vendor was victimized and was robbed of P20,000, medicine and a cellphone.

text: Pebrero 18 sang udto natabo naman ang holdup incident sa Barotac Viejo sa diin isa ka Indian national ang nabiktima kag nakuha sang mga suspek ang P4,500.
english: On February 18 afternoon, a holdup incident occurred in Barotac Viejo where an Indian national was victimized and the suspects stole P4,500.

text: Isa sa duha ka mga suspek ang nadakpan sang kapulisan.
english: One of the two suspects was arrested by the police.

text: Samtang pagkagab-i sang Pebrero 18, ginholdup ang isa ka manugbaligya isda sa diin nakuha sang mga suspek ang P159,000 nga cash kag cellphone.
english: Meanwhile, on the night of February 18, a fish vendor was robbed where the suspects seized P159,000 in cash and a cellphone.

text: Suno kay Mondejar, bangud sa madamo nga insidente sang holdup sa Iloilo, kinahanglan magdoble effort pa ang mga kapulisan kag mapabaskog ang ila mga tikang sa pag-identify kag pagdakop sang mga suspek kag agud indi na liwat nga matabo ang kaangay nga insidente.
english: According to Mondejar, due to the many holdup incidents in Iloilo, the police need to redouble their efforts and strengthen their measures to identify and arrest the suspects and to prevent such incidents from happening again.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, kun indi masolusyonan ang holdup incidents sa Iloilo mangin makaalarma ini sa publiko.
english: He added that if the holdup incidents in Iloilo are not resolved, it will be alarming to the public.

text: Ginsipa ni President Donald Trump sa pwesto bilang chair sang Joint Chiefs of Staff si General C.Q. Brown.
english: President Donald Trump fired General C.Q. Brown.

text: Plano nga ibulos sa posisyon si Air Force Lt.
english: Air Force Lt. Col.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Dan Caine.
english: And Caine.

text: Bilang chair sang Joint Chiefs of Staff, si Brown ang nagserbe bilang top military adviser sang presidente.
english: As chair of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, Brown served as the president’s top military adviser.

text: Iya gin-assume ang position para sa iya apat ka tuig nga tenure sang Oktubre 2023.
english: He will assume the position for his four-year tenure in October 2023.

text: Wala naman sang may ginhatag nga rason si Trump sa pagkakas kay Brown.
english: Trump did not give a reason for firing Brown.

text: Ini ang una nga tion nga ang top military official sang US ang ginsipa sa pwesto sang tuman ka temprano gikan sa iya apat ka tuig kuntani nga termino.
english: This is the first time that the top US military official has been kicked out of office so early from what would have been his four-year term.

text: Wala sang kahangawa si US President Joe Biden sa padayon pa nga pagtaas sang balor sang US dollar.
english: US President Joe Biden is not concerned about the continued appreciation of the US dollar.

text: Sa baylo, ginbasol sini ang anemic growth kag sala nga mga polisa sa iban nga bahin sang kalibutan nga amo suno sa iya ang nagapalala pa sang dalagan sang pagkalibutanon nga ekonomiya.
english: Instead, it blamed anemic growth and wrong policies in other parts of the world which it said were making the course of the global economy worse.

text: “I’m not concerned about the strength of the dollar, I’m concerned about the rest of the world,” suno kay Biden.
english: “I’m not concerned about the strength of the dollar, I’m concerned about the rest of the world,” according to Biden.

text: Kun Estados Unidos lang ang hambalan suno kay Biden, tuman ka pag-on ang ekonomiya sini.
english: As for the United States, Biden said, its economy is very strong.

text: “Our economy is strong as hell — the internals of it.
english: “Our economy is strong as hell — the internals of it.

text: Inflation is worldwide.
english: Inflation is worldwide.

text: It’s worse off everywhere else than it is in the United States.
english: It’s worse off everywhere else than it is in the United States.

text: So the problem is the lack of economic growth and sound policy in other countries, not so much ours,” pahayag sang presidente.
english: So the problem is the lack of economic growth and sound policy in other countries, not so much ours,” the president said.

text: Baliskad ang komento ni Biden sa statements sang iban nga mga lider halin sa iban nga mga pungsod nga nagareklamo nga ang nagataas nga balor sang US dollar ang rason sang pagtaas pa sang inflation sa ila tagsa ka ekonomiya.
english: Biden's comments contradict statements by other leaders from other countries who complain that the rising value of the US dollar is the cause of further inflation in their respective economies.

text: Ang mataas nga dolyar ang nagahatag bug-at sa ekonomiya sang pigado nga mga pungsod ilabi na ang nagasalig sa food imports.
english: The high dollar is weighing on the economies of poor countries, especially those that rely on food imports.

text: Ang kombinasyon sang mataas nga dolyar, mataas nga interest rates, kag ang mataas man nga commodity prices ang nagapanubo pa sa gahum sang iban nga mga nasyon nga makabakal sang pagkaon.
english: The combination of a high dollar, high interest rates, and also high commodity prices is further reducing the power of some countries to buy food.

text: Bilang resulta, nagalala pa ang global food crisis.
english: As a result, the global food crisis is getting worse.

text: Lain ang komento ni Biden ipaanggid sa iban nga mga presidente sang Estados Unidos.
english: Biden's comments are different from those of other US presidents.

text: Kun matandaan, sang tion ni anay US President Donald Trump, ginpahayag sini nga indi sini gusto ang mataas nga dolyar nga may malain nga epekto sa trade sa iban nga mga nasyon.
english: During the time of former US President Donald Trump, he said he did not want the high dollar to have a negative impact on trade with other countries.

text: Ginpadala sang pamilya Duterte ang anum ka mga Pilipino nga abogado agud nga magtambong sa confirmation of charges hearing batok kay former President Rodrigo Duterte sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: The Duterte family sent six Filipino lawyers to attend the confirmation of charges hearing against former President Rodrigo Duterte at the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Sa statement sang Duterte Family, ginpahayag nga maga-upod sa proceedings ang Filipino legal team agud masiguro nga ma-representar sang husto ang former president.
english: In a statement, the Duterte Family said the Filipino legal team will accompany the proceedings to ensure that the former president is properly represented.

text:
Ini amo sanday:

Sa press statement sang pamilya, wala ginkumpirma kun magatambong man sila sa hearing ukon kun sin-o sa ila ang magakadto sa The Hague, Netherlands, apang ila ginklaro nga wala nagpasugot ang ICC nga mabisita nila si Duterte samtang padayon ang hearings.
english:
These are:

In a press statement, the family did not confirm whether they will attend the hearing or which of them will go to The Hague, Netherlands, but they clarified that the ICC did not allow them to visit Duterte while the hearings are ongoing.

text: Ang gintugtan lamang sang korte amo ang pagtawag pamaagi sa telepono.
english: The only thing the court allowed was the telephone call method.

text: Ginpasalamatan man sang pamilya Duterte ang Filipino lawyers sa ila suporta kag ang Filipino community sa The Hague.
english: The Duterte family also thanked the Filipino lawyers for their support and the Filipino community in The Hague.

text: Sandig kay Panelo, ginalauman nga magapungko sila sa public gallery kag magalantaw sa proceedings nga maga-umpisa 5:00 karon sa hapon oras sa Pilipinas.
english: According to Panelo, they are expected to sit in the public gallery and watch the proceedings that will start at 5:00 pm Philippine time.

text: May hearings man sa buwas, Martes, sa Huwebes, kag sa Byernes.
english: There will also be hearings tomorrow, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa idalom sang Rome Statute, ang ICC-accredited lawyers lamang ang opisyal nga maka-representar sa isa ka suspek ukon mangin sa mga biktima sa proceedings sang korte sa The Hague.
english: Under the Rome Statute, only ICC-accredited lawyers can officially represent a suspect or even victims in court proceedings in The Hague.

text: Ang head legal counsel ni Duterte amo ang British-Israeli lawyer nga si Nicholas Kaufman kag paga-updan sang veteran trial lawyer nga si Dov Jacobs nga amo ang associate counsel.
