english: Duterte's head legal counsel is British-Israeli lawyer Nicholas Kaufman and will be joined by veteran trial lawyer Dov Jacobs as associate counsel.

text: Nagpaidalom sa vasectomy ang celebrity host nga si Drew Arellano.
english: Celebrity host Drew Arellano underwent a vasectomy.

text: Gin-post sini sa Instagram ang iya selfie samtang nagasuksok sang hospital gown kag yara sa hospital bed.
english: She posted a selfie on Instagram while wearing a hospital gown and in a hospital bed.

text: “Happy late and advanced Mother’s Day to my wife,” pahayag sini sa caption dala ang hashtags nga #HappyVA-SEC-TO-MEEE kag #snipsnip.
english: “Happy late and advanced Mother’s Day to my wife,” he said in the caption with the hashtags #HappyVA-SEC-TO-MEEE and #snipsnip.

text: Kasado si Drew sa host nga si Iya Villania halin sang 2014.
english: Drew has been married to host Iya Villania since 2014.

text: May yara na sila sang lima ka mga bata nga sanday Primo, Leon, Alana, Astro, kag Anya.
english: They already have five children namely Primo, Leon, Alana, Astro, and Anya.

text: Base sa Mayo Clinic, ang vasectomy ang isa ka sahi sang birth control kag ginakonsiderar nga minor surgery kun sa diin utdon kag iga-seal sang surgeon ang tubes nga nagadala sang sperm.
english: According to the Mayo Clinic, vasectomy is a type of birth control and is considered a minor surgery where the surgeon cuts and seals the tubes that carry sperm.

text: Sa comments section, gindayaw sang fans kag netizens si Drew sa pag-promote sang sini nga sahi sang contraceptive para sa mga lalaki.
english: In the comments section, fans and netizens praised Drew for promoting this type of contraceptive for men.

text: 𝗞𝗨𝗪𝗔𝗜𝗧 — Nagbulagay ang isa ka mag-asawa sa Kuwait, matapos ang tatlo ka minutos sang ila ginhiwat nga kasal.
english: 𝗞𝗨𝗪𝗔𝗜𝗧 — A couple in Kuwait broke up, after three minutes of their wedding.

text: Ang natabo gintawag sang mga foreign news nga “probably the shortest marriage” kag “fastest divorce case” sa ila tagsa ka mga report.
english: The incident was called “probably the shortest marriage” and “fastest divorce case” by foreign news in their respective reports.

text: Natabo ini sang 2019, apang nagguwa ini liwat sa social media kag nangin viral.
english: It happened in 2019, but it resurfaced on social media and went viral.

text: Suno sa istorya, ang mag-asawa nga nagpakasal sa isa ka korte sa Kuwait bag-o lang gindeklarar nga mag-asawa.
english: As the story goes, the couple who got married in a Kuwait court were recently declared husband and wife.

text: Pagguwa nila sa pwertahan sang venue, nasandad ang bride.
english: When they walked out the door of the venue, the bride stumbled.

text:
Nabatian niya ang nobyo nga nagtawag sa iya nga “buang.”

Nag-init ang nobya kag nagbalik sa sulod sang courthouse.
english:
She heard the boyfriend call her “stupid.”

The girlfriend got hot and went back inside the courthouse.

text: Sa amo man nga tion kag didto ginpangabay niya ang hukom nga kanselahon ang ila kasal.
english: Right then and there she asked the judge to annul their marriage.

text: Nagpasugot ang hukom kag nagpaguwa sang divorce decree tatlo ka minutos pagkatapos nila kasal.
english: The judge agreed and issued the divorce decree three minutes after they were married.

text: Samtang, sa website sang U.S. Embassy in Kuwait, gindiskusyon ang pagbulagay sang mga babayi sa ila mga bana nga taga-Kuwait.
english: Meanwhile, on the website of the U.S. Embassy in Kuwait, women’s separation from their Kuwaiti husbands was discussed.

text: Ang “Shari’a” ukon “khali’a” ginsambit bilang isa ka opsyon sa diborsyo nga magamit para sa mga kababayin-an sa Kuwait.
english: “Shari’a” or “khali’a” was mentioned as a divorce option available for women in Kuwait.

text: Rason agud nga ang isa ka babayi mahimo magdiborsio sa iya bana sang madasig nga indi kinahanglan nga magpasad sang mga rason, kon magsugot siya nga ihatag ang iya mga kinamatarong sa propiedad kag mga pagkabutang sang iya bana (apang indi ang pag-atipan sang iya mga kabataan).
english: Reason so that a woman can divorce her husband quickly without having to establish grounds, if she agrees to give up her rights to her husband’s property and assets (but not the custody of her children).

text: LIWAT nag-andar ang wala sa lugar nga pamahog ni Presidente Duterte.
english: President Duterte's misplaced threat is on again.

text: Pinahog niya ang indi magpabakuna nga ipa-priso sila, ukon indi man, piliton gid ini sila nga patublukan sang dagum para mabakunahan.
english: He threatened those who refused to be vaccinated with imprisonment, or if they did not, he would force them to be injected with a needle to be vaccinated.

text: May rason ang isa ka tawo kon ngaa indi siya luyag magpabakuna.
english: Someone has a reason for not wanting to get vaccinated.

text: Kon ano man ina nga rason, kinamatarong ugaling sang tawo ang magbakuna ukon indi, kag indi mo siya mapilit sa aton Demokrasya.
english: Whatever the reason, it is the right of the person to vaccinate or not, and you cannot force him in our Democracy.

text: Abogado si Presidente Duterteya kag dapat kahibalo siya nga indi mo mapapriso ang tawo tungod lang indi siya magpabakuna kay wala kita sing kasuguan nga naga-penalize sina.
english: President Duterteya is a lawyer and he should know that you can't put a person in jail just because he doesn't get vaccinated because we don't have a law that penalizes that.

text: Diniktador ina ya nga panugyan sang Presidente!
english: The President's advice is dictatorial!

text: Well, posible man nga nahimo yadto ni Presidente Duterte tungod lang sang iya “frustration” sa malaka nga pagkadto sang mga pumuluyo sa mga vaccination site.
english: Well, it is possible that President Duterte did that just because of his “frustration” with the frequent visits of the people to the vaccination sites.

text: Daw indi man.
english: Apparently not.

text: Kon naglaka ang pagkadto sang mga pumuluyo sa vaccination site ina, sunu kay Mayor Isko Moreno sang Manila, tungod “by appointment” ang pagpabakuna.
english: If the residents are going to the vaccination site, it is because of the “by appointment” vaccination, according to Mayor Isko Moreno of Manila.

text: Pero sang gintugot ang walk-in nagaalawas man gani ang nagkadto sa vaccination site.
english: But when walk-in was allowed, those who went to the vaccination site were getting sick.

text: In fact, nagagwa nga ang problema yara gid sa gobyerno nga tubtub karon wala mapakita nga abilidad agud maka-acquire sang bastante nga mga bakuna para sa mga pumuluyo.
english: In fact, it turns out that the problem lies with the government which has so far not shown the ability to acquire enough vaccines for the people.

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text:
***

May namangkot sa aton kon ano ang “soulmate” kag kon may “soulmate” gid man.
english:
***

Someone asked us what a “soulmate” is and if there is a “soulmate” at all.

text: Paano bala nagtuhaw ining ideya nga “soulmate”?
english: How did this idea of ​​a “soulmate” come about?

text: Sunu kay Greek Philosopher Plato, sa sugid man sa iya ni  Aristophanes, nga isa ka poeta sang ila panahon sadtong ancient times, ang kada tawo may kapihak (twin), pagkatapos nga ginbulag ni Zeus ang orihinal nga kahimtangan sang tawo sa duha kag separado nga kapid, nga ginpatihan man sang mga tawo sadto sa ila pagtuo sa mga diyos-diyos sa pagpamuno ni Zeus kag sang iya asawa nga si Hera.
english: According to the Greek philosopher Plato, as told to him by Aristophanes, a poet of their time in ancient times, each human being had a twin, after Zeus separated the original state of man into two separate twins, which was also believed by the people of that time in their faith in the gods Zeus and his wife that Hera.

text: “Kon ang isa makakita sang iya kapihak, nga iya man kaugalingon, mangin lubos gid ang ila kalipay sa gugma (love), pakig-abyan (friendship) kag kahirup (intimacy) nga indi na sila luyag magbulagay pa,” paathag ni Aristophanes.
english: “When one finds one's other, who is also one's own, they become so full of love, friendship and intimacy that they do not want to separate,” explains Aristophanes.

text: Ang tinaga nga “soulmate” para sa amo ina nga relasyon sang kapid nga personalidad una gingamit sadtong 1882 ni poeta Samuel Taylor Coleridge.
english: The word “soulmate” for such a twin-personality relationship was first used in 1882 by poet Samuel Taylor Coleridge.

text: Sa isa niya ka sulat nagsiling siya (ginlubad sa Hiligaynon): “Agud mangin malipayon sa inyo pag-asawahay…kinahanglan ninyo ang “Soul-mate”.
english: In one of his letters he said (translated into Hiligaynon): “To be happy in your marriage...you need a “Soul-mate”.

text: Sa iya paathag, siling niya nga “Ang madinalag-on nga pag-asawahay nagakinahanglan sing labaw pa sa ‘economic or social responsibility’.
english: In his explanation, he says that “A successful marriage requires more than ‘economic or social responsibility’.

text:
Nagakinahanglan ini sang ispiritwal nga koneksyon.”

Sugod sadto, nangin popular na sa Amerika kag bisan pa sa iban nga bahin sang kalibutan ang tinaga kag pagpati sa “soulmate” sa pagpaathag nga ini ni Coleridge, labi na gid sa mga pungsod nga may diborsyo ukon diin luyag lang anay mag-live-in (trial marriage) tubtub maseguro ang ila kaugalingon sa pagminyo formal.
english:
It requires a spiritual connection.”

Since then, the word and belief in “soulmate” has become popular in America and even in other parts of the world to explain that it is Coleridge, especially in countries where there is divorce or where they just want to live-in (trial marriage) until they can secure themselves in formal marriage.

text: Tungod sining mga hitabo, ginpatihan na sang madamo nga “wala sing forever” sa isang relasyon, nga nagbutang man gani sa peligro ang sinumpaan “For better or for worse, ‘til death do us part!” sang kalaslon nga ginapatuman sang mga simbahan, labi na gid sang Simbahan Catoliko.
english: Because of these events, many have come to believe that “there is no forever” in a relationship, which has even endangered the oath “For better or for worse, ‘til death do us part!” of marriage imposed by the churches, especially the Catholic Church.

text:
***

Pero, ano gid bala ang “soulmate”?
english:
***

But, what exactly is a “soulmate”?

text:
Sunu kay Laura Hinson, nga isa ka behavioral expert, sa iya artikulo sa Refinery 29, nga isa ka global media company nga naga-focus sa ”young women”, “A soulmate (connection) is a connection of minds, mutual respect, unconditiona love, and total understanding.”

Paano naman ini gina-manifest sang isa ka tawo?
english:
According to Laura Hinson, who is a behavioral expert, in her article in Refinery 29, a global media company that focuses on ”young women”, “A soulmate (connection) is a connection of minds, mutual respect, unconditiona love, and total understanding.”

How does a person manifest it?

text: Sunu pa gid kay Hinson, ini nga connection “just gets you”, nga indi kinahanglan ang madugay nga pagkilalahay.
english: According to Hinson, this connection “just gets you”, which does not require a long acquaintance.

text: Sunu naman sa kay psychoanalyst Mary C. Lamia, ang “soulmate experience” pwede ma-manifest sa non-verbal kag verbal nga level, ukon bisan lang sa facial expression kag body language nga makapukaw sang “innermost feeling”.
english: According to psychoanalyst Mary C. Lamia, the “soulmate experience” can be manifested on non-verbal and verbal levels, or even in facial expression and body language that can evoke the “innermost feeling”.

text: Ang experyensya naman ni Lee sa artikulo ni Hinson nagasiling nga “As someone who loves engaging with an expansive cross-section of human beings, numerous people have touched my soul as friends, lovers, even distant acquaintances whose actions or opinions have influenced me positively.
english: Lee's experience in Hinson's article says, “As someone who loves engaging with an expansive cross-section of human beings, numerous people have touched my soul as friends, lovers, even distant acquaintances whose actions or opinions have influenced me positively.

text:
These people are all soulmates to me through the ongoing effect they’ve had on my life.”

Naluyagan ko  ining “soulmate experience” ni Lee.
english:
These people are all soulmates to me through the ongoing effect they’ve had on my life.”

I love this “soulmate experience” of Lee.

text: Amo na gid lang man seguro ang akon pagtan-aw sa “soulmate” – SOMETHING YOU EARN AND MUST WORK FOR agud mangin malipayon sa ano man nga relasyon, lakip na sa aton relasyon sa pinalanggaon naton nga Ginuo./PN
english: That's probably how I see a soulmate – SOMETHING YOU EARN AND MUST WORK FOR in order to be happy in any relationship, including our relationship with our beloved Lord./PN

text: Sa tion sang imo pagtulog, mas pabor ka bala nga nagasiga ang imo suga ukon lampara?
english: During your sleep, do you prefer to have your light or lamp on?

text: Sa isa ka pagtuon nga gin-publish sang 2014 sa ‘The Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism,’ napamatud-an nga ang ‘LIGHT’ ukon kasanag ang isa sa pinaka-importante nga factor kag may madalom nga impact sa pag-angkon sang kalidad nga tulog.
english: In a study published in 2014 in ‘The Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism,’ it was proven that ‘LIGHT’ or light is one of the most important factor and has a profound impact on achieving quality sleep.

text: Natukiban sa pagtuon nga kun present ang light source ukon may nagasiga nga suga sa tion sang pagtulog, tuman ka apektado ang circadian rhythm sang lawas — isa ka biological mechanism nga naga-regulate sang cycle sa pagtulog kag pagbugtaw.
english: The study found that if a light source is present or a light is on during sleep, the body's circadian rhythm — a biological mechanism that regulates the cycle of sleep and wakefulness — is severely affected.

text: Bangud diri, ginarekomenda ang pagtulog sa ‘complete pitch darkness’ bangud ang tuman kadulom nga palibot ang naga-send sa lawas sang signal sa utok nga oras na sa pagpahuway.
english: Because of this, sleeping in ‘complete pitch darkness’ is recommended as the extremely dark environment sends the body a signal to the brain that it’s time to rest.

text: Diri kag naga-produce ang utok sang hormone nga melatonin nga nagaresulta sang pagkatuyo, muscle relaxation, kag pagnubo sang body temperature.
english: This is where the brain produces the hormone melatonin, which results in sleepiness, muscle relaxation, and a decrease in body temperature.

text: Bangud man sini, naganubo ang risgo sa pag-angkon sang isa ka indibidwal sang depression kag metabolic disorder.
english: This also reduces an individual's risk of developing depression and metabolic disorder.

text: Napamatud-an man nga ang mga ginatawag nga “night owls” ukon mahilig magpulaw kun gab-i kag exposed sa suga ukon light ang tuman ka vulnerable sa pag-angkon sang muscle loss, diabetes kag metabolic syndrome, ilabi na ang mga tawo nga masami kulang ang tulog.
english: It has also been proven that so-called “night owls” or those who like to stay up at night and are exposed to light are very vulnerable to muscle loss, diabetes and metabolic syndrome, especially people who often lack sleep.

text: Ginpadala na sang Iloilo Provincial Government ang mga dokumento sa supreme court (SC) nga nagapamatok sa nangin ruling sang korte nga nagapahanugot sa commercial fishing vessels nga makasulod sa municipal waters sang Iloilo.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Government has sent documents to the Supreme Court (SC) challenging the court's ruling allowing commercial fishing vessels to enter the municipal waters of Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Dennis Ventilacion, head sang Iloilo Provincial Legal Department, iya ginpahayag nga natalana nga mag-file sang motion for leave of court ang Iloilo Provincial Government sa idalom sang direktiba ni Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Dennis Ventilacion, head of the Iloilo Provincial Legal Department, said the Iloilo Provincial Government is scheduled to file a motion for leave of court under the directive of Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: Ini agud mag-intervene kag batunon ang dugang nga mga dokumento nga gin-file sang mga petitioners may kaangtanan sa nangin desisyon sang Supreme Court nga nagapahanugot sa commercial fishing vessels nga makasulod sa 15-kilometer municipal waters.
english: This is to intervene and accept additional documents filed by the petitioners in connection with the Supreme Court's decision allowing commercial fishing vessels to enter 15-kilometer municipal waters.

text: Lakip si Atty. Ventilacion kag Provincial Agriculture Office’s Fisheries Division Head Felina Grace Basco sa nagpatigayon sang final review sang mga dokumento antes ipasa sa Supreme Court.
english: Including Atty. Ventilacion and Provincial Agriculture Office’s Fisheries Division Head Felina Grace Basco for conducting the final review of the documents before being submitted to the Supreme Court.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang damlag lang, nagpasar sang resolution ang Sangguniang Panlalawigan sang Resolution 2025-062 nga naga-authorize kay Gov.
english: It is known that recently, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan passed a resolution of Resolution 2025-062 authorizing Gov.

text: Defensor nga i-represent ang probinsya sang Iloilo sa Korte Suprema may kaangtanan sa mga petitions nga gin-file batuk sa ruling sang SC.
english: Defensor to represent the province of Iloilo in the Supreme Court in connection with the petitions filed against the SC ruling.

text: Suno kay Ventilacion, 16 ka mga banwa ang nagpetisyon, kon sa diin, halos naghalin sa coastal municipalities sang probinsya.
english: According to Ventilacion, 16 towns petitioned, most of which came from the coastal municipalities of the province.

text: Nakasaysay naman sa petition letter ang mga concerns sang mga manugpangisda lakip ang negatibo nga matuga sang pagsulod sang commercial fishing vessels.
english: The petition letter also expressed the concerns of the fishermen including the negative impact of the entry of commercial fishing vessels.

text: Nagmandu na si Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. has ordered the

text: sa National Food Authority (NFA) nga umpisahan ang pagsaylo sang stocks sang bugas sa Visayas bilang preparasyon sang paglunsar sang P20-per-kilo rice program.
english: to the National Food Authority (NFA) to begin the transfer of rice stocks to the Visayas in preparation for the launch of the P20-per-kilo rice program.

text: Ini kasunod sang kumpirmasyon sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) nga ginhatagan sini sang exemption ang proyekto sang DA sa election spending ban kaangot sa nagahilapit nga May 12 national and local elections.
english: This follows the confirmation of the Commission on Elections (Comelec) that it has granted exemption to the DA's project from the election spending ban in connection with the upcoming May 12 national and local elections.

text: Suno sa DA, kuhaon ang suplay halin sa buffer stocks sang NFA nga nakalab-ot sa five-year high nga 7.17 million 50-kilogram bags sang milled rice.
english: According to the DA, the supply will be taken from the NFA's buffer stocks which reached a five-year high of 7.17 million 50-kilogram bags of milled rice.

text: As of the latest data, ang inventory nagsaka pa sa 7.56 million bags nga bastante na nga mapakaon ang pungsod sa 10 ka adlaw.
english: As of the latest data, the inventory has risen to 7.56 million bags which is enough to feed the country for 10 days.

text: Suno pa sa DA, sinemana pa kalawigon sang pagsaylo sang ginatos ka libo nga 50-kilo bags halin sa NFA warehouses, partikular sa Mindoro, pakadto sa nagkalain-lain nga parte sang Visayas.
english: According to the DA, it will take weeks to move hundreds of thousands of 50-kilo bags from NFA warehouses, particularly in Mindoro, to various parts of the Visayas.

text: Bisan pa nga mas bastante nga suplay halin sa NFA warehouses sa Iloilo nga lab-ot sa 862,409 ka sako sang bugas, ginsiling ni NFA Administrator Larry Lacson nga kinahanglan magbyahe sang additional stocks halin sa Mindoro agud masuportahan ang areas nga may limitado nga rice production kaangay sang Cebu, Negros Island, Samar, kag Leyte.
english: Despite the more sufficient supply from NFA warehouses in Iloilo amounting to 862,409 sacks of rice, NFA Administrator Larry Lacson said additional stocks need to be transported from Mindoro to support areas with limited rice production such as Cebu, Negros Island, Samar, and Leyte.

text: Ginpasaka na ang panumbungon nga murder batok sa driver sang sports utility vehicle (SUV) nga nag-arado sa Lapu Lapu Day festival sa Vancouver, Canada nga gintambungan sang mga Pilipino.
english: Murder charges have been filed against the driver of a sports utility vehicle (SUV) that plowed into the Lapu Lapu Day festival in Vancouver, Canada attended by Filipinos.

text: Eight counts sang second-degree murder ang ginapangatubang sang suspek nga ginhingadlan nga si Kai-Ji Adam Lo, 30, residente man sang Vancouver.
english: The suspect, identified as Kai-Ji Adam Lo, 30, also a resident of Vancouver, is facing eight counts of second-degree murder.

text: Posible pa nga madugangan ini nga charges suno pa sa otoridad.
english: The charges are likely to be increased, according to the authorities.

text: Natabo ang insidente pasado alas otso sa gab-i oras sa amo nga lugar sang hinali lang nga nag-abot ang black Audi SUV sa East 43rd Avenue kag Fraser Street.
english: The incident occurred around 8 pm local time when a black Audi SUV suddenly arrived at East 43rd Avenue and Fraser Street.

text: 11 ang patay kag masobra 20 ang pilason sandig sa latest data halin sa pulis.
english: 11 dead and more than 20 injured according to the latest data from the police.

text: Pahayag sang pulisya, singko anyos ang edad sang pinakabata nga biktima, samtang 65-anyos naman ang pinakatigulang.
english: Police said the youngest victim was five years old, while the oldest was 65 years old.

text: Wala pa sang ginpaguwa nga statement ang pulis sa motibo apang gindugang nga kilala nila ang suspek nga may history sang mental health-related interactions sa mga otoridad.
english: Police have not yet released a statement on the motive but added that they know the suspect who has a history of mental health-related interactions with the authorities.

text: Ginpahayag man sang otoridad nga kumpyansa sila nga indi ini isa ka akto sang terorismo.
english: Authorities also said they were confident it was not an act of terrorism.

text: Sandig pa sa Vancouver Police Department Major Crime Section, nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon subong, kag nagahingyo man ini sa publiko nga maghatag sang dugang nga impormasyon sa krimen.#
english: According to the Vancouver Police Department Major Crime Section, the investigation is ongoing, and it is also asking the public to provide more information on the crime.

text: Nakig-simpatiya si President Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr. expressed his condolences.

text: sa mga pamilya sang mga Pilipino nga apektado sang gin-arado sang isa ka sports utility vehicle (SUV) ang mga Pilipino nga nagtambong sa Lapu Lapu Day Festival sa Vancouver, Canada nga nagbilin na sang 11 ka patay kag masobra 20 ka pilason.
english: to the families of Filipinos affected when a sports utility vehicle (SUV) plowed through Filipinos attending the Lapu Lapu Day Festival in Vancouver, Canada, leaving 11 dead and more than 20 injured.

text: Suno kay Marcos, sa ngalan sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas, ginapalab-ot niya kag ni First Lady Liza Marcos ang ila nga pagpakig-unong sa bug-os nga Filipino community sa.
english: Marcos said that on behalf of the Philippine government, he and First Lady Liza Marcos extend their condolences to the entire Filipino community in.

text: “I am completely shattered to hear about the terrible incident during a Lapu Lapu Day Block Party in Vancouver, BC, Canada,” suno sa punong ehekutibo.
english: “I am completely shattered to hear about the terrible incident during a Lapu Lapu Day Block Party in Vancouver, BC, Canada,” the chief executive said.

text: “On behalf of the Philippine Government and the Filipino people, Liza and I would like to express our deepest sympathies to the families of the victims and to the strong and thriving Filipino community in Canada,” dugang sini.
english: “On behalf of the Philippine Government and the Filipino people, Liza and I would like to express our deepest sympathies to the families of the victims and to the strong and thriving Filipino community in Canada,” it added.

text:
“We are one with the families of the victims and the Filipino community in Vancouver during this difficult time.”

Gindugang sini nga naga-obra na ang Philippine Consulate General sa Vancouver agud mapasiguro ang imbestigasyon sa insidente kag agud nga mahatagan sang suporta ang mga biktima kag ila pamilya.
english:
“We are one with the families of the victims and the Filipino community in Vancouver during this difficult time.”

He added that the Philippine Consulate General in Vancouver is already working to ensure the investigation into the incident and to provide support to the victims and their families.

text: Sa separado sini nga statement, nagpahayag ang presidente: “On a day meant to honor the courage of Lapu-Lapu, our kababayans in Vancouver became victims of an unspeakable tragedy.
english: In a separate statement, the president said: “On a day meant to honor the courage of Lapu-Lapu, our fellow citizens in Vancouver became victims of an unspeakable tragedy.

text: As your President, and as a father, I share in your grief and your anguish.
english: As your President, and as a father, I share in your grief and your anguish.

text:
These lives will not be forgotten.”

Sa statement naman sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), ginsiling nga handa ini kag ang Philippine Consulate General nga maghatag sang nagakaigo nga assistance, kag magasuporta man sa Canadian authorities sa imbestigasyon.
english:
These lives will not be forgotten.”

In a statement, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) said it and the Philippine Consulate General are ready to provide appropriate assistance, and will also support the Canadian authorities in the investigation.

text: Ang ginaselebrar kuntani sang mga Pilipino nga Lapu Lapu Day ang nagadumdom sa kaisog ni Lapu Lapu, ang Pilipino nga baganihan nga nagpanguna sa paglutos kay Portuguese explorer Ferdinand Magellan sa isa ka away sang 1521.
english: What Filipinos would have celebrated as Lapu Lapu Day commemorates the bravery of Lapu Lapu, the Filipino hero who led the defeat of Portuguese explorer Ferdinand Magellan in a battle in 1521.

text: Nanindugan ang Philippine Coast Guard nga indi magpadaog sa China kaangot sa kinamatarong sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard insists it will not give in to China over rights in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Commodore Jay Tarriela, PCG Spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea, iya ginpahayag nga nagakadapat nga respetuhon sang China ang 2016 arbitral tribunal ruling sa diin nasaad diri nga sakop sang teritoryo sang Pilipinas ang West Philippine Sea.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Commodore Jay Tarriela, PCG Spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea, said China should respect the 2016 arbitral tribunal ruling which states that the West Philippine Sea is part of Philippine territory.

text: Suno kay Tarriela, tanan nga tikang sang Pilipinas ang kinahanglan nga nagasunod sa international law kag non-escalatory.
english: According to Tarriela, all measures of the Philippines must be in accordance with international law and non-escalatory.

text: Agud maprotektahan ang mga kinamatarong sang Pilipinas sa Exclusive Economic Zone (EZZ), ginpahayag ni Tarriela nga magapadayon sila sa pagpatigayon sang air surveillance flights kag maritime patrols.
english: To protect the Philippines' rights in the Exclusive Economic Zone (EZZ), Tarriela said they will continue to conduct air surveillance flights and maritime patrols.

text: Gindugang man sang natungdan nga ang manggad sa West Philippine Sea ang para sa mga Pilipino kag sa mga masunod pa nga henerasyon.
english: He added that the resources in the West Philippine Sea are for the Filipinos and future generations.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginaakusaran sang China ang Pilipinas nga padayon nga nagahimo sang probokasyon kag nagapalala sang sitwasyon sa West Philippine Sea.
english: China accuses the Philippines of continuing to provoke and exacerbate the situation in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Nagpaguwa sang bag-o nga paandam si Russian President Vladimir Putin nga malala pa ang maabtan sang sin-o man nga magapadayon sa paghimo sang “terroristic attack” sa teritoryo sang Russia.
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin has issued a new warning that the consequences will be worse for anyone who continues to carry out a “terrorist attack” on Russian territory.

text: Ang statement ni Putin ang kasunod man sang iya mandu nga paulanan sang cruise missiles kag maglunsar sang makamamatay nga pagpang-atake sa mga syudad sa Ukraine kahapon, Oktubre 10.
english: Putin's statement also follows his order to rain cruise missiles and launch deadly attacks on Ukrainian cities yesterday, October 10.

text: Ini ang ginatawag “largest airstrikes” halin sang nag-umpisa ang Russian invasion sa Ukraine.
english: These are being called the “largest airstrikes” since the Russian invasion of Ukraine began.

text: Ginpangguba man sang missiles ang energy facilities, military command, kag communications facilities sa Lviv sa west padulong sa Kharkiv sa northeast.
english: The missiles also destroyed energy facilities, military command, and communications facilities in Lviv in the west to Kharkiv in the northeast.

text: Suno sa state emergency services, 14 ka tawo ang patay sa amo nga sunod-sunod nga Russian missile attacks.
english: According to state emergency services, 14 people were killed in the series of Russian missile attacks.

text: Ini ang ginapahayag balos ni Putin sa paghalit sa Kerch Strait bridge ukon ang taytay nga amo ang naga-angot sa gin-annex nga Crimean Peninsula sa Russia sang nagligad nga weekend.
english: This is allegedly in retaliation for Putin damaging the Kerch Strait bridge or the bridge that links the annexed Crimean Peninsula with Russia last weekend.

text: Ang amo nga taytay amo ang longest bridge sa Europa nga gintukod sang Russia sang nasakop na sini ang Crimea Peninsula sang 2014 nga iya anay sang Ukraine.
english: The bridge is the longest bridge in Europe that Russia built when it annexed the Crimean Peninsula in 2014, which used to belong to Ukraine.

text: Gin-selebrar sang Ukraine ang pagsigabong sa amo nga taytay apang wala man ini opisyal nga nag-ako nga sila ang responsable sa natabo.
english: Ukraine celebrated the torching of that bridge but has also not officially acknowledged responsibility for the incident.

text: Bangud sa balos sang Russia, suno sa prime minister ni Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, 11 ka major infrastructure targets ang naigu sa walo ka mga rehiyon nga rason sang pagkautod sang kuryente.
english: Due to Russia's retaliation, according to the prime minister of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, 11 major infrastructure targets were hit in eight regions causing power outages.

text: Daku nga pagpanghangkat para sa Commission on Elections – Iloilo City ang bag-o nga paagi sa baligyaanay kag baklanay sang boto nga nahimo naman nga digital sa tunga sang pagbag-o sang teknolohiya.
english: The new way of selling and buying votes that has become digital amid technological change is a big challenge for the Commission on Elections – Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Pinky Jevini Tentativa, election officer IV sang Iloilo City Comelec, iya ginpahayag nga ginagamit na subong ang nagkalain-lain nga digital money applications sa maduging gihapon nga vote buying activities kadungan sang election season.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Pinky Jevini Tentativa, election officer IV of the Iloilo City Comelec, said that various digital money applications are now being used in vote buying activities during the election season.

text: Suno kay Tentativa, ‘challenging’ ini indi lamang sa ila sa Comelec kundi pati sa stakeholders.
english: According to Tentativa, this is challenging not only for them in the Comelec but also for the stakeholders.

text: Pahayag sini, may yara sang Kontra Bigay committee nga gintukod ang national office sang poll body apang natalana pa nga pungkuan kag diskusyunan sang local offices para ma-address sang maayo ini nga iligal nga buluhaton.
english: He said there is a Kontra Bigay committee established by the national office of the poll body but it is scheduled to sit and discuss with local offices to address this illegal activity.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sa task force, ginhimo nga committee ang Kontra Bigay para nga maproteksyunan sang maayo ang mga dokumento kag ebidensya sang mga reklamo kag maresolba ang mga kaso bisan pagkatapos pa sang eleksyon.
english: It was learned that from the task force, Kontra Bigay was formed into a committee to better protect the documents and evidence of the complaints and resolve the cases even after the election.

text: Magabulig man ini nga committee sa law enforcement authorities para matumod ang mga akto sang vote-buying, vote-selling, kag pagpang-abuso sa state resources.
english: The committee will also assist law enforcement authorities to identify acts of vote-buying, vote-selling, and abuse of state resources.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang vote-buying kag vote-selling ang makabig nga election offenses sa idalom sang Section 262 sang Omnibus Election Code.
english: Vote-buying and vote-selling are considered election offenses under Section 262 of the Omnibus Election Code.

text: Wala sang Low Pressure Area (LPA) ukon bagyo nga na-monitor sa Pilipinas.
english: No Low Pressure Area (LPA) or typhoon was monitored in the Philippines.

text: Ang Shear Line ang nagaapekto sa Southern Luzon kag Visayas.
english: The Shear Line affects Southern Luzon and Visayas.

text: Ang Shear Line ang isa ka linya ukon makitid nga lugar sa diin may gulpi nga pagbag-o sa direksyon sang hangin.
english: A Shear Line is a line or narrow area where there is a sudden change in the direction of the wind.

text: Bangud sa pagbunggu-anay ukon convergence sang hangin, nagaluntad ang masami nga pagpangilat ukon mga pag-ulan sa shear line.
english: Due to wind collision or convergence, frequent lightning or showers occur along the shear line.

text: Samtang ang Northeast Monsoon ukon hangin Amihan ang nagaapekto sa nabilin nga bahin sang Luzon.
english: Meanwhile, the Northeast Monsoon is affecting the rest of Luzon.

text: Ginsabat ni former Iloilo City Councilor Plaridel Nava ang mga pahayag ni Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne Baronda may kaangtanan sa mga isyu nga naangot sa mga delayed projects sa syudad.
english: Former Iloilo City Councilor Plaridel Nava responded to the statements of Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne Baronda regarding issues related to delayed projects in the city.

text: Ini nga mga proyekto ang nagalakip sang Multi-purpose Building Project sa Concepcion, City Proper kag Mandurriao Public Market.
english: These projects include the Multi-purpose Building Project in Concepcion, City Proper and Mandurriao Public Market.

text: Kasunod ini sang pagbasol ni Baronda sa kontraktor sa Mandurriao Public Market nga suno sa mamalidha, nanghulam lang sang license agud makontrata ang amo nga proyekto rason nga nag-angkon sang problema kag na-delay.
english: This follows Baronda's blame on the contractor at the Mandurriao Public Market who, according to the lawmaker, borrowed a license to contract the project, causing problems and delays.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang kontraktor sang Mandurriao Public Market amo ang J.E. Tico Construction Company, Inc.
english: The contractor of the Mandurriao Public Market is J.E. Tico Construction Company, Inc.

text: kag si Nava ang nagaserbe nga liaison officer kag consultant.
english: and Nava serves as liaison officer and consultant.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Nava, iya ginpahayag nga ang sakop lang sang ila nga gin-bid amo ang una kag ikaduha nga panalgan sang merkado kang natapos nila ini kag indi na nila sakop ang ikatlo nga panalgan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Nava said they only covered the first and second floors of the market when they finished it and they did not cover the third floor.

text: Suno sa iya, indi man sila obligado nga ubrahun ang third floor bangud nga wala man sang budget nga ginpain si Baronda para diri.
english: He said they are not obliged to build the third floor because Baronda has no budget allocated for it.

text: Samtang, isa man ka component sang proyekto ang sewerage treatment plant nga wala pa natapos asta subong.
english: Meanwhile, another component of the project is the sewerage treatment plant which has not been completed yet.

text: Suno kay Nava, gin-ayo sila sang Department of Public Works and Highways nga maghimo sang design para diri bangud wala sang tinawo ang ahensya nga makahangop sa paghimo design.
english: Nava said they were asked by the Department of Public Works and Highways to make a design for it because the agency does not have staff who understand the design.

text: Sa subong, ang kinahanglan na lang i-construct amo ang sewerage treatment plant apang gin-athag ni Nava nga indi sila ang cause sang delay.
english: Currently, the only thing that needs to be constructed is the sewerage treatment plant but Nava clarified that they are not the cause of the delay.

text: Sa bahin sang Multi-purpose building project sa Concepcion, City Proper, ginpahayag ni Nava nga natapos nila kun ano ang nakasaad sa ila kontrata.
english: Regarding the Multi-purpose building project in Concepcion, City Proper, Nava said they have completed what is stipulated in their contract.

text: Suno sa iya, nakompleto nila ang Phase 1 bangud ini lang ang sakop sang ila scope of work.
english: He said they completed Phase 1 because it was the only one within their scope of work.

text: Pahayag niya, wala na napadayon ini bangud wala man sang ginhatag nga budget si Baronda bangud suno kay Nava, akig sa iya ang mamalidha.
english: He said it was not continued because Baronda did not give a budget because according to Nava, the lawmaker was angry with him.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang kontraktor sa proyekto sa Concepcion amo ang Mandanas Construction kun sa diin si Nava ang authorized representative.
english: The contractor for the project in Concepcion is Mandanas Construction where Nava is the authorized representative.

text: Nag-atubangay na liwat sanday Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky kag US President Donald Trump matapos ang ila pagbaisay sa Oval Office sa White House sang Pebrero.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and US President Donald Trump have faced each other again after an argument in the Oval Office at the White House in February.

text: Natabo ang panibag-o nga face-to-face encounter sa Vatican antes ang lubong ni Pope Francis, Abril 26.
english: The new face-to-face encounter took place at the Vatican ahead of Pope Francis' April 26 funeral.

text: Nakuhaan sang laragway ang duha nga nagapungko kag madalom ang gina-istoryahan minutos antes ang pagsugod sang funeral mass sa St Peter’s Basilica.
english: The two were photographed sitting and talking deeply minutes before the start of the funeral mass at St Peter's Basilica.

text: Suno sa White House, 15 minutos lamang ang ila pag-istoryahanay apang produktibo ini.
english: The White House said the conversation lasted only 15 minutes but was productive.

text: Suno naman kay Zelensky, tuman ka symbolic ang ila naistorya kag posible pa nga mangin maragtason.
english: Zelensky said the talks were very symbolic and could be historic.

text: Antes sini nga diskusyon, may pahayag si Trump nga nagasentro sa panibag-o nga atake sang Russia sa Ukraine, kun sa diin ginkwestyon sini ang desisyon ni Russian President Vladimir Putin kun handa gid man ini nga tapuson ang gyera sini sa Kyiv.
english: Before this discussion, Trump made a statement focusing on Russia's renewed attack on Ukraine, where he questioned Russian President Vladimir Putin's decision to end his war in Kyiv.

text: Matandaan nga ang gyera man ang gina-istoryahan sang nagbaisay sanday Trump kag Zelensky sang Pebrero — topiko nga na-broadcast sa bilog nga kalibutan bangud natabo ang tension sa atubang mismo sang mga katapo sang media.
english: It can be recalled that the war was also discussed when Trump and Zelensky argued in February — a topic that was broadcast around the world because the tension occurred right in front of members of the media.

text: Gin-deploy sang Estados Unidos ang ila nga aircraft carrier sa Philippine Sea inadlaw matapos gin-report nga nasiplatan man sa north Luzon ang aircraft carrier kag iban pa nga warships sang China.
english: The United States deployed its aircraft carrier in the Philippine Sea a day after it was reported that the aircraft carrier and other Chinese warships were also spotted in northern Luzon.

text: Suno sa US Navy release, ang Nimitz Carrier Strike Group nga ginapangunahan sang flagship nga USS Nimitz (CVN 68) ang naga-operate na sa Philippine Sea kasunod sang scheduled port visit sa Guam.
english: According to a US Navy release, the Nimitz Carrier Strike Group led by the flagship USS Nimitz (CVN 68) is now operational in the Philippine Sea following a scheduled port visit to Guam.

text: Pahayag sini, naga-demonstrar ini kun ano ka handa ang barko sa operasyon kag nagapakita man sang commitment sang US Navy sa malinong nga Indo-Pacific region.
english: He said it demonstrates how ready the ship is for operations and also shows the commitment of the US Navy to the peaceful Indo-Pacific region.

text: Magluwas sa Nimitz (CVN 68), nalakip sa strike group ang Carrier Air Wing (CVW) 17, kag Destroyer Squadron (DESRON) 9 ang ginabug-usan sang USS Gridley (DDG-101), USS Lenah Sutcliffe Higbee (DDG-123), USS Curtis Wilbur (DDG-54) kag USS Wayne E. Meyer (DDG-108).
english: In addition to Nimitz (CVN 68), the strike group included Carrier Air Wing (CVW) 17, and Destroyer Squadron (DESRON) 9 consisted of USS Gridley (DDG-101), USS Lenah Sutcliffe Higbee (DDG-123), USS Curtis Wilbur (54) EDDG Wayne and USS Meyer Wayne. (DDG-108).

text: Ini nga mga barko ang naga-operate sa U.S. 7th Fleet area of operations nga amo ang pinakadako nga forward-deployed numbered fleet sang US Navy.
english: These ships operate in the U.S. 7th Fleet area of ​​operations which is the largest forward-deployed numbered fleet of the US Navy.

text: Matandaan nga sang Huwebes, ginkumpirma sang Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) ang presensya sang Chinese aircraft carrier Shandong samtang yara sa kadagatan nga sakop sang Pilipinas.
english: On Thursday, the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) confirmed the presence of the Chinese aircraft carrier Shandong while in Philippine waters.

text: May iban pa nga barko sang China nga yara sa lugar nga wala man nagasabat kun maradyuhan sang Philippine Navy.
english: There are other Chinese ships in the area that do not respond to radio calls from the Philippine Navy.

text: NATUBLAG ang mga health authorities sa report nga madamo sa mga nabakunahan ang wala na magbalik para sa ila ikaduha nga dose.
english: HEALTH authorities have been disturbed by reports that many of those vaccinated have not returned for their second doses.

text: Tungod sini, naalarma gid ang mga health authorities kay dapat makumpleto gid ang pagpabakuna para sa mabaskug gid nga proteksyon sang nabakunahan kag ang publiko batok sa COVID-19.
english: Because of this, the health authorities are alarmed because the vaccination must be completed for the strongest protection of the vaccinated and the public against COVID-19.

text: Otherwise, indi mapaseguro ang epekto sang bakuna (vaccine).
english: Otherwise, the effectiveness of the vaccine cannot be guaranteed.

text: Ina tungod ang una nga dose panalawsaw lang sa kon ano ang posible matabo sa nabakunahan; ang ikaduha nga dose amo gid ang makapukaw sing lubos sang immune response sang tawo.
english: That’s because the first dose is just research into what’s likely to happen to the vaccinated; the second dose is actually the one that can fully stimulate the person’s immune response.

text: Pahanumdum ini sa mga bakuna nga naga-requirer sang duha ka dose kag duha man nga pagpatublok sa lang-at nga duha ukon tatlo ka semana.
english: This is a reminder of the vaccines that require two doses and two shots every two or three weeks.

text: Nagalakip ini sang Chinese Sinovac, Pfizer, kag AstraZeneca nga naaprubahan na sang aton Food and Drug Administration (FDA) kag na-administer na gani sa mga walo (8) ka milyon nga pumuluyo diri sa aton pungsod.
english: These include Chinese Sinovac, Pfizer, and AstraZeneca which have been approved by our Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and have been administered to about eight (8) million people here in our country.

text: Ang Johnson & Johnson vaccine, nga nagakinahanglan lang sang isa ka dose agud makumpleto ang pagpabakuna, wala pa naton mabaton diri sa pungsod.
english: The Johnson & Johnson vaccine, which only requires one dose to complete immunization, we have not yet received here in the country.

text: Tungod gani sang pagka-importante sining ikaduha nga dose, ginapangabay gid sang mga health authorities ang mga nabakunahan na sang isa ka dose nga magbalik gid sa tal adlaw nga natalana agud magpatublok sang ikaduha nga dose.
english: Because of the importance of this second dose, the health authorities urge those who have already been vaccinated with one dose to return within three days to get the second dose.

text:
***

Ano gid bala ang problema kon isa lang ka dose ang mabaton sang nabakunahan, sunu sa mga scientist?
english:
***

What's the real problem if only one dose is received by the vaccinated, according to scientists?

text: Sunu sa mga scientist, ang “efficacy” sang bakuna, ukon ang epekto sini, sa “controlled environment” sa laboratoryo, lain man sa “effectiveness” sini sa aktwal nga sitwasyon sa bukas (free) nga environment sa gwa sang laboratoryo.
english: According to scientists, the efficacy of the vaccine, or its effect, in the controlled environment in the laboratory, is also different from its effectiveness in the actual situation in the free environment outside the laboratory.

text: Ang “effectiveness” sang bakuna, in particular, nagapahibalo kon ano gid ini ka-“effective” kag “safe” kon i-administer na sa luyag magbaton sining bakuna sa gwa sang laboratoryo sa “real world”.
english: The effectiveness of a vaccine, in particular, determines how effective and safe it is when administered to those who wish to receive it outside the laboratory in the real world.

text: Parti sa kinahanglan nga duha ka dose sang bakuna, ano na bala ang nahibal-an sang aton mga scientist?
english: As for the need for two doses of the vaccine, what do our scientists know?

text: Ang ulihi nga balita nga nabaton naton nagatudlo sa pagtuon sa United Kingdom sa mga bakuna nga AstraZeneca (92% efficacy) kag Pfizer (96% efficacy).
english: The latest news we’ve received points to studies in the United Kingdom on the AstraZeneca (92% efficacy) and Pfizer (96% efficacy) vaccines.

text: Ang aton ordinaryo nga paghangop sining “efficacy” sang bakuna amo nga sa 92% efficacy, 8% (100% minus 92%) ang pwede pa ma-infect sang COVID-19 sa mga nabakunahan na.
english: Our ordinary understanding of this vaccine efficacy is that at 92% efficacy, 8% (100% minus 92%) of those who have been vaccinated can still be infected with COVID-19.

text: Sa 96% efficacy, mga 4% ang pwede pa ma-infect.
english: With 96% efficacy, about 4% can still be infected.

text: Ano naman ayhan ang resulta sang pagtuon sang “effectiveness”, ukon aktwal na nga resulta sa gwa sang laboratoryo, sining mga bakuna, labi na gid kon sin-o ang laban-laban ma-infect pa sang COVID-19?
english: What will be the results of the study of the “effectiveness”, or actual results outside the laboratory, of these vaccines, especially who is most likely to be infected with COVID-19?

text: Ang pagtuon sang mga scientist, katulad sang ginhiwat sa Singapore, nagapakita nga nagakalain-lain ang natural nga immune response sang kada tawo.
english: Studies by scientists, such as those conducted in Singapore, show that the natural immune response varies from person to person.

text: May yara nga mahina mag-producir sang antibodies nga nagaaway sa virus.
english: Some are weak in producing antibodies that fight the virus.

text: May yara man nga madamo-damo man ang ma-producir.
english: There are also those that can be produced in large quantities.

text: Kag may yara man nga kaya mag-producir sang maximum nga kadamuon sang antibodies.
english: And there are those who can produce the maximum number of antibodies.

text: May yara man nga madasig mag-decline, ukon ang pagnubo sang kadamuon, sang mga antibodies.
english: There are also rapidly declining, or the decrease in the number, of antibodies.

text: Kag may yara man nga madugay gawa ang pagpabilin sini kag handa sa tanan nga tion sa pagkig-away sa virus nga indi na gani seguro kinahanglan ang bulig sang memory cells.
english: And there are also those that stay for a long time and are ready at all times to fight the virus without even needing the help of memory cells.

text: Syempre, ang may mahina nga immune response ang mauna ma-infect sang COVID-19 sa sining mga nabakunahan na, labi na gid sa una pa lang nga dose.
english: Of course, those with weak immune responses will be the first to be infected with COVID-19 among those who have been vaccinated, especially in the first dose.

text: Ang ikaduha nga dose, on the other hand, makahatag sing dugang nga kabaskug sa immune response, sa kadamuon kag pwersa sang mga antibodies, agud maaway sing husto ang mga virus.
english: The second dose, on the other hand, can give more strength to the immune response, in the number and strength of antibodies, to fight viruses properly.

text: In fact, napamatud-an ini sang ulihi nga pagtuon sa United Kingdom sang “effectiveness” sang Pfizer kag AstraZeneca.
english: In fact, this was proven by a recent study in the United Kingdom of the “effectiveness” of Pfizer and AstraZeneca.

text: Sunu sa sining pagtuon, nga nagalakip sang mas makalalaton nga delta variant halin sa India, ang una nga dose sang vaccine may “effectiveness” lang nga 26% tubtub 40% sa kaso sang mga symptomatic cases.
english: According to this study, which includes the more contagious delta variant from India, the first dose of the vaccine has an effectiveness of only 26% to 40% in case of symptomatic cases.

text: In other words, sobra sa 50% (60% tubtub 74%) sang nabakunahan ang natapikan sang COVID-19 sa una nga dose.
english: In other words, more than 50% (60% to 74%) of those vaccinated were infected with COVID-19 in the first dose.

text: Sa natublokan na sang ikaduha nga dose nga sobra 200,000, mga 0.7% ukon 154 lang ang na-infect sang COVID-19.
english: Of the more than 200,000 who have been vaccinated with the second dose, only about 0.7% or 154 have been infected with COVID-19.

text: No doubt, pamatuod ini nga kinahanglan gid ang ikaduha nga dose agud mas mapaseguro ang proteksyon batok sa COVID-19.
english: No doubt, this is proof that the second dose is needed to better ensure protection against COVID-19.

text: Gani, sa natublokan pa lang sang isa ka dose sang bakuna, indi gid pagkalimti ang pagpatublok sang ikaduha nga dose sa talana nga schedule ninyo./PN
english: Therefore, as soon as you have received one dose of the vaccine, do not forget to receive the second dose on your scheduled schedule./PN

text: Isa ka Filipino-American player ang maga-upod sa pwersa nanday Rookie of the Year awardees Victor Wembanyama kag Stephon Castle sa San Antonio Spurs.
english: A Filipino-American player will join the forces of Rookie of the Year awardees Victor Wembanyama and Stephon Castle at the San Antonio Spurs.

text: Ini amo si Dylan Harper nga napilian bilang second overall sa 2025 National Basketball Association (NBA) Draft.
english: This is Dylan Harper who was selected second overall in the 2025 National Basketball Association (NBA) Draft.

text: Isa siya ka versatile guard halin sa Rutgers University kag napili bilang No.
english: He is a versatile guard out of Rutgers University and was selected as the No. 1 overall pick.

text: 2 sang San Antonio Spurs.
english: 2 of the San Antonio Spurs.

text: Pareho sila ni Jalen Green nga may lahi man nga Pinoy nga second overall man sang napilian sang Houston Rockets sang 2021 Draft.
english: They are like Jalen Green, who is also a Filipino, who was also the second overall pick of the Houston Rockets in the 2021 Draft.

text: Halin sa Ilocos Sur ang mga kaparyentehan ni Green, samtang ang iloy naman ni Harper ang nabun-ag kag nagdaku sa Bataan antes nag-migrate sa US sang naga-edad sang pito ka tuig.
english: Green's relatives are from Ilocos Sur, while Harper's mother was born and raised in Bataan before migrating to the US at the age of seven.

text: Ini nga 6-foot-7 playmaker ang ginakonsiderar man nga NBA legacy bangud ang iya amay amo ang five-time champion nga si Ron Harper.
english: This 6-foot-7 playmaker is also considered NBA legacy as his father is five-time champion Ron Harper.

text: Ang amay nga Harper ang nakahampang anay kaupod kanday Michael Jordan sa Chicago Bulls kag Shaquille O’Neal kag Kobe Bryant sa Los Angeles Lakers.
english: Father Harper previously played alongside Michael Jordan with the Chicago Bulls and Shaquille O’Neal and Kobe Bryant with the Los Angeles Lakers.

text: Magabyahe na padulong sa USA si Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Secretary Cristina Roque subong nga semana kaangot sa plano nga mag-istorya sa Trump administration nahanungod sa polisa sa taripa.
english: Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Secretary Cristina Roque will travel to the USA this week in connection with plans to talk to the Trump administration about tariff policy.

text: Abril 29 magahalin ang trade official kaupod si Special Assistant to the President for Investment and Economic Affairs (SAPIEA) Secretary Frederick Go.
english: The trade official will leave on April 29 along with Special Assistant to the President for Investment and Economic Affairs (SAPIEA) Secretary Frederick Go.

text: Matabo naman ang meeting antes ang ila pagpauli sa Mayo 2.
english: The meeting will take place before their return home on May 2.

text: Lakip sa sapulun sang duha amo ang trade gurus sang Trump administration nga sanday US Trade Representative (USTR) Ambassador Jamieson Greer kag Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick.
english: Among the two were Trump administration trade gurus US Trade Representative (USTR) Ambassador Jamieson Greer and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick.

text: Matandaan nga sang Abril 2 sang gin-anunsyo ni US President Donald Trump ang baseline nga 10-percent tariff sa tanan nga mga produkto nga halin sa iban nga mga pungsod, kun sa diin may dugang nga reciprocal tariffs sa mga pungsod nga may trade deficit sa America.
english: It can be recalled that on April 2, US President Donald Trump announced a baseline 10-percent tariff on all products from other countries, with additional reciprocal tariffs on countries with trade deficits with America.

text: 17-percent tariff ang iya sang Pilipinas nga mas manubo sa mga kaiping sini sa Southeast Asia nga amo ang Vietnam (46 percent), Thailand (36 percent), Indonesia (32 percent), kag Malaysia (24 percent).
english: The Philippines' 17-percent tariff is lower than its Southeast Asian neighbors Vietnam (46 percent), Thailand (36 percent), Indonesia (32 percent), and Malaysia (24 percent).

text: Ginsuspinder ang isa ka enlistment officer sa far eastern Russian region matapos sala ang ginpatawag sini nga linibo ka tawo agud mag-away batok sa Ukraine.
english: An enlistment officer in the far eastern Russian region has been suspended after he wrongly summoned thousands of people to fight against Ukraine.

text: Ang ginatumod nga officer amo ang military commissar sang Khabarovsk region.
english: The officer in question is the military commissar of the Khabarovsk region.

text: Ginpahayag nga may sala sa recruitment process rason nga sa linibo ka compatriots nga nakabaton sang summon kag nag-abot sa military enlistment offices sa nagligad nga 10 ka adlaw, katunga gid ang ginpapauli bangud wala sila naka-meet sa selection criteria.
english: It was alleged that there was a mistake in the recruitment process so that of the thousands of compatriots who received summons and arrived at the military enlistment offices in the past 10 days, half were sent home because they did not meet the selection criteria.

text: Ginpahayag nga naga-apply lamang ang partial mobilization sa categories nga aprubado sang ministry of defense kag sang president.
english: The partial mobilization only applies to categories approved by the ministry of defense and the president.

text: Madumduman nga Septyembre 21 sang nagmandu si Russian President Vladimir Putin sang partial mobilization ukon ginpatawag ang ginatos tubtub linibo ka Rurssians agud mag-away sa Ukraine.
english: On September 21, Russian President Vladimir Putin ordered the partial mobilization of hundreds to thousands of Russians to fight in Ukraine.

text: Ini ang rason sang nagkalatabo nga protesta kag pagbiya sang kalalakinhan gikan sa Russia.
english: This is the reason for the protests and the departure of men from Russia.

text: Nagpadala na ang Sweden sang diving vessel agud imbestigaran ang area sang Nord Stream pipelines kun sa diin ang eruption sa Baltic Sea ang nakatuga sang leakage sa sulod na sang pila ka adlaw.
english: Sweden has sent a diving vessel to investigate the area of ​​the Nord Stream pipelines where the eruption in the Baltic Sea has caused leakage for several days.

text: Ini nga insidente ang nakatuga na sang panibag-o nga tensyon sa energy crisis sa bilog nga Europa.
english: This incident has already created new tensions in the energy crisis across Europe.

text: Ginpahayag nga submarine rescue ship ang ginpadala sa site sang leaks kag amo subong ang nagasuporta sa Swedish coast guard nga amo ang nagapanguna sa imbestigasyon.
english: A submarine rescue ship was reportedly sent to the site of the leaks and is now supporting the Swedish coast guard which is leading the investigation.

text: Kun madumduman, sang nagligad nga semana, ang undersea blasts nga naga-involve sang hundred pounds sang explosives ang nakahalit sa Nord Stream 1 kag 2 pipelines sa southern Sweden kag Denmark kag amo ang nangin rason sang methane leaks sa international waters sa Baltic Sea.
english: Last week, undersea blasts involving hundreds of pounds of explosives damaged the Nord Stream 1 and 2 pipelines in southern Sweden and Denmark and caused methane leaks in international waters in the Baltic Sea.

text: Suno sa European leaders, sabotahe ang natabo apang wala ginhingadlan kun sin-o ang may kahimuan.
english: According to European leaders, sabotage occurred but did not name who was responsible.

text: Nagpahayag naman ang Russia nga ang West ang responsable sa explosion.
english: Russia said the West was responsible for the explosion.

text: Ini nga pipelines (nga nagalawig halin sa Russia pa- Germany) amo ang sentro sang growing gas supply crisis sa Europe nga kabahin gihapon sang epekto sang pag-atake sang Russia sa Ukraine.
english: These pipelines (which run from Russia to- Germany) are at the heart of the growing gas supply crisis in Europe that is still part of the impact of the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

text: Kapin sa 250,000 ka mga tawo ang naghatag sang katapusan nga pagtahod sa nagtaliwan nga lider sang Simbahan Katoliko nga si Pope Francis sa sulod sang tatlo ka adlaw nga public viewing sa St.
english: More than 250,000 people paid their last respects to the late leader of the Catholic Church Pope Francis during a three-day public viewing at St. Peter’s Basilica in New York City.

text: Peter’s Basilica sa Vatican City sa Rome, Italy.
english: Peter’s Basilica in Vatican City in Rome, Italy.

text: Halin sa mga katoliko nga tumuluo gikan sa nagkalain-lain nga pungsod tubtob sa mga lideres sang simbahan kag pulitika, nagtambong sila sa 3 ka adlaw nga public viewing nga natapos sang Biernes sang gab-i, Abril 25, sang opisyal nga ginsirado ang lungon sang Santo Papa sa liturgical rites antes ang state funeral sa St.
english: From catholic faithful from different countries to church and political leaders, they attended a 3-day public viewing that ended on Friday evening, April 25, when the Pope’s coffin was officially closed in liturgical rites before the state funeral at St.

text: Peter’s Square kag paglubong sa bangkay sang Santo Papa sa basilica saguwa sang Vatican subong nga adlaw sang Sabado, Abril 26.
english: Peter's Square and burial of the Pope's body in the basilica outside the Vatican today Saturday, April 26.

text: Sa nagligad nga tatlo ka adlaw, linibo ka mga nagakasubo kag naglinya kag naghulat sang inoras agud maghatag sang ila katapusan nga mga paalam kag maghatag sang ila pagtahod sa Santo Papa.
english: For the past three days, thousands of mourners and lined up and waited for hours to say their final goodbyes and pay their respects to the Pope.

text:
Bangod sang mas mataas sangsa ginapaabot nga kadamuon sang mga tawo nga nagabisita sa Vatican, ang oras sang pagbukas sang basilica ginpalawig tubtob sa tungang gab-i.

Samtang, mga 200,000 ka tawo ang ginalauman nga magatipon sa St.
english:
Due to higher-than-expected numbers of people visiting the Vatican, the opening hours of the basilica have been extended to midnight.

Meanwhile, about 200,000 people are expected to gather in St. Petersburg.

text: Peter’s Square kag tubtob sa 300,000 pa sa ruta nga magadala sang bangkay sang nagtaliwan nga Santo Papa halin sa Vatican pakadto sa iya lubong sa St.
english: Peter’s Square and up to 300,000 more on the route that will carry the late Pope’s body from the Vatican to his funeral in St. Peter’s.

text: Mary Major basilica.
english: Mary Major basilica.

text: Kaangot sini, nagdeploy ang Italy sang masobra 2,500 ka mga police officers kag 1,500 ka mga soldado agud maghatag sang seguridad sa lubong subong nga adlaw nga ginalauman nga matapos alas 2:00 sang hapon, oras sang Roma ukon alas 8:00 sang gab-i, oras diri sa Pilipinas.
english: Meanwhile, Italy has deployed more than 2,500 police officers and 1,500 soldiers to provide security for today's funeral which is expected to end at 2:00 pm Rome time or 8:00 pm Philippine time.

text: Ginkakibot ni Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne Baronda nga may suspension sang klase sa mga day care centers sa Iloilo City subong nga adlaw kadungan sang iya pagpanagtag sang packed meals para sa kabataan kahapon, Pebrero 19, bilang kabahin sang iya birthday celebration.
english: Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne Baronda was surprised by the suspension of classes in day care centers in Iloilo City today while distributing packed meals for children yesterday, February 19, as part of her birthday celebration.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rep.

text: Baronda, iya ginpahayag nga sang Martes sang gab-i pa lang, may nabaton na siya nga impormasyon nga gin-anunsyo ang mga klase sa day care centers bangud ang iban ang may yara sang meeting subong nga adlaw.
english: Baronda said that on Tuesday night, he received information that the classes in the day care centers were announced because some of them have meetings today.

text: Suno kay Baronda, sa iya pagkahibalo, halos tanan nga day care center sa tanan nga barangay sa syudad ang nagkansela sang klase.
english: According to Baronda, to his knowledge, almost all day care centers in all barangays in the city have canceled classes.

text: Sa pihak sini, nadayon sa gihapon ang pagpanagtag sang pamahaw sa kabataan kun sa diin sa gymnasium kag sa gwa sang day care centers na lang ginpatigayon ang ila aktibidad.
english: Meanwhile, the distribution of breakfast to the children continued where their activities were conducted in the gymnasium and outside the day care centers.

text: Ginpakakas na sa pwesto ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr., ang principal nga nagpa-uba sang toga sa ila mga estudyante sa ila End-of-School-Year (EOSY) rites sang Abril 15 sa Col.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr., has sacked the principal who made his students take off their togas during their End-of-School-Year (EOSY) rites on April 15 at Col.

text: Ruperto Abellon National School (CRANS) sa Laua-an, Antique.
english: Ruperto Abellon National School (CRANS) in Laua-an, Antique.

text: Suno kay Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Undersecretary and Palace Press Officer Atty. Claire Castro, ang Presidente mismo ang nagmando kay Department of Education Secretary Sonny Angara nga pahalinon sa pwesto si Venus Divinia Nietes kasunod sang ginhimo sini nga kontrobersiya.
english: According to Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Undersecretary and Palace Press Officer Atty. Claire Castro, the President himself ordered Department of Education Secretary Sonny Angara to remove Venus Divinia Nietes from office following her controversy.

text: Gin-athag man ni Castro nga wala ginkakasan sang lisyensya bilang manunudlo si Nietes.
english: Castro also clarified that Nietes was not stripped of his teaching license.

text: Matandaan nga mismo si Laua-an, Antique Mayor Aser Baladjay ang nagpanawagan sa Department of Education nga pangitaan na sang paagi agud nga mapahalin ang kontrobersyal nga si Nietes.
english: It can be recalled that Laua-an, Antique Mayor Aser Baladjay himself called on the Department of Education to find a way to remove the controversial Nietes.

text: Sang Septyembre 2023, sang siya ang principal sang Laua-an National High School, masobra 500 nga mga estudyante kag kapin 20 ka mga manunudlo ang nagpatigayon sang hublag-protesta sa atubang mismo sang agud ipabutyag ang ila disgusto sa pagdumala ni Nietes bangud sa ginaalegar pagpang-bully, pagpamahog kag pag-abuso sa iya posisyon.
english: In September 2023, when he was the principal of Laua-an National High School, more than 500 students and more than 20 teachers staged a protest rally right in front of the to express their displeasure with Nietes’ management over alleged bullying, intimidation and abuse in his position.

text: Napilasan ang isa ka pulis matapos nga natiruhan sa ginpatigayon nga buy bust operation sang Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU) sa Sitio Tuburan, Barangay Trapiche, Oton, Iloilo.
english: A policeman was injured after being stabbed in a buy bust operation conducted by the Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU) in Sitio Tuburan, Barangay Trapiche, Oton, Iloilo.

text: Sa amo man nga operasyon, nakapalagyo ang main subject kag ang kaupod sini nga kumpirmado nga may dala nga pusil kag granada.
english: During the same operation, the main subject and his companion, who was confirmed to have a gun and a grenade, escaped.

text: Ang pulis ginkilala nga si Police Corporal Jilbert Lingaya nga nagaserbe nga backup; samtang ang main subject naman sa buybust amo si alias Mike, singkwentahon ang edad, kag tumandok sang amo nga barangay.
english: The policeman was identified as Police Corporal Jilbert Lingaya who was serving as backup; while the main subject of the buybust is alias Mike, 50 years old, and a native of the said barangay.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Dadje De Lima, head sang PDEU, iya ginpahayag nga pasado alas tres pa lang kahapon sang hapon, nag-umpisa na sila sa operasyon kag natigayon nga nadakpan si alias Mike pasado alas syete sang gab-i.

Nakuha sa iya ang tatlo ka gramos nga ginapasuni shabu kabaylo sang P12,000.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Dadje De Lima, head of the PDEU, said they started the operation around 3 pm yesterday and managed to arrest alias Mike around 7 pm.

Three grams of suspected shabu were recovered from him in exchange for P12,000.

text: Sang nadakpan na ang suspek kag nagapatigayon na sang inventory, nanotisyaran sang operatiba nga may tawo pa sa sulod sang balay.
english: When the suspect was arrested and was conducting an inventory, the operative noticed that there were still people inside the house.

text: Sang gintulod ang puertahan, nagpalupok na ang gunman nga ginapatihan nga himata man ni alias Mike.
english: When the door was pushed, the gunman, believed to be a relative of alias Mike, opened fire.

text: Naigu ang pulis sa butkon, kag nagsinggit ini nga mag-withdraw bangud may pusil kag granada ang gunman nga nakasanto man sa ila nga impormasyon halin sa confidential asset.
english: The policeman was hit in the arm, and he shouted to withdraw because the gunman had a gun and a grenade, which was also in line with their information from the confidential asset.

text: Ginpaathag ni Delima nga ginsapar nila ang seguridad sang ila kaupod kag ginhingalitan naman ini sang subject kag kaupod sini nga makapalagyo sa likod nga masiok kag madulom.
english: Delima explained that they compromised the security of their companion and the subject and his companion managed to escape through the narrow and dark back.

text: Masobra pa sa tatlo ka oras ang pag-kordon sa lugar, nagbulig sa pag-negosyar ang alkalde kag barangay officials apang wala sang may nagasabat.
english: The area was cordoned off for more than three hours, the mayor and barangay officials helped negotiate but no one answered.

text: Sang ulihi, ginkumpirma sang otoridad nga nakapalagyo na ang subject kag himata sini nga subong ginakabig nga armed and dangerous.
english: Later, authorities confirmed that the suspect and his relative, who is now considered armed and dangerous, had fled the scene.

text:
NAKASUNGKA NA SANG UNA

Ginplastar man ni Delima nga nakasungka na anay sa ila barangay si alias Mike bangud sa involvement sini sa iligal nga droga.
english:
SURRENDERED BEFORE

Delima also said that alias Mike had already surrendered in their barangay because of his involvement in illegal drugs.

text: Antes pa man ang ila nga operasyon kahapon, nahibaluan man nga nagkuha pa sang suplay ang subject para mabaligya.
english: Even before their operation yesterday, it was also learned that the subject took supplies to sell.

text: Ginapatihan nga ibaligya ini kadungan sang kapistahan sa Trapiche, Oton sa masunod nga mga inadlaw.
english: It is believed that it will be sold in conjunction with the festival in Trapiche, Oton in the coming days.

text: Ginkumpirma man ni Punong Barangay Jeorge Mediodea nga sang 2016 pa sang nag-surrender si alias Mike.
english: Punong Barangay Jeorge Mediodea also confirmed that alias Mike surrendered in 2016.

text: Pahayag pa sang opisyal, may utod man ini nga nadakpan sang una.
english: The official said he also has a brother who was arrested earlier.

text: Dugang sini, wala man sila nagkulang bangud gina-monitor nila ini kag masami man nga ginapatawag sa meeting sang Barangay Anti-Drug Abuse Council.#
english: He added that they did not fail because they monitored it and often called to the meeting of the Barangay Anti-Drug Abuse Council.

text: Nakarekord ang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) sang apat na ka mga holdup incidents sa probinsya sang Iloilo sa bulan sang Pebrero.
english: The Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) has recorded four holdup incidents in Iloilo province in the month of February.

text: Una diri ang natabo sa banwa sang Pavia sang Pebrero 10, kung sa diin gin hold-up ang isa ka fuel tanker sang Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative (MITSCOOP) samtang sakay naman sa Mitsubishi Mirage ang suspek nga may kaupod nga lookout nga nagasakay sa motorsiklo sa Brgy.
english: The first incident occurred in Pavia town on February 10, where a fuel tanker of the Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative (MITSCOOP) was hold-up while the suspect was riding in a Mitsubishi Mirage with a lookout on a motorcycle in Brgy.

text: Pandac, Pavia.
english: Pandac, Pavia.

text: Nataban sang mga suspek ang masobra P300,000 nga benta sang kooperatiba.
english: The suspects stole more than P300,000 worth of sales from the cooperative.

text: Ikaduwa, ang natabo sa banwa sang Sta.
english: Second, what happened in the town of Sta.

text: Barbara sang Pebrero 11 kun sa diin manogbaligya sang herbal product ang nabiktima nga si Jimmy Arriesgado, 50-anyos kag residente sang Barangay San Isidro, Jaro, Iloilo City samtang ang suspek ang wala pa makilal-an nga nakataban sang ginabanta P20,000 nga cash, bulong kag cellphone sang biktima sa Brgy.
english: Barbara on February 11 where the victim, Jimmy Arriesgado, 50, resident of Barangay San Isidro, Jaro, Iloilo City, was selling herbal products while the suspect, who has not been identified, stole P20,000 in cash, medicine and cellphone from the victim in Brgy.

text: Guno, Sta.
english: Guno, Sta.

text: Barbara.
english: Barbara.

text: Ikatatlo, ang natabo sang Pebrero 18 sang udto sa Brgy.
english: Third, the incident on February 18 at noon in Brgy.

text: San Juan, Barotac Viejo kun sa diin nabiktima diri ang Indian national nga si Khuswant Sig Grewal, 22-anyos kag nagatinir sa distrito sang Jaro.
english: San Juan, Barotac Viejo where the victim was Indian national Khuswant Sig Grewal, 22-years-old and resident of Jaro district.

text: Nataban sang mga suspek ang P4,500 nga kwarta sang biktima apang natigayon nga madakpan ang isa sa duwa ka suspek nga si Jan Pril Sinoy sang Brgy.
english: The suspects stole P4,500 from the victim but managed to arrest one of the two suspects, Jan Pril Sinoy of Brgy.

text: Bancal, Lemery kag napasakaan na sang kaso samtang nakapalagyo naman ang iya upod nga padayon nga ginaayam sang mga kapulisan.
english: Bancal, Lemery and has been charged while his companion fled the scene and is still being hunted by the police.

text: Ikaapat, pagkatapos sang insidente sa Barotac Viejo,pagakagab- i sini, natabo man ang pagpanghold-up sa isa ka manogbaligya sang isda nga si Angelyn Pabilona, 42-anyos kag residente sang Barangay Cabugao Viejo sa Brgy.
english: Fourth, after the incident in Barotac Viejo, the following night, a fish vendor named Angelyn Pabilona, ​​42, resident of Barangay Cabugao Viejo in Brgy.

text: Camiri, San Enrique, Iloilo kun sa diin nataban diri ang P159,000 nga cash kag cellphone.
english: Camiri, San Enrique, Iloilo where P159,000 in cash and a cellphone were stolen.

text: Suno kay Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson sang IPPO,sa apat ka mga holdup incidents, ginakonsidera na nga case solved ang natabo sa Barotac Viejo bangud nadakpan ang isa ka suspek.
english: According to Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson of the IPPO, of the four holdup incidents, the case in Barotac Viejo is considered solved because one suspect was arrested.

text: Dugang ni Araño, bangud sini mas pabaskugon pa sang IPPO ang police visibility sa probinsya.
english: Araño added that the IPPO will strengthen police visibility in the province.

text: Nangin sentro sang atensyon ang American hurdler nga si Chris Robinson matapos niya nga nadaugan ang 400-meter hurdles race sa Golden Spike meet sa Ostrava, Czech Republic sa pihak sang wala ginlauman ng wardrobe malfunction.
english: American hurdler Chris Robinson became the center of attention after he won the 400-meter hurdles race at the Golden Spike meet in Ostrava, Czech Republic despite an unexpected wardrobe malfunction.

text: Sa tunga sang iya pagdalagan, naglusot ang iya kinatawo halin sa iya nga shorts.
english: In the middle of his run, his penis slipped out of his shorts.

text: Sa pihak sini, ginpadayon niya ang pagdalagan samtang ginakay-o ang iya shorts agud matago ang iya kinatawo samtang nagalumpat sa mga hurdle.
english: Despite this, he continued to run while fixing his shorts to hide his genitals while jumping the hurdles.

text: Sa finish line, first placer gihapon si Robinson matapos nagrekord sang 48.05 segundo.
english: At the finish line, Robinson was still first place after recording 48.05 seconds.

text: Matapos ang karera, naghigda si Robinson sa track nga daw nayuha.
english: After the race, Robinson lay on the track looking exhausted.

text: Nag-apologize naman ang mga broadcaster sang Golden Spike sa mga tumalan-aw matapos mapalayag ang wala ginalauman nga eksena.
english: Golden Spike broadcasters apologized to viewers after the unexpected scene aired.

text: Kadam-an sa aton pamilyar sa duag green nga ginagamit bilang pampa-aslom sa linuto sa diin makit-an lamang ini sa ugsaran ukon sa gwa sang aton mga balay.
english: Most of us are familiar with the green color used as a spice in cooking where it can only be found in the yard or outside our homes.

text: Ini amo ang iba nga nangin bantog sa maaslom sini nga sabor.
english: These are some that have become famous for its sour taste.

text: Suno kay Dr. Farrah Agustin-Bunch, magluwas nga epektibo ang iba bilang pampa-aslom sa mga linuto ilabi na sa paborito naton nga sinigang, manggaranon man ini sa vitamins B kag C, calcium, phosphorus, iron kag fiber.
english: According to Dr. Farrah Agustin-Bunch, besides being effective as a thickener in dishes especially our favorite porridge, it is also rich in vitamins B and C, calcium, phosphorus, iron and fiber.

text: Natukiban suno sa doktor nga ang extract ukon duga sang iba fruit, ang nagahatag sang madamo nga benepisyo sa ikaayong lawas.
english: The doctor said it was discovered that the extract or juice of some fruits, provides many health benefits.

text: Lakip na diri ang positibo nga epekto sa metabolic rate bangud sa manubo sini nga calorie content.
english: This includes a positive effect on metabolic rate due to its low calorie content.

text: Pahayag ni Dr. Bunch, nagabulong man ang iba sa hypertension, ubo kag runny nose.
english: Statement by Dr. Bunch, others also treat hypertension, cough and runny nose.

text: Sa mga may ubo, mahimo nga idugang ang duga sang iba fruit sa cough syrup.
english: For those with cough, you can add the juice of other fruits to cough syrup.

text: Dugang pa sang doktor, laga-on lamang ang iba sa mainit nga tubig kag imnon ini sang maalabaab kada aga agud maangkon ang maayo nga ikaayong lawas kag mabulong ang iban pa nga balatian.
english: The doctor added that some of them should be boiled in hot water and drunk warm every morning to achieve good health and cure other diseases.

text: 𝗠𝗔𝗦𝗦𝗔𝗖𝗛𝗨𝗦𝗘𝗧𝗧𝗦, 𝗨𝗦𝗔 —Magahatag sang reward ang isa ka lalaki sa Massachusetts sa pagbalik sang iya wallet pagkatapos ini nga ginkuha sang isa ka seagull sa guwa sang grocery store.
english: 𝗠𝗔𝗦𝗦𝗔𝗖𝗛𝗨𝗦𝗘𝗧𝗧𝗦, 𝗨𝗦𝗔 —A Massachusetts man will offer a reward for the return of his wallet after it was stolen by a seagull in a grocery store.
