text: Si Noah Karberg sang Nantucket nagsiling nga nagbiyahe siya sa Stop & Shop pagkatapos sang adlaw nga siya ang nagpangisda sa isa ka isla.
english: Noah Karberg of Nantucket said he took a trip to Stop & Shop after the day he spent fishing on an island.

text: Sa pahayag ni Karberg, iya ginbutang ang iya telepono kag wallet sa tray sa ibabaw sang shopping cart, nga nagapabilin didto samtang siya nagabutang sang groceries sa iya truck.
english: In Karberg’s statement, he placed his phone and wallet on the tray on top of the shopping cart, which remained there while he loaded groceries into his truck.

text: Suno sa iya, ginkuha niya ang nabilin nga mga bag sa backseat, nagbalik sa shopping cart, apang didto nakita sini nga may seagull nga nagapungko sa cart, kag direkta nga ginkuha ang iya wallet kag naglupad.
english: He said he took the remaining bags from the backseat, returned to the shopping cart, but there he saw a seagull sitting in the cart, and directly took his wallet and flew away.

text: Bangud diri, nagkuha si Karberg sang video samtang ang seagull nagpadulong sa atop sa malapit nga car wash kag nag-umpisa sa pag-usisa sang sulod sang wallet.
english: Because of this, Karberg took video as the seagull headed to the roof at a nearby car wash and started rummaging through the contents of the wallet.

text: Matapos ang hitabo, si Karberg nagsulat sa lokal nga Facebook group nga bisan sin-o nga makakita sang wallet mahimo magkuha sang nabilin nga kwarta kag nagahatag siya sang dugang nga $100 ukon P5,600 nga cash reward para sa pagbalik sang iya lisensya kag mga card.
english: After the incident, Karberg wrote in the local Facebook group that anyone who found the wallet could take the rest of the money and that he was offering an additional $100 or P5,600 cash reward for the return of his license and cards.

text: Handa si Iloilo City MIloilo Central Market nga atubangon kon hinali nga mag-escalate ang imbestigasyon sa Iloilo Central Market kag Iloilo Terminal Market.
english: Iloilo City MIloilo Central Market is ready to face if the investigation in Iloilo Central Market and Iloilo Terminal Market suddenly escalates.

text: Ini kasunod man sa ginpaguwa nga statement sang isa ka senatorial candidate nga nagpadulong sa syudad agud magsekyar sang mga merkado.
english: This follows the statement issued by a senatorial candidate who went to the city to check the markets.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga kon maglab-ot gidman sa Kamara, handa siya nga atubangon ang mga palamangkutanon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said that if it reaches the House, she is ready to face the questions.

text: Nagpanindugan man ini nga nag-agi sa insakto ang proseso sang pagpakaayo sang mga mercado.
english: He also insisted that the process of improving the markets went smoothly.

text: Nagapati man ang alkalde nga nagsunod sa pagsulundan ang proyekto sang syudad kon sa diin, unanimously approved sa Iloilo City council.
english: The mayor also believes that the city's project followed the rules where it was unanimously approved by the Iloilo City council.

text: Gin-athag man ni Fantilaga nga nagapabilin nga transparent sa publiko ang paghuman sang mga merkado.
english: Fantilaga also clarified that the composition of the markets remains transparent to the public.

text: Nahibaluan nga una na nga nagpasalig ang syudad nga sa bulan sang Mayo, mahimo na makasaylo ang mga vendors kag magamit ang duha ka merkado.
english: The city had earlier promised that by May, vendors could move in and use the two markets.

text: LUAS sa suod nga myembo sang amon pamilya wala na sing nakahibalo sang akon birthday agud bisan ma-greet man lang ako.
english: EXCEPT for my close family members, no one knew my birthday to even greet me.

text: Man wala man ako nagapanugid sa iban.
english: I don't tell anyone else either.

text: Kag kon may iban nga nakahibalo gid man, exceptional na ini sila nga mga tinuga.
english: And if anyone else does know, they are exceptional creatures.

text: Sa tuig nga ini, may duha gid man sa gwa sang akon pamilya ang nakadumdum agud ma-greet ako mismo sa adlaw sang akon kaadlawan.
english: This year, there were two outside my family who remembered to greet me personally on my birthday.

text: Thanks Frat Brod Rex Bacaling Demafelis.
english: Thanks Frat Brod Rex Bacaling Demafelis.

text: Si Brod Rex 2012 Charter (first) President sang amon Samahan, nga isa ka paghugpong nasyonal sang nagakalain-lain nga tsapter sang amon brotherhood (Fraternity-Sorority).
english: Brod Rex is the 2012 Charter (first) President of our Society, which is a national association of the various chapters of our fraternity (Fraternity-Sorority).

text: Former Vice Chancellor sa UP-Diliman si Brod Rex kag isa ini ka scientist sa UP-Los Baños nga tapos sa MS in Chemical Engineering sa UP-Diliman.
english: Brod Rex is a former Vice Chancellor at UP-Diliman and a scientist at UP-Los Baños who graduated from MS in Chemical Engineering at UP-Diliman.

text: Thanks man kay Pete (Jimenea), ang isahanon sa fellow mediamen ko nga nakadumdum sa pag-greet man sa akon kaadlawan.
english: Thanks also to Pete (Jimenea), the only one of my fellow mediamen who remembered to greet me on my birthday.

text: Sa liwat, thank you gid sa inyo nga duha!
english: Once again, thank you both so much!

text:
***

Amat-amat nagaathag ang mga isyu nga dal-on sang Opposition Coalition nga ISambayan sa palaabuton nga May 2021 presidential election.
english:
***

The issues that the Opposition Coalition ISambayan will bring in the upcoming May 2021 presidential election are slowly becoming clearer.

text: Sunu sa spokesperson sang ISambayan nga si retired Senior Supreme Court Justice Antonio  Carpio, ginapangunahan ini sang ila indi mabali nga tindug sa Demokrasya, human rights, kag soberanya sang Filipinas.
english: According to ISambayan spokesperson retired Senior Supreme Court Justice Antonio Carpio, it is led by their unwavering stand on democracy, human rights, and sovereignty of the Philippines.

text: Una na dira ang isyu sang “authoritarian” nga klase sang pangginahum ni Presidente Duterte sa pagpagusto sini sang iya luyag ihambal kag isugo sa kapulisan bisan wala na nagakaigu sa kasuguan kag maayo nga binatasan.
english: First of all, the issue of President Duterte's “authoritarian” class of rule in doing what he wants to say and order the police even if it is no longer in accordance with the law and good manners.

text: Indi man mabali ang tindug sang ISambayan batok sa anti-terror law kag death penalty, kag ang tindug sini batok sa extrajudicial killings, kon diin akusado sa karon si Presidente Duterte sang “crime against humanity” sa International Criminal Court tungod sa gina-alegar nga “state sponsored” nga pagpatay sang sobra 10,000 sa Duterte Drug War.
english: ISambayan's position against the anti-terror law and the death penalty, and its position against extrajudicial killings, is also unwavering, where President Duterte is currently accused of a “crime against humanity” at the International Criminal Court for the alleged “state sponsored” killing of more than 10,000 people in the Duterte Drug War.

text: Mabaskug man ang tindug sang ISambayan pabor sa aton legal claim sa 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) sa West Philippine Sea kag Scarborough Shoal, nga gindaug naton sa Hague Tribunal sadtong 2016, nga gintawag ni Presidente Duterte nga isa lang ka “scrap of paper” ukon basura.
english: ISambayan also stands strongly in favor of our legal claim to the 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) in the West Philippine Sea and Scarborough Shoal, which we won in the Hague Tribunal in 2016, which President Duterte called a “scrap paper” of garbage.

text:
***

Sa sining uncompromising nga mga tindug, ang ISambayan wala sing ginapasin-o.

Bisan si boxing legend kag Senador Manny Pacquiao indi gani mabaton diri tungod sa iya tindug sa death penalty kag kwestyonable nga tindug sa extrajudicial killings.
english:
***

With these uncompromising positions, ISambayan does not compromise.

Even boxing legend and Senator Manny Pacquiao cannot be accepted here because of his stance on the death penalty and questionable stance on extrajudicial killings.

text: Ang independent critic ni Presidente Duterte nga si Senador Panfilo Lacson indi man gani mabaton sang ISambayan tungod sa iya pagsuporta sa anti-terror law, nga labag sa kahilwayan kag kinamatarong sang mga pumuluyo agud bantayan kag sawayon ang kapaltahan sang gobyerno kay sila ang matuod nga amo (master) kag indi suluguon (servant) sang gobyerno.
english: President Duterte's independent critic, Senator Panfilo Lacson, is not even accepted by ISambayan because of his support for the anti-terror law, which violates the freedom and right of the people to monitor and criticize the government's failures because they are the true masters and not servants of the government.

text: Of course, open ang ISambayan sa tanan, lakip na ang luyag mag-upod halin sa Duterte Coalition nga nagapati sa panindugan sang ISambayan.
english: Of course, ISambayan is open to everyone, including those who want to join from the Duterte Coalition who believe in the position of ISambayan.

text: Bilang coalition lang, ang isa ka grupo nga katapo sini pwede magbulag diri kon san-o nila ini gustuhon.
english: As a coalition only, a group that is a member of it can break away from it whenever they want.

text:
***

Tungod gani  human na ang tindug sang ISambayan sa palaabuton nga May 2021 presidential election, ang kulang na gid lang amo kon paano nila mapaugyon ang mga botante sa sining ila tindug sa Demokrasya.
english:
***

Since the ISambayan's position in the upcoming May 2021 presidential election is ready, the only thing that remains is how they can convince the voters to agree on their position on democracy.

text: Parti sa kon ano ang luyag nila sa isa ka Presidente, ang survey sadtong Disyembre 2009 para sa 2010 presidential election nagpakita nga luyag sang mga pumuluyo ang Presidente nga pro-poor, indi corrupt, kag may matarong nga pagkatao.
english: As for what they want in a President, a survey in December 2009 for the 2010 presidential election showed that people want a President who is pro-poor, not corrupt, and has a righteous personality.

text: Gindaug ini nga eleksyon ni Noynoy Aquino sadtong  2010.
english: Noynoy Aquino won this election in 2010.

text:
Sa panahon ni Duterte, ginpadaug ini siya sang mga pumuluyo sa iya ginpasalig nga liderato nga wala nahadlok sa pag-atubang sa kon sin-o nga poderoso sa sosyedad, katulad sang mga oligarch kag drug lords, lakip

na ang Catholic Church nga sadto nagbulig sa pagtumba kay Marcos.
english:
During Duterte's time, the people gave him victory over his promised leadership that is not afraid to confront anyone who is powerful in society, such as oligarchs and drug lords, including

the Catholic Church that had helped overthrow Marcos.

text: Unfortunately para sa iya sumulunod, nag-back-fire ining estilo sang iya liderato tungod sa wala nagakaangay nga pamahog, paghingabot, human rights violations angot sa iya drug war, kag ang pagpatumbaya sang kawsa sang Filipinas sa South China Sea.
english: Unfortunately for his followers, this style of his leadership back-fired due to unwarranted threats, harassment, human rights violations related to his drug war, and the neglect of the Philippines' cause in the South China Sea.

text: Salabton man ining mga isyu sang mga kandidato ni Presidente Duterte sa ila pagpangampanya sa May 2021 election tungod sa pag-endorsar sini sa ila.
english: President Duterte's candidates will also be responsible for these issues in their campaign for the May 2021 election because of his endorsement of them.

text: Gani ginapaabot sang publiko ang pagtuhaw sang mga bagay nga isyu batok sa mga kandidato ni Presidente Duterte, katulad sang “Atin ang Filipinas, huwag i-surrender ito sa China!”, “Panagutin si Duterte sa Crime Against Humanity!”, “Buhay at Kabuhayan ng mga Mahirap Matters!”, “Huwag bastusin ang Kababaehan at Kabataan!”, etc./PN
english: Therefore, the public expects the emergence of issues against President Duterte's candidates, such as “The Philippines is ours, don't surrender it to China!”, “Duterte will be held accountable for Crime Against Humanity!”, “Life and Livelihood of the Poor Matters!”, “Don't abuse the youth!”, etc.

text: Liwat nagnubo ang balor sang piso batok sa dolyar matapos naglab-ot sa P59.22 kada $1 subong nga Martes, Disyembre 9, 2025.
english: The peso fell again against the dollar after reaching P59.22 per $1 on Tuesday, December 9, 2025.

text: Ini ang pinakamanubo nga lebel sa kasaysayan nga pungsod, nga naglagpas sa anay record nga P59.17 sang Nobyembre 12, 2025.
english: This is the lowest level in the country’s history, breaking the former record of P59.17 on November 12, 2025.

text: Nag-umpisa ang tuig sa lebel nga P55 kada $1 apang amat-amat nga naghinay ang piso bangud sa mataas nga inflation kag mabaskog nga dolyar.
english: The year started at the level of P55 per $1 but the peso gradually depreciated due to high inflation and a strong dollar.

text: Suno sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, padayon nila nga ginabantayan ang sitwasyon kag handa sila nga mag-intervene agud mapadayon ang stability ng piso.
english: According to the Central Bank of the Philippines, they continue to monitor the situation and are ready to intervene to maintain the stability of the peso.

text: Ang pagnubo sang piso ang nagtuga sang mas mataas nga presyo sang imported goods kaangay sang gatong kag pagkaon, nga direkta nakaapekto sa mga komunidad.
english: The depreciation of the peso has led to higher prices for imported goods such as fuel and food, directly affecting communities.

text: Sa halip na ituring ang tubig bilang kalaban, hinikayat ng mga eksperto ang pamahalaan na gamitin ito bilang kakampi sa pag-unlad ng agrikultura sa pamamagitan ng mas malawak at epektibong irigasyon.
english: Instead of treating water as an enemy, experts urged the government to use it as an ally in the development of agriculture through more extensive and effective irrigation.

text: Matagal nang inuuna ng bansa ang pagtatayo ng mga pader, kanal, at iba pang flood control structures para labanan ang baha.
english: The country has long prioritized the construction of walls, canals, and other flood control structures to combat flooding.

text: Ngunit sa kabila ng halos dalawang libo’t tatlong daang milimetrong taunang pag-ulan, nananatiling kapos sa tubig ang mga magsasaka.
english: But despite the nearly two thousand three millimeters of annual rainfall, farmers remain water scarce.

text: Sa kasalukuyan, 2.15 milyong ektarya lamang ng lupa ang may irigasyon, mula sa potensyal na 3.1 milyong ektarya.
english: Currently, only 2.15 million hectares of land are irrigated, out of a potential 3.1 million hectares.

text: Ang kakulangan na ito ang sanhi ng pabagu-bagong ani, lalo na ng palay.
english: This shortage is the cause of fluctuating yields, especially of rice.

text: Nakakabigla ang pagkakaiba sa badyet: sa 2025, halos 346 na bilyong piso ang inilaan sa flood control, habang 69 bilyon lamang sa irigasyon — limang beses na mas maliit.
english: The difference in budget is striking: in 2025, nearly 346 billion pesos will be allocated to flood control, while only 69 billion pesos will be allocated to irrigation — five times less.

text: Isa pang isyu ay ang pagkawala ng irrigation service fee sa ilalim ng Free Irrigation Service Act.
english: Another issue is the absence of irrigation service fee under the Free Irrigation Service Act.

text: Bagama’t maganda ang layunin, nawala ang maliit ngunit mahalagang pondo para sa pang-araw-araw na maintenance ng mga irigasyon.
english: Although the intention was good, the small but important funds for the day-to-day maintenance of the irrigation systems were lost.

text: Iminumungkahi ngayon ang pagbabalik ng community-based approach: bigyang-kapangyarihan ang irrigators’ associations na mangolekta ng makatuwirang kontribusyon para sa maintenance, at gantimpalaan ang mga asosasyong lalampas sa target sa pamamagitan ng kagamitan, training, at pondo para sa reinvestment.
english: The return of a community-based approach is now proposed: empower irrigators' associations to collect reasonable contributions for maintenance, and reward associations that exceed the target with equipment, training, and funds for reinvestment.

text: Bukod dito, dapat muling gamitin ang bond financing — hindi lang para sa konstruksiyon kundi para sa tuloy-tuloy na maintenance.
english: In addition, bond financing should be used again — not just for construction but for ongoing maintenance.

text: Ito ay napatunayan nang gumana noong 2006 at 2009, ngunit natutunan din ang leksyon: walang saysay ang pag-rehabilitate kung wala namang pondo para sa pagpapanatili.
english: This was proven to work in 2006 and 2009, but the lesson was also learned: there is no point in rehabilitation if there is no fund for maintenance.

text: Sa harap ng lumalakas na produksyon ng palay ngayong taon, naniniwala ang mga tagapagtaguyod ng reporma na ang tunay na pag-unlad ay magmumula sa irigasyon — hindi sa pagpigil ng baha, kundi sa mas matalinong paggamit ng tubig para sa pagkain at kabuhayan ng lahat.
english: In the face of rising rice production this year, reform advocates believe that real progress will come from irrigation — not from flood control, but from smarter use of water for food and livelihoods for all.

text: Naghingyo ang grupo sang mga mamumugon nga makig-istorya kay President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: The group of workers requested talks with President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: kaangot sa pending gihapon nga mga hagna sa Kongreso nga ginduso agud pasakaan ang sweldo sa pribado nga sector.
english: in connection with the pending bills in Congress proposed to raise wages in the private sector.

text: Ginpasa sang National Wage Coalition ang ila sulat kay Labor Secretary Bienvenido Laguesma kahapon agud nga ma-facilitate sini ang dayalogo sa tunga sang Presidente kag sa labor sector.
english: The National Wage Coalition forwarded its letter to Labor Secretary Bienvenido Laguesma yesterday so that he could facilitate a dialogue between the President and the labor sector.

text: Ini nga koalisyon ang ginabug-usan sang Bukluran ng Manggagawang Pilipino, Kilusang Mayo Uno, Nagkaisa kag Trade Union Congress of the Philippines.
english: The coalition is composed of the Filipino Workers' Union, Kilusang Mayo Uno, Magkaisa and the Trade Union Congress of the Philippines.

text: Ginsiling sang grupo nga ang wage hike ang isa ka bagay nga ginadalian gid sang Filipino workers.
english: The group said the wage hike is one of the most pressing issues for Filipino workers.

text: Pananglitan matabo ini nga istoryanay, mabatian ang sentimyento sang mga mamumugon antes ang Labor Day sa Mayo 1.
english: Assuming this conversation happens, workers’ sentiments will be heard before Labor Day on May 1st.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang president nga seryoso pa nga ginarepaso ang ginaproponer nga P200 daily pay hike.
english: Earlier, the president said the proposed P200 daily pay hike is still being seriously reviewed.

text: Matandaan nga naaprubahan na sang House Committee on Labor and Employment ang substitute bill nga nagaduso sang P200 daily across-the-board wage increase para sa private sector workers.
english: The House Committee on Labor and Employment has already approved a substitute bill proposing a P200 daily across-the-board wage increase for private sector workers.

text: Wala sang makapugong sa Pilipinas nga malab-ot ang target sini nga mangin upper-middle income economy sa 2026.
english: Nothing can stop the Philippines from achieving its target of becoming an upper-middle income economy by 2026.

text: Ini ang ginpahayag ni National Economic Development Authority (NEDA) Secretary Arsenio Balisacan bisan pa nga may mga pagpanghangkat kaangay sang trade war sa tunga sang igapatuman ni US President Donald Trump nga reciprocal tariff policy.
english: This was stated by National Economic Development Authority (NEDA) Secretary Arsenio Balisacan despite challenges such as the trade war amid US President Donald Trump's reciprocal tariff policy.

text: Kumpyansa ang socioeconomic planning chief nga magasangkad ang gross domestic product (GDP) sang Pilipinas sa 6% nga amo ang pinakamanubo sa growth target sang Marcos administration subong nga tuig.
english: The socioeconomic planning chief is confident that the Philippines' gross domestic product (GDP) will expand to 6%, which is the lowest of the Marcos administration's growth target this year.

text: “But we still think that 6%… is still achievable… We are crossing our fingers, there are risks out there but we’ve been watchful, vigilant.
english: “But we still think that 6%… is still achievable… We are crossing our fingers, there are risks out there but we’ve been watchful, vigilant.

text: We’ve adjusted policy tools to make sure our economy maintains its resilience amid uncertainties,” suno sa tiglikom.
english: We’ve adjusted policy tools to make sure our economy maintains its resilience amid uncertainties,” the secretary said.

text: Sa idalom sang latest classification sang World Bank as of July 2024, nagapabilin ang Pilipinas sa lower middle income economy nga may gross national income (GNI) per capita nga $3,950 sang 2022 nga sulod sa bracket para sa sini nga status.
english: Under the World Bank’s latest classification as of July 2024, the Philippines remains a lower middle income economy with a gross national income (GNI) per capita of $3,950 in 2022 that falls within the bracket for this status.

text: Kaupod sang Pilipinas sa sini nga bracket subong amo ang Vietnam ($4,010 GNI per capita); Laos ($2,360); Cambodia ($1,700); kag Myanmar ($1,210).
english: Joining the Philippines in this bracket today are Vietnam ($4,010 GNI per capita); Laos ($2,360); Cambodia ($1,700); and Myanmar ($1,210).

text: Yara naman sa upper-middle income level ang kaiping nga mga pungsod kaangay sang Malaysia ($11,780); Thailand ($7,230); kag Indonesia ($4,580).
english: Neighboring countries such as Malaysia ($11,780) are in the upper-middle income level; Thailand ($7,230); and Indonesia ($4,580).

text: Mas mataas pa gid ang Singapore ($67,200) kag Brunei ($31,410) nga yara na subong sa high-income bracket.
english: Even higher are Singapore ($67,200) and Brunei ($31,410) which are now in the high-income bracket.

text: Mainit nga nagsabtanay sanday SAGIP Party List Representative Rodante Marcoleta kag Philippine Coast Guard Spokesperson Commodore Jay Tarriela kaangot sa isyu sa West Philippine Sea sa ginpatigayon nga hearing sang House tri-committee.
english: SAGIP Party List Representative Rodante Marcoleta and Philippine Coast Guard Spokesperson Commodore Jay Tarriela had a warm exchange on the West Philippine Sea issue during the House tri-committee hearing.

text: Ini may kaangtanan sa pahayag ni Tarriela natuhoy sa statement ni Marcoleta nga wala sang West Philippine Sea nga makit-an sa mapa.
english: This is in connection with Tarriela's statement regarding Marcoleta's statement that there is no West Philippine Sea on the map.

text: Sa resumption sang House Tri Committee hearing may kaangtanan sa paglapta sang disinformation kag misinformation online, namangkot si Marcoleta tuhoy sa claims sa social media nga gintawag siya ni Tarriela nga traidor nga ginpanginwala naman sang PCG spokesperson.
english: At the resumption of the House Tri Committee hearing on the spread of disinformation and misinformation online, Marcoleta asked about claims on social media that Tarriela called him a traitor which the PCG spokesperson denied.

text: Suno kay Tarriela, ini ang una nga tion nga ginpamangkot siya kun traidor ukon indi si Marcoleta.
english: According to Tarriela, this is the first time he was asked whether Marcoleta is a traitor or not.

text: Pahayag niya, wala siya sang obligasyon nga magsabat sa mga social media posts sang vloggers kag social media influencers kag suno sa iya, kun depensahan man niya ang mamalidha, mamalisyahan pa ini nga ginasuportahan niya ang opisyal nga nagakandidato subong sa pagka-senador.
english: He said he has no obligation to respond to social media posts by vloggers and social media influencers and said that if he defends the lawmaker, he will be accused of supporting the official who is now running for senator.

text: Nagsabat naman si Marcoleta nga ang pag-athag sa isa ka butang ang indi pulitika kag ginpamangkot si Tariella kun ngaa importante sa iya ang pag-athag sang isa ka pahayag nga wala man naghalin sa iya baba.
english: Marcoleta replied that clarifying something is not political and asked Tariella why it was important for her to clarify a statement that did not come from her mouth.

text: Nagbalos naman si Tarriela nga nahibaluan lamang niya ini nga isyu amo ang sang tion nga nabatian niya ang interview nga gintawag siya nga gago kag mango ni Marcoleta kag wala sang rason nga depensahan niya ang tawo nga nagabuyayaw sa iya.
english: Tarriela replied that he only knew about the issue when he heard the interview that he was called a fool and a mango by Marcoleta and there was no reason for him to defend the person who was insulting him.

text: Depensa naman ni Marcoleta nga ang akto ni Tariella amo ang iya ginatumod kag indi ang PCG spokesperson mismo.
english: Marcoleta defended that he was referring to Tariella's act and not the PCG spokesperson himself.

text: Gin-athag man niya nga ang iya statement sa West Philippine Sea ang natuhoy sa pagkinahanglan sang Pilipinas nga magrehistro sang pangalan nga ginhimo sini sa International Hydrographic Organization.
english: He also clarified that his statement on the West Philippine Sea was about the need for the Philippines to register the name it created with the International Hydrographic Organization.

text: Apang para kay Tarriela, may yara na sang layi nga naga- establish sang West Philippine Sea.
english: But for Tarriela, there is already a law that establishes the West Philippine Sea.

text: Gintuad man ni Tarriela nga madamo sang mga pro-China trolls ang nag-ulhot nga nagagamit sang social media bilang pamaagi sa pagpalapta sang disinformation.
english: Tarriela also acknowledged that many pro-China trolls have emerged using social media as a means of spreading disinformation.

text: Gindesignar ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. designated

text: ang tatlo ka mga opisyal sang Gabinete nga amo ang mangin caretakers diri sa pungsod samtang didto siya kag si First Lady Liza Marcos sa Vatican.
english: the three Cabinet officials who will be the caretakers here in the country while he and First Lady Liza Marcos are in the Vatican.

text: Ini amo sanday Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla, kag Agrarian Reform Secretary Conrado Estrella III.
english: They are Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla, and Agrarian Reform Secretary Conrado Estrella III.

text: Subong nga gab-i ang byahe sang mag-asawa nga Marcos para nga magtambong sa lubong ni Pope Francis nga naka-schedule sa Sabado.
english: The Marcos couple will fly tonight to attend the funeral of Pope Francis scheduled for Saturday.

text: Sa statement sang Malacañang, ginpahayag nga ipalab-ot sang First Couple ang mga pagpangamuyo kag pagdumdom sang mga Pilipino sa Santo Papa ukon ginatawag man nga si Lolo Kiko.
english: In a statement, Malacañang said the First Couple will convey the prayers and remembrance of Filipinos to the Pope or also known as Lolo Kiko.

text: Ginsiling man sang Palasyo nga kaupod ni President Marcos ang ginabanta 170 dignitaries lakip na ang heads of state nga maga-upod sa linibo ka mga tumuluo nga magasaksi sa funeral rites para sa Santo Papa.
english: The Palace also said that President Marcos will be accompanied by an estimated 170 dignitaries including heads of state who will join thousands of faithful who will witness the funeral rites for the Pope.

text: Nahibaluan nga subong nga adlaw, nagbyahe naman pakadto sa Roma sanday Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines President kag Kalookan Bishop Pablo Virgilio Cardinal David amo man si Manila Archbishop Jose Cardinal Advincula.
english: Today, the Catholic Bishops' Conference of the Philippines President and Kalookan Bishop Pablo Virgilio Cardinal David as well as Manila Archbishop Jose Cardinal Advincula left for Rome.

text: Magluwas nga maga-attend sa lubong, nagahanda man sila sa Conclave ukon ang pagtipon sang College of Cardinals agud magpili sang masunod nga Santo Papa.
english: Besides attending the funeral, they are also preparing for the Conclave or the gathering of the College of Cardinals to elect the next Pope.

text: Lunes sang gin-anunsyo sang Vatican nga napatay ang Pope sa edad nga 88-anyos bangud sa stroke kag heart failure.#
english: The Vatican announced on Monday that the Pope had died at the age of 88 due to a stroke and heart failure.

text: Patay ang alkalde sang Rizal, Cagayan nga si Mayor Joel Ruma matapos ginluthang sang wala pa makilal-an nga mga suspek kagab-i, Abril 23.
english: Rizal, Cagayan Mayor Joel Ruma was shot dead by unidentified suspects last night, April 23.

text: Suno sa pulis, natabo ang pagpangluthang samtang nagapatigayon sang campaign sortie ang alkalde kag iya mga kaalyado sa barangay hall sa Barangay Illuru Sur sa amo nga banawa.
english: According to police, the shooting occurred while the mayor and his allies were conducting a campaign sortie at the barangay hall in Barangay Illuru Sur in the town.

text: Base sa inisyal nga impormasyon, may duha ka iban pa nga nadalahig sa areas kun sa diin natabo ang shooting.
english: Based on initial information, there were two others involved in the areas where the shooting took place.

text: Nagaguwa sa initial reports ang pangalan nga Merson Abiguebel kag Melanie Talay apang padayon pa nga gina-check ang update sa ila medical condition.
english: Initial reports show the names of Merson Abiguebel and Melanie Talay but the update on their medical condition is still being checked.

text: Nagapatigayon na subong sang hot pursuit operation ang Rizal Police Station kaupod sa iban nga units sa idalom sang Cagayan Police Provincial Office.
english: The Rizal Police Station is now conducting a hot pursuit operation together with other units under the Cagayan Police Provincial Office.

text: Nagpaathag ang Sangguniang Bayan sang Dumangas, Iloilo kaangot sa postponement sang hearing nga nagatalakay sa reklamo ukon supplemental complaint batok sa bulangan sang Stephanie Coliseum.
english: The Sangguniang Bayan of Dumangas, Iloilo has explained the postponement of the hearing on the complaint or supplemental complaint against the Stephanie Coliseum.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dumangas, Iloilo Vice Mayor Ronaldo Golez, iya ginpahayag nga naka-schedule kuntani ang hearing kahapon nga adlaw, Pebrero 17, 2025, apang natabo-an nga wala nakaabot ang alkalde sang banwa nga si Mayor Braeden John Biron.
english: Dumangas, Iloilo Vice Mayor Ronaldo Golez said the hearing was scheduled for yesterday, February 17, 2025, but the town's mayor, Mayor Braeden John Biron, did not arrive.

text: Suno kay Golez, nagpungko siya bilang acting mayor apang, nakulangan naman sang kwarto bangud ang session ang pagasakopan sang Committee of the Whole.
english: According to Golez, he took office as acting mayor but, lack of room because the session will be covered by the Committee of the Whole.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga bangud sa alang-alang ang sitwasyon, nagdesisyon na lang sila nga i-reschedule ang amo nga hearing.
english: He also said that due to the uncertainty of the situation, they decided to reschedule the hearing.

text: Gin-athag man ni Golez nga may mga tikang ukon recommendations na man sila nga ginpasa kay Mayor Biron bangud sa nagadugang na lang ang mga complaints batok sa Stephanie Coliseum.
english: Golez also explained that they have already submitted measures or recommendations to Mayor Biron because of the increasing complaints against the Stephanie Coliseum.

text: Rason man nga ginsuspende ang bulangan sang duha ka semana sugod Pebrero 1 tubtob 14, 2025.
english: The clinic was also suspended for two weeks from February 1 to 14, 2025.

text: Nagpasalig man ang natungdan nga gilayon mapa-schedule subong nga semana ang amo nga concern agud mahatagan sang igtalupangod.
english: He also assured that the concern will be scheduled this week for attention.

text: Una na nga ginpa-Bombo ang amo nga bulangan bangud sa ginaalegar improper use of municipal tax kag failure to complaint with documental requirements.
english: The bulangan was previously bombed for alleged improper use of municipal tax and failure to complain with documentary requirements.

text: Ginkakabit naman sang complainant ukon ang nagpa-Bombo batok sa Stephanie Coliseum ang pag-abot sang sulat sang lokal nga pangulohan sang Dumangas nga naga-imbitar sa iya agud nga magtambong sang hearing subong nga adlaw.
english: The complainant or the one who filed the Bombo against Stephanie Coliseum said he received a letter from the local government of Dumangas inviting him to attend the hearing today.

text: Suno kay Rey Domines, ang nagpa-Bombo, iya ginpahayag nga naka-schedule man siya subong sa iya nga neurologist kaangot man sa iya ikaayong lawas.
english: According to Rey Domines, who sent Bombo, he said he is also scheduled to see his neurologist regarding his health.

text: Dugang sini nga daw nagulpihan man siya sa amo nga pagpatawag sa iya bangud nag-timing man nga may kaladtuan siya.
english: He added that he was surprised by the summons because it was timed that he had a destination.

text: Nagalaum man ini nga hulaton siya sang Local Government sang Dumangas agud nga makatambong sa hearing.
english: He also hopes that the Local Government of Dumangas will wait for him to attend the hearing.

text: Una na nga ginbuyagyag sang natungdan ang iya nga pagkadismaya sa nangin lihok sang LGU sang Dumangas batok sa Stephanie Coliseum.
english: Earlier, he expressed his disappointment with the action of the LGU of Dumangas against the Stephanie Coliseum.

text: Kon balikan, gin-alegar ni Domines nga nagapanukot ang Stephanie Coliseum sang tax collection nga P350 apisar P200 lang dapat ini.
english: Looking back, Domines alleged that the Stephanie Coliseum is charging a tax collection of P350 even though it should be only P200.

text: Gintuad man sang natungdan nga sugod sang Oktubre tubtob Disyembre 2024, wala sila ka remit sang municipal tax rason nga nagpasaka ini sang complaint sang Disyembre 27, 2024.
english: He also admitted that from October to December 2024, they did not remit the municipal tax, which is why he filed a complaint on December 27, 2024.

text: MADAMO ang indi sugot sa hingyo sang pila ka myembro sang PDP-Laban Party, kon diin party chairman si Presidente Duterte, nga padalaganon siya sa pagka-Bise Presidente sa palaabuton nga May 22 presidential election.
english: MANY people disagree with the request of some members of the PDP-Laban Party, of which President Duterte is party chairman, to run for Vice President in the upcoming May 22 presidential election.

text: Isa na dira sa indi gid sugot amo ang abyan naton nga si Pedro.
english: One of the most disagreeable is our friend Peter.

text: Nahadlok ining aton abyan nga si Pedro sa “strongman rule”.
english: This friend of ours Peter is afraid of the “strongman rule”.

text: In  fact, nag-upod siya sa minilyon nga mga pumuluyo sa “bloodless” Edsa Revolution nga gamit lang ang rosarito kag mga bulak agud ululuhan ang mga soldado sa pagtipyok kontra sa diktador nga si Marcos.
english: In fact, he joined millions of people in the “bloodless” Edsa Revolution using only the rosary and flowers to lead the soldiers to rally against dictator Marcos.

text: Wala na mahimo si Marcos sang pati ang mga soldado nag-upod na sa mga naga-rebelde nga mga pumuluyo sa pagpamuno sang balo ni Senador Ninoy Aquino nga si Cory.
english: Marcos was helpless when even the soldiers joined the rebellious people led by Senator Ninoy Aquino's widow Cory.

text: Upod sini sanday Constabulary chief Fidel Ramos kag Defense Secretary Juan Ponce Enrile.
english: They were accompanied by Constabulary chief Fidel Ramos and Defense Secretary Juan Ponce Enrile.

text: Sang ginlusob na sang mga nagasinggitan nga mga pumuluyo ang Malakanyang, naghingagaw na gid lang sa paglayas si Marcos kag ang iya pamilya pa-Hawaii sadtong Pebrero 25, 1986.
english: When the protesters stormed Malakanyang, Marcos and his family fled to Hawaii on February 25, 1986.

text: Na-trauma seguro sang martial law, ginakahadlukan man ni Pedro ang pagdalagan ni Presidente Duterte  para Bise Presidente sa sining palaabuton nga eleksyon.
english: Traumatized by martial law, Pedro is also afraid of President Duterte's run for Vice President in the upcoming elections.

text: Nahadlok siya,  sunu sa iya, kon magdaug bilang ikaduha nga pangulo sang pungsod si Duterte.
english: He is afraid, he said, if Duterte wins as the country's second president.

text: Posible kuno makabalik ini sa poder bilang Presidente nga ang authoritarian rule sini wala gid siya sing luyag.
english: He is said to be able to return to power as President whose authoritarian rule he does not like.

text: Basi kuno ipapatay sang iya mga “fanatic” ang presidente nga indi kaugyon ni Duterte agud ibalik siya sa poder by succession bilang Bise Presidente kag ibalik man ang iya authoritarian nga klase sang pangginahum.
english: He said his “fanatics” might kill the president who does not agree with Duterte in order to return him to power by succession as Vice President and restore his authoritarian class of rule.

text: Man nagatakam-takam gid kuno ining mga “fanatic” sa “extrajudicial killings”nga daw mga vampira nga uhaw sa dugo.
english: These fanatics are said to be enjoying extrajudicial killings like bloodthirsty vampires.

text: Daw mga wala man tinun-an nga mga hubog ini sila nga ordinaryo lang sa ila ang binastos nga sugilanon nga luyag pa nila mabatian sang mga kabataan – nga indi sang matarong nga mga ginikanan luyag matun-an nila!
english: They are like uneducated drunks who are used to the obscene stories that children want to hear – which righteous parents do not want them to learn!

text: Ngaa ayhan amo gid ini nga lider ang ila luyag?
english: Why might they really want this leader?

text: Seguro tungod idolo nila ang bandido nga klase sang baganihan.
english: Maybe because they idolize the bandit class of heroes.

text: Ina bala ang wala nagakilala sang kasuguan kundi ang makabalos ukon mapangapinan lang ang kaugalingon kag pamilya sa bisan paano nga paagi.
english: Is it the one who doesn't recognize the law but can only fight back or defend himself and his family in any way.

text: Kawsa man sining bandido nga baganihan ang mga lupig kon diin wala sing otoridad nga nagapangapin sa ila kag kon kis-a kaaway pa nila ining mga otoridad nga kaupod pa sang mga tulisan.
english: This bandit hero is also the cause of the oppressed where there is no authority to protect them and sometimes these authorities are their enemies who are still with the robbers.

text:
Masami man gani patungdan sining bandido ng baganihan ining kaaway sang mga pumuluyo sang iya kaugot paagi sa masingki nga lenggwahe katulad sang “pu…ang ina mo!”

Well, kita mismo nakakilala sining gina-idolo sang madamo sa ila mga pelikula katulad ni Rudy Fernandez, Eddie Garcia, kag iban pa.
english:
This heroic bandit often even directs his anger at this enemy of the people with harsh language such as “pu...ang ina mo!”

Well, we ourselves know this idol of many in their films like Rudy Fernandez, Eddie Garcia, and others.

text: Siling gani sang iban nga ini nga klase sang baganihan ang ginasunod ni Presidente Duterte sa iya mga sugo sa pagpamatay sa mga suspetsado nga ang iban wala gani sing armas ukon luyag lang tani magsungka apang natiruhan patay gihapon sang mga trigger-happy nga mga pulis.
english: Some even say that this kind of hero is followed by President Duterte in his orders to kill suspects who are not even armed or just wanted to surrender but were still shot dead by trigger-happy policemen.

text: Segurado naton nga idolo man sang madamo ta nga pulis si Hollywood star Clint Eastwood sa iya mga pelikula, katulad sang Magnum Force, kon diin naga-play siya bilang judge-and-executioner sang mga kaaway sang kasuguan nga wala niya ginatagaan sing “due process” sunu sa ginasugo sang kasuguan.
english: We are sure that many of our policemen also idolize Hollywood star Clint Eastwood in his films, such as Magnum Force, where he plays as a judge-and-executioner of enemies of the law without giving them due process as required by law.

text: Ti, ano na lang kon wala sing kasuguan?
english: Well, what if there is no law?

text: Masig-patyanay na lang kita sa isa ka “survival of the fittest” nga sitwasyon?
english: Are we just going to kill each other in a “survival of the fittest” situation?

text: Salamat man ugaling nga sa pila sini ka pelikula may naga-play man sang role sang pulis nga matumanon sa kasuguan nga wala ginapasugtan si Detective Harry sa iya malain nga “personal mission”.
english: Thankfully, however, in some of these films there is also a law-abiding policeman who does not allow Detective Harry to go on his evil “personal mission”.

text: Batasan man gani ni Presidente Duterte ang mamuyayaw sang “pu…ang ina mo!” katulad ni Rudy Fernandez sa madamo sini nga pelikula.
english: President Duterte even has a habit of shouting “pu...ang ina mo!” like Rudy Fernandez in many of these films.

text: Pwede lang, ugaling,  matabo ini sa pelikula kag indi sa aktwal nga pang-serbisyo sang aton mga opisyales sa gobyerno kag sang mga kapulisan tungod wala man sing mahalitan aktwal kay pelikula man lang ini.
english: However, this can only happen in the movie and not in the actual service of our government officials and the police because no one is actually harmed because it is just a movie.

text: Luas, of course, sa malain nga leksyon nga matun-an sang mga pumuluyo sa sining mga pelikula nga masami wala sing bawi nga moral lesson bisan sa hingapusan man lang nga bahin sang istorya.
english: Apart, of course, from the bad lessons that the people learn from these films, there is often no moral lesson even at the end of the story.

text: Kon matabo ini nga binandido nga binatasan sa aktwal, siyempre indi pwede ina kag dapat may salabton ang nagahimo sini sa idalom sang aton kasuguan.
english: If this bandido behavior actually happens, of course it is not allowed and the perpetrator should be held accountable under our law.

text: Indi bala?/PN
english: Isn't it?/PN

text: ILOILO CITY-Nakatilaw ka na bala sang karne nga gin-preserve anay sang 15 ka tuig antes makaon?
english: ILOILO CITY-Have you ever tasted meat that was preserved for 15 years before eating?

text: Didto sa may Polmard, isa ka gamay nga farm sa Saint Mihiel, France, naga-produce sila sang ginakabig nga world’s most exclusive meat gamit ang proseso nga ginatawag nga hibernation.
english: There near Polmard, a small farm in Saint Mihiel, France, they produce what is considered the world’s most exclusive meat using a process called hibernation.

text: Buot silingon,ang karne ang taguon sa sulod sang 15 ka tuig nga wala nagakabuhinan ang kalidad sini.
english: This means that the meat will be stored for 15 years without decreasing its quality.

text: Suno kay Alexandre Polmard,isa ka sixth-generation farmer, breeder, kag butcher,ang ila pamilya naga-produce sang amo nga karne humalin sang 1846.
english: According to Alexandre Polmard,a sixth-generation farmer, breeder, and butcher,their family has been producing the meat since 1846.

text: Apang mas nakilala ang ila Negosyo sang 1990s, matapos ang iya lolo kag amay ang nag-imbento sang bag-o kag revolutionary meat treatment nga ila gintawag nga ‘hibernation’.
english: But their business became better known in the 1990s, after his grandfather and father invented a new and revolutionary meat treatment that they called 'hibernation'

text: Ang proseso nagalakip sang pagbutang sang karne sa -43 Celsius suludlan sa ila state-of-the-art laboratory kag ibilin ina sang masobra isa ka dekada nga indi maapektuhan ang ila kalidad.
english: The process involves placing the meat in a -43 Celsius container in their state-of-the-art laboratory and leaving that for more than a decade without affecting their quality.

text: Ang presyo naman sang isa ka kilo sang 15-year-old hibernated rib steak ang yara sa $3,200 ukon kapin P184,000.
english: The price of a kilo of 15-year-old hibernated rib steak is $3,200 or more than P184,000.

text: Kun magtulok ka sa bulan kun kagab-ihon, mabatyagan mo man bala ang madalum nga koneksyon sa kalibutan?
english: When you look at the moon at night, do you feel a deep connection to the world?

text: Suno kay Sadie Bingham, longtime meditator kag clinical social worker in anxiety sa Gig Harbor, Washington, sa Hindu system sang medisina, ginapatihan nga makabulong sa anxiety kag stress sang isa ka indibidwal ang simple nga pagtulok sa bulan.
english: According to Sadie Bingham, longtime meditator and clinical social worker in anxiety in Gig Harbor, Washington, in the Hindu system of medicine, it is believed that a simple gaze at the moon can cure an individual’s anxiety and stress.

text: Pahayag ni Bingham, samtang naga-meditate ang isa ka indibidwal sa bulan, naga-release ang lawas sang melatonin nga nagahatag sang malawig nga relaxation.
english: Bingham said that as an individual meditates on the moon, the body releases melatonin which provides prolonged relaxation.

text: Natukiban man nga ang pagtulok sa bulan ang nagapadugang sang kalipay sang isa ka inibidwal kag masulhay nga disposisyon kag panan-awan.
english: It has also been found that looking at the moon increases an individual's happiness and comfortable disposition and outlook.

text: Magluwas diri, ang masami nga pagtulok sa celestial bodies kaangay sang bulan, ang napamatud-an man nga nagahatag sang masangkad nga emotional awareness, mabaskog nga sense of intuition kag kalidad nga tulog.
english: In addition, frequent gazing at celestial bodies such as the moon, has also been proven to provide enhanced emotional awareness, a strong sense of intuition and quality sleep.

text: Dugang pa ni Bingham, bentaha man ang moon gazing sa mga kababainhan bangud simbolo ang bulan sang masangkad nga fertility.
english: Bingham added that moon gazing is also advantageous for women because the moon is a symbol of high fertility.

text: Nagahanda na si Pinay tennis star Alex Eala para sa potential nga rematch kay Jelena Ostapenko sa Eastbourne Open.
english: Pinay tennis star Alex Eala is preparing for a potential rematch with Jelena Ostapenko at the Eastbourne Open.

text: Ginlutosa ni Eala ang Latvia star sa Miami Open.
english: Eala beat the Latvia star at the Miami Open.

text: Ang nasambit nga rematch ang matapos ginlutos ni Eala si World number 61 Lucia Bronzetti sa score na 6-0, 6-1 sa Round of 16 sang torneo.
english: The rematch came after Eala defeated World number 61 Lucia Bronzetti 6-0, 6-1 in the Round of 16 of the tournament.

text: Makasambuwa ni Eala si Ostapenko kun ini magdaog kay Sonay Kartal sang United Kingdom.
english: Eala will face Ostapenko if she beats Sonay Kartal of the United Kingdom.

text: Ini ang last torneo ni Eala bag-o ang paghampang niya sa Wimbledon.
english: This is Eala's last tournament before playing at Wimbledon.

text: Magalupad man padulong sa Roma si Kalookan Bishop Pablo Virgilio Cardinal David, president sang Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines, sa Huwebes.
english: Kalookan Bishop Pablo Virgilio Cardinal David, president of the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines, will also fly to Rome on Thursday.

text: May kaangtanan ini sa ginalauman nga pagtipon sang mga Cardinals para sa lubong ni Pope Francis.
english: This is related to the expected gathering of Cardinals for the funeral of Pope Francis.

text: Magapatigayon man sila sang general congregations ukon serye sang meetings kag magpreparar para sa eleksyon sang bag-o nga pope.
english: They will also hold general congregations or a series of meetings and prepare for the election of a new pope.

text: Tatlo ka Filipino cardinals ang eligible nga magpartisipar sa papal election: sanday Luis Antonio Tagle, Jose Advincula, kag David.
english: Three Filipino cardinals are eligible to participate in the papal election: Luis Antonio Tagle, Jose Advincula, and David.

text: Ginsaysay ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga manami sa balatyagon nga makatambong sa Regional Development Council (RDC) kaupod ang pinakamataas nga opisyal sang Pilipinas.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas said it was a good feeling to be able to attend the Regional Development Council (RDC) with the highest official of the Philippines.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga lakip sa naistoryahan sa amo nga pagsinapol amo ang Panay-Guimaras-Negros Bridge, Panay River Basin project sa Capiz, Iloilo-Capiz Expressway kag pagpadayon sa konstruksyon sang Jalaur Mega Dam Project.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Treñas said that among the issues discussed during the meeting were the Panay-Guimaras-Negros Bridge, Panay River Basin project in Capiz, Iloilo-Capiz Expressway and the continuation of the construction of the Jalaur Mega Dam Project.

text: Suno kay Treñas, sa masobra 35 ka tuig nga pagserbisyo niya sa syudad, ini ang una nga kahigayonan nga nahatagan sang malawig nga tion agud nga maistoryahan ang mga proyekto kaupod ang presidente sang pungsod.
english: Treñas said in his more than 35 years of service to the city, this is the first time he has been given a long time to discuss projects with the president of the country.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga lakip sa naistoryahan amo ang power supply sa Western Visayas.
english: He also said that among the issues discussed was the power supply in Western Visayas.

text: Nahibaluan nga Pebrero 13, 2025 sang nagpadulong sa Iloilo City si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: It is known that on February 13, 2025, President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. visited Iloilo City.

text: agud pangunahan ang grand rally sang Alyansa para sa Bagong Pilipinas.
english: to lead the grand rally of the Alliance for a New Philippines.

text: Gindala na sa iya katapusan nga destinasyon sa Libingan ng mga Bayani ang National Artist kag Superstar nga si Nora Aunor.
english: National Artist and Superstar Nora Aunor has been taken to her final destination at the Libingan ng mga Bayani.

text: Takna las-12 sang udto kaina sang ginhiwat ang state funeral para sa superstar.
english: The state funeral for the superstar was held at 12 noon yesterday.

text: Nagtaliwan siya sang Abril 16, 2025, sa edad nga 71 anyos.
english: He passed away on April 16, 2025, at the age of 71 years.

text: Bilang isa ka National Artist, ginhatagan siya sang state funeral nga ginhiwat sa Metropolitan Theatre sa Manila antes ang iya katapusan nga palahuwayan.
english: As a National Artist, he was given a state funeral held at the Metropolitan Theater in Manila before his final resting place.

text: Madamo nga mga fans ang nagtambong sa necrological services sa paghatag sang pasidungog sa iya hamili nga mga kontribusyon sa sining kag pelikula.
english: Many fans attended necrological services to pay tribute to his invaluable contributions to art and film.

text: Sanday Lotlot kag Ian de Leon, naghatag sang emosyonal nga pagpasidungog sa ila iloy, nga nadumduman bilang isa ka kapawa nga indi gid madula.
english: Lotlot and Ian de Leon, paid an emotional tribute to their mother, who was remembered as a light that will never go out.

text: Ang iya mga pelikula pareho sang “Himala” kag “Bona” ginpaguwa liwat bilang kabahin sang pagdumdom sang iya legasiya.
english: His films like “Himala” and “Bona” have been re-released as part of commemorating his legacy.

text: Ang iya pagtaliwan nagdala sang daku nga kasubo sa industriya sang pelikula, apang ang iya arte magapabilin nga buhi sa tagipusuon sang iya mga tagasuporta.
english: His passing brought great sadness to the film industry, but his art will live on in the hearts of his supporters.

text: ILOILO CITY – Opisyal na nga gin-proclaim bilang hari si Charles III pinaagi sa isa ka seremonya nga may trumpet fanfare kag gun salutes kasunod sang kamatayon ni Queen Elizabeth II.
english: ILOILO CITY – Charles III was officially proclaimed king through a ceremony with trumpet fanfare and gun salutes following the death of Queen Elizabeth II.

text: Sa nangin speech sang hari, ginpangako niya nga mangin kaangay siya sang iya nga iloy kag magaserbe tubtob nga buhi ini.
english: In the king's speech, he promised to be like his mother and serve her as long as she lived.

text: Isa ka court official ang nag-declare sa bag-o nga hari bilang lawful kag rightful monarch nagikan sa balkonahe sang St James’s Palace matapos ang historic nga Accession Council meeting sang senior royals, clergy kag sang gobyerno.
english: A court official declared the new king as lawful and rightful monarch from the balcony of St James's Palace after the historic Accession Council meeting of senior royals, clergy and the government.

text: Ang century-old tradition sang council ang gin-televise sa pinakauna nga tion sang gin-anunsiyo na ang 73- anyos nga si Charles bilang monarch.
english: The century-old tradition of the council was televised for the first time when 73- year-old Charles was announced as monarch.

text: Suno sa hari, nakahibalo siya sang iya duties kag tuman ka bug-at nga mga responsibilidad.
english: The king said he was aware of his duties and very heavy responsibilities.

text: Dugang pa niya, sa pagbaton niya sang responsibilidad, tinguhaan niya nga mangin ehemplo.
english: He added that upon taking on the responsibility, he will strive to lead by example.

text: Sa proclamation, walo ka mga trumpeters ang nag-upod nga ginsundan sang exciting nga paghugyaw para sa bag-o nga hari nagikan sa mga Coldstream Guards soldiers.
english: At the proclamation, eight trumpeters joined in followed by an exciting cheer for the new king from the Coldstream Guards soldiers.

text: May yara man sang ceremonial kag simultaneous nga gun salutes sa bilog nga United Kingdom.
english: There will also be ceremonial and simultaneous gun salutes across the United Kingdom.

text: Gin-ako ni Punong Barangay Madonna Martin sang Barangay Concepcion, Iloilo City Proper nga siya mismo ang nagsugo nga magbutang sang karatula nga nakasab-it sa wala matapos nga multipurpose gym sang ila barangay.
english: Punong Barangay Madonna Martin of Barangay Concepcion, Iloilo City Proper admitted that she personally ordered the installation of the sign hanging on the unfinished multipurpose gym of their barangay.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Martin, iya ginpahayag nga 2021 sang ginsugod tukod ang proyekto kon sa diin may tatlo ini ka panalgan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Martin said the construction of the three-storey project began in 2021.

text: Ginlaragway man sang pila ka mga residente ang proyekto nga daw kaangay nga bodega bangud wala matandog kag wala natapos-tapos.
english: Some residents also described the project as being like a warehouse because it was untouched and unfinished.

text: Ginapahayag nga masobra duha na ka tuig nga wala nagamit ang multipurpose gym ilabi na kon may mga aktibidad kaangay sang sport events.
english: The multipurpose gym has reportedly not been used for more than two years especially during activities such as sporting events.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga intensyon lamang niya nga matutokan kag mahatagan sang igtalupangod ang proyekto ni Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam-jam” Baronda.
english: He also explained that his intention is to focus and give attention to the project of Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam-jam” Baronda.

text: Suno kay Martin, nagabalor sang P40 million ang amo nga proyekto.
english: According to Martin, the project is worth P40 million.

text: Nagalaum man ini nga masabat ang ila concern agud nga matapos na ang multipurpose hall.
english: He also hopes that their concern will be addressed so that the multipurpose hall can be completed.

text: Gin-istorya ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas si Mr. JV Mabilog nga Assistant Head sang Public Order and Safety Management Office may kaangtanan sa ginapasuni nagagwa nga misinformation.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas spoke to Mr. JV Mabilog, Assistant Head of the Public Order and Safety Management Office, regarding the alleged misinformation.

text: Ini nahanungod sa ginpahayag ni Former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog nga utang sang syudad para sa pagkaayo sang mga public markets.
english: This is regarding what Former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog said the city owes for the repair of public markets.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga gusto niya man lang man nga insakto ang mga impormasyon nga nagaguwa sa publiko.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Treñas said he wants the information that comes out to the public to be accurate.

text: Suno sa alkalde, bukas sa publiko ang mga dokumento sang syudad nga makapamatuod nga wala sang kamatuoran nga ₱3.3 billion ang gin-utang sang Iloilo City Government para lang sa merkado.
english: The mayor said the city's documents are open to the public to prove that there is no truth that the Iloilo City Government borrowed ₱3.3 billion just for the market.

text: Para sa natungdan, indi manami nga magdala-dala sang kabutigan agud makabalik sa ambisyon sini nga makapungko sa Iloilo City Hall.
english: For the concerned, it is not good to carry lies in order to return to his ambition to sit in Iloilo City Hall.

text: Gintumod man ni Treñas nga hayag sa publiko ang pag-utang, bidding, kag bisan ang dokumento nga nagapakita sang proseso sa pag-utang sang syudad kon may proyekto.
english: Treñas also pointed out that the borrowing, bidding, and even the document that shows the city's borrowing process when there is a project is open to the public.

text: Nag-abot sa Taiwan ang grupo sang lawmakers halin sa Estados Unidos kag sa France.
english: A group of lawmakers from the United States and France arrived in Taiwan.

text: Wala gin-anunsyo sang Estados Unidos ang pagpadala sini sang walo ka lawmakers nga ginpanganuhan ni Stephanie Murphy, isa ka Democrat halin sa Florida nga nagapungko sa House Armed Services Committee.
english: The United States did not announce its deployment of eight lawmakers led by Stephanie Murphy, a Democrat from Florida who sits on the House Armed Services Committee.

text: Magatinir ang delegasyon sang Amerika tubtub sa Byernes.
english: The American delegation will stay until Friday.

text: Suno sa foreign ministry sang Taiwan, magapakigkita sila kay President Tsai Ing-wen samtang yara sila sa isla.
english: According to Taiwan’s foreign ministry, they will meet with President Tsai Ing-wen while they are on the island.

text: Magluwas sa US lawmakers, may lima man ka French lawmakers nga nag-abot sa Taipei nga amo ang first high-level European delegation halin sang nag-ibwal ang kaakig sang China bangud sa pagbisita ni US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: In addition to the US lawmakers, five French lawmakers have also arrived in Taipei, the first high-level European delegation since China sparked anger over a visit by US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi last month.

text: Sa kaakig sang China, nagpadala ini sang warships, missiles, kag fighter jets sa palibot sang Taiwan bilang pagpakita sang pagpamatok sang presensya ni Pelosi.
english: Infuriated, China sent warships, missiles, and fighter jets around Taiwan in a show of opposition to Pelosi’s presence.

text: Ang ginhimo sang China ang ginakabig pinaka-agresibo sini nga exercises halin sang mid-1990s.
english: What China has done is considered its most aggressive exercises since the mid-1990s.

text: Nakatalana nga papanaogan sang warrant of arrest si Iloilo Public Information and Communications Affairs Office (PICAO) Head Mr. Nereo Lujan may kaangtanan sa tatlo ka counts sang cyber libel nga ginpasaka ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas.
english: Iloilo Public Information and Communications Affairs Office (PICAO) Head Mr. Nereo Lujan in connection with three counts of cyber libel filed by Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ang warrant of arrest ang nagaangot kay Lujan sa naguwa nga resolution sang Iloilo City Prosecutor’s Office kon sa diin, nakitaan nila sang malisya ang tatlo ka mga posts ni Lujan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Treñas said the warrant of arrest links Lujan to the resolution issued by the Iloilo City Prosecutor's Office where they found malice in Lujan's three posts.

text: Suno kay Treñas, may intension si Lujan nga pakahuy-an siya paagi sa mga posts sini sa social media.
english: According to Treñas, Lujan intended to embarrass him through his posts on social media.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga nagdugang siya sang walo ka counts sang kapareho nga kaso batok sa Iloilo Public Information and Communications Affairs Office Head.
english: He also said he added eight counts of the same case against the Iloilo Public Information and Communications Affairs Office Head.

text: Gin-athag man ni Treñas nga wala gid siya kaagi nga nagpasaka sang kaso batok sa mga media apisar sang mga akusasyon batok sa iya.
english: Treñas also clarified that he has never filed a case against the media despite the accusations against him.

text: Wala man sini ginakabig nga media si Lujan apang para sa iya, indi maayo nga representasyon sa media ang ginhimo ni Lujan.
english: He did not consider Lujan as a media but for him, Lujan did not represent the media well.

text: Nahibaluan nga una na nga nagpasaka sang 12 counts sang cyber libel si Treñas batok kay Lujan, kon sa diin, sa subong nakitaan ang tatlo sang grounds agud padayunon ang kaso.
english: Treñas has already filed 12 counts of cyber libel against Lujan, of which three have now been found grounds to continue the case.

text: Nagtukod ang Philippine National Police (PNP) sang duha ka specialized committees — ang anti-kidnapping kag ang anti-fake news.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) has set up two specialized committees — anti-kidnapping and anti-fake news.

text: Ang Joint Anti-Kidnapping Committee (JAKAC) amo ang magatutok sa pag-identify, pag-imbestigar, kag pagdakop sa organisado nga kidnap-for-hire operations diri sa pungsod.
english: The Joint Anti-Kidnapping Committee (JAKAC) will focus on identifying, investigating, and arresting organized kidnap-for-hire operations in the country.

text: Gin-establisar ini kasunod sang pag-kidnap kag pagpatay sa Filipino-Chinese businessman nga si Anson Que kag iya driver nga siArmanie Pabillo.
english: It was established following the kidnapping and murder of Filipino-Chinese businessman Anson Que and his driver Armanie Pabillo.

text: Tatlo ka mga suspek ang yara na sa kustodiya sang mga pulis, samtang ginalagas pa kun sin-o ang mastermind sa likod sang kidnapping kag murder.
english: Three suspects are now in police custody, while the mastermind behind the kidnapping and murder is still being pursued.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ang Joint Anti-Fake News Action Committee (JAFNAC) amo naman ang ginalantaw nga magatapna sang misinformation kag disinformation.
english: On the other hand, the Joint Anti-Fake News Action Committee (JAFNAC) is expected to curb misinformation and disinformation.

text: Ginakabig ini sang awtoridad nga isa man ka moderno nga pamahog bangud mahimo sini maguba ang pagsalig sang publiko, ang kalinong sa komunidad, kag mangin ang pagka-estable sang pungsod.
english: The authority considers it also a modern threat because it can destroy public trust, community peace, and even the stability of the country.

text: Gintukod ini nga task force kasunod sang unverified reports nga nagalapta online kun sa diin ginaalegar nga may kidnappings sang prominente nga mga negosyante.
english: The task force was formed following unverified reports circulating online alleging kidnappings of prominent businessmen.

text: Tuyo sang committee nga makahimo sang coordination, monitoring, kag response strategies agud matapna ang sala nga mga impormasyon sa nagkalain-lain nga social media platforms.
english: The committee aims to develop coordination, monitoring, and response strategies to prevent misinformation on various social media platforms.

text: “Fake news is not harmless—it can incite fear, panic, and even unrest.
english: “Fake news is not harmless—it can incite fear, panic, and even unrest.

text: Under Bagong Pilipinas, we are taking a firm stand.
english: Under Bagong Pilipinas, we are taking a firm stand.

text: WE will not allow deception to dictate the public narrative,” suno kay General Rommel Marbil, chief sang PNP.
english: WE will not allow deception to dictate the public narrative,” said General Rommel Marbil, chief of the PNP.

text: “These committees are not just organizational measures— they are proactive responses to modern-day threats.
english: “These committees are not just organizational measures— they are proactive responses to modern-day threats.

text: From kidnap-for-hire syndicates to digital disinformation campaigns, the PNP is moving decisively to protect our people.”
english: From kidnap-for-hire syndicates to digital disinformation campaigns, the PNP is moving decisively to protect our people.”

text: Attention, motorists!
english: Attention, motorists!

text: An oil price hike will take effect tomorrow, February 18, 2025.
english: An oil price hike will take effect tomorrow, February 18, 2025.

text:
According to oil industry sources, fuel prices will increase as follows:

Motorists are advised to refuel before the price adjustment takes effect.
english:
According to oil industry sources, fuel prices will increase as follows:

Motorists are advised to refuel before the price adjustment takes effect.

text: Nagsaka na sa siyam ang numero sang patay kasunod sang pagkalugdang sang barko nga MV Hong Hai 16 sa Rizal, Occidental Mindoro.
english: The death toll has risen to nine following the capsizing of the MV Hong Hai 16 in Rizal, Occidental Mindoro.

text: Ini matapos ang dugang nga mga bangkay nga na-recover sa nagligad nga Lenten break lakip na ang duha kahapon, Easter Sunday.
english: This comes after more bodies were recovered during the last Lenten break including two yesterday, Easter Sunday.

text: Suno kay Lt Jr.
english: According to Lt. Jr.

text: Grade Kenneth Bongabong, PCG Occidental Mindoro Station Commander, duha pa ka missing mga indibidwal ang ila padayon nga ginapangita.
english: Grade Kenneth Bongabong, PCG Occidental Mindoro Station Commander, two more missing individuals are still being sought.

text: 25 crew members ang sakay sang barko kun sa diin 13 ang mga Pinoy kag 12 ang Chinese nationals sang natabo ang insidente sang nagligad nga Martes Santo.
english: The ship was carrying 25 crew members, 13 Filipinos and 12 Chinese nationals, when the incident occurred last Holy Tuesday.

text: Matandaan nga sa mga napatay, isa ang kumpirmado nga taga-Leon, Iloilo nga amo si Mark Dave Calopez, 23 anyos, nga isa ka apprentice sa barko.
english: One of the dead was confirmed to be from Leon, Iloilo, Mark Dave Calopez, 23, an apprentice on the ship.

text: Una naman nga nagkumpirma ang provincial government sang Occidental Mindoro nga samtang padayon ang imbestigasyon sa natabo, pauntaton anay sini ang operasyon sang Bluemax Tradelink, Inc.
english: Earlier, the provincial government of Occidental Mindoro confirmed that while the investigation into the incident is ongoing, it will suspend the operation of Bluemax Tradelink, Inc.

text: nga amo ang kumpaniya sa likod sang dredging sa Lumintao River.
english: which is the company behind the dredging in the Lumintao River.

text: Subong nga adlaw natalana nga ipaguwa ang cease-and-desist order sa Bluemax.
english: A cease-and-desist order on Bluemax is scheduled to be issued today.

text: Ginmanduan man ang tag-iya sang barko nga Keen Peak Corp.
english: The ship’s owner, Keen Peak Corp., was also ordered to do so.

text: nga kuhaon na ang MV Hong Hai 16 sa area nga gintabuan sang insidente.
english: to remove MV Hong Hai 16 from the area where the incident occurred.

text:
[Warning: Ini nga balita ang nagaunod sang sensitibo nga mga detalye.]

Makaluluoy ang nadangtan sang isa ka bag-o ginbun-ag nga lapsag nga ginkaon sang mag-iloy nga ido sa Minglanilla, Cebu.
english:
[Warning: This news story contains sensitive details.]

A newborn baby was eaten by a mother dog in Minglanilla, Cebu.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, una nga nakit-an ang utod nga ulo sang lapsag nga ginaangkab sang totoy.
english: According to the investigation, the baby's broken head was first found being carried by the breast.

text: Sunod naman nga nakit-an ang lawas sini nga ginakaon sang iloy nga ido.
english: His body was later found being eaten by a mother dog.

text: Nakit-an man sa kahilamunan ang duster kag apron nga madamo sang dugo nga posible nga gin-gamit sa pagputos sa lapsag.
english: Also found in the grass were a duster and an apron with a lot of blood possibly used to wrap the baby.

text: Ginahibalo pa kun buhi pa ang lapsag ukon patay na sang gin-angkab ini sang mag-iloy nga ido.
english: It is still unknown whether the baby was still alive or dead when he was bitten by the mother dog.

text: WALA salig si Presidente Duterte sa ikasarang sang iya anak nga si Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio agud mangin Presidente sang pungsod.
english: PRESIDENT DUTERTE does not trust the ability of his daughter, Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio, to become President of the country.

text: Ginpahayag niya ini mismo sa nagalagaw nga sugilanon nga ginatulod sang pila ka kapartido nga padalaganon sa pagka-Presidente ini tal-os sa iya amay nga matapos na ang termino sa Hunyo 2022.
english: He said this himself in the circulating rumor that some party members are pushing him to run for President after his father whose term ends in June 2022.

text: “Indi palanublion ang pagka-Presidente,” siling gani ni Manila City Mayor Isko Moreno.
english: “The Presidency is not hereditary,” said Manila City Mayor Isko Moreno.

text: In fact, upod lang ini sa balatyagon sang mga pumuluyo nga indi luyag himuon nga palanublion ang pinakamataas nga pwesto sa gobyerno,  ukon ang pagka-Presidente, sang pungsod mismo sa pagkatapos sang termino sang amay ukon iloy nga Presidente.
english: In fact, this is only in line with the feelings of the people who do not want to inherit the highest position in government, or the Presidency, of the country itself after the term of the father or mother President.

text: Wala gani ginpahanugutan sadto ni Presidente Cory nga ipanubli ang iya pagka-Presidente sa iya anak pagkatapos sang iya termino.
english: President Cory did not even allow his son to pass on his Presidency after his term.

text: Wala man ini gintugot sang iban naton nga mga Presidente halin kay Roxas tubtub sa kay Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo.
english: Other Presidents from Roxas to Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo have not allowed this.

text:
***

Kon gin-aku ni President Duterte nga wala sing ikasarang agud mag-Presidente ang anak niya nga si Sara, ina tungod kilala gid niya ining iya anak nga babaye.
english:
***

If President Duterte admits that his daughter Sara is not capable of becoming President, it is because he knows her daughter very well.

text: Hambalon pa, President Duterte knows better kon ano lang ang masarangan ni Sara.
english: In other words, President Duterte knows better what Sara can do.

text: Tubtub lang seguro mangin mayor sang Davao City nga isa ka diutay nga lugar nga may diutay man nga problema.
english: Maybe until he becomes mayor of Davao City, a small place with few problems.

text: Wala ugaling naluyagan sang mga kababaenhan sa ila advocaciya sa Women Power nga kinahanglan pa dalahigon ni Presidente Duterte ang iban nga kababaehan, samtang indi man ang tanan nga kababehan wala sing ikasarang para sa kasubong nga kabug-at nga responsibilidad.
english: However, the women in their advocacy of Women Power did not like that President Duterte had to involve other women, while not all women are not capable of such a heavy responsibility.

text: In fact, madamo nga kababehan ang ginasaligan kag padayon nga ginasaligan sang ila mga pumuluyo sa madamo man gani nga pungsod.
english: In fact, many women are trusted and continue to be trusted by their people in many countries.

text: Kon indi presidente, prime minister, ukon ano pa dira nga titulo ang pagkilala nila sa ila lider.
english: If not president, prime minister, or whatever title they recognize their leader.

text: Kon indi si Sara makasarang, ti siya lang kag indi ilakip pa ang iban nga babaye nga napamatud-an bisan pa gani sang mga dalagku nga pungsod nga makasarang, katulad sang United Kingdom kag iban pa, siling gani nila.
english: If Sara can't do it, then she's the only one and not including other women who have been proven even by big countries to do it, like the United Kingdom and others, they said.

text:
“Okey, may kahuyang ang babae, pero sa pisikal lang seguro nga ikasarang,”siling nila, “In fact, ang kinahanglan sang isa ka lider amo lang ang ikasarang sa kinaalam kag ihibalo nga pwede man matun-an kag mahibal-an sa experyensya nga wala sing kinalis sa mga lalake.”

Indi man kuno problema ang kahumok sang balatyagon sang isa ka babaye.
english:
“Okay, women have weaknesses, but probably only in physical ability,” they said, “In fact, all a leader needs is the ability in wisdom and knowledge that can also be learned and known through experience that is no different from men.”

The softness of a woman's feelings is not a problem.

text: Bentaha pa gani ini sa aton pagkilala sa babaye sa iya pagka-matatapon sa mga anak.
english: It is even an advantage for us to recognize the woman for her care for her children.

text: Indi katulad ini kay Presidente Duterte nga wala sing kaluoy sa pagsugo nga pamatyon ang mga nakasala sa pasalig nga wala sila sing salabton kay akuon niya ini tungod sa iya “immunity” sa mga akusasyon samtang Presidente.
english: This is not like President Duterte who ruthlessly ordered the execution of the perpetrators with the assurance that they were not responsible because he would accept it because of his “immunity” from accusations while President.

text: Nagtulod ini sa pila ka kapulisan agud mangin “trigger-happy” sa diutay lang nga hulag sang mga suspetsado kag wala sing “due process” nga ginapatuman ang ila gutgut sa kay kon sin-o man nga may personal sila nga kaakig.
english: This has led some police officers to become “trigger-happy” with the slightest movement of the suspects and no “due process” to enforce their anger against anyone they have a personal grudge against.

text: Indi tani dapat matabo ini sa aton Demokrasya tungod “government of laws” kita – indi “government of men” – kon diin may igwal nga kinamatarong ang tanan sa “due process” tubtub mahusgaran gid sing husto.
english: This should not happen in our democracy because we are a “government of laws” – not a “government of men” – where everyone has the right to due process until they are judged fairly.

text: Remember nga bisan ang Roman Empire, nga sadto pinakagamhanan sa tanan nga pungsod, natumba tungod sa kapintas sini nga nagtulod sa mga pumuluyo sa pag-ribok kag magdaug gamit lang ang Kristohanon nga gugma kag ang kahandaan nga mapatay (martyrdom) sa hinganiban sang mapintas nga mga hangaway Romano.
english: Remember that even the Roman Empire, once the most powerful of all nations, fell because of its cruelty that led the people to revolt and win using only Christian love and the willingness to die (martyrdom) in the weapons of the cruel Roman armies.

text: In other words, indi mo madala ang mga pumuluyo sa pirme nga pamahog kag pamintas agud mapasunod sa salsalon nga kamot sang gobyerno sa luyag lang sini, kundi sa pagkilala sa ila kinamatarong sa ila makatawo nga balatyagon, kinahanglan nga hustisya, kinamatarong sa pagpanibag-o sang kabuhi, kag ang pag-ulikid sa ila kinahanglanon nga wala sing pinilian.
english: In other words, you cannot bring citizens to constant threats and oppression to submit to the iron hand of government at will, but to recognize their right to their human feelings, the need for justice, the right to renew life, and the care for their needs without discrimination.

text: Kag remember nga kon may tion man nga kinahanglan ang matig-a nga kamot agud mapaluntad ang kalinong, indi ini dapat magdugay kay madale matak-an ang tawo sa madugay nga pagdula sang ila kahilwayan.
english: And remember that if there is a time when a hard hand is needed to maintain peace, it should not last long because people can easily get tired of the long-term loss of their freedom.

text: Natural sa tawo ang mabuhi nga hilway sa katalunan, sa kapatagan kag bisan sa pakig-salamuha sa kapareho.
english: It is natural for man to live freely in the wild, in the plains and even in the company of others.

text: Ang madugay nga paglupig sining natural nga kinamatarong, nga natun-an ta sa kasaysayan sang kalibutan, nagabunga sing pag-ribok, nga ginahalinan sang pagkatumba sang bisan sang pinakagamhanan nga gobyerno.
english: The long-term suppression of this natural right, as we learn from world history, results in rebellion, which is the source of the overthrow of even the most powerful government.

text: Dapat tandaan naton ina!/PN
english: We should remember that!/PN

text: Magaatubang sa Pre-Trial Chamber I sang International Criminal Court (ICC) si former President Rodrigo Duterte para sa iya una nga hearing subong nga Marso 14, Biyernes, alas-2 sang hapon Central European Time (CET) ukon (alas-9 sang gab-i sa oras sa Pilipinas).
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte will appear before the Pre-Trial Chamber I of the International Criminal Court (ICC) for his first hearing this March 14, Friday, at 2 pm Central European Time (CET) or (9 pm Philippine time).

text: Pangunahan ang hearing nanday Judge Iulia Antoanella Motoc (Romania), kaupod sanday Judge Reine Adélaïde Sophie Alapini-Gansou (Benin) kag Judge María del Socorro Flores Liera (Mexico).
english: The hearing will be presided over by Judge Iulia Antoanella Motoc (Romania), alongside Judge Reine Adélaïde Sophie Alapini-Gansou (Benin) and Judge María del Socorro Flores Liera (Mexico).

text: Diri kag ipahibalo kay Duterte ang mga kaso nga ginpasaka sa iya, ang iya kinamatarong bilang akusado kag ang schedule sang mga masunod nga mga hearing.
english: Here, Duterte will be informed of the cases filed against him, his rights as an accused and the schedule of the next hearings.
