text: Nagpreparar ang Oklahoma City sang daku nga selebrasyon kasunod sang pagbulsa sang Thunder sang kampyonato sa 2025 NBA Finals.
english: Oklahoma City prepared for a big celebration following the Thunder pocketing the championship in the 2025 NBA Finals.

text: Kahapon, Hunyo 23, ginlutos sang OKC ang Pacers sa Game 7 sa score nga 103-91 nga amo ang naghatag sa Oklahoma City sang labing-una nga kahigayunan nga mahakwat ang Larry O’Brien championship trophy.
english: Yesterday, June 23, OKC beat the Pacers in Game 7 with a score of 103-91 which gave Oklahoma City its first chance to lift the Larry O'Brien championship trophy.

text: Buwas, 11:30 sa aga, oras sa amo nga syudad, may yara sang masobra isa ka oras nga parada nga pagasundan sang pagtilipon sa sulod sang ila home court nga Paycom Center kag closing program sa Scissortail Park.
english: Tomorrow, at 11:30 am local time, there will be an hour-long parade followed by a gathering inside their home court Paycom Center and a closing program at Scissortail Park.

text: Pagpalawig pa ini sang selebrasyon matapos nga nasaksihan sang masobra 18,000 ka fans kahapon ang maragtason nga kampyonato sa pagpanguna sang superstar nga si Shai Gilgeous-Alexander nga may 30.3 points, 4.6 rebounds, 5.6 assists, 1.9 steals kag 1.8 blocks sa bilog nga Finals.
english: This is an extension of the celebration after more than 18,000 fans witnessed the historic championship yesterday led by superstar Shai Gilgeous-Alexander with 30.3 points, 4.6 rebounds, 5.6 assists, 1.9 steals and 1.8 blocks throughout the Finals.

text: Si SGA ang 11th player sa NBA history nga nagdaog bilang league MVP, kampyon sa NBA Finals kag Finals MVP.
english: SGA is the 11th player in NBA history to win league MVP, NBA Finals champion and Finals MVP.

text: 𝗕𝗥𝗔𝗭𝗜𝗟 — Kon masami, aton mabatian nga tawo lamang ang nagapositibo sa paggamit sang iligal nga druga.
english: 𝗕𝗥𝗔𝗭𝗜𝗟 — Often, we hear that only humans test positive for illegal drug use.

text: Apang, sa isa ka tumalagsahon nga tion, nagpositibo sa cocaine ang mga pating sa baybayon sang Brazil.
english: However, in an unusual moment, sharks off the coast of Brazil tested positive for cocaine.

text: Madugay na nga nagahambal ang mga manugpanalawsaw nga ang kabuhi sa dagat mahimo maapektuhan sang mga droga nga ginhaboy sa tubig sang mga smuggler, nga may tonelada sang cocaine nga makita sa palibot sang Florida, South and Central America.
english: Researchers have long argued that marine life could be affected by drugs dumped into the water by smugglers, with tons of cocaine found around Florida, South and Central America.

text: Ang isa ka pagtuon gikan sa Oswaldo Cruz Foundation sa Brazil nakasapo karon sang ebidensya nga ang mga pating sa pagkamatuod apektado sang mga droga nga nagahigko sang kadagatan.
english: A study from the Oswaldo Cruz Foundation in Brazil has now found evidence that sharks are in fact affected by drugs polluting the ocean.

text: Gin-usisa sang mga siyentipiko ang 13 ka wild nga Brazilian sharpnose sharks nga ginbakal gikan sa magagmay nga mga sakayan sa pagpangisda, bangud ang mga species nag-uyang sang ila bug-os nga kabuh sa baybayon kag posible nga maapektuhan sang polusyon.
english: The scientists examined 13 wild Brazilian sharpnose sharks purchased from small fishing boats, as the species have spent their entire lives offshore and are likely to be affected by pollution.

text: Gin-test ang muscle kag liver tissue gamit ang isa ka sulundan nga teknik nga ginatawag liquid chromatography nga may tandem mass spectrometry – sa diin ang mga molekula ginapain sa isa ka likido – sa pagpangita sang cocaine kag benzoylecgonine, ang panguna nga metabolite sa bulong.
english: Muscle and liver tissue were tested using a standard technique called liquid chromatography with tandem mass spectrometry – where molecules are separated in a liquid – to look for cocaine and benzoylecgonine, the main metabolite in the drug.

text: Natukiban nga ang tanan nga 13 ka mga pating ang positibo sa cocaine, nga may konsentrasyon nga 100 ka pilo nga mas mataas sangsa ginreport sang una para sa iban nga mga tinuga sa tubig.
english: It turned out that all 13 sharks tested positive for cocaine, with concentrations 100 times higher than previously reported for other aquatic creatures.

text: Ini ang una nga pagtuon sa pagpangita sang presensya sang cocaine sa mga free-range shark, kag natukiban nga ang substance mas lapnag sa tissue sang kaunuran sangsa mga atay sang pating.
english: This is the first study to find the presence of cocaine in free-range sharks, and found that the substance is more prevalent in muscle tissue than in shark livers.

text: Apang, ang pagtuon nagsiling nga ang patag sang pagpanalawsaw “tuman ka limitado” kag ang epekto sang cocaine sa kabuhi sa tubig indi pa bug-os nga nahibal-an.
english: However, the study said the field of research is “very limited” and the impact of cocaine on aquatic life is not yet fully known.

text: Ang panalawsaw ginbalhag sa outlet nga Science of the Total Environment.
english: The research was published in the outlet Science of the Total Environment.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang Hunyo sang nagligad nga tuig, ang US Coast Guard nakakuha sang masobra 14,100 pounds (6,400 kg) sang cocaine sa Caribbean Sea kag Atlantic Ocean, nga may ginabanta nga balor nga $186 million ukon malapit P11 billion.
english: It is known that in June last year, the US Coast Guard seized more than 14,100 pounds (6,400 kg) of cocaine in the Caribbean Sea and Atlantic Ocean, with an estimated value of $186 million or nearly P11 billion.

text: Wala na nag-develop bilang Tropical Depression ang Low Pressure Area nga nauna nga na-monitor sa gwa sang Philippine Area of Responsibility.
english: The Low Pressure Area, which was previously monitored outside the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility, has not developed into a Tropical Depression.

text: Ang Shear Line ang nagaapekto sa eastern section sang Northern Luzon.
english: The Shear Line affects the eastern section of Northern Luzon.

text: Ang Shear Line ang isa ka linya ukon makitid nga lugar sa diin may gulpi nga pagbag-o sa direksyon sang hangin.
english: A Shear Line is a line or narrow area where there is a sudden change in the direction of the wind.

text: Bangud sa pagbunggu-anay ukon convergence sang hangin, nagaluntad ang masami nga pagpangilat ukon mga pag-ulan sa shear line.
english: Due to wind collision or convergence, frequent lightning or showers occur along the shear line.

text: Ang Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) ang nagaapekto naman sa Southern Mindanao.
english: The Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) is affecting Southern Mindanao.

text: Ang ITCZ amo ang ang lugar sa diin ang hangin sang Northern Hemisphere kag Southern Hemisphere ay nagakit-anay kag nagaresulta sang malain nga panahon kaangay sang Low Pressure Area kag Bagyo.
english: The ITCZ ​​is the area where the Northern Hemisphere and Southern Hemisphere winds meet and result in bad weather such as Low Pressure Areas and Typhoons.

text: Nahilway na ang walo ka Filipino seafarers nga gin-detain sa Malaysia sa sulod sang isa ka semana bangud sa ginaalegar nga paglapas sa layi sa immigration.
english: Eight Filipino seafarers who were detained in Malaysia for a week for alleged violations of immigration laws have been released.

text: Suno sa Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), gin-release sila subong nga adlaw, Abril 18, kasunod sang desisyon sang Prosecutor’s Office sa Johor.
english: According to the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), they were released today, April 18, following the decision of the Prosecutor’s Office in Johor.

text: “Following yesterday’s welfare visit and today’s decision of the Prosecutor’s Office in Johor, the eight  Filipino crew members of vessel MT Krishna 1 detained in Kota Tinggi have been released today, 18 April 2025,” sandig sa ahensya.
english: “Following yesterday’s welfare visit and today’s decision of the Prosecutor’s Office in Johor, the eight  Filipino crew members of vessel MT Krishna 1 detained in Kota Tinggi have been released today, 18 April 2025,” the agency said.

text: Kaangot diri, gina-proseso na sang DMW, Migrant Workers Office, kag Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) in Kuala Lumpur ang insigida nga repatriation.
english: In this regard, the DMW, Migrant Workers Office, and Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) in Kuala Lumpur are already processing the immediate repatriation.

text: Nagpakig-angot naman ang department sa mga pamilya sang seafarers kag ginsigurado sila kaangot sa safety sang mga involved.
english: The department has contacted the families of the seafarers and assured them of the safety of those involved.

text: Ini nga walo ka Pinoy ang sakay sang MT Krishna 1 kaupod ang 12 ka Indian crew members sang gin-detain sila sang Royal Malaysian Police sa Kota Tinggi Police District Headquarters sa Johor, Malaysia sang nagligad nga Abril 11.
english: The eight Filipinos were on board the MT Krishna 1 along with 12 Indian crew members when they were detained by the Royal Malaysian Police at the Kota Tinggi Police District Headquarters in Johor, Malaysia last April 11.

text: Ang gin-cite nga violation amo ang pagsulod sa Malaysia nga wala sang passports kag wala sang valid documents.
english: The cited violation was entering Malaysia without passports and without valid documents.

text: “Upon learning of the arrest, MWO-OWWA Malaysia immediately coordinated with Kota Tinggi police authorities to ensure the welfare and well-being of the seafarers, and communicated with the concerned Licensed Manning Agency (LMA) and principal for their cooperation during the police investigation,” kabahin pa sang press release sang DMW.
english: “Upon learning of the arrest, MWO-OWWA Malaysia immediately coordinated with Kota Tinggi police authorities to ensure the welfare and well-being of the seafarers, and communicated with the concerned Licensed Manning Agency (LMA) and principal for their cooperation during the police investigation,” the DMW said in a press release.

text:
“The LMA, meanwhile, of the 8 Filipino seafarers assured the continued payment of salaries and benefits to the seafarers and their families.”

Ginpasalig man nga may ihatag nga nagakaigo nga assistance paagi sa AKSYON Fund.
english:
“The LMA, meanwhile, of the 8 Filipino seafarers assured the continued payment of salaries and benefits to the seafarers and their families.”

He also assured that appropriate assistance will be provided through the AKSYON Fund.

text: Ini nga programa amo ang kumprehensibo nga support system sa overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) nga ginahatag sang ahensya lakip ang financial aid, legal assistance, medical assistance, kag iban pa.
english: This program is a comprehensive support system to overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) provided by the agency including financial aid, legal assistance, medical assistance, and others.

text: Matapos ang 50 ka tuig nga serbisyo sa gobyerno, manaog na sa pwesto sa Disyembre si Dr. Anthony Fauci, ang longtime director sang US National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) kag ang chief medical adviser ni US President Joe Biden.
english: After 50 years of government service, Dr. Anthony Fauci, the longtime director of the US National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) and the chief medical adviser to US President Joe Biden.

text: Nagserbe si Fauci, 81, bilang NIAID director halin sang 1984.
english: Fauci, 81, has served as NIAID director since 1984.

text: Sang 2020, siya ang nangin nawong sang Covid-19 response sang US government.
english: In 2020, he became the face of the US government’s Covid-19 response.

text: Nag-serbe si Fauci sa pito ka US presidents halin pa sa termino ni Ronald Reagan.
english: Fauci has served seven US presidents since Ronald Reagan's term.

text: Nagserbe man siya sang tion nga may emerging kag re-emerging infectious disease threats kaangay sang HIV/AIDS, Ebola, kag Zika.
english: He also served during a time when there were emerging and re-emerging infectious disease threats such as HIV/AIDS, Ebola, and Zika.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag nga maga-retiro ang nasambit nga infectious disease expert sa katapusan sang first term ni Biden, apang ginapanan-aw subong nga mas temprano ang iya pagbiya sa pwesto.
english: It was previously announced that the infectious disease expert would retire at the end of Biden's first term, but it is now expected that he will leave office earlier.

text: Magapanaog man si Fauci bilang chief sang NIAID Laboratory of Immunoregulation
english: Fauci will also step down as chief of the NIAID Laboratory of Immunoregulation

text: 21 ang kumpirmado nga patay sa 30 ka oras nga hostage-taking nga ginpatigayon sang armado nga mga suspek sa isa ka hotel sa Somalia.
english: 21 were confirmed dead in a 30-hour hostage-taking conducted by armed suspects at a hotel in Somalia.

text: Suno sa Somali security forces, yara naman sa 106 ka mga tawo ang natigayon nga ma-rescue.
english: According to Somali security forces, 106 people were rescued.

text: Gin-ako naman sang Islamist militant group nga al-Shabab nga sila ang responsable sa amo nga pagpang-atake.
english: The Islamist militant group al-Shabab claimed responsibility for the attack.

text: Affiliate sang al-Qaeda ang al-Shabab kag madugay na nga nagapamatok sa federal government.
english: al-Shabab is an affiliate of al-Qaeda and has long opposed the federal government.

text: Suno sa pulis, nag-gamit ang mga suspek sang duha ka car bomb kag explosives agud makasulod sa Hayat Hotel sa Mogadishu.
english: According to police, the suspects used two car bombs and explosives to enter the Hayat Hotel in Mogadishu.

text: Ginakahangaw-an man nga magtaas pa ang numero sang mga patay bangud posible nga nahakot na sang mga pamilya ang bangkay sang ila mga himata antes pa man ginsuguran ang official count sa mga biktima.
english: The death toll is also feared to rise as families may have picked up the bodies of their relatives before the official count of the victims began.

text: 117 man ka tawo ang injured kag 15 ang yara sa critical condition.
english: 117 people were also injured and 15 are in critical condition.

text: Tuman man ka dako ang halit sa hotel bangud sa away nga natabo sa tunga sang militante kag sang pwersa sang gobyerno.
english: The hotel was also badly damaged due to the fighting between the militants and the government forces.

text: Ini ang una nga pagpang-atake sang al-Shabab halin sang nagpungko sa pwesto sang Mayo ang bag-o nga presidente sang Somalia nga si Hassan Sheikh Mohamud.
english: It was al-Shabab’s first attack since Somalia’s new president Hassan Sheikh Mohamud took office in May.

text: Nagtipon ang bantog nga mga artista kag ang mga abyan sang movie icon nga si Nora Aunor kadungan sang una nga gab-i sang iya haya sa Heritage Park sa Taguig.
english: Famous actors and friends of movie icon Nora Aunor gathered for the first night of her marriage at Heritage Park in Taguig.

text: Lakip sa yara sa misa nga ginpatigayon alas otso kagab-i amo sanday Jericho Rosales, Janine Gutierrez, singer nga si Imelda Papin, Ricky Lee, Nadia Montenegro, Coco Martin kag Julia Montes, kag iban pa nga dalagku nga pangalan sa showbiz industry.
english: Among those present at the mass held at 8 pm were Jericho Rosales, Janine Gutierrez, singer Imelda Papin, Ricky Lee, Nadia Montenegro, Coco Martin and Julia Montes, and other big names in the showbiz industry.

text: Ginbutang man ang Philippine flag sa lungon sang aktres bilang parte sang pag-abi-abi kag pagdayaw sa iya bilang National Artist.
english: The Philippine flag was also placed on the coffin of the actress as part of the welcome and praise for her as a National Artist.

text:
Naghatag man ang myembro sang Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) sang military salute sa Philippine cinema “superstar.:

Bukas sa publiko ang haya sang film icon sa Abril 19 kag 20 kag naka-schedule naman ang state funeral sa Abril 22, Martes.
english:
The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) member also gave a military salute to the Philippine cinema “superstar.:

The film icon's funeral will be open to the public on April 19 and 20 and the state funeral is scheduled for April 22, Tuesday.

text: Ilubong ang 71-anyos nga beterana nga singer-actress sa Libingan ng mga Bayani bilang testamento sa iya legasiya bilang national treasure.
english: The 71-year-old veteran singer-actress will be buried in the Libingan ng mga Bayani as a testament to her legacy as a national treasure.

text: Ginbun-ag si “Ate Guy” bilang si Nora Cabaltera Villamayor sa Iriga City, Camarines Sur, kag nahingadlan nga National Artist for Film and Broadcast Arts sang 2022.
english: “Ate Guy” was born Nora Cabaltera Villamayor in Iriga City, Camarines Sur, and was named National Artist for Film and Broadcast Arts in 2022.

text: Pinaka-kilala siya sa iya iconic roles sa mga pelikula nga “Himala,” “Bona,”, “Minsa’y Isang Gamu-gamo”, “Bulaklak sa City Jail”, “The Flor Contemplacion Story”, “Tatlong Taong Walang Diyos”, kag iban pa.
english: He is best known for his iconic roles in the films “Himala,” “Bona,” “Minsa’y Isang Gamu-gamo”, “Bulaklak sa City Jail”, “The Flor Contemplation Story”, “Three People Without God”, and others.

text: Lakip naman sa iya katapusan nga nangin proyekto amo ang “Mananambal” kag “Pieta”.
english: His latest projects include “Mananambal” and “Pieta”.

text:
Magluwas sa pag-arte, kilala man siya sa pagkanta kag lakip sa iya bantog nga mga ambahanon amo ang “Pearly Shells” kag “Tiny Bubbles.”

Ginkasal siya anay sa aktor nga si Christopher de Leon sang 1975, apang sang ulihi nag-separar kag gin-annul ang kasal sang 1996.
english:
Apart from acting, she is also known for singing and among her famous songs are “Pearly Shells” and “Tiny Bubbles.”

She was previously married to actor Christopher de Leon in 1975, but later separated and annulled the marriage in 1996.

text: May yara sila sang biological child nga si Ian kag adopted children nga sanday Lotlot, Matet, Kiko, kag Kenneth.
english: They have a biological child named Ian and adopted children named Lotlot, Matet, Kiko, and Kenneth.
